label: Talk to Sylas near the Taverley POH portal to start
detail: Sylas the collector explains he wants a griffin feather and a dwarf's helmet for his magic beans.

label: Travel to the north-east side of White Wolf Mountain
detail: Follow the marked path up White Wolf Mountain to reach Grimgnash's nest.

label: Talk to Grimgnash the griffin and tell an escalating bedtime story
detail: Route the dialogue tree to tell an increasingly violent bedtime story about a skeleton named Skullrot instead of fighting the griffin.

hints.value: 1I heard you were a great and mighty Griffin!
1There once was a graveyard filled with undead.
2There lived a skeleton named Skullrot.
4Skullrot was insane!
4Skullrot hungrily grabbed the gnome's hair.
3Started to strangle the poor gnome.
1He saw a hole he could just fit through.

label: Take a feather from beside Grimgnash's nest
detail: Steal a feather from next to the griffin's nest while he is distracted by the story.

label: Return the griffin feather to Sylas
detail: Hand the feather to Sylas so he can start work on the second item.

hints.value: 3I should be off, I think.

label: Travel to the stone tower south of the Mind Altar
detail: The tower sits between Goblin Village and Ice Mountain, imprisoning the dwarf Rupert.

label: Climb the tower's crumbling east wall
detail: Scale the crumbling section on the tower's east side to get inside.

label: Talk into the drain pipe twice to signal Rupert
detail: Speak into the drain pipe, then talk into it again to route the dialogue about climbing up.

hints.value: 2I think I might have an idea!
2I could try and climb up.
2Is there anything up there that can help?

label: Climb Rupert's lowered beard and talk to him
detail: Climb up the beard he lowers down and speak to Rupert the Beard.

label: Climb down and talk to Miazrqa behind the tower
detail: Miazrqa, Rupert's second cousin, will only free him if her pendant is recovered first.

hints.value: 2I see there is an embarrassed-looking dwarf...
4Your second-cousin, twice removed?
4I need a key for the house.
4I should be off, I think.

label: Enter the basement of the Witch's House
detail: The house is next to the Taverley POH portal; a door key and (optionally) leather gloves for an electrified gate are useful here.

label: Play the correct notes on the basement piano
detail: Play E-F-E-D-C on the upper (right) side, then A-E-G-A on the lower (left) side of the piano.

label: Search the piano for the shrunk ogleroot
detail: Searching the piano after playing the tune reveals a shrunk ogleroot.

label: Brew a shrinking potion from the shrunk ogleroot
detail: Add the shrunk ogleroot to unfinished tarromin potions to make shrinking potions.

label: Drink a shrinking potion by the mouse hole
detail: Go through the south door on the ground floor and drink a shrinking potion beside the mouse hole to shrink down.

label: Climb the nail ladders through the mouse-sized area
detail: Climb the wall nails in sequence (north-east, south-west, south, down to north-east, north-east) while avoiding level-95 mice that hit up to 9 damage.

label: Take the pendant
detail: Pick up Miazrqa's pendant once the nail-ladder area is cleared.

label: Travel back to the stone tower
detail: Head back to the tower with the recovered pendant.

label: Give the pendant to Miazrqa
detail: Hand over the pendant so Miazrqa frees Rupert.

label: Talk to Rupert to receive his helmet
detail: Rupert, now freed, hands over his helmet. Optional extra dialogue with Miazrqa and Rupert is available for flavour.

label: Give Rupert's helmet to Sylas
detail: Hand the helmet over so Sylas can grow the magic beans.

label: Plant and water the magic beans
detail: Plant then water the beans in the plot south-west of the Taverley tree patch; this creates a private instanced area with the beanstalk.

label: Climb the fast-growing beanstalk
detail: Climb the beanstalk; followers and pets cannot come along, even carried in the inventory.

label: Defeat Glod
detail: Glod is a level 118-138 cloud giant weak to Magic that quakes to drain Prayer and heals itself; looting includes a golden goblin.

label: Talk to Sylas after the battle
detail: Report back to Sylas once Glod is defeated.

label: Shrink and chop down the beanstalk
detail: Use the spare shrinking potion on the beanstalk (do not drink it), then chop it down.

label: Talk to Sylas to finish the quest
detail: Report to Sylas a final time to complete Grim Tales.

label: Travel to the Dwarven Ferryman
detail: Reach the ferryman via the tunnel and cave just south of the Polar Hunter area (fairy ring code DKS), or via the Dwarven Boatman's Travel option from northern Keldagrim.

label: Pay or travel across the river with the Dwarven Ferryman
detail: Use a Ring of charos (a) to charm a free crossing, or pay coins/use the Travel option instead.

hints.value: 3(Charm) I don't have any money on me.

label: Talk to Dondakan
detail: Cross the bridges north then east past the second wooden bridge to find Dondakan firing a cannon at a rock wall.

hints.value: 2Why are you firing a cannon at a wall?
1So why were you trying to get through the rock again?
1Sounds interesting!

label: Travel to western Keldagrim
detail: Head to the Trading Consortium's palace smithing shop in western Keldagrim; the Dwarven Boatman gives a quick shortcut there and back.

label: Talk to the Dwarf Engineer
detail: Speak to the Dwarf Engineer in the Trading Consortium's palace smithing shop.

label: Travel to the Dwarven Mine's Ice Mountain entrance
detail: Head to the Ice Mountain side entrance of the Dwarven Mine.

label: Talk to Rolad
detail: Rolad is in the east house at the mine entrance; the conversation disengages once then re-engages.

label: Optionally buy an Ammo mould from Nulodion
detail: Nulodion sells the Ammo mould needed later to cast the golden cannon ball, useful if one was not kept from Dwarf Cannon.

label: Go down the trapdoor into the Dwarven Mine
detail: Descend into the mine proper to start collecting lore-book pages.

label: Kill scorpions for Book page 1
detail: Fight scorpions in the Dwarven Mine until Book page 1 drops.

label: Search mine carts for Book page 2
detail: Search the mine carts scattered through the Dwarven Mine until Book page 2 turns up.

label: Mine any non-Adamantite/Coal rock for Book page 3
detail: Mine any rock in the Dwarven Mine except Adamantite or Coal until Book page 3 appears.

label: Return to Rolad
detail: Report back to Rolad; lie about how it went. Dialogue disengages then re-engages again.

hints.value: 2Of course. (lie)

label: Read the Dwarven lore book
detail: Read the Dwarven lore book cover to cover and keep it; it is needed again later for the base schematics.

label: Return to Dondakan at the Keldagrim mines
detail: Head back to the Keldagrim mines to talk to Dondakan.

label: Use a gold bar on Dondakan
detail: Hand Dondakan a gold bar to set up the golden cannonball plan.

label: Travel to a furnace
detail: Any furnace works; Edgeville is recommended for easy fairy-ring or Keldagrim-minecart access.

label: Smelt the golden cannon ball
detail: Use a gold bar on the furnace, with an Ammo mould held, to cast a golden cannon ball.

label: Fire the golden cannon ball at Dondakan's rock
detail: Use the golden cannon ball on Dondakan to receive a Schematic.

hints.value: 1Yes, I'm sure this will crack open the rock.
1So you want to... fire me into the rock?
2I can't argue with that, shoot me in!

label: Read the Dwarven lore book again
detail: Re-read the Dwarven lore book to receive the base schematics.

hints.value: 1Yes

label: Collect the Engineer's schematics
detail: Return to the Dwarf Engineer at the Western Trade Consortium for their schematics.

label: Smith the gold helmet
detail: Use a gold bar on the nearby anvil to make a gold helmet; smithing it in the Wilderness Resource Area also completes a Wilderness Diary Medium task.

label: Travel to the pub in the White Wolf Mountain passage
detail: Head to the pub inside the White Wolf Mountain passage tunnel.

label: Talk to Khorvak
detail: Speak to Khorvak at the pub about the schematics.

hints.value: 1No, I've had enough of buying drinks for people!

label: Assemble the completed Schematic
detail: Combine the Dondakan Schematic, the Dwarf Engineer's Schematics, and the Base schematics per the in-game diagram.

label: Equip the gold helmet and best pickaxe
detail: Gear up with the gold helmet and your best wieldable pickaxe before entering the arena.

label: Start the final battle with Dondakan
detail: Talk to Dondakan with the completed Schematic to begin; an 8-minute timer starts and removing the gold helmet mid-fight aborts the attempt, teleporting you out.

hints.value: 1You may fire when ready!

label: Mine gold ore inside the arena
detail: Mine 6 or 15 gold ore and keep it in the inventory; getting 15 lowers the Arzinian Avatar from level 125 to 75, recommended for lower-level players.

label: Pass through the first set of flames
detail: Walk to the centre of the area and go through the first set of flames.

label: Talk to the second set of flames
detail: Interact with the second set of flames to trigger the boss encounter.

label: Defeat the Arzinian Avatar
detail: The avatar variant is chosen by your highest combat stat: Magic avatar if melee is highest, Ranged avatar if Magic is highest, Strength avatar if Ranged is highest -- gear and pray accordingly.

label: Talk to Dondakan to finish
detail: Report to Dondakan a final time to complete Between a Rock...

label: Talk to the monk outside Paterdomus Temple
detail: Speak with the monk stationed outside Paterdomus Temple, east of Varrock, and agree to help him.

hints.value: Sure thing, what do you need?
Fairy ring code CKS lands nearby; run west and climb the shortcut to reach the temple quickly.

label: Travel to Doric's house north of Falador
detail: Head to Doric's house, north of Falador, to forge the strange weapon.

label: Grind the mithril 2h sword into a slender blade
detail: Use the mithril 2h sword on Doric's Whetstone to grind it down into a slender blade.

label: Attach the bow string to the slender blade
detail: Attach a bow string to the slender blade to complete the bow-sword.

label: Hand the bow-sword to the monk
detail: Return to the monk with the finished bow-sword; he trades an orb for it.

hints.value: Yep, got it right here for you.

label: Load the orb into the large pouch
detail: Put the orb the monk gave you inside a large pouch so it can be carried through the Abyss.

hints.value: Ultimate Ironmen lose the pouch on death while the orb is inside it; load the orb only after banking for the Entrana trip.

label: Swap to Abyss supplies
detail: Bank your weapons and armour, then withdraw food and prayer supplies to survive the Abyss's monsters.

label: Cross the Wilderness Abyss to the Law Altar
detail: Navigate the Wilderness Abyss to reach the Law Altar rift and pass through it.

label: Head to the church on Entrana
detail: Exit the altar portal and walk to the church on Entrana.

label: Use the pouch on the church altar
detail: Use the pouch holding the orb on the Entrana church altar and watch the swap cutscene play out.

label: Talk to the High Priest
detail: Speak with the High Priest of Entrana after the cutscene.

label: Return to Paterdomus
detail: Travel back to Paterdomus Temple.

label: Talk to the monk again
detail: Speak to the monk back at Paterdomus.

label: Search the dead monk
detail: Search the body of the dead monk at Paterdomus for the item that reveals what really happened during the swap.

hints.value: Wiki text does not name the item found; treat as an unnamed story item until confirmed.

label: Return to Entrana
detail: Travel back to Entrana.

label: Report back to the High Priest
detail: Speak with the High Priest of Entrana a second time.

hints.value: The Rat Pits minigame teleport (requires Ratcatchers) or the Pest Control minigame teleport both land close to Port Sarim as a shortcut.

label: Head to Falador Park
detail: Travel to Falador Park.

label: Report to Sir Tiffy Cashien
detail: Speak with Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park to finish the quest.

hints.value: Devious Minds.

label: Apply to Achietties
detail: Talk to Achietties outside the Heroes' Guild in Burthorpe to begin gathering the three proof items.

hints.value: I'm a hero, may I apply to join? / I'll start looking for all those things then.

label: Ask Gerrant about lava eels
detail: Talk to Gerrant, the fishing shop owner in Port Sarim, about catching a lava eel.

hints.value: I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.

label: Make blamish oil
detail: Use the blamish snail slime on an unfinished harralander potion to create blamish oil.

label: Oil the fishing rod
detail: Use the blamish oil on a fishing rod so it can catch a lava eel.

label: Travel to Taverley Dungeon
detail: Head to Taverley Dungeon to reach the lava eel pool near the blue dragons.

hints.value: Alternatives: skip the key with 70 Agility for the shortcut, or use the level-60-Sailing (non-boostable) Charred Dungeon route; the Wilderness Lava Maze route is discouraged.

label: Kill the Jailer for his key
detail: Kill the Jailer standing by the prison to obtain the key to Velrak's cell.

label: Unlock Velrak's cell
detail: Use the Jailer's key on Velrak's cell door.

label: Get the dusty key from Velrak
detail: Talk to Velrak the explorer, in the southern part of the dungeon, for the dusty key. Do not ask for a reward.

hints.value: So do you know any good places to explore? / Yes please!
Skip this and the Jailer/key steps entirely if you already hold a dusty key (a steel key ring with dusty key works) or have 70 Agility for the shortcut.

label: Open the door to the blue dragons
detail: Use the dusty key on the locked door guarding the blue dragon area, or take the agility shortcut instead.

label: Catch a lava eel
detail: Run to the southernmost lava pool and fish a lava eel; only one is needed since they cannot be burned, though catching a spare is safe.

label: Cook the lava eel
detail: Cook the lava eel on a range or fire.

label: Volunteer for master-thief rank
detail: Talk to Katrine in the Black Arm gang headquarters, south-west Varrock, about earning master thief rank.

hints.value: Is there any way I can get the rank of master thief?

This whole checkpoint needs a genuine second player from the opposite gang (Phoenix Gang if you're Black Arm, or vice versa); the quest cannot be soloed. Steps below follow the Black Arm partner's track.

label: Travel to Brimhaven
detail: Head to Brimhaven, the building directly south of the agility arena entrance.

label: Volunteer to Trobert
detail: Give the gang password to enter, then talk to Trobert about stealing Scarface Pete's candlesticks.

hints.value: Gang password: Four leaved clover.
So can you help me get Scarface Pete's candlesticks? / I volunteer to undertake that mission!

label: Equip Black armour
detail: Equip your Black armour before entering the mansion.

label: Get the Miscellaneous key from Grip
detail: Enter the mansion in the north-west of town and talk to Grip for a Miscellaneous key.

hints.value: So what do my duties involve? / Anything I can do now?

If a Miscellaneous key already sits in your bank, Grip will not hand out a second one. Hand this key to your Phoenix-gang partner, who uses it to reach Grip's mansion room via the food shop's gherkin password and secret wall panel.
Already completed the quest and just helping a friend? Skip straight to talking to Grip for the key; Black armour is not required in that case.

label: Search the cupboard to lure Grip
detail: Enter the room north of the entrance and search the cupboard so Grip comes to investigate, then close the door behind him to trap him.

hints.value: He won't notice me having a quick look.
Your partner then kills the trapped Grip with Ranged or Magic from outside; wait for them to finish.

label: Take Grip's key and the candlesticks
detail: Take Grip's key from his remains, use it on the north-west door, and take 2 candlesticks from the chest inside.

label: Turn in a candlestick for the armband
detail: Give one candlestick to your partner and keep the other, then bring your candlestick back to Katrine for the Thieves' armband.

hints.value: I have a candlestick now.

label: Defeat the Ice Queen for her gloves
detail: Fight through White Wolf Mountain's northern tunnels (mine the rockslide, then the ladder/tunnel maze) and kill the level-111 Ice Queen for her gloves.

hints.value: Skip this whole step if you already own ice gloves. Bring combat gear/food and a Mining-boost item if you need to reach 50 Mining.

label: Equip the ice gloves
detail: Equip the ice gloves.

label: Travel to Entrana
detail: Travel to Entrana.

label: Kill the Firebird for its feather
detail: Kill the Firebird near the Law Altar on Entrana and take the fire feather.

label: Deliver all three proofs
detail: Hand the cooked eel, thieves' armband, and fire feather to Achietties to complete the quest.

label: Talk to Grubfoot
detail: Talk to Grubfoot in the Dorgeshuun Mines, right outside the main entrance to Dorgesh-Kaan.

hints.value: Yes
Bring a light source; no pets may be following you.

label: Hear Zanik's dream
detail: Head north-west into Oldak's laboratory and talk to Zanik about her new dream.

hints.value: So why have you come to talk to Zanik? / What was this new dream? / (any) / I'm ready.

label: Let Zanik pass the temple guards
detail: Head north-west to the temple entrance stairs and talk to the two goblin guards blocking it so Zanik can pass.

label: Pick a black mushroom
detail: Pick a black mushroom near the entrance if you don't already have black dye.

hints.value: Skip if you already hold black dye.

label: Travel to the Makeover Mage
detail: Travel to the Makeover Mage south-west of Falador (skills necklace to the Crafting Guild, or a Falador teleport).

label: Get transformed into a goblin
detail: Ask the Makeover Mage to turn you into a goblin.

hints.value: Can you turn me into a goblin? / I need to slip past some goblin guards. / Can you turn me into a goblin or not?

label: Pick pharmakos berries
detail: Pick berries from the pharmakos bush outside the Makeover Mage's building.

label: Brew the goblin potion
detail: Use the pharmakos berries on an unfinished toadflax potion to create a goblin potion.

label: Return to the Goblin Cave
detail: Return to the Goblin Cave near the Fishing Guild, most easily via a skills necklace.

label: Drink the goblin potion
detail: Drink the goblin potion in front of the goblin guards, picking any goblin appearance.

label: Prepare black dye
detail: Use a pestle and mortar on a black mushroom with an empty vial in your inventory to make black dye, if you don't already have it.

label: Climb down into the temple
detail: Climb down the cave entrance to enter the Goblin Temple.

hints.value: Me want get into temple. / Yes, me [goblin name].

label: Dye the goblin mail black
detail: Use black dye on your goblin mail and wear it.

hints.value: If you don't already own a goblin mail, search the crates in the main temple room for a free one.

label: Equip the black goblin mail
detail: Wear the black-dyed goblin mail.

label: Search the crate for the sphere
detail: Enter the north-eastern room and search the crate inside for a Dorgesh-kaan sphere.

label: Free Zanik from her cell
detail: Talk to Zanik in the prison cell while carrying the Dorgesh-kaan sphere to free her.

label: Pass High Priest Bighead's quiz
detail: Head back to the main room, talk to High Priest Bighead in the north, and answer his goblin-lore test correctly.

hints.value: I understand Big High War God. / True. / Big High War God commands it. / False. / Goblins not mighty warriors before he chose us. / False. / That one of the commandments. / Lead goblins to victory over whole world. / Me want to know about Yu'biusk. / Where is Yu'biusk? / Can I talk to old high priests?

label: Pickpocket the northern priest
detail: Re-enter the north-eastern room, where the goblins now wear black goblin-mail, and pickpocket the priest for his Huzamogaarb key.

label: Travel to Draynor Village
detail: Leave the cave (equip a piece of gear to be thrown out, then teleport) and head to Draynor Village.

label: Ask Aggie to prepare dyes
detail: Ask Aggie in Draynor Village to prepare the black, yellow, purple, orange, and blue dyes you'll need for the remaining priests.

hints.value: Can you make dyes for me please? / Can you make black or white dye?

label: Get a raw slimy eel
detail: Acquire a raw slimy eel before heading to the Fishing Contest area.

label: Travel to Hemenster
detail: Head to the Fishing Contest area in Hemenster with a fishing rod and the slimy eel.

label: Get access to the whitefish spot
detail: Click the gate to the Fishing Contest area.

hints.value: I need to catch a Hemenster Whitefish.

label: Catch a Hemenster whitefish
detail: Catch a Hemenster whitefish.

label: Trade the whitefish for white goblin mail
detail: Return to Aggie, trade the whitefish for a white goblin mail, and collect the prepared dyes.

hints.value: Can you make dyes for me please? / Could you remove the dye from this goblin mail?
Do not teleport out of the temple later with a full inventory, or you will lose your goblin mail.

label: Return to the Goblin Temple wearing the white mail
detail: Head back into the Goblin Temple wearing the white goblin mail.

label: Steal the western priest's key
detail: Steal the Saragorgak key from the priest in the western room of the temple, then remove the mail to leave the room quicker.

label: Steal the remaining four coloured keys
detail: Repeat the dye-and-pickpocket cycle for each remaining priest, in order: yellow (north-west), purple (south-west), orange (south-east), blue (east).

label: Unlock the crypt
detail: Use all six coloured keys to unlock the crypt door before leaving; this also grants extra inventory space.

label: Enter the crypt
detail: Enter the crypt through the large door north of the temple.

hints.value: Prepare combat gear before entering; four ancestor bosses plus Strongbones wait inside.

label: Defeat and question Snothead
detail: Use "Say-name" on the south-west grave to fight Snothead, then talk to her once defeated.

hints.value: What was your predecessor's name?

label: Defeat and question Snailfeet
detail: Use "Say-name" on the south-east grave to fight Snailfeet, then talk to him once defeated.

hints.value: What was your predecessor's name?

label: Defeat and question Mosschin
detail: Use "Say-name" on the north-west grave to fight Mosschin, then talk to her once defeated.

hints.value: What was your predecessor's name?

label: Defeat and question Redeyes
detail: Use "Say-name" on the north-east grave to fight Redeyes, then talk to him once defeated.

hints.value: What was your predecessor's name?

label: Defeat Strongbones and learn Yu'biusk's location
detail: Use "Say-name" on the northern grave to fight the level-184 Strongbones, ignoring her summoned skoblins and praying Protect from Magic, then ask her where Yu'biusk is.

hints.value: Where is Yu'biusk?
Make sure to ask Strongbones about Yu'biusk before leaving the crypt.

label: Report back to Zanik
detail: Return to Dorgesh-Kaan and talk to Zanik in Oldak's laboratory.

label: Head to Oldak in the South Dungeon
detail: With a light source, travel to Oldak in the South Dungeon beneath Dorgesh-Kaan's agility course.

hints.value: Three routes: fairy ring code AJQ; a Dorgesh-kaan sphere down through the agility course; or simply run south to the agility course and take the ladder down, then east through the dungeon.

label: Talk to Oldak
detail: Speak with Oldak.

label: Activate Oldak's machine
detail: Use combination 9-4-1 on the machines next to Oldak to activate them.

label: Open the strange box
detail: Open the strange box in the north-western part of Yu'biusk to trigger the finishing cutscene and complete the quest.

label: Travel to the Troll Stronghold kitchen
detail: Enter via the secret kitchen door after freeing the prisoners, a slayer ring mountain entrance, or a Trollheim teleport heading west; climbing boots or 12 coins may be needed for the route.

label: Talk to Burntmeat to accept the quest
detail: Speak to Burntmeat in the kitchen and agree to help My Arm.

hints.value: 1 What do you want now? -> 2 Alright, I'll lend him a hand.

label: Talk to My Arm to begin the adventure
detail: My Arm stands east of Burntmeat; talking to him starts the goutweed errand.

label: Teleport to Death Plateau
detail: Use a games necklace or minigame teleport to Burthorpe, then reach the Death Plateau; thrower trolls attack along the way and on the plateau, so protect from ranged.

label: Use a bucket on the cooking pot for the goutweedy lump
detail: With one free inventory slot, use an empty bucket on the cooking pot at the plateau's centre; a spare bucket spawns south of the pot if you forgot one.

label: Return to the Troll Stronghold
detail: Carry the goutweedy lump back to the Stronghold.

label: Talk to My Arm after returning with the goutweedy lump
Talk to My Arm after he leads you to a new area
detail: Follow My Arm to the new area then talk to him again; he hands you a book.

label: Talk to My Arm after reading his book
detail: Read the book he gave you, then talk to him again to proceed.

label: Prepare the soil patch with dung and supercompost
detail: Use three buckets of Ugthanki dung then seven buckets of supercompost on the soil patch, in that order.

label: Talk to My Arm after preparing the patch
Talk to Captain Barnaby to sail to Karamja

hints.value: 1 This is My Arm. We'd like to go to Karamja.

label: Talk to My Arm at Tai Bwo Wannai
detail: Meet him east of the general store.

label: Talk to Murcaily near the hardwood grove for tubers
detail: Requires at least 60% Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup favour and one free inventory slot; if he can't be found, log out and back in; raise favour to 60% first if it's below that.

hints.value: 1 A troll called My Arm wants a favour...

label: Talk to My Arm to sail back to Ardougne
detail: After the cutscene, speak to My Arm; the boat returns you to Ardougne where the bank is accessible.

label: Return to the Troll Stronghold roof
detail: Take the ladder in the west room on the upper level, past the Troll Generals, up to the roof; get a spade from the Tool Leprechaun if needed.

label: Talk to My Arm on the roof
Give My Arm the rake
detail: If My Arm breaks the rake, pick up the pieces, reassemble it, and give it back to him.

label: Give My Arm supercompost or ultracompost (optional)
detail: Optional: without ultracompost/supercompost the patch may become diseased and need curing; regular compost has no effect.

hints.value: optional

label: Give My Arm the hardy gout tubers
detail: Quantity needed is not stated numerically on the quick guide.

label: Give My Arm the seed dibber
Give My Arm a plant cure if the patch is diseased
detail: Conditional: only needed if skipping ultracompost/supercompost let the patch become diseased.

label: Talk to My Arm to start the boss fight
detail: This triggers the instanced fight against the Baby Roc and Giant Roc guarding the crop; bring food.

label: Defeat the level 75 Baby Roc and level 172 Giant Roc
detail: The Giant Roc's regular attacks can be dodged by moving between tiles, but its stun attack cannot be dodged.

label: Talk to My Arm after the fight
Give My Arm a spade
detail: If you don't have one, go back down and up the ladder to make the Tool Leprechaun reappear.

label: Return to Burntmeat in the kitchen
Talk to My Arm on the roof to complete the quest
Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien for the Commorb v2
detail: Speak to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park to receive a Commorb v2; Savant will contact you through it multiple times to scan surroundings or give hints.

hints.value: 1 Do you have any jobs for me yet?

label: Talk to Col. O'Niall on the Witchaven dock

hints.value: 1 What's the mission? -> 3 Who are the important people in Witchaven?

label: Talk to Brother Maledict in the church
Talk to Mayor Hobb and scan with the Commorb
detail: Mayor Hobb is in the most north-west building; after Savant prompts you, scan with the Commorb v2.

hints.value: 1 I'm here to relax.

label: Talk to Holgart by the Fishing Platform boat
detail: Holgart wears a green shirt, north-east of the quest icon.

label: Talk to Col. O'Niall again to report
Descend the Old Ruin Entrance west of Witchaven
Push the false wall east of the entrance
detail: The false wall on the east wall by the entrance is shown red on the minimap.

label: Follow the path to the imposing door
detail: Use the shortcut if able, then try to open the door.

label: Scan the imposing door with the Commorb for the transcription
detail: Requires one free inventory space to receive the torn transcription.

label: Pick up a dead sea slug west of the imposing door
detail: Required before Jorral will talk to you.

label: Talk to Jorral at the outpost north-west of Ardougne
detail: Necklace of passage is a recommended item for fast travel here.

hints.value: 2 Translations (only if Making History has not been started)

label: Talk to Col. O'Niall
Talk to Brother Maledict
Search the mayor's study desk for a page fragment

detail: Requires three free inventory spaces.

detail: Air Altar south of Falador, Mind Altar north of Falador (just below the Wilderness), Water Altar south of Lumbridge next to the Zanaris shack, Earth Altar north-east of Varrock (balloon transport if unlocked), Fire Altar west of the Emir's Arena in Al Kharid (ring of dueling); bring spare essence in case of failure.

label: Use the handmade runes on the imposing door
detail: Bring the Commorb along; this opens the door beneath Witchaven.

label: Kill the level 62 Slug Prince
detail: Only melee damages it and it drains Prayer points; it can be safespotted with a halberd.

label: Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien to complete the quest

hints.value: 1 Slug Menace.

label: Travel to the Troll Stronghold via fairy ring or Trollheim
detail: Use fairy ring code AJR, a slayer ring, or a Trollheim teleport to reach the Secret Door north-east of the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon; climbing boots help with a shortcut on this route.

label: Talk to Ug in the south-west corner of the Stronghold

hints.value: 1 Aww, you poor troll. What seems to be the problem? -> 3 Don't worry now, I'll see what I can do.

label: Talk to Aga in the room to the north

hints.value: 2 So... how's your... um... love life? -> 1 Errr... I've got to go.

label: Talk to Ug again
Talk to Tenzing west of the Warriors' Guild

hints.value: 4 Do you know where I can find Trollweiss? -> 2 What would I need to make such a sled?

label: Use swamp tar on the bucket of wax to make Wax
Use the Wax on the sled
Run north-west from the Trollheim teleport to the cave

label: Exit through the crevasse
Equip the sled and slide down the slope
detail: Go south then click to slide down.

detail: Walk west after the first sled-ride cutscene; do not trigger the next cutscene before collecting the flowers.

Talk to Ug about your Trollweiss flowers
Talk to Arrg to start the fight

detail: Arrg can despawn if not killed fast enough via a safe-spot, which makes this difficult on a low-level account.

label: Return to the Troll Stronghold after the fight
Talk to Ug to complete the quest
Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park

hints.value: 1 Ask about the Wanted! Quest

Follow the dungeon north, east, then south to the Black Knights' Base
Talk to Lord Daquarius in the south-western room
Kill a level 33 Black Knight

label: Talk to Lord Daquarius again
Talk to the Mage of Zamorak at the Chaos Altar in Varrock

hints.value: 1 Solus Dellagar (or 2 if Temple of the Eye is completed)

hints.value: 1 Solus Dellagar

label: Head to Canifis for Savant's call
detail: Fairy ring code CKS reaches Canifis quickly.

label: Scan with the Commorb near the Canifis bank to unveil Solus
Scan repeatedly to track Solus through each clue location
detail: Savant names a random item at each stop; travel to the matching location from the clue table and scan again until the 20 noted pure essence is obtained. Roughly 7 of about 20 possible locations are visited, in a randomized set/order per playthrough; the 4th scan triggers a non-lethal Flames of Zamorak hit and the 6th spawns a level 32 Black Knight that does not need to be killed.

label: Head to the rune essence mine via a teleporting mage
Kill Solus Dellagar
detail: Instanced fight in the rune essence mine; bring combat equipment.

Talk to Sir Amik Varze to complete the quest
Talk to Unferth in his house in northern Burthorpe

detail: Use shears on Unferth repeatedly; the animation continues until he goes bald.

detail: Discuss A Tail of Two Cats with the Apothecary.

detail: Unequip any weapons, then equip the doctor's hat or nurse hat plus white top and bottom (desert clothing top/bottom works, desert legs do not) before approaching Unferth.

label: Talk to Unferth with a vial of water
detail: Speak to Unferth while carrying a vial of water and wearing the white outfit.

detail: Report to Unferth once more to finish the quest.

detail: Bring the ghostspeak amulet and ecto-tokens (or materials to make them: 4 empty pots, 4 empty buckets, 4 bones).

detail: Speak to Alice at the chicken farm.

detail: Hand the crone-made amulet to Malcolm.

detail: A cutscene plays after this conversation.

detail: Malcolm now sells undead chickens for ecto-tokens.

2Could I buy two chickens?

detail: Return to the west wing of Draynor Manor with 5 iron bars, a hammer and the two undead chickens.

hints.value: Wiki text does not pin the exact moment iron bars/chickens are consumed beyond 'bring these to Ava'; modeled as consumed on hand-off here rather than guessing a later atom.

detail: The Witch is in the north-west corner room of the manor.

detail: Receive a piece of selected iron from the Witch.

detail: Stand in the marked forging spot facing north before using the hammer.

mapMarkers.label: Rimmington mine forging spot, face north

detail: Use the hammer on the selected iron while facing north in Rimmington mine.

detail: Return the forged magnet to Ava.

label: Talk to Ava to start the twigs segment
detail: Speak to Ava before cutting the undead tree.

detail: Use the mithril axe on the Undead tree (not the Dead tree) in front of the manor; yellow-examine confirms the right tree.

hints.value: First cut with only the mithril axe does not yield twigs; the wiki does not spell out why beyond needing the Blessed axe for the second cut.

label: Teleport to Burthorpe
detail: Use a games necklace to reach Burthorpe.

detail: Turael the Slayer master is in a house in south-eastern Burthorpe.

hints.value: 4I'm here about a quest.

detail: Turael gives a Blessed axe provided you carry a mithril axe and a holy symbol.

detail: Use the Blessed axe on the undead tree to obtain undead twigs.

detail: Hand the undead twigs to Ava.

detail: Ava hands over garbled research notes that need to be solved.

detail: Turn off every green orb except the 2nd, 5th and 9th counted left to right to solve the notes.

label: Talk to Ava after solving the notes
detail: Report the solved notes to Ava.

detail: Combine the solved notes with the polished button and the hard leather.

hints.value: Wiki text never names the finished item beyond 'the container'; own-words placeholder slug used rather than a guessed proper name.

label: Give Ava the finished container
detail: Hand the container to Ava to finish the quest.

label: Talk to Ur-tag or Ambassador Alvijar
detail: Speak to either NPC in the north-east part of Dorgesh-Kaan's middle level to start.

hints.value: 1What are you arguing about?
1I'd love to help!

label: Head to the excavation cave south of the middle level
detail: Go to the south-west corner of the city's middle level and enter the doorway marked with the transportation symbol, then walk south on the tracks.

label: Talk to Tegdak at the dig site
detail: Speak to Tegdak to begin the excavation.

label: Dig up 6 artefacts with the trowel
detail: Dig up artefacts from the ground with the trowel; six artefacts total.

label: Clean the artefacts on the specimen table
detail: Use each artefact on the specimen table to clean it.

label: Talk to Tegdak with the cleaned artefacts
detail: Zanik automatically starts following you after this conversation, if you have no other follower.

label: Make sure Zanik is following before moving on
detail: If Zanik is not following, head back to the cave and talk to her again.

label: Talk to the Goblin scribe
detail: The scribe is in the house west of Ur-tag, where the quest started.

label: Talk to Oldak to teleport to the Goblin Village
detail: Oldak is in the north-west corner of the city's lower level, reached via stairs in the house west of the scribe; talking to him teleports you to the Goblin Village.

label: Talk to General Wartface or Bentnoze to start the ambush
detail: A cutscene begins after speaking to either goblin general.

label: Defeat the H.A.M. Mage
detail: Run south to the ladder staying behind the west-side houses to avoid being hit, climb up, and defeat the H.A.M. Mage using Ranged or Magic only.

hints.value: Throwing darts work only with the 'long range' combat style; a spare crossbow and 50 bronze bolts spawn nearby if you arrive unequipped.

label: Defeat the H.A.M. Archer
detail: Defeat the H.A.M. Archer alongside the Mage, using Ranged or Magic only.

label: Talk to the general for the ancient mace
detail: Receive the ancient mace and two goblin warrior allies from General Wartface or Bentnoze.

label: Head to the Lumbridge Swamp Cave entrance
detail: The entrance is outside by the giant frogs in Lumbridge Swamp.

label: Talk to a goblin sergeant before entering
detail: Speak to one of the goblin sergeants at the cave entrance.

label: Enter the caves and climb down the nearby ladder
detail: Descend into the stealth section immediately after entering.

label: Tell a sergeant to wait
detail: As soon as you're down, talk to the sergeants and tell one of them to wait.

hints.value: 2One of you wait here

label: Run to the first room and wait for 2 guards to pass
detail: Enter the room and wait until two guards have passed before moving further.

label: Tell the sergeant to wait in the room
detail: Tell the sergeant accompanying you to wait here.

hints.value: 1Wait here

label: Trigger and dodge the third guard
detail: Run up to the boxes to trigger a third guard, then run back to the room so he doesn't spot you.

until.state: 3rd guard has passed without detecting you

label: Tell the sergeant to follow again
detail: After the third guard passes, ask your sergeant to follow you again.

hints.value: 2Follow me

label: Walk (do not run) to the end of the tunnel
detail: Walking instead of running here avoids early detection; the final guard attacks your sergeant at the end.

label: Climb down the ladder to Sigmund's chamber
detail: Descend the ladder to reach Sigmund for the final fight.

label: Defeat Sigmund
detail: Sigmund is level 64; use the Ancient mace's special attack only after he activates Protect from Melee/prayer, since the special disables his prayer for the rest of the fight.

label: Untie Zanik
detail: Free Zanik to complete the quest.

label: Optional: ride the train to Keldagrim
detail: Not required for quest completion; only needed for a Lumbridge & Draynor Diary hard task.

hints.value: optional

label: Find and read the Soul journey book on a random bookshelf
detail: The book spawns on a random bookshelf in the Arceuus Library each playthrough; the AKP... fairy code CIS lands nearby.

until.state: Soul journey book found on a random bookshelf

hints.value: Held row flags a third-party client's book-search helper as narrowing this down; not itself a wiki-sourced fact.

label: Talk to Aretha at the Soul Altar
detail: Aretha directs you to dig in the church crypt.

hints.value: 3I've been reading your book...
1Yes please.

label: Climb up into the Arceuus church
detail: The church is east of the library; climb up the staircase to get inside.

label: Climb down to the courtyard
detail: Descend the inner staircase to the courtyard at the centre of the church.

label: Dig anywhere in the courtyard
detail: Digging anywhere in the courtyard yields the Damaged soul bearer.

hints.value: Lost soul bearers are freely re-obtainable by digging the crypt again (held-row prior knowledge, not itself in this fetched section).

label: Travel to Cerberus' Lair in the Taverley Dungeon
detail: The Key Master who repairs the soul bearer is found here.

label: Talk to the Key Master to repair the soul bearer
detail: Trade the damaged soul bearer for a working Soul bearer.

label: Talk to Sir Amik Varze in the White Knights' Castle
detail: He is on the 2nd floor of the western section of the castle in Falador.

hints.value: 1I seek a quest!
1I laugh in the face of danger!
1Ok, I'll do my best.

label: Head to the Black Knights' Fortress
detail: Bring an iron chainbody and a bronze med helm for the disguise.

label: Equip the iron chainbody and bronze med helm disguise
detail: Equip both pieces before entering so the guards see you as a Black Knight.

label: Enter through the sturdy door
detail: The entrance is toward the south, on the left stretch of the hallway.

label: Push the first hidden wall
detail: Push the wall in front of you to reveal the passage.

label: Navigate the ladders and doors to the eastern grill
detail: Climb up the ladder twice, climb down south, go through the eastern door, climb up, then climb down the eastern ladder, go south through a door, and climb down again to reach the grill.

label: Listen at the grill on the eastern wall
detail: Eavesdrop on the conversation through the grill.

label: Return to the entrance the same way
detail: Retrace the same route back to the entrance after the conversation.

label: Bluff the guard into the dining area
detail: Go through the eastern door into the dining area; finish the guard's conversation to be let through. Black Knights that attack during this can be killed, or the chat can be rushed through to avoid combat.

hints.value: 2I don't care. I'm going in anyway.

label: Navigate to the second hidden wall
detail: Run north, climb up the ladder, then run east and south.

label: Push the second hidden wall
detail: Push the wall to reveal the secret weapon's works.

label: Jam the secret weapon with the cabbage
detail: Use a cabbage on the hole to jam the weapon's works. Do not eat the cabbage.

hints.value: BE CAREFUL NOT TO EAT THE CABBAGE.

label: Return to Falador
detail: Your character remarks that you should head back to Falador after sabotaging the weapon.

label: Report back to Sir Amik Varze
detail: Talk to Sir Amik Varze to finish the quest.

label: Sail to Entrana
detail: Speak to the monks on the second most northern dock in Port Sarim to sail across to Entrana.

label: Talk to Auguste to start the quest
detail: Find Auguste north of the Herblore shop on Entrana and talk to him three times to agree to help build the balloon.

hints.value: Yes! Sign me up.
Umm, yes. What's your point?
Yes.

label: Use papyrus on the ball of wool
detail: Combine a papyrus with the ball of wool to make a component for the balloon structure.

label: Light the balloon structure with the candle
detail: Use the unlit candle on the balloon structure near Auguste.

label: Talk to Auguste again
detail: Report back to Auguste after handling the candle and papyrus.

label: Give Auguste the papyrus and potatoes
detail: Talk to Auguste again while carrying the remaining two papyrus and a sack of potatoes.

hints.value: Yes, I have them here.

label: Fill sacks with sand
detail: Fill the eight empty sacks with sand just south of Auguste's position.

label: Hand over dye, silk, bowl and sandbags
detail: Give Auguste a yellow dye, a red dye, ten silk, a bowl and the eight sandbags. A bowl spawns in the house just east of Auguste, up the ladder, if you need one.

detail: Axes cannot be brought to Entrana, so leave to gather logs and branches; Pest Control's minigame teleport or the Port Sarim ships both work for banking along the way.

detail: Trim willow branches with secateurs from a willow tree, including the sapling Auguste can grow, without felling the tree until all branches are collected.

label: Chop 10 regular logs
detail: Cut ten regular logs before returning, since axes cannot be carried onto Entrana itself.

label: Return to Entrana
detail: Sail back across to Entrana with the branches and logs.

label: Attach the willow branches to the balloon frame
detail: Use the willow branches on the balloon frame on the platform near Auguste.

label: Store spare logs in log storage (optional)
detail: Optionally bank any extra noted oak, willow, yew or magic logs in log storage to unlock further balloon routes after the quest.

label: Tell Auguste you're ready to fly
detail: Talk to Auguste once the frame is fully assembled to begin the flight.

hints.value: Okay.

label: Burn a log
detail: Screen one: burn a log to adjust altitude.

detail: Screen one: click relax nine times in sequence.

detail: Screen one: pull the red steering rope.

detail: Screen one: relax twice more.

label: Pull the brown rope
detail: Screen one: pull the brown steering rope.

label: Relax 5 times
detail: Screen one: finish with five relaxes.

detail: Screen two: burn a log.

detail: Screen two: relax once.

detail: Screen two: relax ten times.

detail: Screen two: relax five times to finish.

detail: Screen three: relax seven times.

label: Pull the red rope
detail: Screen three: pull the red rope.

detail: Screen three: pull the brown rope.

detail: Screen three: relax three times.

label: Burn a log
detail: Screen three: burn a log.

detail: Screen three: relax four times.

detail: Screen three: pull the brown rope to land.

Yes.

detail: Talk to the drunken dwarf again and hand him a beer to loosen his tongue.

hints.value: I need to know about the Red Axe...

detail: Head to the White Wolf Mountain tunnel; optionally buy a 100-coin ticket from the Keldagrim Cart Conductor and ride the south minecart track.

detail: Speak to Khorvak in the pub under White Wolf Mountain.

detail: Speak with Rind the Gardener at the Kelda Hops Patch south-east of the bank before using the patch.

detail: Wait for a chat notification that the crop is ready (you can log out while waiting) then harvest the kelda hops.
