hints.value: Do you have any spare ale yeast?
That's a good deal - please fill my pot with ale yeast for 25GP.

label: Add water to the vat
detail: Pour two buckets of water into the vat first.

label: Add barley malt to the vat
detail: Add two barley malts to the vat next.

label: Add kelda hops to the vat
detail: Add the harvested kelda hops to the vat.

label: Add ale yeast to the vat
detail: Add the ale yeast last, in this order: water, barley malt, kelda hops, ale yeast.

label: Wait for the brew
detail: Wait for another chat notification (15-20 minutes) that the kelda ale has finished brewing.

label: Draw the finished ale
detail: Turn the valve and use an empty beer glass on the barrel to draw the finished kelda ale.

label: Report the ale to the drunken dwarf
detail: Return to the drunken dwarf's house north-east of the kebab shop and talk about the Red Axe again.

hints.value: I need to know about the Red Axe...

label: Ask about the closed-off tunnel
detail: Talk to the southernmost cart conductor in south-eastern Keldagrim; only one of the conductors will discuss the closed-off tunnel.

hints.value: Ask about closed off tunnel.

label: Ask your mining company director for help
detail: Find the director of the mining company you joined during The Giant Dwarf, upstairs in either the west or east marketplace; only your own director has time to talk.

hints.value: Can you help me with a boarded up tunnel?

label: Ride the southernmost minecart into the tunnel
detail: Return to the minecarts and ride the southernmost cart; no ticket is needed but both hands must be free.

label: Search the box in room 1
detail: Search the box in the first room to collect stones for the cart-track puzzle.

label: Use the dwarven machinery
detail: Use the dwarven machinery in room 1 to open the sliding-block cart-track puzzle interface.

label: Solve the room 1 cart-track puzzle
detail: Set up each of the three shown paths in turn and click OK, riding the cart and collecting more stones from the box between attempts, to move on to room 2.

label: Crawl through room 2
detail: Listen to the conversation, crawl to the other side of room 2, and leave.

label: Solve the room 3 cart-track puzzle
detail: Complete the sliding-block cart-track puzzle in room 3 the same way as room 1.

label: Read the Red Axe documents in room 4
detail: Search the crates and bookshelves in room 4 until you've read three documents relating to the Red Axe, then continue on.

label: Solve the room 5 cart-track puzzle
detail: Complete the sliding-block cart-track puzzle in room 5 the same way as the previous ones. Room 6 is a cutscene with no player action, watched on entry.

label: Buy a kebab (optional)
detail: Buy a kebab from the kebab shop in East Keldagrim if you don't already have one.

label: Buy a beer (optional)
detail: Buy a beer in the East Keldagrim pub if you don't already have one.

label: Report the tunnel to Commander Veldaban
detail: Return to Commander Veldaban west of the bank and report what you found in the tunnel.

label: Drink the beer
detail: Back at the eastern pub on the east side of Keldagrim, drink your beer.

label: Eat the kebab
detail: Eat your kebab at the eastern pub to complete the quest.

label: Talk to Thormac
detail: Speak to Thormac on the top floor of the Sorcerer's Tower, south of Seers' Village, to receive the scorpion cage.

hints.value: What do you need assistance with?
So how would I go about catching them then?
Ok, I will do it then

label: Talk to a Seer
detail: Speak to a Seer in Seers' Village (wait until he finishes checking himself in the mirror). This is mandatory -- skipping it blocks access to the Taverley Dungeon scorpion room. Scorpions can then be caught in any order with no need to return to Thormac between catches.

hints.value: Your friend Thormac sent me to speak to you.

label: Kill the jailer for a dusty key (if under 70 Agility)
detail: If you lack 70 Agility for the dungeon shortcuts, head south to the Black Knights' Base and kill the jailer to get a key.

label: Free Velrak for the dusty key
detail: Use the key on the jail cell and talk to Velrak the explorer; he gives you the dusty key. A dusty key also spawns near the lava eel fishing spot south of the blue dragon area as an alternative, or skip this with the 70/80 Agility shortcuts.

label: Reach the hidden scorpion room
detail: Enter Taverley Dungeon from South Taverley, pass the poison spider area (an anti-dragon shield is recommended near the blue dragons), and search the old wall directly south of the level 80 Agility shortcut.

label: Cage the first Kharid Scorpion
detail: Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion; trying to pick it up instead stings you.

label: Head to the Barbarian Outpost
detail: Travel to the Barbarian Outpost (a games necklace helps), enter the fenced area near the agility course entrance, then the building in the north-east corner.

label: Cage the second Kharid Scorpion
detail: Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion; it may be loose outside the small room if someone else let it out.

label: Head to Edgeville Monastery
detail: Travel to the Monastery between Edgeville and Ice Mountain (a combat bracelet teleports directly there), climb the eastern ladder to the east side of the floor. If a monk stops you, say you want to join the order.

mapMarkers.label: third Kharid Scorpion, Edgeville Monastery upper floor

label: Cage the third Kharid Scorpion
detail: Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion.

label: Return the full cage to Thormac
detail: Hand the scorpion cage, now holding all three Kharid Scorpions, back to Thormac to finish the quest.

label: Sober up Skippy with water
detail: Right-click 'Sober-Up' on Skippy, south-east of Rimmington, using a bucket of water.

hints.value: Throw the water!

label: Use nettle tea on Skippy
detail: Right-click use the nettle tea on Skippy. Do not accidentally drink it yourself.

label: Talk to Skippy
detail: Talk to Skippy after the tea.

label: Make chocolatey milk
detail: Use the chocolate dust on the bucket of milk.

label: Brew the hangover cure
detail: Use the snape grass on the chocolatey milk. Do not accidentally drink the chocolatey milk yourself.

label: Use the hangover cure on Skippy
detail: Use the finished hangover cure on Skippy to complete the miniquest. No combat is required; the mogre Slayer-task unlock afterward is best used with 32 Slayer and fishing explosives.

label: Talk to Captain Tock near Falador farm
detail: Speak to Captain Tock just south of the entrance to Falador farm and agree to help with his curse.

hints.value: What kind of help do you need?
Sure, I'll try to help with your curse.

label: Sail to Corsair Cove with Captain Tock
detail: Meet Captain Tock again on the single dock just west of Rimmington and sail to Corsair Cove.

hints.value: Okay, I'm ready to go to Corsair Cove.

label: Speak to Ithoi the Navigator first
detail: On arrival, speak to Ithoi the Navigator before any other NPC or their dialogue breaks. He's west along the beach, upstairs in the southernmost building.

hints.value: I hear you've been cursed.

label: Speak to Arsen the Thief
detail: Speak to Arsen the Thief upstairs in the first house west of the docks.

hints.value: I hear you've been cursed.

mapMarkers.label: Arsen the Thief and Cabin Boy Colin's house

label: Speak to Cabin Boy Colin
detail: Speak to Cabin Boy Colin in the same room as Arsen, just east of him.

hints.value: I hear you've been cursed.

mapMarkers.label: Arsen the Thief and Cabin Boy Colin's house

label: Speak to Gnocci the Cook
detail: Speak to Gnocci the Cook upstairs in the building just north-west.

hints.value: I hear you've been cursed.

label: Grab a tinderbox by Gnocci (if needed)
detail: Pick up the tinderbox next to Gnocci if you don't already carry one; it's needed later.

label: Grab a spade south of Gnocci's hut (if needed)
detail: Pick up the spade directly south of Gnocci's hut, right by the tree near the water, if you don't already carry one.

label: Receive the ogre artefact
detail: Cross the south gangplank to speak with Captain Tock back on the boat; he explains Arsen gave him a sacred ogre relic.

hints.value: Arsen says he gave you a sacred ogre relic.

label: Return the ogre artefact to Chief Tess
detail: Speak to Chief Tess in the Corsair Cove Dungeon, entrance just west in the middle of four small pillars, and hand over the ogre artefact.

hints.value: I've come to return what Arsen stole.

label: Dig the lump of sand
detail: Use a spade to dig the lump of sand next to the tropical tree west of the fishing spot where Gnocci fished in the cutscene, three steps east of the tree.

label: Use the telescope on Ithoi's deck
detail: Use the telescope on the deck of Ithoi the Navigator's hut.

label: Report findings to Gnocci
detail: Return to Gnocci the Cook and report what you found.

label: Report findings to Arsen
detail: Speak to Arsen the Thief with your findings.

mapMarkers.label: Arsen the Thief and Cabin Boy Colin's house

label: Report findings to Colin
detail: Speak to Cabin Boy Colin with your findings.

mapMarkers.label: Arsen the Thief and Cabin Boy Colin's house

label: Rule out the crew's theories with Captain Tock
detail: Speak to Captain Tock now that all three theories have been ruled out.

hints.value: I've ruled out all the Corsairs' theories...
So what do I do now?

label: Ask Gnocci about the meal
detail: Speak to Gnocci the Cook about when the sickness started.

hints.value: I hear it happened straight after dinner.

label: Ask Arsen about the meal and Francois
detail: Speak to Arsen the Thief about who cooked the meal and about Francois' mission.

hints.value: I hear Ithoi cooked the meal you ate that night.
What is the mission Francois is doing?

mapMarkers.label: Arsen the Thief and Cabin Boy Colin's house

label: Ask Colin about firing Ithoi
detail: Speak to Cabin Boy Colin about the Captain considering firing Ithoi.

hints.value: I hear the Captain's thinking of firing Ithoi.

mapMarkers.label: Arsen the Thief and Cabin Boy Colin's house

label: Confront Ithoi about the meal
detail: Speak to Ithoi the Navigator about cooking the meal and the Captain's plan to fire him.

hints.value: I hear you cooked the meal they ate before getting sick.
Maybe because the Captain's thinking of firing you.

label: Accuse Ithoi of faking the curse
detail: Speak to Ithoi the Navigator again, accusing him of faking his curse.

hints.value: I know you've faked the curse.
I bet I can prove you're well enough to get up.

label: Torch the driftwood under Ithoi's hut
detail: Use your tinderbox on the driftwood under Ithoi's hut to smoke him out.

label: Catch Ithoi not-sick
detail: Speak to Ithoi the Navigator again after the smoke reveals he isn't actually sick.

hints.value: I saw you running around! You're not sick!

label: Report Ithoi to Captain Tock
detail: Speak to Captain Tock to report that Ithoi isn't sick; this triggers the instanced fight.

hints.value: I've seen Ithoi running around. He's not sick at all.
I'll be back.

label: Kill Ithoi the Navigator
detail: In the instance, head west and kill Ithoi the Navigator (level 35); using Protect from Magic avoids all his damage. Recommended 20+ Combat with weapons, armour and food.

label: Report Ithoi's death to Captain Tock
detail: Speak to Captain Tock to report killing Ithoi for poisoning the crew, completing the quest.

hints.value: I've killed Ithoi for poisoning your crew.

label: Talk to the Dwarven Boatman to travel to Keldagrim
detail: Take fairy ring code DKS then head through the tunnel south-west and the Cave Entrance, or simply speak to the boatman to begin the trip.

hints.value: 1That's a deal!
1Yes, I'm ready and don't mind it taking a few minutes.

label: Finish the conversation with Commander Veldaban
detail: Commander Veldaban, near the West Keldagrim bank, briefs you on the sculptor's project.

hints.value: 2Yes, I will do this.

label: Talk to Blasidar the sculptor
detail: Blasidar, on the east side of Keldagrim south of the kebab shop, explains he needs items for a statue of King Alvis.

hints.value: 2Yes, I will do this.

label: Ask Vermundi about the exquisite clothes
detail: Vermundi the silk trader works the large eastern-market building in East Keldagrim.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for some special clothes.

label: Ask the Librarian about Dwarven costumes
detail: The Librarian sits in the library at the north-east corner of West Keldagrim.

hints.value: 2Do you know anything about King Alvis' clothes?

label: Climb a bookcase for the costume book
detail: Climbing any library bookcase yields the Scholars Guide to Dwarven Costumes; carrying 30kg or more of gear blocks the climb.

label: Source coal for the spinning machine
detail: Coal can be mined in the north-east corner of East Keldagrim, or bought from Ordan at the Blast Furnace if not already carried.

label: Tell Vermundi you're ready for the clothes
detail: Return to Vermundi once coal and logs are in hand.

hints.value: 2Yes, about those special clothes again...

label: Spin coal and logs into cloth
detail: Use coal and logs on the spinning machine next to Vermundi, then light the result with a tinderbox.

label: Buy the exquisite clothes from Vermundi for 200gp
detail: Pay Vermundi 200gp once the spun cloth is ready.

hints.value: 2Yes, about those special clothes again...
1I'll pay.

label: Buy 3 sapphires from Hervi if not already carried
detail: Hervi runs the gem stall just north of Vermundi.

label: Ask Saro about the special boots
detail: Saro works the anvil south-west of the West Keldagrim bank.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for a pair of special boots.

label: Speak to Dromund
detail: Dromund lives in a house just north of the West Keldagrim bank.

label: Take the left boot while Dromund isn't looking
detail: Slip the left boot away from Dromund's house while he's distracted.

label: Telegrab the right boot through the window
detail: Go outside behind Dromund's house and cast Telekinetic Grab on the right boot through the window while he isn't looking.

label: Ask Santiri about the battleaxe
detail: Santiri runs the weapon shop in north-western West Keldagrim and hands over the ancient dwarven battleaxe.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe.
2Blasidar the sculptor needs it for his statue.
2Perhaps I can repair the axe?

label: Socket the 3 sapphires into the battleaxe
detail: Use the 3 sapphires on the ancient battleaxe now in your inventory.

label: Talk to Santiri again to confirm the axe
detail: Confirm the gem-set axe with Santiri before moving on.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe.

label: Ask the Librarian about the Imcando dwarves if needed
detail: Skip this and the next step entirely if Thurgo was already met via The Knight's Sword.

label: Ask Reldo about the Imcando dwarves if needed
detail: Reldo, in the Varrock Palace library, points toward Thurgo; skip if Thurgo has already been met.

label: Get Thurgo to repair the battleaxe
detail: Thurgo works at Mudskipper Point (fairy ring AIQ); give him an iron bar to repair the axe, with a redberry pie as a possible extra if he hasn't received one recently, then take the option to return to Keldagrim immediately.

hints.value: 2Something else.
3Can you help me with this ancient axe?
1Would you like a redberry pie?
1Return to Keldagrim immediately.

label: Give Riki the clothes, boots and axe
detail: Riki, Blasidar's model, receives the exquisite clothes, both boots, and the repaired battleaxe.

label: Talk to Blasidar and watch the statue cutscene
detail: Blasidar completes the statue once Riki has the items.

label: Choose a company and offer to help its secretary
detail: Pick any company except the Red Axe from the market's upper floor; progress only counts toward the one company chosen.

hints.value: 3Is there anything I can help you with?

label: Deliver requested ores until the hidden score allows bar tasks
detail: Each successful ore delivery (5 of a kind is a safe buffer, ores can be noted) gives 20 hidden points, refusals cost 2; ores can also be bought from Ordan at the Blast Furnace. Repeat until 75+ points unlocks director bar tasks.

label: Deliver bars for the director until membership is offered
detail: Bring unnoted metal bars requested by the director (12 points each); unlike the secretary, click the director again before advancing the dialogue. Continue until 100 points is reached.

hints.value: 3Do you have any more tasks for me?

label: Officially join the chosen company
detail: Accept membership when the director offers it, mentioning Blasidar sent you.

hints.value: 2I'd like to officially join your company.
3Blasidar the sculptor has sent me.
1I would support you.
1Yes! Long live the <company name>!

label: Report to Commander Veldaban to finish
detail: Talk to Commander Veldaban west of the bank; you may decline the meeting invite offered afterward.

label: Talk to Bert in Yanille to get a sandy hand
detail: Bert lives in the house next to the Yanille POH portal and lends you a sand-covered hand.

hints.value: 2Eww a hand, in the sand! Why haven't you told the authorities?
1Yes.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Buy a beer from the Dragon Inn bartender if needed
detail: The Dragon Inn pub sits south of Bert's house; skip if a beer is already carried.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Give the beer to the Guard Captain
detail: The Guard Captain is stationed at the Dragon Inn pub.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Ring the Wizards' Guild bell and hand over the sandy hand
detail: Ring the bell outside the eastern doors of the Wizards' Guild, or enter with 66 Magic, then give Zavistic Rarve the hand.

hints.value: 2I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you.
Alternate dialogue option shown if Zogre Flesh Eaters has already been started.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Get Bert's rota from Bert
detail: Bert hands over his work rota.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Travel to Sandy's house in Brimhaven
detail: Sandy's house sits south of the Shrimp and Parrot restaurant and north-west of the Brimhaven pub.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Search Sandy's desk for his rota
detail: Search the desk inside Sandy's house.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Pickpocket Sandy until sand drops
detail: Repeatedly pickpocket Sandy until a portion of sand is stolen.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Return to Yanille
detail: Head back to Yanille to continue with Bert.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Get a magic scroll from Bert
detail: Bert provides a magic scroll for the next step.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Ring the bell and collect the magical orb
detail: Zavistic Rarve hands over a magical orb.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Accept a teleport to Port Sarim
detail: Zavistic Rarve offers to teleport you straight to Port Sarim.

hints.value: 4Can you help me more?
1Yes, that would be great!
Numbering shifts to options 2/4/1 if Zogre Flesh Eaters has been started.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Get a bottled water from Betty
detail: Betty runs the magic shop in Port Sarim.

hints.value: 1Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Mix redberries then white berries into the water
detail: Add redberries first, then white berries, to make a pink dye; redberries are sold at the southern Port Sarim food store.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Dye the lantern lens with the pink dye
detail: Dyeing the lens produces a rose-tinted lens.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Betty again to have the vial placed on the counter
detail: This sets up the truth-serum step.

hints.value: 1Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Use the rose-tinted lens on the counter from the doorway
detail: Stand in the doorway and use the lens on the counter to make a truth serum.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Hand your sand to Betty
detail: Give Betty the sand collected earlier from Sandy.

hints.value: 1Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Travel back to Sandy's house in Brimhaven
detail: Head back to Brimhaven for the confrontation.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Distract Sandy then dose his coffee with truth serum
detail: Pick a distracting dialogue option, then use the truth serum on Sandy's coffee mug.

hints.value: 1There's a herd of huge mutant herring about to drop from the sky!
2But the pygmy shrews have eaten all the sand!
3A small parrot with a pink banana is sitting outside your window!

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Activate the magical orb and question Sandy fully
detail: Activate the orb, then talk to Sandy and click through every dialogue option offered.

hints.value: 1Why is Bert's rota different from the original?
1Why doesn't Bert remember the change in his hours?
1What happened to the wizard?

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Ring the bell and talk to Zavistic Rarve
detail: Requires 5 earth runes and a bucket of sand carried in the inventory.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve again for a cutscene
detail: Consumes the earth runes and bucket of sand for the ritual shown in the cutscene.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Travel to Entrana
detail: Sail to Entrana to find Mazion.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Mazion at the sandpit
detail: Mazion hands over a wizard's head.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Return to Yanille
detail: Head back to Yanille for the final report.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Ring the bell and talk to Zavistic Rarve to finish
detail: Hand over the wizard's head to complete the quest.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to the Squire about the lost ceremonial sword
detail: The Squire, in the White Knights' Castle courtyard, explains the sword needs replacing.

hints.value: 1And how is life as a squire?
2I can make a new sword if you like...
1So would these dwarves make another one?
1Ok, I'll give it a go.

label: Ask Reldo about the Imcando dwarves
detail: Reldo, in the Varrock Palace library, points toward Thurgo; skip this if Thurgo was already met during The Giant Dwarf.

hints.value: 2. What do you know about the Imcando dwarfs?
Option shifts to number 4 if Shield of Arrav has not been started.

label: Give Thurgo a redberry pie
detail: Thurgo works south of Port Sarim by the anvil, north of fairy ring AIQ.

hints.value: 2Would you like a redberry pie?
Option shifts to number 3 if The Giant Dwarf is in progress.

label: Talk to Thurgo again
detail: Continue the conversation with Thurgo.

hints.value: 1Something else.

label: Report back to the Squire
detail: Return and update the Squire on progress.

label: Climb to Sir Vyvin's bedroom in the castle
detail: Climb the eastern ladder to the 1st floor, go west, then up the eastern staircase to reach the bedroom.

label: Search the cupboard for Sir Vyvin's portrait
detail: He must not be looking at you when the cupboard is searched.

label: Give Thurgo the portrait
detail: Also bring iron bars along for the forging step that follows.

hints.value: 1About that sword...

label: Enter the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon
detail: Use the trapdoor east of Thurgo, then follow the path west, north, then east to the icy area.

label: Mine blurite ore along the icy area's southern wall
detail: Mine a second blurite ore too if planning to also complete the Falador Easy Diary.

label: Give Thurgo the iron bars and blurite ore to forge the sword
detail: Thurgo forges the replacement sword once both materials are handed over.

hints.value: 1Can you make that replacement sword now?

label: Deliver the finished sword to the Squire
detail: Hand over the replacement sword to complete the quest.

label: Talk to the boy about his lost ball
detail: He's found south-east of the long garden in Taverley, next to the members gate.

hints.value: 1What's the matter?
1Ok, I'll see what I can do.

label: Walk to the witch's front door
detail: Head west then north to the house across from the player-owned house portal.

label: Find the door key under the potted plant
detail: Look under the potted plant closest to the door.

label: Unlock and enter the front door
detail: Use the recovered key on the door.

label: Read the Diary on the table
detail: The diary sits on the table just inside the house.

label: Climb down the ladder to the basement
detail: The ladder is to the north of the entrance room.

label: Search the boxes for leather gloves
detail: The boxes in the basement conceal a pair of leather gloves.

label: Equip the leather gloves before opening the gate
detail: Wearing the gloves is required before touching the electrified gate.

label: Open the basement gate
detail: Open the gate now that the gloves are equipped.

label: Search the cupboard for a magnet
detail: The magnet sits inside a cupboard beyond the gate.

label: Climb back up and enter the small southern room
detail: Climb the ladder back up, then head to the small room to the south.

label: Drop cheese to lure a mouse then catch it with the magnet
detail: The mouse must be caught quickly with the magnet right after cheese is dropped in the room.

label: Sneak through the garden hedges to the fountain
detail: Stick to the hedges and never step on the grass; getting caught means repeating the break-in, except the door-key search.

label: Check the fountain
detail: Search the garden fountain.

label: Unlock the shed with the door key
detail: Taking the ball too early makes the Witch's experiment attack and lower your combat stats.

label: Defeat the Witch's experiment through all four forms
detail: Forms are level 19/30/42/53; the shed's north-east corner and its south side both offer magic safespots.

label: Take the ball
detail: Pick up the boy's ball once the experiment is defeated.

label: Leave the house by teleporting out or through the garden
detail: Getting caught on the way out means recovering the ball again; world-hop if it fails to respawn.

label: Return the ball to the boy to finish
detail: Hand the ball back to the boy.

label: Check the noticeboard behind the Wine Stall
detail: The board sits on the wall behind the Wine Stall in Draynor Village market.

hints.value: 1Yes.

label: Talk to Sarah about the bounty
detail: Sarah works near the loom at South Falador Farm, north of Port Sarim; trading her also completes an easy Falador Diary task.

hints.value: 1Talk about the bounty.

label: Follow the vegetable trail to the strange hole
detail: From the crossroads north of Draynor Village and south of Draynor Manor, follow scattered cabbages and carrots north-east to the hole.

label: Use a rope on the hole and climb down
detail: A rope opens the way down into the cave.

label: Investigate the skeleton at the cave's end
detail: A cutscene plays after investigating the skeleton.

label: Talk to Spria for reinforced goggles
detail: Spria appears after the cutscene and hands over protective goggles.

label: Equip the reinforced goggles
detail: Wear the goggles before facing the Sourhog.

label: Kill the level 37 Sourhog back down the hole
detail: Sourhog resists slash and magic damage; bring a non-slash, non-whip/claw weapon or other suitable combat gear.

label: Remove the foot from the dead Sourhog
detail: Take the foot as proof of the kill.

label: Return the Sourhog's foot to Sarah
detail: Hand the foot over to claim the bounty.

hints.value: 1Talk about the bounty.

label: Report back to Spria to finish
detail: Talk to Spria in Draynor Village to complete the quest.

label: Talk to Willow south of Ice Mountain
detail: Willow, on the path south of Ice Mountain and north of Falador, explains she needs her old crew reunited.

hints.value: 1Yes.

label: Speak to Checkal near the pottery oven in Barbarian Village
detail: Checkal is found by the pottery oven building.

label: Train with Atlas in The Long Hall tavern
detail: Grab cooked meat and a beer from the tavern's tables first if not already carried.

hints.value: 1Yes.

label: Return to Checkal and use the Flex emote
detail: Use the Flex emote on Checkal when prompted to finish recruiting him.

label: Speak to Marley at the Edgeville yew trees first
detail: Marley must be spoken to before the Blue Moon Inn cook will share the sandwich recipe.

label: Get the steak sandwich recipe from the Blue Moon Inn cook
detail: The cook works the east room of the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.

hints.value: 1I was wondering if you'd be able to make me a Steak sandwich?

label: Make a steak sandwich
detail: Use a knife on cooked meat while carrying bread in your inventory.

label: Give Marley the steak sandwich
detail: Hand over the finished sandwich.

label: Speak to Burntof at Falador's Rising Sun Inn
detail: Burntof is inside the Rising Sun Inn.

label: Buy a beer if you don't already have one
detail: Emily or Kaylee will sell any beer for 3 coins.

hints.value: 1What ales are you serving?
1One Asgarnian Ale, please.

label: Play a round of rock-paper-scissors with Burntof
detail: Any option choice wins the round and recruits Burntof.

label: Meet Willow at the Ruins of Camdozaal entrance
detail: The dungeon icon sits on the west side of Ice Mountain; talking to Willow with all three recruits triggers an entry cutscene.

hints.value: 1Yes.

label: Defeat the level 25 Ancient Guardian
detail: Attack it directly, or mine its 4 corner structural pillars as a combat-free alternative.

label: Speak to Elena to begin the quest
detail: Talk to Elena in her East Ardougne house, directly west of the shortcut log, to start the quest and agree to retrieve her distillator.

hints.value: 1I'll try to retrieve it for you.

label: Speak to Jerico
detail: Speak to Jerico in the house just south of the northern Ardougne bank (the house with pigeon cages in the backyard).

label: Search Jerico's cupboard for bird feed
detail: Search the cupboard to obtain bird feed; click continue or it won't be added to your inventory.

label: Take a pigeon cage from the backyard
detail: Grab a pigeon cage from Jerico's backyard.

label: Walk to the West Ardougne watchtower
detail: Go south-west of Ardougne Castle to speak with Omart, then north to the small watchtower in front of the West Ardougne gates and stand in the corner where the two spiked fences meet.

label: Distract the watchtower guard with bird feed
detail: Use bird feed on the watchtower fence to lure the guard's attention.

label: Open the pigeon cage
detail: Click open on the pigeon cage in your inventory while the guard is distracted.

label: Equip the gas mask
detail: Equip your gas mask before crossing into West Ardougne.

label: Cross into West Ardougne with Omart
detail: Run south from the watchtower and speak to Omart; after a short delay you arrive in West Ardougne.

hints.value: 1Ok, lets do it.

label: Squeeze into the Mourner HQ backyard
detail: Head around the Mourner Headquarters to the north-eastern area with the vat and mangle, then squeeze through the fence into the backyard.

label: Pick up the rotten apple
detail: Pick up the rotten apple in the backyard.

label: Use the rotten apple on the cauldron
detail: Use the rotten apple on the cauldron, then squeeze back through the fence.

label: Walk to Nurse Sarah's house
detail: Go to Nurse Sarah's house, south-west of the West Ardougne church.

label: Search the cupboard for a medical gown
detail: Search the cupboard in the northern part of the house for a medical gown.

label: Equip the medical gown
detail: Equip the medical gown, go back to the Mourner Headquarters and open the door.

label: Kill a mourner upstairs
detail: Go upstairs inside the headquarters and kill a mourner; a key is placed in your inventory automatically.

label: Unlock the caged room
detail: Use the key on the gate to get into the caged room.

label: Search the crate for the distillator
detail: Search the crate third from the left on the northern wall to find Elena's distillator.

label: Return the distillator to Elena
detail: With 3 empty inventory spaces, return to Elena and give her the distillator (via Ardougne Teleport, Skills necklace to the Fishing Guild, over the wall by Kilron, or via the Plague City sewers).

label: Walk to the Rimmington chemist
detail: Go to the chemist in south-western Rimmington (ship from Captain Barnaby at the Ardougne Dock for 30gp, or teleport).

label: Get the touch paper from the chemist
detail: Speak to the Chemist about your quest; he gives you the touch paper.

hints.value: 2Your quest.

label: Give Chancy the liquid honey
detail: Find Chancy, Da Vinci and Hops around a fire outside the Chemist's house and give Chancy the vial of liquid honey.

hints.value: 2You give him the vial of liquid honey...

label: Give Da Vinci the ethenea
detail: Give Da Vinci the vial of ethenea. Giving any henchman the wrong vial forces you to redo the round with all three in Varrock before retrying.

hints.value: 1You give him the vial of ethenea...

label: Give Hops the sulphuric broline
detail: Give Hops the vial of sulphuric broline.

hints.value: 3You give him the vial of sulphuric broline...

label: Walk to the fenced area south-east of Varrock bank
detail: Teleport or travel to Varrock and head to the fenced area south-east of the bank; the guard searches you but lets the plague sample and touch paper through.

label: Get a free priest gown from Asyff (optional)
detail: (Optional) Speak to Asyff, the Fancy Dress Shop owner, in the building south-east for a free priest gown top and bottom, or buy one from him.

label: Equip the priest gown
detail: Equip the priest gown top and bottom.

label: Walk to the Dancing Donkey Inn
detail: Head to the Dancing Donkey Inn to reclaim the vials.

label: Reclaim the vial from Hops
detail: Talk to Hops to get the processed vial back; make sure you have free inventory space. Do not pass back through the Varrock gate or the vials are confiscated and you must get new samples from Elena.

label: Reclaim the vial from Da Vinci
detail: Talk to Da Vinci to get the processed vial back.

label: Reclaim the vial from Chancy
detail: Talk to Chancy to get the processed vial back.

label: Walk to Guidor's house
detail: With the priest gown equipped, head to Guidor's house in the south-east of the fenced area.

label: Deliver the sample to Guidor
detail: Speak to Guidor and tell him Elena has sent a sample that needs to be processed.

hints.value: 1I've come to ask your assistance in stopping a plague.

label: Report back to Elena
detail: Return to Ardougne and speak to Elena.

label: Walk to King Lathas' floor in Ardougne Castle
detail: Go to the first floor of Ardougne Castle.

label: Report to King Lathas to finish
detail: Speak to King Lathas to complete the quest.

hints.value: 1I don't understand...

label: Speak to Doric to start the quest
detail: Talk to Doric at his house just outside Taverley's east gate, north of Falador; he gives you a bronze pickaxe.

label: Mine iron ore south-east of the mine ladder
detail: Mine 2 un-noted iron ore at the spot just south-east of the ladder down into the Dwarven Mine, south of Ice Mountain (east of the quest start).

label: Mine copper ore south-east of the mine ladder
detail: Mine 4 un-noted copper ore at the same spot south-east of the ladder; watch for aggressive Scorpions/King Scorpions at low combat.

label: Mine clay near the agility shortcut
detail: Mine 6 un-noted clay south of the iron/copper spot, near the Agility shortcut.

label: Hand the materials to Doric to finish
detail: Talk to Doric with the un-noted 2 iron ore, 4 copper ore and 6 clay in your inventory to complete the quest.

hints.value: 1I wanted to use your anvils.|1Yes, I will get you the materials.

label: Speak to Captain Lawgof to start
detail: Talk to Captain Lawgof by the Coal truck mining site west of Seers' Village (fairy ring code ALS then run east through the loose railing, or skills necklace to Fishing Guild and run west/north).

hints.value: 1Yes.

label: Take a hammer if needed
detail: (Optional, if you don't already have one) pick up the hammer in the house to the east.

label: Repair the six bent railings
detail: Use the hammer to fix the six bent railings on the west and south sides of the fence.

label: Report the fence repair
detail: Talk to Captain Lawgof after fixing the railings.

label: Walk to the tower south of the gate
detail: Go to the tower south of the gate.

label: Take the dwarf remains
detail: Climb the two ladders inside the tower and take the dwarf remains.

label: Report the dwarf remains
detail: Talk to Captain Lawgof after retrieving the dwarf remains.

label: Walk to the cave south-east of the Fishing Guild
detail: Run south (or teleport to the Fishing Guild) and enter the cave at its south-east corner.

label: Find Lollk hiding in a crate
detail: In the cave, go as far north-west as possible; in the north-westernmost room search the northernmost crate by the east wall to find Lollk. The conversation does not need to be finished.

label: Report finding Lollk, receive the toolkit
detail: Talk to Captain Lawgof after finding Lollk; he hands over the cannon toolkit.

hints.value: 1Okay, I'll see what I can do.

label: Fit the hook tool on the spring
detail: Use the hook tool (right) on the broken multicannon's spring -- first of the fixed assembly order.

label: Fit the pliers on the safety switch
detail: Use the pliers (middle) on the safety switch at the bottom -- second in the assembly order.

label: Fit the tooth tool on the gear
detail: Use the tooth tool (left) on the gear at the bottom of the hammer -- third and final in the assembly order.

label: Hand back the reassembled cannon
detail: Talk to Captain Lawgof; this conversation must be completely finished.

hints.value: 2Okay then, just for you!

label: Walk to the Dwarven Black Guard camp
detail: Go to the Dwarven Black Guard camp north-east of Falador / south of Ice Mountain / west of Barbarian Village.

label: Get Nulodion's notes
detail: Talk to Nulodion, in the house on the west side of the mining camp.

label: Deliver notes and mould to finish
detail: Return to Captain Lawgof with Nulodion's notes and your cannonball mould to complete the quest.

hints.note: acquisition point for the cannonball mould is never spelled out in the fetched Quick-guide text

label: Inspect the empty display case
detail: Inspect the empty display case in the north-east corner of the Grand Museum, Civitas illa Fortis, to start the quest.

hints.value: 1Yes.

label: Ask Herminius about the display case
detail: Talk to Curator Herminius in the middle of the museum about the empty display case.

hints.value: 4Could you tell me more about that empty display?

label: Investigate the tools behind the case
detail: Investigate the tools behind the display case.

label: Inspect the display case again
detail: Inspect the display case a second time.

label: Ask around until someone mentions a suspect
detail: Talk to the citizens, academics, and tourists around the room about their suspicions until one mentions a mysterious individual.

label: Ask Regulus Cento about the suspect
detail: Talk to Regulus Cento by the quetzals south-west of the museum.

hints.value: 2Have you seen anybody suspicious around?

label: Ask the Trader Crewmember about the man with a case
detail: Go east and talk to a Trader Crewmember about the suspicious man (needs 1 free inventory space).

hints.value: 4Have you seen a man with a case?|1As long as it is just the one favour...

label: Get the sail repaired by Artima
detail: Go to the crafting shop south-east and have Artima repair the sail as the favour the crewmember asked for.

hints.value: 2I was hoping for some help.|1Go on then.

label: Follow up with the Trader Crewmember
detail: Go back to the Trader Crewmember and ask about the suspicious man again.

hints.value: 4So, about that man with the case

label: Walk to Port Sarim
detail: Head to Port Sarim.

label: Ask Trader Stan's crew at the south dock
detail: Talk to Trader Stan or any of the Trader Crewmembers at the most southern dock.

hints.value: 4Have you seen a grey-haired man with a case?

label: Ask Betty for the lead
detail: Talk to Betty in the rune shop in north-west Port Sarim; she gives you a note to read.

hints.value: 2Have you seen a grey-haired man with a case?

label: Walk to Varrock Museum
detail: Head to Varrock Museum.

label: Ask Curator Haig Halen about Xerna's Diadem
detail: Talk to Curator Haig Halen about Xerna's Diadem (a different option applies if Bone Voyage is already complete).

hints.value: 1I'm looking for Xerna's Diadem.
hints.note: option 2 instead if Bone Voyage is complete

label: Pickpocket Haig Halen for the storeroom key
detail: Pickpocket Haig Halen for the storeroom key.

label: Unlock the north-east storeroom
detail: Use the storeroom key to open the storeroom in the north-east part of the museum.

label: Search the storeroom crates
detail: Search the crates inside the storeroom for evidence.

label: Confront Haig Halen with the evidence
detail: Talk to Haig Halen again and pick option 1 to begin the confrontation scene (option 2 instead if Bone Voyage is complete).

hints.value: 1I found Xerna's Diadem...
hints.note: option 2 instead if Bone Voyage is complete

label: Select the shaming dialogue options
detail: Select the dialogue options that shame Haig Halen into confessing; the exact option chain is deferred to the wiki's separate in-depth guide, not spelled out on the Quick guide.

hints.note: exact shame-dialogue option chain not given on the Quick guide page, only referenced as existing in a separate in-depth guide

label: Return to the Grand Museum
detail: Head back to the Grand Museum in Civitas illa Fortis.

label: Report back to Herminius to finish
detail: Talk to Curator Herminius to close the case and complete the quest.

hints.value: 4About that empty display...

label: Walk to Goblin Village
detail: Head to Goblin Village, north of Falador.

label: Gather 3 sets of goblin mail from crates
detail: Collect goblin mail from 3 crates: behind the Generals' hut to the north-east, in the hut south-west of the Generals, and north of the top of the southernmost ladder.

label: Buy woad leaves from Wyson
detail: Offer to buy 2 woad leaves for 20gp from Wyson the gardener in Falador Park.

label: Take onions from the farm north of Rimmington
detail: Take 2 onions from the farm north of Rimmington.

label: Buy redberries from Wydin's Food Store
detail: Buy 3 redberries from Wydin's Food Store in Port Sarim (hop worlds to restock if needed).

label: Make blue dye with Aggie
detail: Use the woad leaves on Aggie in Draynor Village to make blue dye.

label: Make red dye with Aggie
detail: Use the redberries on Aggie to make red dye.

label: Make yellow dye with Aggie
detail: Use the onions on Aggie to make yellow dye; don't eat the onions by accident with left-click.

label: Combine red and yellow dye into orange dye
detail: Use the red dye on the yellow dye to create orange dye. Never use both dyes separately on the goblin mail.

label: Dye one goblin mail set blue
detail: Use blue dye on one set of goblin mail.

label: Dye one goblin mail set orange
detail: Use orange dye on a second set of goblin mail; leave the third set its natural brown.

label: Present each colour until they settle on brown
detail: Offer to pick a colour for the generals: present the orange mail (rejected), then the blue mail (rejected), then the plain brown mail, which they finally accept to complete the quest. Dialogue differs slightly if Dragon Slayer I is in progress.

hints.value: 3 Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?|1 Start the quest?|3 What about a different colour?
hints.note: alternate opener (2 So How is life for the goblins? | 3 Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you? | 3 What about a different colour?) if Dragon Slayer I is in progress

hints.value: 1 I have some blue armour here
1 I have some brown armour here

label: Accept the shipwreck salvage job
detail: Talk to Will or Anne at the south docks of Port Sarim to accept their shipwreck salvaging job.

hints.value: 1 Yes|1 I guess I'm ready...

label: Sail south to the wreck site
detail: Take the helm and navigate south through the Bay of Sarim until you reach east of the Karamja Shipyard; click the minimap/water to set heading, trim the sails on wind gusts for a speed boost, and un-set the sails when Will says you've arrived.

label: Deploy the salvaging hook
detail: Deploy the salvaging hook at the wreck site; you are pushed overboard afterward.

label: Talk to Steve Beanie at the Pandemonium Pub
detail: Talk to 'Squawking' Steve Beanie at the Pandemonium Pub.

label: Discuss the map with Ribs
detail: Talk to Ribs just to the north to discuss the map; any dialogue option works.

hints.value: Any

label: Ask Steve Beanie about Will and Anne
detail: Talk to Steve Beanie again about Will and Anne's disappearance.

hints.value: 2 About Will and Anne...|2 Do you have any idea where Will and Anne might have gone?

label: Walk to the docks
detail: Head east to the docks.

label: Trade the old cup for a raft
detail: Talk to Junior Jim to get a raft in exchange for the salvaged old cup; he takes you to the shipyard.

label: Take a hammer if needed
detail: (If needed) take a hammer from the crates just to the south of the shipyard.

label: Take a saw if needed
detail: (If needed) take a saw from the same crates.

label: Board the gangplank to the raft
detail: Board the gangplank onto your raft.

label: Build a cargo hold on the raft
detail: Build a cargo hold in the raft's facility hotspot using the hammer and saw.

label: Disembark back to the Pandemonium
detail: Disembark the gangplank.

label: Return to the Pandemonium and get the Captain's log
detail: Talk to Junior Jim again to return to the Pandemonium; he gives you a Captain's log.

label: Board the raft north-east
detail: Board the gangplank to the north-east; requires free hands with no weapon equipped to carry cargo later.

label: Sail north to Port Sarim
detail: Navigate north through Mudskipper Sound and the Bay of Sarim until you reach Port Sarim; optionally use the buoy to dock.

label: Disembark at Port Sarim
detail: Disembark the gangplank at the Port Sarim docks.

label: Take cargo from the ledger table
detail: Take cargo from the ledger table near the Port Sarim docks.

label: Board the raft again
detail: Board the gangplank again with the cargo.

label: Store the cargo in the hold
detail: Open the basic cargo hold and store the cargo inside it.

label: Sail back to the Pandemonium
detail: Navigate back to the docks at the Pandemonium.

label: Withdraw the cargo from the hold
detail: Open the basic cargo hold and withdraw the cargo.

label: Disembark with the cargo
detail: Disembark the gangplank.

label: Deliver the cargo at the ledger table
detail: Deposit the cargo at the ledger table.

label: Tell Junior Jim the cargo is delivered
detail: Talk to Junior Jim to let him know you delivered his cargo.

label: Report to Steve Beanie to finish
detail: Talk to 'Squawking' Steve Beanie in the pub for an update on Will and Anne to complete the quest.

label: Talk to Redbeard Frank at the pub north of Port Sarim dock
detail: Ask Redbeard Frank about the pirate treasure story and agree to search for it; he asks you to bring him rum.

hints.value: 1I'm in search of treasure.
1Ok, I will bring you some rum

label: Sail from Port Sarim to Karamja (30 coins)
detail: Talk to Seaman Thresnor, Seaman Lorris, or Captain Tobias on the south-west docks and pay the 30 coin fare to cross to Karamja.

label: Buy a Karamjan rum from the bar west of the dock (30 coins)
detail: Head west to the Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers bar and buy one Karamjan rum; do not try to leave the island with it in hand.

label: Pick 10 bananas from the nearby trees
detail: Gather ten bananas from the trees near the plantation to fill Luthas' crate; be careful not to eat any.

label: Talk to Luthas about the customs workers
detail: Ask Luthas the banana farmer about the customs officer to open the conversation about smuggling rum.

hints.value: 2That customs officer is annoying isn't she?

label: Ask Luthas for a job on the plantation
detail: Talk to Luthas again and ask him for employment so you can access the outside crate.

hints.value: 1Could you offer me employment on your plantation?

label: Fill the outside crate with rum and bananas
detail: Place the Karamjan rum in the crate outside (not the one in the bedroom), then right-click Fill to add the 10 bananas.

hints.value: Two crates exist on the plantation; the bedroom crate is a decoy, only the outside crate works.

label: Talk to Luthas to collect your payment
detail: Speak to Luthas again once the crate is filled to receive your wages.

hints.value: Wiki does not state the payment amount; left as "??" rather than guessed.

label: Sail back to Port Sarim
detail: Take the boat back to Port Sarim; the crew asks about your cargo on the return trip.

hints.value: 1Can I journey on this ship?
2Search away, I have nothing to hide.

label: Take a white apron from Gerrant's Fishy Business
detail: Pick up a free white apron inside Gerrant's Fishy Business fishing store in Port Sarim.

label: Equip the white apron
detail: Wear the apron so Wydin will recognise you as suitable to hire.

label: Ask Wydin for a job while wearing the white apron
detail: Talk to Wydin in the food store south of Gerrant's while wearing the white apron to get hired.

hints.value: 4Well, can I get a job here?

label: Search the crate for the smuggled rum
detail: Search the crate marked with a banana on it to retrieve the rum Luthas smuggled through for you.

label: Give the rum to Redbeard Frank for the chest key
detail: Hand the rum over to Redbeard Frank; he gives you a chest key in return.

hints.value: 1Ok thanks, I'll go and get it.

label: Travel to the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock
detail: Head upstairs inside the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.

label: Open the chest with the key and read the pirate message
detail: Use the chest key on the chest in the room directly west upstairs, then read the pirate message inside for the treasure's location.

label: Head to Falador Park
detail: Travel to Falador Park, the location pointed to by the pirate message.

label: Get a spade from the Estate Agent's house if you don't have one
detail: Optional: the Estate Agent's house on the park's south-west side, next to the study desk, has a free spade if you didn't bring your own.

hints.value: Only needed if you don't already own a spade; skip if you have one.

label: Dig at the marked spot in Falador Park
detail: Dig at the marked spot in Falador Park; this spawns a level-4 Gardener.

label: Defeat or evade the Gardener
detail: Fight and defeat the level-4 Gardener that spawns, or simply run away far enough to make him despawn instead.

label: Dig again to unearth the treasure casket
detail: Dig the same spot again after dealing with the Gardener to receive the buried treasure casket, completing the quest.

label: Talk to Sir Amik Varze on White Knights' Castle's upper floor
detail: Sir Amik, in the western section of White Knights' Castle, explains the Temple Knights want to test your problem-solving; agree to take part.

hints.value: 1Yes please

label: Bank all equipped items and inventory before the test
detail: Empty your inventory and equipment into the bank; Hardcore Ironmen lose their status if they die to Sir Leye during the test.

hints.value: Hardcore Ironman status is lost on death to Sir Leye specifically.

label: Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in the park to begin the test
detail: Speak to Sir Tiffy Cashien to start the 5-room puzzle gauntlet.

hints.value: 3Yes, let's go!

label: Pick up the Steel warhammer in Sir Kuam Ferentse's room
detail: Take the Steel warhammer sitting in Sir Kuam Ferentse's room; this room always appears since Sir Leye is fought every playthrough.

label: Equip the Steel warhammer
detail: Wear the warhammer so the killing blow on Sir Leye is not landed with a bladed weapon.

label: Defeat Sir Leye
detail: Fight and defeat Sir Leye with the warhammer or unarmed; any bladed weapon on the killing blow fails the room. Prayer is allowed.

label: Solve 4 more puzzle rooms drawn at random from a pool of 6
detail: Besides Sir Leye's guaranteed fight, 4 of 6 remaining rooms appear in random order each playthrough: Lady Table's statue-colour memory test (only ~10 seconds to answer), Sir Ren Itchood's door clue from the first letter of each sentence he says, Sir Tinley's silent-conversation room, Sir Spishyus's chicken/grain/fox river-crossing puzzle, Ms Hynn Terprett's multiple-choice riddle set, and Miss Cheevers' two-door bookshelf-and-chemistry puzzle.

until.state: 4 of the 6 non-Leye rooms cleared, random selection and order per playthrough

hints.value: Lady Table's room only allows ~10 seconds to find and select the answer once entered.

Miss Cheevers' room is a two-stage bookshelf/chemistry puzzle; full item-by-item steps are on the cited Quick guide rather than unrolled here since exact bookshelf contents can vary in presentation but not substance.

label: Talk to Hetty in her house in Rimmington
detail: Ask Hetty about a quest and agree to help her become one with her darker side.

hints.value: 1 I am in search of a quest.
1 Yes, help me become one with my darker side.

label: Kill a rat in the archery store west of Hetty's house
detail: Kill a rat inside the archery shop directly west of Hetty's house for a rat's tail.

label: Buy an eye of newt from Betty (3gp)
detail: Purchase one eye of newt from Betty's shop for 3 coins.

label: Travel to the chapel south of Port Sarim
detail: Head to the small chapel south of Port Sarim to find a giant rat.

label: Kill the giant rat at the chapel for raw rat meat
detail: Defeat the giant rat inside the chapel and take the raw rat meat it drops.

label: Run back to Hetty's house in Rimmington
detail: Return to Hetty's house carrying the raw rat meat.

label: Burn the raw rat meat on Hetty's fireplace
detail: Use the raw rat meat on Hetty's fireplace to burn it; if it cooks instead of burning, use it on the fireplace again to burn it properly.

hints.value: Wiki does not name the burnt meat product item; left as "??" rather than guessed.

label: Pick an onion from the field north of Rimmington
detail: Harvest one onion from the field patch north of Rimmington.

label: Talk to Hetty carrying all four items
detail: Bring the rat's tail, eye of newt, burnt rat meat, and onion to Hetty; she starts brewing once all four are delivered.

hints.value: Wiki does not state whether the items are handed over on this talk or when drinking the cauldron; modeled here as that is the described exchange point.

label: Drink from Hetty's cauldron
detail: Drink the finished potion from the cauldron to complete Witch's Potion.

label: Talk to Veos in The Sheared Ram, Lumbridge
detail: Ask Veos about a quest to begin X Marks the Spot.

hints.value: 1I'm looking for a quest.
1Sounds good, what do I do?
If Great Kourend has already been visited, the opening options differ: "1 Can I help?" then "1 Sounds good, what do I do?"

label: Dig at the first clue spot by Bob's Brilliant Axes
detail: Dig right under the north-westernmost window of the small room attached to Bob's Brilliant Axes, one tile west of the plant against the wall.

label: Dig at the second clue spot behind Lumbridge Castle
detail: Dig just outside the kitchen door on the castle's south-west side, one tile south-west of the large crate.

label: Travel to Draynor Village
detail: Walk to Draynor Village, or teleport there with an Amulet of glory.

label: Dig at the third clue spot near the Draynor jail
detail: Dig north-west of the Draynor Village jail, by the wheat farm, four tiles north of the bush near Leela.

label: Dig at the fourth clue spot in the pig pen
detail: Dig in the pig pen next to Martin the Master Gardener to unearth the ancient casket.

label: Use the ancient casket on Veos at the Port Sarim docks
detail: Find Veos at the Port Sarim docks, south of the Rusty Anchor Inn, and use the ancient casket on him to complete the quest.

label: Talk to Jamila in Sophanem to begin the quest
detail: Speak with Jamila to start Beneath Cursed Sands and receive a message to read.

hints.value: What's this special item?
Yes.

label: Travel to Maisa's campsite east of Sophanem
detail: Head north from the small mining site by the cliffs, or exit via Sophanem's south-eastern gate for a shorter route; after a first visit, a level-62 Agility fairy ring shortcut (code AKP) reaches the necropolis directly.

label: Talk to Maisa at the campsite
detail: Agree to accompany Maisa; if carrying a Pharaoh's sceptre, commune with the nearby obelisk to unlock a direct 'Jaltevas' teleport back here afterward.

hints.value: Let's go.

label: Inspect the blocked entrance to Jaltevas Pyramid
detail: Examine the sealed pyramid entry before speaking with someone nearby about it.

label: Talk to a citizen or Menaphite Guard about the blockage
detail: Ask a nearby NPC about the sealed pyramid entrance to trigger the guard confrontation.

label: Defeat the Head Menaphite Guard without Protect from Melee
detail: The level-174 guard deals roughly a third of max hitpoints through Protect from Melee, so fight without it (boosting prayers like Piety are still fine).

label: Report back to Maisa after the fight
detail: Speak to Maisa to close out the Entranced Menaphites chapter.

label: Return to Maisa's camp
detail: Head back to the campsite to continue the quest chain.

label: Talk to Maisa to proceed to the Ruins of Ullek
detail: Speak with her to move on to the next chapter.

label: Get a tinderbox from the camp equipment if needed
detail: Search the camping equipment by the tent; skip this if you already carry a tinderbox.

label: Pick up the spade at the north side of the campsite
detail: A spade is available there if you don't already own one.

label: Travel south then north to the Ruins of Ullek stairs
detail: From the campsite go south, east around the cliffs, then north to the stairway down.

label: Light the furnace with coal and a tinderbox
detail: Use coal then the tinderbox on the furnace to ignite it for later use.

label: Search the well for a stone tablet and read it
detail: The well can also refill waterskins while you're there.

label: Dig up and open the passcode-locked chest by the ritual pillar
detail: Dig in front of the southernmost ritual pillar to reveal a locked chest, then enter the passcode to open it.

label: Craft a scarab emblem at the furnace
detail: Return north to the lit furnace with the scarab mould and an iron bar to craft the emblem.

label: Head further north to the inner pillar
detail: Continue past the furnace to the next pillar.

label: Insert the scarab emblem into the pillar
detail: Place the crafted emblem into the pillar's slot.

label: Rotate the scarab so its pincers face upward
detail: The scarab must face downward overall with its pincers pointing up to solve the mechanism.

label: Defeat the two Scarab Mages guarding the stairs down
detail: Logging out mid-fight places you back outside the cave, so try to finish the fight in one sitting.

label: Climb down the stairs again to the trap corridor
detail: Descend further into the ruins.

label: Dodge the projectiles to the junction, then reach the first lever
detail: Head west to the junction, then south and east, avoiding the corridor's trap projectiles.

label: Pull the first lever and race back to the junction
detail: The lever resets after roughly a minute, so hurry back to the junction then follow the path north and east.

label: Pull the second lever to disable the traps
detail: Successfully pulling this lever at the far end disables the corridor's traps.

label: Go through the door west of the junction
detail: Proceed to the next area.

label: Inspect the south-western plaque for four emblems
detail: Collect all four emblem types (Scarab, Human, Crocodile, Baboon) from the plaque before solving the puzzle.

label: Read the north-western plaque for the riddle clues
detail: The riddle text is unique per player and maps items/gods to urn positions using the Emblem/God/Item table.

label: Place each emblem in its riddle-matched urn
detail: Match each clue's item or god to its emblem and place it in the centre-south, southernmost, northernmost, or centre-north urn per your own riddle text.

hints.value: Player-specific solution — cross-reference the clue text against the Emblem/God/Item table rather than a fixed answer.

label: Pull the lever to the south-west to continue
detail: Proceed after solving the urn puzzle.

label: Speak to the Spirit in the next room
detail: Continue the chapter's dialogue.

label: Take the rusty key from the urn at the back of the room
detail: Needed to unlock the boss-room door in the next chapter.

label: Return and unlock the door with the rusty key
detail: The door to the boss room only needs to be unlocked once; resupply for a ranged fight before opening it.

label: Defeat the Champion of Scabaras using ranged from a distance
detail: Use Protect from Magic and stay out of melee range; destroy its 20hp Shadow Rift quickly, kill its poison scarab swarm fast, and stay away from melee range to dodge its 4-tile Shadow Burst.

label: Talk to the High Priest of Scabaras
detail: Wrap up the chapter's conversation.

label: Travel to Nardah and find Maisa or Zahur
detail: They are in the building directly south of the fountain.

label: Talk to Zahur about curing the pox
detail: Learn what's needed for the cure.

label: Buy raw beef or cooked meat from the Nardah General Store if you don't have any
detail: Needed to lure the crocodile at the River Elid.

label: Head west to the River Elid lily island
detail: Find the stepping stones near the lilies.

label: Throw the meat to the crocodile from the stepping stones
detail: Distract the crocodile so you can reach the lily.

label: Pick the Lily of the Elid
detail: Collect the flower needed for Zahur's cure.

label: Head back to Zahur's building
detail: Return to Nardah.

label: Balance Zahur's heat puzzle to brew the pox cure
detail: Max the middle and right-hand bars, drop the right-hand bar to half, then lower the middle bar until the mixture is complete.

label: Talk to Zahur to receive the cure crate
detail: Collect the finished cure.

label: Deliver the cure crate to the High Priest in Sophanem
detail: Gear up for a melee fight against a level-351 boss before heading to the necropolis afterward.

label: Head to the necropolis and find Maisa
detail: She's directly south of Sophanem's south-eastern gate, by the bend in the path.

label: Talk to Maisa to trigger the cutscene
detail: Start the final boss encounter.

label: Defeat the Menaphite Akh with melee
detail: Watch for her twitch before a lightning-bolt attack (stand behind or beside her to dodge it) and kill her summoned Menaphite Shadow quickly or it can swap places with her.

hints.value: Speak to Osman outside camp to restart the fight if you leave; deaths let you reclaim items at the same spot.

label: Return to Sophanem
detail: Head back after defeating the Akh.

label: Talk to Maisa or the High Priest to finish the quest
detail: Completing this conversation finishes Beneath Cursed Sands.

label: Switch to the Ancient Magicks spellbook before starting
detail: Required before entering the Ancient Vault to begin the quest.

detail: Found south-east of fairy ring code dlq or north-east of Nardah.

detail: Continue the serum-brewing sequence.

detail: Stops the strangled from rooting you or forcing a restart, though normal damage still applies.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Defeat Vardorvis
detail: Weak to slash weapons; dodge the arena's axe spawns (or accept the bleed), avoid the prayer-disabling blue dart with Protect from Missiles, and click the blood splats when he roots you to avoid heavy damage.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

detail: You are about to fight another boss immediately after.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

detail: Return to deliver the key.

label: Talk to Kasonde
detail: Trigger his own boss fight.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Defeat Kasonde
detail: Pray Protect from Missiles and kite while using Ranged; avoid green venom splats and orange splats that disable protection prayers, block his charge attack behind a pillar, and out-DPS his continual healing to finish him.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

detail: Continue to the next room.

detail: Learn about the three puzzle passages ahead.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

detail: Which passage you arrive in varies by player, but all three must be solved before Perseriya's ships open; a slayer helmet or facemask is required for the second and third passages, and leaving The Scar resets any completed puzzles.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

detail: Hit the creatures (diagonally or directly) to navigate them to their matching terminal while dodging randomly-striking lightning.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

detail: Combine breakable nerve endings (fire+water=steam, fire+earth=lava, earth+air=dust, fire+air=smoke) to gather 3 fire, 2 air, 2 earth, and 1 water nerve, then repair the endings in the middle of the room; use air bubbles to regenerate oxygen.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Clear the Summoning Circle room
detail: Kill the four scarred imps providing protection prayers to the circled demons, then kill the demons themselves (they also summon scarred lesser demons and hellhounds to deter you).

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Collect the shipwreck room items

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Burn the east section of the ship
detail: Completes the Middle passage.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

detail: Begin the North-west passage.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Solve the Abyssal Stem puzzle underwater
detail: With both hands empty, touch the central abyssal stem, then touch the four abyssal growths in the same order they light up; swim into air bubbles to regain oxygen.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Defend the Brain Pillar from creatures
detail: Protect the abyssal antibodies healing the pillar -- freeze spells don't work well here, and losing all antibodies forces you out of the room with major damage.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Kill the creatures guarding the crimson and radiant veins
detail: They attack with blood spells that Protect from Magic seems to negate; drops crimson and radiant fibre.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

detail: Also take illuminating lures from the light leeches to repair the 4 luminescent growths until both veins appear.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

detail: Tinderbox from the north-east crate, gunpowder from the south-east skeleton, slimy key from the north-west skeleton, and a damp tablet from the chest at the south end -- read it before burning the ship.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

detail: Push the green/orange cerebral orb pathfinders and pathbreakers south, east, south, west, east, then south in sequence to reach and touch the tether, staying on circle tiles to avoid chip damage.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Solve the Catalyst puzzle
detail: Combine nerves (Fire+Air=Smoke, Mind+Mind=Soul, Mind+Water=Blood, Water+Earth=Nature, Soul+Nature=Cosmic, Cosmic+Earth=Astral, Smoke+Blood=Wrath) to match and destroy whatever form the central catalyst cycles to.

hints.value: Dropping any item while solving this puzzle moves it to another instance and makes it unobtainable -- carry only what you're willing to lose.

detail: Use illuminating lures from light leeches to repair the 4 luminescent growths, then solve the resulting order puzzle by trial and error until all elemental lights turn white.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

detail: Completes the South-east passage -- all three ships are now burned.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

detail: Use Ranged with Shadow spells to stun it; pray Protect from Magic on blue attacks, Missiles on green, and Melee on orange. Landing a shadow spell stuns it -- shoot its back for bonus damage and brace for a follow-up special; it speeds up and adds orange orbs as the fight progresses.
