detail: Unlocks fast travel around the Lassar Undercity as you explore it.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Collect the five coloured shadow keys and the shadow blocker schematic
detail: Green and the schematic from the north-western Science District building, purple from the building south of it, and blue/white/red from further buildings uncovered while clearing tentacles in the Shadow Realm.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Trade each recovered schematic to Ketla for its finished shadow device
detail: Produces the shadow blocker, then in turn the basic, superior, and perfected shadow torches, the revitalising idol, and the anima portal as their schematics are found.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Destroy the shadow tentacles blocking doors across the districts
detail: Clears access to each building holding a key or schematic; some require the shadow blocker placed nearby first.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Touch the revitalising idol in the Shadow Realm to restore sanity
detail: Place it near a teleporter first; restores 50% sanity per use and can be repeated as needed.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Light the four braziers around the locked Palace chest
detail: Required to open the chest.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Open the Palace chest for the perfected shadow torch schematic
detail: Requires the shadow blocker, anima portal, and revitalising idol placed as directed nearby.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Touch the remnant upstairs in the pub
detail: Viewing the remnant does not lower sanity.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Combine the two icon segments into the strange icon
detail: One half comes from the square building's chest, the other from the South Science District tentacle room.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Talk with Ketla using the strange icon
detail: Continue toward the pillar interaction.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Enter the drain in the centre of the Residential District
detail: Head down the ladder to the east.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Interact with the ancient pillar
detail: Advances the chapter's story.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Finish the conversation with Ketla and collect the perfected shadow torch
detail: Search her workbench once the conversation ends.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Destroy the tentacles blocking the entrance to the Sunken Cathedral
detail: Clears the way to the final boss.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Defeat the Whisperer
detail: Weak to Magic; the fight requires frequent prayer switching to match its attack patterns.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Find the hair clip in the bed
detail: Needed to unlock the rigged cell you wake up in.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Unlock the cell door with the hair clip
detail: Escape the cell.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Retrieve your items from the chest to the east
detail: Regear before continuing.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Inspect the altar to the west
detail: Continue the finale sequence.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Fight the Mysterious Figure
detail: It freezes you before launching dangerous orbs -- spam-click to break free and dodge; if you die or leave, resume via the portal south of the Bandit Camp Quarry.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Enter the Ancient Vault and finish the cutscene
detail: All four medallions are now placed.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Defeat the Forsaken Assassin
detail: Lure him into white smoke bombs and dodge his poison bottles; avoid the pink smoke bombs, which heal him and damage you.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Defeat Ketla the Unworthy
detail: Pray Protect from Missiles; dart down all but two of her summoned clones and stand behind the survivors so they tank her special attack.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Defeat Kasonde the Craven
detail: Pray Protect from Missiles and dodge his corruption bottles; avoid his shockwave/slam special by standing on the tiles not marked with a shadow.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Defeat Persten the Deceitful
detail: Pray Protect from Magic; quickly close his leech-spawning portal or kite the spawns, and dodge his lightning special by running to the open tiles.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Finish the conversation with Azzanadra
detail: Completes Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire.

refs.title: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire/Quick guide

label: Fairy-ring teleport to Uzer Oasis (code DLQ)
detail: Quickest route to the starting area.

label: Talk to Elias White at Uzer Oasis
Enter the Uzer Mastaba on top of the hill to the south
Search the southernmost skeleton for a mastaba key
detail: Head south to the cave beyond the first room to find it.

label: Search the skeleton near the stone boat for a second mastaba key
detail: In the central room with the stone boat, search the skeleton north-west of it.

label: Disable the trap set at the south-east corner of the tomb
detail: Search the odd wall markings to disable the traps, then pull the lever.

label: Disable the trap set at the north-east corner, east of the imposing doors
detail: Mirror the south-east corner: search the wall markings, then pull the lever.

label: Open the imposing doors to the west
Kill the golem guard
detail: When the screen shakes it performs a prayer-piercing attack hitting up to 28 three times in succession; move one tile away to avoid it.

label: Climb the stairs and cross the coloured tiles
detail: Step on either the blue-and-green pair or the yellow-and-red pair on the south side; stepping on the wrong pair mid-crossing deals moderate damage.

label: Pull the lever on the far side of the coloured tiles to disable them
Search the shelves in the north of the burial chamber for a canopic jar
Inspect the southern mural in the Tumeken statue room
Use 3 dwellberries on the canopic jar
Use the ring of life on the canopic jar afterward

hints.value: You can log out and back in to quickly exit the mastaba.

label: Talk to Elias again
Travel to Trollweiss Dungeon via the path north-west of Trollheim, towards the ice gate
detail: Enter the dungeon directly west of the ice gate.

label: Activate Protect from Melee before continuing through the dungeon
Follow the tunnel north to the crevasse, then reach the cave at the summit of Trollweiss Mountain
detail: Enter the crevasse to reach the summit, then once outside run directly east into the cave.

label: Mine through the rubble piles blocking the cave passages until you reach the end of the dungeon
detail: Each rubble pile can only be mined once from a given side, so you may need to circle around to clear it from another direction.

label: Head up the stairs and speak to Arrav
Search the tapestry for the base plans and base key
detail: Use the unlocked door to the east to reach the room with the tapestry.

label: Return to Elias at the Uzer Oasis
Talk to Elias with the base plans and key
Make your way to the entrance of Zemouregal's Base, north of the Digsite
Talk to Elias again at the base entrance
Enter the base and make your way through the dungeon to the kitchen
detail: The kitchen is marked by a cooking-range icon; enter it through the gate.

label: Wear your insulated boots before entering the sewer
Enter the sewer via the pipe on the kitchen's southern wall, then exit through the pipe at the far end of the path
Search the western table in the southern room for the decoder strips
Open the chest for the code key
Read the code key and note the four-letter code
Enter the four-letter code into the decoder strips at the metal doors
detail: Each strip is numbered 0-9 with an order 1-4; use the up/down arrows to set each digit, then the right arrow to confirm it.

label: Equip your crossbow and mith grapple before the fire traps
Click the metal bars above the fire traps to climb over them
Attempt to take Arrav's heart to trigger the boss cutscene
Activate Protect from Melee for the fight with Arrav
detail: Every three attacks Arrav swings his axe for up to 26 damage in the direction he's facing -- move adjacent or behind him, or unequip your weapon and face him to catch the axe for bonus damage instead. Armoured zombies spawn with 10 HP each and leave venom pools that poison for up to 4 damage per tick if you stand in them.

label: Defeat Arrav to complete the quest
detail: Finish watching the cutscene and the dialogue afterward.

label: Talk to the High Priest in Sophanem to start the quest

hints.value: 1 Sounds like a quest for me; I can't turn that down! -> 4 Is there any way into Menaphos from below?

label: Head to the north-eastern building in Sophanem
Talk to Jex

hints.value: 2 Better get down there.

label: Climb down the ladder then the trapdoor into the dungeon
Activate Protect from Magic and turn off auto-retaliate before the labyrinth
detail: Recommended precautions for the trap-filled maze ahead.

label: Follow the tile-marker path through the labyrinth to the ladder
detail: Green markers show the correct direction at forks, yellow markers show tiles to step on carefully around traps, red markers are other warnings. Floor and wall traps deal 10% of current HP plus 10 damage if triggered; crusher blocks deal 8 damage on a failed diagonal crossing; sand pits spawn a scarab swarm if stepped on; one scarab trap on this path drops you a level into multi-combat if triggered, so avoid standing directly under it.

label: Search Kaleef's body
Read the parchment for the next lead
Talk to Maisa to the west

hints.value: 2 Draynor Village -> 3 Leela

label: Speak to Osman in front of the Al Kharid palace

hints.value: 2 I want to talk to you about Sophanem -> 3 It would drive a wedge between the Menaphite cities.

label: Travel to Sophanem and speak to Osman again outside the gates

hints.value: 3 I know of a secret entrance to the north.

label: Enter the instanced dungeon and navigate the tunnels back to the ladder
detail: This is a separate instanced version of the same tunnels traversed earlier.

label: Kill the level 191 Giant Scarab
detail: Safespottable near Kaleef's body with Protect from Missiles if maging or ranging it; it can still spawn mages and riders that attack you, and it can extinguish bullseye lanterns, so bring a tinderbox.

label: Talk to Osman after defeating the Giant Scarab
Optionally pick up Keris for the Desert hard diary
detail: Do not teleport out if pursuing the Desert hard diary task; instead return to the maze and kill a locust rider with Keris.

label: Return to Sophanem
Talk to the High Priest to complete the quest
Talk to Lazim to start the statue-building task
detail: Approach Lazim, north-east of the Bandit Camp Quarry, and accept the job through the dialogue.

hints.value: Of course! / Okay, I'll get on with it.

label: Gather 32kg of sandstone for the statue base
detail: Collect sandstone in any combination of pieces totalling 32kg (weight, not a piece count); big pieces can be broken down with a chisel.

label: Chisel the 32kg of sandstone into the statue base
detail: Use a chisel on the assembled 32kg of sandstone and place the finished base on the flat ground to start the statue.

label: Gather 20kg of sandstone for the statue body
detail: Repeat the sandstone collection for the body piece, again as a 20kg weight total rather than a fixed piece count.

label: Chisel the 20kg of sandstone into the statue body
detail: Chisel the assembled 20kg of sandstone into the body and set it onto the base, then chisel the combined statue to finish shaping it.

label: Talk to Lazim and choose a head design
detail: Talk to Lazim and pick any head design for the statue; remember which one is chosen, since a wrong head must be remade.

label: Mine two 5kg granite pieces
detail: Mine granite (not sandstone) for the head: one 5kg piece is carved now, the other is carried to the middle floor for later. Ironman accounts mine a third piece of any size for King's Ransom (out of scope here).

label: Carve the chosen head from a 5kg granite piece
detail: Chisel one of the 5kg granite pieces into the head design chosen earlier and give it to Lazim to fit onto the statue.

label: Top up clay or coal if not already carried
detail: Only needed if not already carrying soft clay or coal: mine some now, since both are needed on the middle floor later.

hints.value: conditional — skip if already carrying clay and coal

label: Talk to Lazim to fall into the buried temple
detail: Hand over the finished statue by talking to Lazim, which triggers the fall into the temple below.

label: Talk to Lazim on the bottom floor
detail: Talk to Lazim after landing. Optionally climb the ladder and sand pile next to the statue now to unlock exiting/entering the temple from any outer room later.

hints.value: optional shortcut — climb ladder+sand pile now for later outer-room access

label: Chisel the fallen statue four times for its limbs
detail: Use a chisel on the fallen statue four times to collect all four limbs.

label: Talk to Lazim again to retrieve the statue head
detail: Talk to Lazim a second time to get the fallen statue's head.

label: Take the M sigil from the pedestal
detail: Take the M sigil from the pedestal south of Lazim; this step can be skipped and returned to later if short on inventory space.

label: Collect the R, K and Z sigils around the outer hallways
detail: Walk the outer hallway rooms to pick up the R, K and Z sigils; the matching limb is automatically used and consumed to open each door.

label: Head to the centre room
detail: Once all four sigils are collected, walk to the centre room of the bottom floor.

label: Place all four sigils to open the centre doors
detail: Try to open each door with its sigil, completing the dialogue each time.

label: Climb the ladder to the middle floor
detail: Climb the ladder up from the centre room to reach the middle floor.

label: Use soft clay on the pedestal
detail: Mould soft clay onto the pedestal; cast a fire spell on the frozen fountain first if a water source is still needed for the clay.

label: Chisel the remaining 5kg granite piece
detail: Chisel the second 5kg granite piece (carried from the statue build) into a new stone head for the pedestal.

label: Fit the new stone head onto the pedestal
detail: Place the newly carved head into the pedestal — the original head is slightly too small, but the new one fits and triggers a cutscene; finish the dialogue.

label: Feed Pentyn in the north-west corner
detail: Use bread, cake or pie on Pentyn; right-click again on Pentyn if the food is applied to the spell instead.

hints.value: It's okay, I don't need any help.

label: Cast a wind spell on the furnace in the north-east corner
detail: Cast Wind Bolt, Wind Blast, Wind Wave or Wind Surge on the furnace.

label: Cast a fire spell on the fountain in the south-west corner
detail: Cast Fire Bolt, Fire Blast, Fire Wave or Fire Surge on the frozen fountain.

label: Light all six braziers in the south-east corner
detail: Light the six braziers with their fuels; each brazier needs a specific fuel from logs, oak logs, willow logs, maple logs, a candle or coal — the quick guide does not spell out which fuel matches which brazier, so match by trial and error or a per-brazier hint.

hints.value: exact fuel-to-brazier pairing is not stated on the fetched page — "??"

label: Pass the magic barrier and climb to the top floor
detail: With all four corner puzzles solved, walk through the now-open magic barrier and climb the ladder; talk to Lazim if the barrier still won't open.

label: Cast Crumble Undead on the first boneguard
detail: Cast Crumble Undead on the boneguard blocking the way to destroy it and open the path south.

label: Climb down the stone ladder to the south
detail: Climb down the stone ladder south of the defeated boneguard.

label: Turn on Protect from Melee
detail: Activate the Protect from Melee prayer before approaching the second boneguard.

label: Talk to the second boneguard
detail: With Protect from Melee active, talk to the new boneguard.

hints.value: Of course, I'll help you out. / Okay, I'll start building.

label: Take three sandstones from the rubble pile
detail: Collect three sandstone pieces from the nearby rubble pile.

label: Patch the southern wall with sandstone
detail: Use a sandstone piece on the southern wall, then chisel it into place; repeat for all three pieces to complete the repair.

label: Talk to the boneguard to finish the quest
detail: Talk to the boneguard again to complete Enakhra's Lament.

label: Minigame-teleport to the Giants' Foundry
detail: Use the Minigame Teleport option to travel directly to Giants' Foundry.

label: Talk to Kovac at the Giants' Plateau
detail: Speak to Kovac, who is striking a Hill Giant on the Giants' Plateau, to begin.

hints.value: Yes.

label: Enter the Giants' Foundry
detail: Walk inside the Giants' Foundry building.

label: Repair the polishing wheel
detail: Use the required repair items on the broken polishing wheel; the exact item-to-machine split isn't spelt out — bring the full needed list (oak logs, wool, nails, hammer, chisel, bucket of water or ice gloves).

hints.value: per-machine item split not stated by the fetched text

label: Repair the grindstone
detail: Use the required repair items on the broken grindstone.

label: Repair the trip hammer
detail: Use the required repair items on the broken trip hammer.

label: Talk to Kovac twice
detail: Speak to Kovac twice in a row to proceed.

label: Search the crate for items
detail: Search the nearby crate to find items to deposit into the crucible; the crate's exact contents aren't named on the fetched page.

label: Deposit the found items into the crucible
detail: Deposit everything found into the crucible (large bucket) hanging east near the bank; different item types are deposited separately.

label: Talk to Kovac to learn mould selection
detail: Speak to Kovac, who explains how to pick the correct moulds shown in red text.

label: Select the forte, blade and tip moulds at the mould jig
detail: Pick the three correctly-shaped mould pieces (forte, blade, tip) that Kovac described at the mould jig.

label: Talk to Kovac again to learn pouring
detail: Speak to Kovac again; he explains how to pour the metal.

label: Pour molten metal from the crucible into the mould
detail: Pour the metal from the crucible into the assembled mould.

label: Cool the poured sword with water
detail: Fill a bucket from the pile and use it on the waterfall, then pour it on the sword (or use ice gloves instead) — hands must be free to then pick up the preform.

label: Heat the preform to maximum on the lava pool
detail: Use the preform on the lava pool; Heat-preform raises heat in small increments while Dunk-preform heats it faster. Aim for maximum (red) heat.

label: Hammer the preform on the trip hammer
detail: Hit the preform with the repaired trip hammer, repeating until the progress bar reaches the yellow section; keep the temperature in the red band, since the hammer cools the preform and working outside the right heat band lowers sword quality.

label: Cool the preform in the waterfall
detail: Cool the preform at the waterfall until its temperature is almost green; Cool-preform is slow, Quench-preform is faster.

label: Grind the preform on the grindstone
detail: Use the preform on the repaired grindstone, repeating until progress reaches the green section; watch the temperature, since the grindstone reheats the preform.

label: Cool the preform in the waterfall again
detail: Cool the preform at the waterfall until its temperature is high green.

label: Polish the preform on the polishing wheel
detail: Use the preform on the polishing wheel, repeating until the sword is complete; watch the temperature, since the wheel cools the preform.

label: Talk to Kovac to finish the quest
detail: Speak to Kovac to hand in the finished sword and complete Sleeping Giants.

label: Talk to Rat Burgiss at the Varrock crossing
detail: Speak to Rat Burgiss at the crossing south of Varrock to start the quest.

hints.value: Shall I get them back for you? / Of course! Tell me what you need me to do.

detail: Pick up the rat's paper dropped by the killed Outlaws.

label: Fill the folder with the 5 papers
detail: Use the 5 collected rat's papers to fill the folder.

label: Return the filled folder to Rat Burgiss
detail: Hand the completed folder back to Rat Burgiss.

detail: Speak to Surok Magis in the northernmost room of Varrock Palace's library.

detail: Enter the Chaos Altar and use the wand on the altar with 15 chaos runes in your inventory; there is an alternative entrance that avoids the Wilderness (see the full guide).

hints.value: alternative non-Wilderness entrance exists per the full guide, not detailed in the Quick guide section fetched

label: Return the infused wand and an empty bowl to Surok Magis
detail: Bring the infused wand and an empty bowl back to Surok Magis.

hints.value: I have the things you wanted!

detail: Speak to Rat Burgiss to pass along what Surok Magis revealed.

hints.value: Yes! I have a letter for you!

detail: Speak to Zaff, sent by Rat Burgiss.

hints.value: Rat Burgiss sent me!

detail: Speak to Surok Magis, which starts the instanced fight against King Roald.

hints.value: Bring it on!

detail: Fight the instanced King Roald down to 2 hitpoints or less; do not finish him off with damage.

detail: Operate the Beacon ring once the chatbox shows "Now would be a good time to summon Zaff!"; this finishes off King Roald.

detail: Optional: grab the Dagon'hai history book before leaving the instance to hand to Historian Minas for 5 bonus Kudos after the quest.

detail: Speak to Rat Burgiss to complete What Lies Below.

detail: Speak to Dimintheis, south-east of Varrock, to start Family Pest.

hints.value: Have you got any quests for me? / Oh come on, however menial, I want to help!

detail: Travel to the Al Kharid mine, north of Al Kharid, to find Avan.

label: Talk to Avan
detail: Speak to Avan in the Al Kharid mine; he turns down help with a comic non-problem.

detail: Speak to Caleb in Catherby; he too turns down help.

detail: Speak to Johnathon upstairs in the Jolly Boar Inn; he also turns down help.

detail: Continues the citizen interviews.

Never add 4 coal at once -- a 'pop' sound just means restart the coal-feeding without exiting the interface; the process can finish using only 4-5 coal.

detail: Speak to the KGP Agent once more.

detail: Speak to the KGP Agent stationed at the end of the main hall by the control panel.

label: Talk to Ping or Pong in the east room
detail: Speak to either guard, Ping or Pong, in the east room.

label: Leave the outpost, unequip the suit, and talk to Larry
detail: Exit the outpost, head back to Larry, and remove the Clockwork suit.

label: Craft penguin bongos from mahogany plank and leather
detail: Use a mahogany plank on leather (not hard leather) to make penguin bongos.

label: Suit up again and re-enter the outpost
detail: Use the tuxedo-time option on Larry and head back into the outpost.

label: Play the bongos for Ping or Pong to distract them
detail: Talk to Ping or Pong again with the bongos to distract the guards.

hints.value: Yes.

label: Use the main hall control panel
detail: Operate the control panel in the main hall while the guards are distracted.

label: Enter the War Room to the east
detail: Head east into the now-unlocked War Room.

detail: Defeat the level 51 Icelords wielding icicles (1-3 per the held quest_db row, wiki text doesn't state an exact number) -- each grants a bonus 40 Attack xp -- then exit the pen through the west door.

hints.value: kill count varies 1-3 per held quest_db data; the fetched walkthrough text itself doesn't give an exact number

label: Return to the surface via the eastern chasm
detail: Use the chasm to the east of the room to climb back to the surface.

label: Report the penguin invasion plan to Larry to finish the quest

detail: Only available once you've spoken to the right guard; costs 5 coins.

hints.value: I'd like a Khali brew please.

detail: He drinks it and falls asleep, dropping the cell keys.

detail: Safespottable like the ogre.

hints.value: Purely optional — the quest completes either way.

hints.value: Talk about the Observatory quest.

detail: He's ready to show you the finished telescope.

The reward is randomly assigned per account from a fixed table (Aquarius/Aries/Cancer/etc, each with its own item+XP+uncut sapphire); which one a given playthrough gets isn't determinable from the walkthrough alone, so left as "??".

Yes.

detail: Needs a light source plus a knife or slash weapon.

detail: You must weigh -1kg or less (the boots alone are enough) or you'll fail and take 20 damage.

Take the lever inside
Cross the lava bridge again to head back
Attach the lever to the bracket on the wall west of the entry ladder
Pull the attached lever
detail: Triggers hidden machinery somewhere in the dungeon.

label: Go through the south gate and follow the icy path
Search chests along the icy path for ice arrows
detail: 16 arrows is enough with Ava's device and 60+ Ranged; re-search a chest right after it drops an arrow since the same chest can hit multiple times in a row, and search every chest to reset them (world-hopping no longer works for that).

label: Head back through the north gate (pendant equipped) and continue north to a small lever room
Search the lever for traps, then pull it
detail: Requires 42 Thieving.

Kill the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus (level 84) with ice arrows
detail: He spawns automatically when you try the second door; Protect from Magic negates his damage. Requires Ranged 40 to wield the ice-arrow bow; 60+ is recommended for efficient arrow farming above.

detail: Opens a dungeon shortcut from McGrubor's Wood.

hints.value: Optional — not required to finish the quest.

detail: You now choose a side: the walkthrough below follows the good path (siding with the Guardians); the evil path instead has you take the Staff of Armadyl straight off the table, possibly fighting a safespottable level 43 Guardian of Armadyl, then handing the staff to Lucien.

hints.value: Evil-path alternative folded in here rather than atomized separately: grab the staff (may require killing a level 43 Guardian), then give it to Lucien west of the Grand Exchange.

label: Remove the Pendant of Lucien
detail: Required before approaching a Guardian of Armadyl on the good path.

detail: Convince them you'll help rather than steal the staff for Lucien.

hints.value: I seek the Staff of Armadyl.
Lucien will give me a grand reward for it!
You're right, it's time for my yearly bath.
Ok! I'll help!

detail: The walkthrough doesn't spell out the exact hand-off, only that you now carry an Armadyl pendant instead.

Kill Lucien (level 14)
detail: Completes the good path and the quest.

label: Talk to Almera north-east of Baxtorian Falls

Talk to Hudon

hints.value: Must exhaust all dialogue options or the Book on Baxtorian never appears.

Enter the large building to the north where Hadley is
Search the southernmost bookcase upstairs on the eastern wall
Read the Book on Baxtorian, then close it again

Search the off-coloured crate east of the dungeon entrance for a key
Go west and unlock the gate with the key
Talk to Golrie

Use the pebble on the tombstone to enter the tomb
detail: The pebble isn't consumed by this.

detail: Weapons and armour can come back too if you left them.

Use the rope on the rock south across the water

Take the right path and search the northernmost crates for a key
Go back and take the left side, avoiding the fire giants

Place one air, one water, and one earth rune on each of the 3 pillars

detail: Either item satisfies this step.

Take Elena's picture off the table in the house
Speak to Edmond again
Pour 4 buckets of water on the mud patch behind the house

Try the barred building south of the town square, marked with an X

Talk to the Clerk in the main room

hints.value: I've planted seeds with my fists!

label: Ask Otto about pot-smashing farming
detail: Talk to Otto Godblessed again and ask about other bare-handed farming tricks.

hints.value: Are there any other fist related farming activities I can learn?

label: Plant a sapling by smashing its pot
detail: Plant any sapling in a free farming patch using a spade, smashing the sapling's pot in the process.

label: Report the pot-smashing success to Otto
detail: Talk to Otto again and tell him you smashed a pot while farming.

hints.value: I've smashed a pot whilst farming!

label: Ask Otto about barbarian spears
detail: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him to teach spear-smithing.

hints.value: Tell me more about the use of spears.

label: Forge exactly one bronze spear
detail: Use a bronze bar and a log on the nearby barbarian anvil to smith exactly one bronze spear, no more.

label: Ask Otto about spears again
detail: Talk to Otto about spears a second time to unlock the hasta topic.

hints.value: Tell me more about the use of spears.

label: Ask Otto about the one-handed hasta
detail: Ask Otto about hastae, the one-handed spears he just mentioned.

hints.value: What of the one-handed spears of which you spoke?

label: Forge one bronze hasta
detail: Use the second bronze bar and log on the barbarian anvil to smith a bronze hasta.

label: Report the hasta success to Otto
detail: Ask Otto about hastae again to confirm you've learned to smith one.

hints.value: What of the one-handed spears of which you spoke?

label: Ask Otto about barbarian herblore
detail: Talk to Otto Godblessed and ask him about the secret barbarian herblore knowledge.

hints.value: What was that secret knowledge of herblore we talked of?

label: Brew a barbarian potion from roe
detail: Use the roe saved from the fishing lesson on a 2-dose attack potion to make a barbarian potion; a knife is also listed as required.

label: Report the herblore success to Otto
detail: Talk to Otto again and tell him you made a barbarian potion.

hints.value: I've made a barbarian potion!

label: Ask Grish about the sick ogres
detail: Speak with Grish in Jiggig and offer to help investigate the zombified ogres.

hints.value: What do you mean sickies? -> Can I help in any way? -> Yes.

label: Get the ogre guard to remove the barricade
detail: Speak to the Ogre guard east of Grish so he clears the way into the Zogre-infested area.

label: Climb the barricade and descend into the cave
detail: Climb over the crushed barricade, run east to the stairs, and go down them.

label: Search the skeleton and defeat the zombie it spawns
detail: Search the skeleton next to the broken lecturn; a zombie appears and must be killed to get the ruined backpack.

hints.value: Under 89 combat, Zogre/Skogre attacks from here on can cause disease that lowers a random skill 10 levels roughly every minute -- carry super restore potions.

label: Open the ruined backpack
detail: Open the backpack to obtain a Dragon inn tankard, rotten food, and a knife.

label: Search the broken lecturn for the torn page
detail: Search the broken lecturn and keep the torn page it holds.

label: Cut open the coffin and search it for the black prism
detail: Use the knife on the coffin west of the skeleton, then search it (may take a few tries) for the black prism.

label: Show the tankard to the Yanille bartender
detail: Go to the Dragon Inn in Yanille and use the Dragon inn tankard on the bartender to begin identifying its owner.

label: Speak to Zavistic Rarve at the Wizards' Guild
detail: Find Zavistic Rarve inside the Wizards' Guild in Yanille (ring the bell out front if you lack the level to enter).

hints.value: I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres (only if Hand in the Sand already started)

label: Speak to the bedridden Sithik Ints
detail: Sithik is bedridden in the upstairs bedroom of the guest house north of the Wizards' Guild; ask to look around his room.

hints.value: Do you mind if I look around?

label: Search Sithik's drawers, cupboard, and wardrobe
detail: Search all three pieces of furniture in the room for a portraiture book, necromancy book, papyrus, charcoal, and a Book of H.A.M.

hints.value: More papyrus can be found here if a re-sketch is needed later.

label: Read all three found books
detail: Read the portraiture book, necromancy book, and Book of H.A.M before acting on them.

label: Use all three books on Sithik
detail: Use the portraiture book, necromancy book, and Book of H.A.M on Sithik in turn.

label: Use papyrus on Sithik to sketch his portrait
detail: Use papyrus on Sithik to sketch a portrait whose examine text must read a classic realist charcoal portrait of Sithik.

hints.value: A low Crafting level (1-10) reduces the odds of sketching a correct portrait on the first try; 20+ Crafting is recommended to speed this up -- soft speed factor, not a hard requirement.

label: Show the sketched portrait to Sithik
detail: Use the portrait on Sithik; he must appreciate its honesty, not just its truth.

label: Return to the Dragon Inn
detail: Head back to the Dragon Inn in Yanille to get the portrait signed.

label: Have the bartender sign the portrait
detail: Use the tankard then the portrait on the bartender; he signs the portrait as an affidavit.

label: Return to the Wizards' Guild
detail: Head back to Zavistic Rarve at the Wizards' Guild with the evidence in hand.

label: Present the evidence to Zavistic Rarve
detail: Speak to Zavistic Rarve while holding the necromancy book, Book of H.A.M, the tankard, and the signed portrait to receive a strange potion.

hints.value: I have some items that I'd like you to look at.
Text doesn't explicitly say whether the 4 items are truly consumed here vs merely checked -- modeled as consumed.

label: Spike Sithik's tea
detail: Use the strange potion on the cup of tea on top of Sithik's drawers.

label: Reset Sithik's dialogue by leaving and returning
detail: Go downstairs then back upstairs so Sithik has drunk the spiked tea before you talk to him.

label: Get the three secrets out of Sithik
detail: Question Sithik for the cures to the disease, the removal of the undead ogres, and the effects of the spell -- needed for Relicym's balm and Brutal arrows.

hints.value: How do I remove the effects of the spell from the area? / How do I get rid of the undead ogres / How do I get rid of the disease / Sorry, I have to go.

label: Report the culprit to Grish
detail: Tell Grish you found who's responsible for the Zogres; he gives you an ogre gate key for the ceremonial chamber.

hints.value: I found who's responsible for the Zogres being here.

label: Learn to equip a composite ogre bow
detail: Ask Grish about an easier way to kill Zogres to learn how to equip composite ogre bows.

hints.value: "??" (option 2, label text not given)

label: Chop an achey tree for logs
detail: Optional: cut an achey tree for logs to make a composite ogre bow instead of relying on Crumble Undead.

hints.value: Optional side-path; not required to finish the quest.

label: Make an unstrung comp bow
detail: Use a knife on the achey tree logs with wolf bones in your inventory and select box 2 to create an unstrung comp bow.

label: String the composite ogre bow
detail: String the unstrung bow with a bow string to finish it.

label: Brew Relicym's balm
detail: Optional: add a Rogue's purse to a vial of water then add snake weed to brew Relicym's balm; not needed for the quest itself but unlocks purchasing more from Uglug Nar.

hints.value: ge_violation: page also lists 'buy one from the Grand Exchange' as an alternative -- excluded per the never-GE-buy hard rule; only the gather/produce path is modeled.

label: Cut achey trees for arrow logs
detail: Optional: cut achey trees for logs to fletch brutal arrows instead of buying them.

hints.value: ge_violation: page also says 'if you have access to the Grand Exchange, just buy the arrows and skip this section' -- excluded per the never-GE-buy hard rule.

label: Fletch the logs into ogre arrow shafts
detail: Fletch the achey tree logs with a knife into ogre arrow shafts.

label: Add feathers to the arrow shafts
detail: Add feathers to the ogre arrow shafts to make flighted ogre arrows.

label: Nail the flighted arrows into brutal arrows
detail: With a hammer in your inventory, use nails on the flighted ogre arrows to finish them.

label: Head to the ceremonial chamber
detail: Return to Jiggig, travel west through both sets of doors, then go down the stairs.

label: Search the stand at the end of the chamber
detail: Follow the chamber to its end and search the stand to approach Slash Bash.

hints.value: No item result is stated for this search -- treated as a pure trigger.

label: Kill Slash Bash
detail: Fight the level-111 Slash Bash, who uses both Ranged and Melee; safe-spot with Protect from Missiles or use Crumble Undead.

label: Return to Grish to finish
detail: Report Slash Bash's defeat to Grish to complete the quest.

hints.value: "??" (option 1, label text not given)

label: Ask Halgrive about the sheep problem
detail: Speak to Councillor Halgrive outside the East Ardougne church; make sure you have at least 1 empty inventory slot first.

hints.value: What's wrong? -> I can do that for you.

label: Get the plague outfit from Doctor Orbon
detail: Speak to Doctor Orbon in the church to receive a plague jacket and trousers.

hints.value: Okay, I'll take it.

label: Put on the plague jacket and trousers
detail: Wear the plague jacket and trousers before entering the sheep enclosure.

label: Head to the sheep enclosure
detail: Walk to the enclosure north-west of the Ardougne north bank.

label: Pick up the cattleprod
detail: Pick up the cattleprod next to the incinerator.

label: Prod one sheep of each colour through the gate
detail: Wield the cattleprod and herd the blue (north-west), yellow (north), green (east), and red (south) sheep through the gate one at a time.

label: Feed the sheep poisoned feed until they die
detail: Feed the pen's sheep sheep feed repeatedly until all four are dead.

hints.value: Where sheep feed is obtained is never stated in the Quick guide -- left as an unstated pre-existing consumption per the never-fabricate-a-sourcing-step discipline.

label: Pick up the sheep bones
detail: Collect the bones left by the dead sheep.

label: Burn the bones on the incinerator
detail: Use the collected sheep bones on the incinerator to destroy the corpses.

label: Report back to Halgrive to finish
detail: Return to Councillor Halgrive to complete the quest.

label: Start the quest with Effigy
detail: Speak to Effigy south of East Ardougne to begin the quest.

hints.value: Sure, why not.

label: Speak to Bonafido at the tower entrance
detail: Bonafido asks you to get a builder's costume before entering.

label: Answer Black-eye's questions for the hat
detail: Talk to 'Black-eye' and answer his questions correctly to get the hard hat.

hints.value: Three -> Torn curtains -> 10 clay pieces

label: Give a beer to 'The Guns' for the shirt
detail: Hand a beer to 'The Guns' in exchange for the builder's shirt.

hints.value: Beer's acquisition point is not stated on the Quick guide.

label: Search the plants for the trousers
detail: Search the plants south-east of the tower (try south-west too if none found) for the builder's trousers.

label: Talk to 'No fingers'
detail: Speak to 'No fingers' before attempting to pickpocket him for the boots.

label: Pickpocket 'No fingers' for the boots
detail: Pickpocket 'No fingers' to obtain the builder's boots.

label: Wear the full builder's costume
detail: Equip the hat, shirt, trousers, and boots together.

label: Answer Bonafido's questions in costume
detail: Talk to Bonafido while wearing the full costume and answer his questions.

hints.value: Tea -> Whistle for attention -> Your legs are getting a bit cold -> Carry on, it'll fix itself

label: Enter the tower in costume
detail: Walk into the tower while still wearing the full builder's costume.

label: Take the pressure machine's supplies
detail: Search the crates inside the tower for 4 valve wheels, 3 metal sheets, and 4 coloured balls.

label: Head up to the pressure machine room
detail: Climb the first staircase on the west side of the tower.

label: Fix the pressure machine
detail: Fit the supplies onto the machine and solve the valve/lever puzzle: for each of the 4 pipes, turn its valve the stated way and pull the matching lever until every pipe fills with water.

hints.value: Full stated sequence: Pipe2 left lever down + valve2 left x2 then right until full; Pipe4 right lever down + valve4 right x3 then left x1 then right until full; Pipe3 right lever up + valve3 right x2 then left x1 then right until full; Pipe1 left lever up + valve1 left x2 then right until full.

label: Take the pipe machine's supplies
detail: Search the crates for 4 pipes, 5 pipe rings, and 6 rivets.

label: Head up two more floors
detail: Climb up two floors to the room with the pipe machine.

label: Fix the pipe machine
detail: Fit the pipes, rings, and rivets onto the machine on the south side of the room to complete its puzzle.

label: Take the cage's supplies
detail: Search the crates for 5 metal bars and 4 binding fluids.

label: Head to the top floor
detail: Climb to the top floor of the tower where the cage is.

label: Fix the cage
detail: Fit the metal bars and binding fluid onto the cage and place each side's horizontal/vertical pieces in the stated sizes (per side: e.g. side one is Horizontal-2, Horizontal-3, Vertical-2) until all four sides are complete.

hints.value: Full per-side piece list: side1 H2/H3/V2, side2 H2/V2/V4, side3 H4/V2/V3, side4 H2/H2/V2.

label: Report the fixed machines to Effigy
detail: Talk to Effigy after completing all three repairs.

label: Watch the alchemist cutscene
detail: Go to the top floor for a cutscene involving the alchemists and the Homunculus.

label: Talk to Effigy outside
detail: Go back outside to talk to Effigy again.

label: Answer the Homunculus' quiz consistently
detail: Return to the top floor and answer the Homunculus' questions, picking consistently either all-Logic or all-Magic answers until the bar fills.

hints.value: Logic route: 1,3,3,1,2,2,3

Magic route (alternate, not both): 2,2,1 Runecraft/enchant/alchemy,3 bananas or peaches,3 depends where headed but teleports are safe,1 yes magic potions boost skills,1 by harnessing the power of the gods

label: Talk to Effigy again
detail: Speak to Effigy once more after the quiz.

label: Descend to the dungeon floor
detail: Go through the trapdoor to the south to reach the dungeon floor inside the tower.

label: Talk to the Homunculus to finish
detail: Speak to the Homunculus to the north to complete the quest.

label: Ask the Homunculus about creating monsters
detail: Optional: talk to the Homunculus again to unlock the Symbol of Life altar for a Medium Ardougne Diary task.

label: Head to the Symbol of Life altar
detail: Run south-south-west to the altar.

label: Offer the raw chicken to the altar
detail: Use a raw chicken on the altar.

label: Offer the raw swordfish to the altar
detail: Use a raw swordfish on the altar.

label: Activate the altar
detail: Activate the altar to spawn the swordchick.

label: Kill the swordchick
detail: Kill the swordchick for the Medium Ardougne Diary task.

label: Start the quest with Brother Kojo
detail: Talk to Brother Kojo at the Clock Tower to begin; speak to him again if he hands you a Watch.

hints.value: OK old monk, what can I do?

label: Descend to the four-door hub
detail: Go down the ladder in the middle room and follow the path to a hub with four doors.

hints.value: Each spindle has a colour on its end -- players can carry only one cog at a time regardless of colour.

label: Head through the south-eastern door
detail: Walk down the passageway past the ogres to reach the red cog.

hints.value: Held quest_db row describes this passage as ogre-guarded and survivability-only -- confirmed by the page ("ability to run past level 53 Ogres").

label: Pick up the red cog
detail: Grab the red cog from the ogre passage.

label: Return and climb to the ground floor
detail: Head back to the ladder and climb up to the ground floor.

label: Fit the red cog on the red spindle
detail: Use the red cog on the red spindle, on the column beside the ladder facing north.

label: Head to Brother Cedric
detail: Leave the Clock Tower and go east to where Brother Cedric stands, south of Ardougne zoo.

label: Fill a bucket at the well
detail: Optional if you didn't already bring a bucket of water or ice gloves: fill a bucket from the well near Brother Cedric, needed later to cool the black cog.

label: Head down and along the tunnel
detail: Go down the ladder east of Brother Cedric and follow the tunnel to its end.

label: Push the wall to reveal the hidden room
detail: Push the wall at the end of the tunnel to get inside.

label: Pick up the blue cog
detail: Grab the blue cog inside the hidden room.

label: Climb to the first floor
detail: Climb the ladder up, head to the centre room, then climb the staircase to the first floor.

label: Fit the blue cog on the blue spindle
detail: Use the blue cog on the blue spindle, on the south side of the column.

label: Head to the basement fire
detail: Go back to the basement, through the north-eastern door, as far east as the fire.

label: Cool and pick up the black cog
detail: Use the bucket of water on the cog (or wear ice gloves) to safely pick it up; finish the dialogue or the cog won't be collected.

hints.value: Ice gloves is a non-consuming alternative to the bucket of water; only the bucket path is modeled as the canonical consumes.

label: Return toward the ladder without climbing
detail: Head back toward the ladder but do not climb it -- the black spindle is in the basement.

label: Fit the black cog on the black spindle
detail: Use the black cog on the black spindle, on the east side of the basement column.

label: Head through the north-western door
detail: Take the north-western door from the hub toward the rat area.

label: Pick up the rat poison
detail: Grab the rat poison to the north-west; take an extra if Ratcatchers isn't done yet.

hints.value: Take an extra rat poison here for Ratcatchers if not already completed.

label: Head to the dungeon rat cage
detail: Walk to the end of the tunnel where the dungeon rat cage sits, levers on its north wall.

label: Pull the levers to open the rat cage
detail: Pull both levers on the north wall upward to open the cage.

label: Poison the food trough
detail: Use the rat poison on the food trough.

label: Wait for the rats to die
detail: Wait until every dungeon rat has died from the poisoned trough.

label: Go through the western gate
detail: Head through the western gate once the rats are dead.

label: Pick up the white cog
detail: Grab the white cog beyond the gate.

label: Climb to the top floor
detail: Climb the ladder up and head inside to the top floor.

label: Fit the white cog on the white spindle
detail: Use the white cog on the white spindle, on the west side of the column at the top of the tower.

label: Head back down to Brother Kojo
detail: Return to the ground floor where Brother Kojo waits.

label: Talk to Brother Kojo for the reward
detail: Speak to Brother Kojo to complete the quest and collect the reward.

label: Ask Arhein about the duck
detail: Speak to Arhein on the Catherby docks to start the quest.

hints.value: What's with the duck? -> Yes.

label: Speak to Councillor Catherine
detail: Find Councillor Catherine in the council office in north-east Catherby.

label: Get charcoal from the nearby cabinet
detail: If you need charcoal to fill in the form, search the nearby cabinet for it.

label: Fill in form cr-4p
detail: Fill in form cr-4p with any answers; remember exactly what you chose, since the same quiz is repeated later.

hints.value: Answers are free-choice but must be repeated identically at the Fish mayor checkpoint; picking the first option every time is the simplest way to remember them.

label: Submit the completed form
detail: Talk to Councillor Catherine again; she reveals the by-law needs mayoral approval and that Catherby's mayor died.

label: Tell Arhein you need a new mayor
detail: Speak to Arhein about finding the Mayor of Catherby.

hints.value: I need to find the Mayor of Catherby.

label: Buy the mayoral fishbowl and tiny net from Harry
detail: Talk to Harry at the fishing shop in east Catherby and buy the mayoral fishbowl and tiny net for 50 coins.

hints.value: I'm here about the mayor. -> Yes.

label: Fish a new mayor from the aquarium
detail: Fish in the aquarium next to Harry using the mayoral fishbowl and tiny net to catch the new Mayor of Catherby.

label: Collect the mayoral chain from Arhein
detail: Talk to Arhein again to receive the mayoral chain for the new mayor.

hints.value: About the mayor...

label: Redo the form quiz for Catherine
detail: Talk to Councillor Catherine again and match the answers you gave to form cr-4p earlier; only wrong answers need repeating.

label: Sign form 7r4-5h with the new mayor
detail: Use form 7r4-5h on the Mayor of Catherby to have it signed.

hints.value: Form 7r4-5h's own acquisition point is never stated in the Quick guide -- modeled as a pre-existing consumed item rather than fabricated.

label: Return the signed form to change the by-law
detail: Give the signed form back to Councillor Catherine so she changes the by-law.

label: Collect the current duck
detail: Talk to Arhein again now that the by-law has changed, to receive the current duck.

hints.value: The by-law has been changed!

label: Sail out to the ripple
detail: Board your boat south of Catherby and sail east to find a small ripple in the water by the Obelisk of Water.

hints.value: Requires a boat docked at Catherby for this leg (per held quest_db detail).

label: Set the duck in the ripple
detail: Click the current duck in your inventory near the ripple to set it in the water.

label: Follow the duck to shore
detail: Follow the current duck until it reaches the shore near Holgart.

label: Collect the duck
detail: Pick the current duck back up once it reaches shore.

label: Return the duck to Arhein to finish
detail: Talk to Arhein one last time to report the charted currents and complete the quest.

hints.value: I've charted the currents!

label: Start the quest with Charlie
detail: Speak to Charlie in Ardougne Zoo, who needs help finding huntsman Nickolaus.

hints.value: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing! -> Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?

label: Travel to Eagles' Peak
detail: Head to Eagles' Peak west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold, via necklace of passage to The Outpost, fairy ring code AKQ, or the rowboat south-east of the Piscatoris teleport scroll (fastest).

label: Find the campsite at the mountain's base
detail: Go to the northern side of the mountain's base, by the agility shortcut, to find Nickolaus' campsite.

label: Inspect the campsite books
detail: Inspect the books at the campsite to receive a bird book.

label: Click the bird book for the metal feather
detail: Click on the bird book to obtain a metal feather.

label: Climb up to the rocky outcrop
detail: Climb the rocks attached to the mountain next to the campsite (25 Agility), or follow the grey path south-east of the campsite if you lack the level.

hints.value: Agility 25 is only needed for the rock-climbing shortcut -- an unrequired grey-path alternative exists for lower levels.

label: Open the dungeon entrance
detail: Use the metal feather on the rocky outcrop to open the cave and enter Eagles' Peak Dungeon.

hints.value: The metal feather only opens the dungeon entrance -- it is not consumed and is not the same feather used later on the eagle door.

label: Head to the canyon edge
detail: In the dungeon, go east to the Y-shaped intersection then south to the edge of the canyon.

label: Take a giant feather to draw out Nickolaus
detail: Try to take a giant feather from the south-western-most pile; Nickolaus, trapped by a giant eagle, shouts at you.

hints.value: The Ardougne zookeeper sent me to find you. -> Well if you gave me a ferret I could take it back for you. -> Could I help at all?

label: Collect 10 eagle feathers
detail: Pick up 10 eagle feathers from any of the piles on the ground.

label: Travel to the Fancy Clothes Store
detail: Head to the south-east corner of Varrock to the Fancy Clothes Store (Varrock teleport, Rat Pits Grouping teleport, etc).

hints.value: Items required for the disguise: 10 eagle feathers, 50gp, swamp tar, yellow dye.

label: Ask Asyff about the bird costumes
detail: Talk to Asyff and mention you're after a couple of bird costumes.

hints.value: Well, specifically I'm after a couple of bird costumes.

label: Hand over the materials for the disguise
detail: Give Asyff the eagle feathers, swamp tar, yellow dye, and 50gp; she makes you an eagle cape and fake beak.

hints.value: I've got the feathers and materials you requested. -> Okay, here are the materials. Eagle me up.
Swamp tar and yellow dye's own acquisition points are not stated in the Quick guide -- modeled as pre-existing consumed items.

label: Enter the south-west tunnel
detail: Go back into Eagles' Peak Dungeon and enter the farthest south-west tunnel.

label: Operate the four corner winches
detail: Try to grab the feather from the pedestal to trigger the trap, then operate all four corner winches in any order to release it.

label: Grab the bronze feather
detail: Take the bronze feather from the pedestal now that the winches are set.

label: Enter the next tunnel north
detail: Exit the bronze-feather tunnel and enter the next tunnel to the north.

label: Read the pedestal trail
detail: Inspect the pedestal, then complete the trail by inspecting the rock to the east and the rocks to the north-east.

label: Threaten the kebbit
detail: Inspect the opening in the wall north-east of the cave and threaten the kebbit found there.

hints.value: Taunt the kebbit.

label: Pick up the silver feather
detail: Take the silver feather once the kebbit encounter resolves.

label: Head to the golden feather tunnel
detail: Exit back to the main dungeon, run up the farthest north-east path, and go through the tunnel entrance.

label: Take 6 handfuls of bird seed
detail: Collect 6 handfuls of bird seed near the tunnel entrance.

label: Solve the lever and feeder puzzle
detail: Pull lever (1), place seed in feeders (2) and (3), pull lever (4), push lever (5, same as 1), place seed in (6), pull lever (7), place seed in (8), pull lever (9), place seed in (10), then place the last seed in (11, same feeder as 6).

hints.value: A reset lever outside the chamber restarts the puzzle if it gets messed up.

label: Retrieve the golden feather
detail: Take the golden feather from the pedestal to the west once the puzzle is solved.

label: Head to the eagle door
detail: Exit the golden feather tunnel and go to the door south of Nickolaus.

label: Use all three feathers on the eagle door
detail: Use the bronze, silver, and gold feathers on the door's eagle carving to open it and enter.

label: Wear the eagle disguise
detail: Equip the eagle cape and fake beak made earlier.

label: Walk past the giant eagle
detail: While disguised, click the giant eagle and choose to walk past it.

label: Speak to Nickolaus
detail: Talk to the freed Nickolaus once past the giant eagle.

label: Return to the campsite
detail: Exit the dungeon and go back to the campsite north of the mountain.

label: Learn ferret-catching from Nickolaus
detail: Talk to Nickolaus about the ferret; no box trap is needed for this part.

hints.value: Well I was originally sent to find you because of a ferret. -> That sounds good to me.

label: Receive the ferret after the cutscene
detail: Once the cutscene ends, a ferret appears in your inventory; do not release it or you'll have to catch another.

label: Return to Ardougne Zoo
detail: Head back to Ardougne Zoo with the ferret.

label: Deliver the ferret to Charlie
detail: Give the ferret to Charlie at Ardougne Zoo to complete the quest.

label: Talk to Martin Holt to start the quest
detail: Speak with Martin Holt east of Kourend Castle to begin investigating disgraced Councillor Sophia Hughes' disappearance.

hints.value: 1 Yes.

label: Report to Commander Fullore inside the castle
detail: Speak to Commander Fullore on the ground floor of Kourend Castle; a cutscene introduces the investigation.

hints.value: 1 Let's get going.

label: Search the drawers upstairs for a receipt
detail: Enter the house south of the castle, climb the stairs, and search the eastern room's drawers to find and read a receipt.

label: Question Tomas Lawry by the roses
detail: Go back downstairs and talk to Tomas Lawry, who is tending roses outside the house.

label: Ask the Lovakengj pub owner about the councillor
detail: Travel to the pub north-west of Kourend Castle and ask Fuggy whether any councillors have stayed there recently.

hints.value: 3 Had any councillors stay here recently?

label: Ask Cabin Boy Herbert near Veos's boat
detail: Travel to Veos's boat in the south-eastern corner of Port Piscarilius and speak to Cabin Boy Herbert; a cutscene plays that leads straight into a boss fight.

hints.value: 2 I'm looking for a councillor.

label: Defeat the level-168 demon Judge of Yama
detail: Dodge the overhead fire waves like Galvek by standing clear then closing to melee range; he keeps protect from magic and missiles up the whole fight. Tanking the flames to close the gap is also viable.

label: Speak to Commander Fullore after the fight
detail: Find Commander Fullore south of the castle, north of the Shayzien mine, following the post-boss cutscene.

label: Report back to Martin Holt
detail: Return to Martin Holt near the Kourend Castle entrance where the quest began.

label: Teleport to the Arceuus Library via Archeio
detail: Head to the ground floor of the Arceuus Library and right-click teleport on Archeio.

label: Pickpocket Istoria for the Bluish key
detail: Pickpocket Istoria in the library to obtain the Bluish key.

label: Search the pink case for Rose's diary
detail: Search the pink case in the south-east corner of the room to retrieve Rose's diary.

label: Show Rose's diary to Martin Holt
detail: Speak to Martin Holt again with the diary; a hidden note falls out of it.

label: Read the note and discuss it with Martin
detail: Read the note that fell from the diary, then speak to Martin about it again.

label: Travel to the Forthos Ruins
detail: Head to the Forthos Ruins, north-east of the Woodcutting Guild.

label: Tell Martin you'll search the ruins
detail: Speak to Martin Holt at the ruins.

hints.value: 4 I'll get searching.

label: Search the stone piles for a numeric code
detail: Search the stone piles around the ruins; each pile reveals a digit unique to the player, spelling out a code for the letters R-O-S-E.

label: Enter the ROSE code on the wall panel
detail: Cut through the vines to the west, squeeze past them, and enter the player-specific R-O-S-E code on the wall panel to reveal a note.

label: Show the note to Martin Holt
detail: Read the note that the panel reveals, then show it to Martin Holt.

hints.value: 4 Alright. I'll see you soon.

label: Travel to the Settlement Ruins
detail: Head to the Settlement Ruins, south-west of Wintertodt.

label: Meet Martin past the ice creatures
detail: Run past the Ice Spiders, Ice Giants and Ice Wolves to reach Martin Holt in the north-west building.

label: Kill the assassin that spawns
detail: An assassin spawns near Martin at the Settlement Ruins; defeat it.

label: Melt the ice chunks and open the panel
detail: Cast fire bolt or higher on the ice chunks south-west of Martin, search the melted chunk, and open the panel on the western wall.

label: Read the note and speak to Martin
detail: Read the note revealed behind the panel and speak to Martin about it.

label: Meet Martin at The Legless Faun and climb the pillar
detail: Travel to The Legless Faun in southern Piscarilius, speak to Martin, then climb the southern pillar.

label: Note the house order on the upstairs panel
detail: Check the panel upstairs and note the order of the house crests it shows.

label: Push the statue panels in the noted order
detail: Climb back down and push the Great Kourend house statues' panels in the order read upstairs, then re-check the panel to confirm and read the note that appears after the cutscene.

label: Search the bed in the shack for a tatty note
detail: Head to the shack north-east of the Farming Guild, west of fairy ring CIR, and search the bed.

label: Read the note and climb down the trapdoor
detail: Read the tatty note, inspect the crates in the north-western corner, then climb down the trapdoor.

hints.value: 1 Climb through it.

label: Travel south to Molch and enter the Lizard dwelling
detail: Exit the shack, head south to Molch, then go to the furthest dwelling east and enter the Lizard dwelling.

label: Ask Khat B'alam for help finding a mage
detail: Go north inside the dwelling and talk to Khat B'alam.

hints.value: 2 Do you think you could help me find a mage?

label: Cross into Kebos Swamp
detail: Exit the temple through the hole to the west, head south-west into Kebos Swamp, and cross the stone bridge.

label: Search the lizardman eggs for one to bring back
detail: Search the south-eastern lizardman eggs; a level-75 lizardman brute attacks but does not need to be killed.

label: Trade the egg for the door key
detail: Return to the temple and give the lizardman egg to Khat B'alam in exchange for a key.

hints.value: 1 So, about the key to that door...

label: Unlock the door on the main corridor's north wall
detail: Open the door indicated by a keyhole on the north wall, south-west of Khat B'alam.

hints.value: 1 Yes.

label: Defeat the spirit boss Xamphur
detail: Pray Protect from Magic throughout; kill the summoned hands to avoid corruption, and dodge the falling-hand mechanic by walking back and forth in a straight line, similar to Vorkath.

label: Search the northern table in the lab
detail: Search the northern table in the lab after defeating Xamphur.

label: Return to the shack and go downstairs
detail: Head back to the shack north-east of the Farming Guild and go downstairs by inspecting the crates again.

label: Visit Lord Trobin Arceuus for support
detail: Speak to Lord Trobin Arceuus on the first floor of the Tower of Magic, west of the Arceuus Library.

label: Visit Lord Kandur Hosidius for support
detail: Speak to Lord Kandur Hosidius at his home in Hosidius, south-east of the bank.

label: Collect volcanic sulphur if needed
detail: Collect a volcanic sulphur from the Sulphur Mine north-west of the Lovakengj Assembly, if not already carrying one.

label: Visit Lady Vulcana Lovakengj for support
detail: Speak to Lady Vulcana Lovakengj in the Lovakengj Assembly, south-western Lovakengj, at The Forsaken Tower quest icon.

label: Visit Lady Shauna Piscarilius for support
detail: Speak to Lady Shauna Piscarilius in The Warrens under Port Piscarilius.

label: Visit Lord Shiro Shayzien for support
detail: Speak to Lord Shiro Shayzien on the first floor of the War Tent in the Shayzien Encampment, by the northern bank icon.

label: Report the Lords' support at Xeric's Lookout
detail: Travel to Xeric's Lookout and talk to Commander Fullore.

label: Speak to Commander Fullore again after the cutscene
detail: A cutscene plays; speak to Commander Fullore again once it ends.

label: Talk to all five Lords again at the Lookout
detail: The five Lords are spread across different floors of the Lookout house, including the basement; make sure to receive the broken redirector from Lord Arceuus, who stands just outside.

label: Ask Commander Fullore about Lady Lovakengj
detail: Talk to Commander Fullore at the Lookout and ask about Lady Lovakengj.

hints.value: 1 I need some help with Lady Lovakengj.

label: Speak with Kaal-Mej-San at Mount Karuulm
detail: Go down the elevator at Mount Karuulm and speak with Kaal-Mej-San.

label: Brew a sulphur potion
detail: Mix a defence potion with volcanic sulphur to create a sulphur potion.

label: Have the sulphur potion enchanted
detail: Speak with Kaal-Mej-San again; they enchant the sulphur potion into a shielding potion.

label: Pour the shielding potion on the Doors of Dinh
detail: Go to the Doors of Dinh at the Wintertodt Camp and pour the potion onto them.

label: Travel to the Barbarian camp in Kourend Woodland
detail: Head to the Barbarian camp south-east of the Rada's blessing teleport, and go down the ladder to the south.

label: Defeat the level-91 Barbarian Warlord
detail: A level-91 Barbarian Warlord attacks; kill him.

label: Talk to Phileas Rimor
detail: Speak to Phileas Rimor after defeating the Barbarian Warlord.

label: Travel to the prison outside the Shayzien wall
detail: Go to the prison just outside the Shayzien wall, west of the Graveyard of Heroes, and down the staircase.

label: Talk to Martin Holt in the prison
detail: Speak to Martin Holt.

label: Talk to Jorra at the Graveyard of Heroes
detail: Go to the Graveyard of Heroes in Shayzien, south of the church, and talk to Jorra.

hints.value: 2 Evil only triumphs when the good do nothing.

label: Kill the level-132 assassin that spawns
detail: An assassin that attacks with both melee and ranged spawns; defeat it.

label: Receive the declaration from Jorra
detail: Speak to Jorra again to receive the declaration.

label: Chip off a dense runestone near the Dark Altar
detail: With a pickaxe and chisel, chip off the dense runestone east of the Dark Altar.

label: Convert the block on the Dark Altar
detail: Use the dense essence block on the Dark Altar to receive a dark essence block.

label: Trade Mori for the dark nullifier
detail: Climb up into the Arceuus church, run east, climb the stairs, and give Mori molten glass and the dark essence block in exchange for a dark nullifier.

label: Enter the Chasm of Fire and complete the dialogue
detail: Go to the Chasm of Fire north-west of fairy ring DJR, try to go inside, and complete the dialogue that follows.

label: Picklock the chest in the Hosidius Vinery
detail: Inspect the eastern wine barrel west of fairy ring AKR, climb inside, and picklock the chest to obtain a Shayzien journal.

hints.value: 1 Climb through it.

label: Return to the Lookout and talk to all five Lords
detail: Go back to Xeric's Lookout and talk to all five of the Lords once more.

label: Talk with Commander Fullore
detail: A cutscene follows this conversation.

label: Speak with Commander Fullore again
detail: Continue the conversation with Commander Fullore.

label: Go down the ladder and speak with Lord Hosidius
detail: Descend the ladder and talk to Lord Hosidius.

label: Finish the quest with Commander Fullore
detail: Return to Commander Fullore for a final long cutscene that completes the quest.

hints.value: 1 Let's do this.

label: Talk to Gordon to start the quest
detail: Speak to Gordon south of the Farming Guild about his missing livestock.

hints.value: 1 Need a hand with anything?
1 Yes.

label: Talk to Mary about the livestock
detail: Speak to Mary inside the main building west of Gordon.

label: Lay a flour trail from the southern gate
detail: Use the pot of flour on the southern gate next to the cow pen east of Gordon to start a scent trail.

label: Follow the flour trail to the mine cave
detail: Follow the trail of flour south past the bridge, then west to the cave at the Kebos Lowlands mine.

label: Kill the Headless Beast in the mine
detail: A level-82 Headless Beast is in the cave; defeat it.

label: Optionally gather clay and planks while here
detail: While in the mine, optionally mine some clay and pick up two planks just to the west for use in the next checkpoint.

label: Report the kill to Gordon
detail: Go back and speak to Gordon after killing the beast.

label: Speak to Gordon to begin crafting
detail: Talk to Gordon before making the fake head.

label: Speak to Mary to begin crafting
detail: Talk to Mary before making the fake head.

label: Carve the soft clay into a clay head
detail: Use a knife on the soft clay to make a clay head.

hints.value: 1 Yes.

label: Show Gordon the clay head
detail: Speak to Gordon after making the clay head.

label: Attach fur to make a fur head
detail: Use bear fur or grey wolf fur on the head while carrying a needle and thread.

hints.value: 1 Yes.

label: Show Gordon the fur head
detail: Speak to Gordon after making the fur head.

label: Dye the head to make a bloody head
detail: Use red dye on the fur head to make a bloody head.

hints.value: 1 Yes.

label: Show Gordon the bloody head
detail: Speak to Gordon again after dyeing the head.

label: Mount the bloody head on the wall
detail: Mount the bloody head in the Mounted Head Space on the wall south of the stairs using two planks and six nails of any kind.

label: Finish the quest by talking to Gordon
detail: Speak to Gordon one more time to complete the quest.

label: Talk to Brother Aimeri to start
detail: Find Brother Aimeri in the southern part of Forthos Dungeon, by the entrance to Sarachnis. Quick travel options include the Watson teleport scroll, Xeric's Talisman to Xeric's Glade, Kourend Castle Teleport, or a skills necklace to the Woodcutting Guild.

label: Feed Brother Aimeri your food
detail: Use all 5 pieces of food in your inventory on Brother Aimeri.

label: Ask to begin the miniquest
detail: Talk to Brother Aimeri again and ask who you are, to start the miniquest.

label: Search the bookshelves for the three tomes
detail: Protect from Magic, run west through the long hallway to the Undead Druid room, and search musty bookshelves until all three tomes are found.

label: Kill monsters for tattered pages
detail: Kill any monsters in Forthos Dungeon until 4 of each tattered sun, moon and temple page have dropped; killing Temple spiders with multi-hit Ancient Magicks or a fast weapon such as the Toxic Blowpipe under Protect from Melee is a fast, semi-AFK option (reset aggression every 10 minutes).

label: Fill the three tomes with their matching pages
detail: Put the collected tattered pages into their corresponding tomes.

label: Travel to the Arceuus Library
detail: Head to the Arceuus Library with the three filled tomes.

label: Hand the filled tomes to Logosia
detail: Use the three filled tomes on Logosia to complete the miniquest.

label: Talk to Mori to start the quest
detail: Speak to Mori in the centre of Arceuus about the first death in the house in a thousand years.

hints.value: 1 What can I do to help?
2 We should let someone know about this.
1 Yes.

label: Report the death to Councillor Andrews
detail: Head south-west to Kourend Castle and speak to Councillor Andrews on the east side of the first floor.

hints.value: 2 There's been a death in Arceuus.

label: Update Mori on the report
detail: Return to Mori and tell her what Councillor Andrews said.

hints.value: 2 What should we do now?

label: Speak to the Tower Mage outside the tower
detail: Walk north-west to the Tower of Magic, west of the Arceuus Library, and speak to the Tower Mage outside its doors.

label: Defeat the 5 Tormented Souls inside the tower
detail: Enter the tower and defeat all 5 Tormented Souls.

label: Talk to Asteros Arceuus upstairs
detail: Head upstairs after the fight and speak to Asteros Arceuus.

label: Travel to Mount Karuulm
detail: Travel to Mount Karuulm (fairy ring code CIR); optionally mine an iron ore at the Mount Karuulm Mine here to complete a Kourend & Kebos Diary Easy task.

label: Activate the elevator at Mount Karuulm
detail: Go to the centre of Mount Karuulm and activate the elevator to descend.

label: Speak to Kaal-Xil-Dar
detail: Talk to Kaal-Xil-Dar after descending.

label: Inspect the Ancient Grave
detail: Exit south and head to the grave south-east of the mountain, south of the water source near the Battlefront, and inspect it.

label: Follow the tracks to the hiding spot
detail: Follow the tracks from the grave, searching nearby bushes and plants, until reaching the Trapped Soul's hiding spot.

label: Defeat the Trapped Soul
detail: Defeat the Trapped Soul at its hiding spot.

label: Report back to Kaal-Xil-Dar
detail: Return to Mount Karuulm and speak to Kaal-Xil-Dar once more.

label: Search the rocks around the Dark Altar
detail: Head to the Dark Altar north of Arceuus (fairy ring code CIS, or games necklace to Wintertodt then run south) and inspect the surrounding rocks until a hidden device is found; it is automatically destroyed.

label: Finish by talking to Lord Trobin Arceuus
detail: Return to the Tower of Magic, head upstairs, and talk to Lord Trobin Arceuus to complete the quest.

label: Talk to Lord Kandur in his house west of the Vinery
detail: Speak to Lord Kandur Hosidius in his house west of the Vinery about his missing son Artur.

hints.value: Anything I can help you with? -> Yes.

label: Talk to Chef Olivia in Lord Kandur's kitchen
detail: Speak to Chef Olivia in the kitchen of Lord Kandur's house; she reveals a secret romance and a research lead.

label: Travel to the Arceuus Library
detail: Head to the Arceuus Library via fairy ring code CIS, games necklace to Wintertodt Camp, or the Lovakengj Minecart Network to Arceuus.

label: Talk to Galana in the library's north-east wing
detail: Speak to Galana on the ground floor's north-east wing of the Arceuus Library about the missing Hosidius heir.

label: Talk to Galana again for the envoy book lead
detail: Speak to Galana a second time; she reveals where to find the Varlamore envoy book, though its exact spot is randomised per player.

hints.value: book location is randomised per player

label: Read the Varlamore envoy book
detail: Locate and read the Varlamore envoy book Galana pointed you to, revealing the lead on the sunken Accord of Twill.

label: Travel to the Crabclaw Caves
detail: Enter the Crabclaw Caves south of the Woodcutting Guild near the water (Rada's blessing, Skills necklace, Xeric's Talisman to Xeric's Look-Out, or Veos/charter ship to Land's End); optionally kill a sandcrab here for an easy diary task.

hints.value: instanced dungeon

label: Navigate to the end of the caves and climb down
detail: Cross the caves' stepping-stone path to its end and climb down the tunnel there.

label: Talk to Artur Hosidius
detail: Speak to Artur Hosidius, found trapped at the bottom of the tunnel.

label: Kill the level 36 Sand Snake
detail: Defeat the Sand Snake guarding Artur; it is weak to magic.

label: Search the chest
detail: Search the nearby chest to recover the item needed to clear Artur's name and free him.

hints.value: held quest_db row names this the 'Royal Accord of Twill' but the fetched Quick guide text never names the chest's contents -- left as '??' pending wiki confirmation

label: Return to Lord Kandur Hosidius
detail: Head back to Lord Kandur's house west of the Vinery to deliver the recovered item.

label: Talk to Lord Kandur to complete the quest
detail: Hand over the recovered item and speak to Lord Kandur to finish the quest.

label: Talk to Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
detail: Speak to Lady Vulcana Lovakengj in the Lovakengj Assembly building west of the southern bank about the failing Doors of Dinh.

hints.value: Yes. -> I'll get going.

label: Travel to Wintertodt Camp
detail: Teleport to Wintertodt Camp via games necklace.

label: Talk to Ignisia if not previously done
detail: Speak to Ignisia in the north-east of the Wintertodt camp, if you haven't met her on a previous quest.

hints.value: only needed if not previously completed

label: Talk to the dwarf Undor
detail: Speak to Undor inside the camp about helping repair the Doors of Dinh; if he redirects you to the 'Fiery lass', talk to Ignisia again then return to him.

hints.value: I've been sent to help you.

label: Travel to The Forsaken Tower
detail: Head to the Forsaken Tower east of Mount Karuulm and west of Lovakengj (fairy ring code CIR, Battlefront Teleport, or Skills necklace to Farming Guild).

label: Inspect the Display Case
detail: Examine the Display Case just inside the tower.

label: Go down the ladder and open the north-eastern door
detail: Descend the ladder behind the Display Case and open the door to the north-east.

label: Search the north-north-east crate for a generator crank
detail: Search the crate to the north-north-east to obtain the generator crank.

label: Start the steam generator
detail: Inspect the steam generator in the south and start it.

hints.value: Start the generator.

label: Align the Power Grid puzzle
detail: Inspect the Power Grid and align its pieces to match the diagram shown in-game.

hints.value: Yes.
puzzle solution is shown as an in-game image, not textual

label: Go up the ladder and search the northern room's cupboards
detail: Climb the ladder into the northern room and search the cupboards for a tinderbox, a 5-gallon jug, and an 8-gallon jug.

label: Measure exactly 4 gallons of coolant using the two jugs
detail: Using the coolant dispenser to the west, fill and pour coolant between the 5- and 8-gallon jugs in sequence (fill the 5, pour it into the 8, fill the 5 again, top the 8 off until full, empty the 8, pour the remaining 2 gallons from the 5 into the 8, fill the 5 again, pour into the 8, fill the 5 a final time, pour into the 8) until the 5-gallon jug holds exactly 4 gallons.

hints.value: fixed deterministic jug-puzzle sequence, not a repeated grind

label: Fill the furnace coolant reservoir and light it
detail: Use the 4 gallons of coolant on the furnace coolant reservoir west of the furnace, then light the furnace with the tinderbox.

label: Optional: smelt an adamantite bar for the diary task
detail: If working on the Kourend & Kebos diary task, smelt an adamantite bar at the furnace now.

hints.value: optional, diary-task only

label: Go upstairs, open the door, and take the notes
detail: Head upstairs, open the door, and take the notes from the eastern cupboard.

label: Take the correct cleansing fluid from the northern table
detail: Take the cleansing fluid potion from the northern table; its position among the potions is randomised per player, so use the notes' riddle (fluids are numbered 1-5 in the order they are mentioned across the five sentences) to identify the correct one before picking it up.

hints.value: WARNING: picking the wrong potion deals 25+ damage and poisons you; logging out before advancing the dialogue avoids the risk

label: Use the cleansing fluid on the refinery and activate it
detail: Use the cleansing fluid on the refinery to the south, then activate the refinery.

hints.value: Yes. / Yes.

label: Go up the ladder to the Altar room
detail: Climb the ladder to reach the room with the four discs and three pylons.

label: Move the four discs between pylons in the correct order
