detail: Working the three pylons labelled West, Centre and East, move one disc at a time in this order: W-E, W-C, E-C, W-E, C-W, C-E, W-E, W-C, E-C, E-W, C-W, E-C, W-E, W-C, E-C.

hints.value: fixed deterministic move sequence

label: Retrieve Dinh's hammer from the display case
detail: Go back downstairs and take Dinh's hammer from the display case.

label: Return to Wintertodt Camp
detail: Head back to Wintertodt Camp to deliver Dinh's hammer to Undor.

label: Use the hammer on Undor
detail: Use Dinh's hammer on Undor to repair the Doors of Dinh.

label: Return to Lady Vulcana Lovakengj to finish
detail: Head back to Lady Vulcana Lovakengj in Lovakengj and speak to her to complete the quest.

label: Search the tent for Kasonde's journal
detail: Search the tent at the Kebos campsite (fairy ring code BLS, then head south-east) to find Kasonde's journal and start the quest.

hints.value: Yes.

label: Read Kasonde's journal
detail: Read the journal to learn about the campsite.

label: Search the camping equipment for secateurs
detail: Search the camping equipment nearby to receive a pair of secateurs.

label: Climb down the nearby hole
detail: Climb down the hole near the campsite to enter the first hidden dungeon.

label: Search the first stone table for a stone tablet
detail: Search the stone table marked '1' to receive the first stone tablet.

label: Read the first stone tablet and the note
detail: Read the stone tablet and take the accompanying note to receive the word translations scroll.

hints.value: Yes.

label: Translate the first word set
detail: Read the word translations scroll, click 'Attempt Translation', and enter the words Island, Water, Time, Vessel, North in order.

label: Climb up the rope to exit the hole
detail: Climb the rope to leave the first dungeon.

label: Travel to Molch Island
detail: Board Boaty and select Molch Island (or use fairy ring code DJR then head west).

hints.value: Molch Island

label: Enter the hole on Molch Island
detail: Climb down the hole on Molch Island to enter the second dungeon.

label: Inspect the vines for a dirty note
detail: Inspect the vines blocking the path to find a dirty note.

label: Cut the vines with the secateurs and squeeze through
detail: Cut the vines using the secateurs, then squeeze through the gap.

label: Search the second stone table for a stone tablet
detail: Search the stone table marked '1' to receive the second stone tablet.

label: Read the second stone tablet
detail: Read the second stone tablet.

label: Translate the second word set
detail: Input the words West, Poison, Body, Food, Earth on the word translations scroll.

label: Climb up the rope to exit the hole
detail: Climb the rope to leave the second dungeon.

label: Travel to Xeric's Shrine
detail: Board Boaty and select Molch, then run west and south to the altar at Xeric's Shrine.

hints.value: Molch

label: Enter the hole at Xeric's Shrine
detail: Climb down the hole at Xeric's Shrine to enter the third dungeon.

label: Search the third stone table for a stone tablet
detail: Search the stone table marked '1' to receive the third stone tablet.

label: Read the third stone tablet
detail: Read the third stone tablet.

label: Translate the third word set
detail: Input the words Make, Yes, No, Move, Arrive, East, South on the word translations scroll.

label: Travel to the Ruins of Morra
detail: Board Boaty and select Shayzien, then run south to the Ruins of Morra.

hints.value: Shayzien

label: Enter the hole at the Ruins of Morra
detail: Climb down the hole at the Ruins of Morra to enter the fourth and final dungeon.

label: Search the final stone table for a stone tablet
detail: Search the stone table marked '1' to receive the fourth and final stone tablet.

label: Read the final stone tablet
detail: Read the fourth stone tablet.

label: Translate the final word set
detail: Input the words Few, Big, Sun, Moon, Life, Death, Mind, Home, Air, Fire on the word translations scroll.

label: Re-read the tablet and the warning note to finish
detail: Read the fourth stone tablet again, then read the warning note to complete the translation and finish the quest.

label: Talk to Tomas Lawry outside the bank
detail: Speak to Tomas Lawry outside the Port Piscarilius bank about the Saviours of Kourend gang; grab a bowl from the general store on the way if planning to make the bribe stew yourself.

hints.value: I'm looking for a quest. / Absolutely. / Yes.

mapMarkers.label: unnamed polygon near quest start (no caption in source, likely the Port Piscarilius bank area)
unnamed polygon near quest start (no caption in source, likely the Port Piscarilius bank area)
unnamed polygon near quest start (no caption in source, likely the Port Piscarilius bank area)
unnamed polygon near quest start (no caption in source, likely the Port Piscarilius bank area)

label: Buy raw beef and a potato from Kenelme
detail: Buy raw beef and a potato from Kenelme to the west, to cook a bribe stew for Robert O'Reilly.

label: Cook the stew
detail: Cook the raw beef and potato together with a bowl into a stew.

label: Head south to Robert O'Reilly's house
detail: Walk south to the house directly west of the bridge.

label: Talk to Robert O'Reilly and give him the stew
detail: Speak to Robert O'Reilly, who asks for a stew as a bribe; hand it over.

hints.value: Okay.

label: Enter the manhole into The Warrens
detail: Enter the manhole to the east, cross the bridge south, then continue west into The Warrens.

label: Talk to Devan Rutter near the fish stall
detail: Speak to Devan Rutter near the fish stall to prove your interest in joining the gang.

hints.value: Nope, sounds good to me.

label: Optional: trade with the General Store Shop Keeper
detail: Optionally trade with the General Store Shop Keeper in The Warrens for an easy Kourend & Kebos Diary task.

hints.value: optional, diary-task only

label: Return to the surface and head to the Foodhall dock
detail: Exit back to the surface the way you came and head to the dock on the southern side of the Piscarilius Foodhall, the largest building.

label: Fake-kill Conrad King
detail: Confront and fake-kill Conrad King (a non-combat scripted encounter) to prove loyalty to the gang; pick either dialogue option offered.

label: Return to The Warrens and enter the tent
detail: Go back down the manhole into The Warrens and enter the tent.

label: Talk to the Queen of Thieves
detail: Speak to the Queen of Thieves inside the tent.

label: Travel to the Council member's house in Kingstown
detail: Exit the sewers and travel south-west to Kingstown; enter the house immediately north of the entrance and climb the stairs to the first floor.

label: Picklock the chest to find the letter
detail: Picklock the chest on the east side of the room (may take several attempts) to find an incriminating letter.

hints.value: held quest_db row's thieving 20 requirement is not explicitly tied to any action in the fetched text -- this picklock atom is the most plausible tie but unconfirmed by wiki wording

label: Return to Tomas Lawry
detail: Head back to Tomas Lawry to report your findings.

hints.value: Let's talk about my quest.

label: Return to the Queen of Thieves to finish
detail: Return to the Queen of Thieves, now revealed and addressed as Lady Shauna Piscarilius, to complete the quest.

label: Travel to Port Piscarilius via Veos
detail: Talk to Veos at the northernmost dock of Port Sarim, just south of the pub (amulet of glory to Draynor Village then run west around the wall to the docks), to sail to Port Piscarilius.

label: Talk to Veos again to start the quest
detail: Once at Port Piscarilius, talk to Veos again to begin the quest.

hints.value: Have you got any quests for me? / Sounds interesting! How can I help?

label: Use a feather on the enchanted scroll
detail: Use a feather on the enchanted scroll to turn it into an enchanted quill.

label: Speak to the Hosidius district store owner
detail: Visit the Hosidius district and speak to its store owner about the district.

mapMarkers.label: Hosidius store owner (district inferred from known Kourend geography; pin uncaptioned in source)

label: Speak to the Piscarilius district store owner
detail: Visit the Piscarilius district and speak to its store owner about the district.

mapMarkers.label: Piscarilius store owner (district inferred from known Kourend geography; pin uncaptioned in source)

label: Speak to Jennifer about Shayzien
detail: Visit Shayzien and speak to Jennifer about the district.

hints.value: Can I ask you about Shayzien? / What is there to do in Shayzien?

label: Speak to Munty about Lovakengj
detail: Visit Lovakengj and speak to Munty about the district.

hints.value: Can I ask you about Lovakengj? / What is there to do in Lovakengj?

label: Speak to the Arceuus district store owner
detail: Visit Arceuus and speak to its store owner about the district.

mapMarkers.label: Arceuus store owner (district inferred from known Kourend geography; pin uncaptioned in source)

label: Return to Veos after visiting all 5 districts
detail: Head back to Veos in Port Piscarilius once all 5 store owners have been spoken to.

hints.value: Let's talk about your client...

label: Travel to the Dark Altar
detail: Teleport to Wintertodt Camp via games necklace and run south to the dark terrain with purple crystals, then east (or use fairy ring code CIS) to reach the Dark Altar.

label: Activate the mysterious orb at the Dark Altar
detail: Activate the mysterious orb in your inventory while standing near the Dark Altar, east of Trossa and north of the fairy ring.

hints.value: the orb's acquisition point is never stated in the fetched Getting-started/Speaking-to-store-owners sections -- left as a pre-existing item rather than guessed

label: Return to Veos to finish the quest
detail: Head back to Veos and speak to him to complete the quest.

hints.value: Let's talk about your client...

label: Start the quest with Alec Kincade
detail: Talk to Alec Kincade outside the Myths' Guild to begin Dragon Slayer II.

hints.value: 2 How can I gain access to the Guild? / 1 Yes.

label: Talk to Dallas Jones at Musa Point
detail: Talk to Dallas Jones at the Karamja pub in Musa Point to continue the investigation.

hints.value: 2 Yes I know it well.

label: Travel to Elvarg's Lair beneath Crandor
detail: Head to Elvarg's Lair under Crandor, using the Karamja volcano shortcut.

label: Talk to Dallas Jones in Elvarg's old lair
detail: Talk to Dallas Jones once inside the lair where Elvarg was fought in Dragon Slayer I.

label: Pickaxe the marked northern wall and enter the tunnel
detail: Use a pickaxe on the northern wall in Elvarg's old lair (marked with a red line on the minimap), then enter the revealed tunnel.

label: Investigate the Ancient Mural
detail: Investigate the Ancient Mural to the north of the tunnel; doing so triggers a hostile spawn.

label: Kill the spawn guarding the mural
detail: Kill the level 100 spawn that attacks after the mural is first investigated.

label: Investigate the Ancient Mural again
detail: Investigate the Ancient Mural a second time now that the guardian spawn is defeated.

label: Report the mural to Dallas Jones
detail: Talk to Dallas Jones after investigating the mural to close out this checkpoint.

label: Enter the House on the Hill basement on Fossil Island
detail: Head to the basement of the House on the Hill on Fossil Island.

label: Ask Dallas Jones about the island
detail: Talk to Dallas Jones in the house basement about Fossil Island.

hints.value: 1 Ask about the island.

label: Search the open chest for map pieces
detail: Search the open chest north of the puzzle map for 5 jigsaw map pieces.

label: Search the upstairs stone chest for map pieces
detail: Go upstairs and search the open stone chest on the north wall for 3 more jigsaw map pieces.

label: Search the fungi outside for map pieces
detail: Go outside and search the fungi just north of the staircase for 4 jigsaw map pieces.

label: Search the Hook briar for map pieces
detail: Search the Hook briar south of the house for 7 jigsaw map pieces.

label: Search the mushtree for the final map pieces
detail: Run east and search the Mushroom Meadow mushtree for the last 5 jigsaw map pieces (24 total collected).

label: Solve the 24-piece jigsaw map
detail: Use all 24 collected map pieces on the puzzle map, rotating and dragging them into place (pieces can be handed to Dallas Jones to save inventory space instead of carrying all 24).

label: Tell Dallas Jones the map is solved
detail: Talk to Dallas Jones once the map puzzle is solved.

hints.value: 1 Let's talk about the investigation. / 1 Let's do it!

label: Talk to Dallas Jones again
detail: Talk to Dallas Jones a further time after the puzzle conversation.

label: Talk to Jardric at the museum camp
detail: Talk to Jardric at the museum camp to close out this checkpoint.

label: Build a rowboat to Lithkren
detail: Bring 8 oak planks, 10 swamp paste, at least 12 nails, a hammer and a saw to the island's west coast (south-west of the Mushroom Meadow mushtree) and build a rowboat.

label: Board the rowboat with Dallas Jones
detail: Talk to Dallas Jones and board the rowboat to Lithkren.

hints.value: 1 I'm ready.

label: Reach the ruined courtyard
detail: Sail north-west to the ruined courtyard and climb the western stairs.

label: Descend into the depths beneath Lithkren
detail: Climb down the southern trapdoor, then take the staircases north and north again into the depths.

label: Talk to Dallas Jones in the depths
detail: Talk to Dallas Jones once inside the depths.

label: Read Aivas' diary from the skeleton
detail: Search the skeleton to the east and read Aivas' diary.

label: Talk to Dallas Jones after reading the diary
detail: Talk to Dallas Jones again after reading Aivas' diary.

label: Find and talk to Bob the Cat
detail: Locate Bob the Cat using the Catspeak amulet (e) and talk to him.

hints.value: Bob's usual haunts change post A Tail of Two Cats; he roams and may need to be relocated with the amulet.

label: Ask the Sphinx to enchant cat-speech
detail: Talk to the Sphinx in Sophanem, who enchants permanent cat-speech so the Catspeak amulet is no longer needed to talk to cats.

hints.value: 1 Ask the Sphinx for help with Bob's memories.

label: Travel to Lunar Isle
detail: Head to Lunar Isle to begin the Robert the Strong checkpoint.

label: Ask the Oneiromancer about Bob's memories
detail: Talk to the Oneiromancer on Lunar Isle about Bob's memories.

hints.value: 3 Bob's memories. / 1 Yes.
A seal of passage is needed to speak to the Oneiromancer, though the bank run by 'Bird's-Eye' Jack works without it.

label: Crush and grind an astral rune
detail: Crush an astral rune with a hammer, then grind the shards with a pestle and mortar.

label: Brew the dream potion
detail: Fill the dream vial with water from the sink west of the bank, then add the goutweed and ground astral rune to brew a dream potion.

label: Light the brazier and enter the dream
detail: Gear up for a fight, light the Ceremonial Brazier in the island's largest building, then use the dream potion on the flame to enter Bob's dream.

label: Talk to Bob and Not Bob inside the dream
detail: Talk to Bob and Not Bob inside the dream, then exit via the giant history book if you need to regear before the fight.

label: Re-enter the dream through the barrier
detail: Talk to Bob outside the brazier to re-enter the dream, then head through the barrier toward Robert the Strong.

hints.value: The dream potion does not need remaking if you leave the dream and re-enter later.

label: Kill Robert the Strong
detail: Kill Robert the Strong with melee/crush gear only (ranged and magic cannot be used); run behind a pillar when he shouts his warning line to dodge his heavy special attack, which otherwise deals up to 60 damage and strips prayers.

label: Descend into the Kharazi Jungle maze
detail: Head to the south-eastern coast of the Kharazi Jungle and descend the staircase into the golem maze; turn off Auto Retaliate before entering.

label: Navigate the maze past the coloured golems
detail: Navigate to the maze centre, avoiding spike/trap tiles with Thieving and Agility, and matching each golem's protection prayer to its colour: red is melee, green is ranged, blue is magic.

label: Take the Karamja dragon key piece
detail: Take the dragon key piece from the plinth at the maze's centre; using the plinth also teleports you back out.

label: Ask Reldo about Tristan
detail: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Castle library and ask about Tristan.

hints.value: 1 Ask about Tristan.

label: Search the marked library bookcase
detail: Search the second bookcase from the north, on the west side of the central row.

label: Ask Reldo about Tristan again
detail: Talk to Reldo again after searching the bookcase.

hints.value: 1 Ask about Tristan.

label: Speak to Sarah in Port Phasmatys
detail: Travel to Port Phasmatys and speak to Sarah, west of the bank.

label: Bring key-piece materials to Ava
detail: Bring a dragonstone, 2 molten glass, a glassblowing pipe and a chisel to Ava in Draynor Manor.

hints.value: 3 I need your help with a key piece.

label: Craft the locator orb
detail: Use the glassblowing pipe on the dragonstone to make an inert locator orb, then use it on Ava to get a working locator orb.

label: Dowse Mort Myre Swamp for the buried key piece
detail: Head to Mort Myre Swamp and repeatedly use the locator orb (starting at Fairy code BKR) to narrow down the buried key piece's location; each use damages you, so bring food.

until.state: location narrowed to single dig spot

label: Dig up the Morytania dragon key piece
detail: Dig up the dragon key piece once the locator orb has narrowed the dig spot down.

label: Ask Brundt about the dragonkin fortress
detail: Ask Brundt the Chieftain in Rellekka about the dragonkin fortress.

hints.value: 2 or 3 Ask about the dragonkin fortress (option varies by seal of passage ownership), or 4 if The Fremennik Exiles is not yet started.

label: Sail to Ungael with Torfinn
detail: Talk to Torfinn on the Rellekka dock to sail to Ungael (100,000gp instance cost).

hints.value: 1 Yes please.

label: Kill Vorkath
detail: Fight Vorkath with full anti-dragonfire/anti-venom preparation, moving off his fireball tiles, re-enabling prayers after his pink fireball, and reacting to his periodic acid-spam or freeze-and-zombie special attacks.

label: Reach the cave north-west of the crater
detail: Climb over the ice chunks north of the crater and walk along the path to the cave on the island's north-west, watching for venomous spiders inside.

label: Pull the lever and beat the timer
detail: Pull the lever in the south-west section, then immediately run to the room on the east wall before the timer expires (needs at least 15% run energy).

label: Claim the Ungael dragon key piece and ancient key
detail: Search the stone chest for the Ungael dragon key piece and the ancient key needed later at the Ancient Cavern.

label: Enter the crypt south of the Graveyard of Heroes
detail: Enter the crypt whose entrance is in the southern part of the Graveyard of Heroes and follow the dirt path south to a small building; the crypt holds aggressive skeletons and zombies attacking with all three combat styles.

label: Inspect the tomb to reveal the puzzle
detail: Head to the bottom of the crypt and inspect the tomb to find the statue-placement puzzle.

label: Place the four statues per the account-specific clues
detail: Place the four statues using the account-specific person/weapon/location riddle clues: the statue seated by its own location goes north, the one opposite the paired weapon-holder goes south, the one asked about first goes west, and the remaining statue goes east.

until.state: account-specific statue solution, see quest's own person/weapon/location table

label: Claim the Kourend dragon key piece
detail: Search the tomb to get the Kourend dragon key piece once the statue puzzle is solved.

label: Travel to the Ancient Cavern
detail: Use a games necklace to teleport to Barbarian Outpost, run south to the whirlpool, and descend the stairs into the Ancient Cavern.

label: Open the mithril door with the ancient key
detail: Run south then west to the mithril door guarding the three clumped mithril dragons and open it with the ancient key found at Ungael.

label: Cast Fire Wave on the three dragon heads
detail: Cast Fire Wave or Fire Surge on each of the three dragon heads in the mithril door room.

hints.value: Rune counts given are for 3 casts of Fire Wave (21 fire, 15 air, 3 blood).

label: Reach the anvils in the south-west caverns
detail: Leave the dragon-head room, go east down the staircase, then climb the rough-hewn steps in the south-western area of the caverns.

label: Forge the Dragon key
detail: Use one of the anvils to forge the four dragon key pieces into the completed Dragon key.

label: Return to Lithkren by rowboat
detail: Return to Fossil Island and take the Rowboat back to Lithkren, west of the Mushroom Meadow mushtree, to the area where Dallas Jones is.

label: Unlock the ancient doors with the Dragon key
detail: Use the completed Dragon key on the ancient doors to unlock them.

label: Trigger the Lithkren cutscene with Dallas
detail: Enter the doors, head north, and speak to Dallas Jones to start a cutscene.

label: Finish dialogue with Jardric and Bob
detail: After the cutscene, finish the dialogue with Jardric and Bob to close out the Lithkren checkpoint.

label: Warn King Roald of the dragon threat
detail: Travel to Varrock and speak with King Roald about the dragon threat.

hints.value: 1 Talk about the dragon threat.

label: Warn Sir Amik Varze of the dragon threat
detail: Speak with Sir Amik Varze in Falador about the dragon threat.

hints.value: 1 Talk about the dragon threat.

label: Warn King Lathas (or King Thoros) of the dragon threat
detail: Speak with King Lathas in East Ardougne about the dragon threat (King Thoros if Song of the Elves is complete).

hints.value: 1 Talk about the dragon threat.

label: Warn Brundt the Chieftain of the dragon threat
detail: Speak with Brundt the Chieftain in Rellekka about the dragon threat; the rulers can be visited in any order.

hints.value: 2 or 3 Talk about the dragon threat (option varies if The Fremennik Exiles is complete).

label: Finalize the plan in Varrock's dining room
detail: Return to Varrock and enter the dining room north of the throne room to finalize the plan with all four rulers.

hints.value: 1 It's a good plan.

label: Talk to Bob after the war council
detail: Talk to Bob after exiting the dining room to close out the World United checkpoint.

label: Return to Ungael for the assault
detail: Return to Rellekka and take Torfinn's boat back to Ungael (100,000gp instance cost) for the final assault.

label: Defend the ship from the boarding raid
detail: Hold off the assault on your ship for 4 minutes by clicking leaks to fill them, fires to douse them, injured Fremennik warriors to heal them, and damaged masts to repair them.

hints.value: Checkpoint after this defence phase; safe to log out and resume.

label: Equip dragonfire protection for the boarding fight
detail: Put on full dragonfire protection and combat gear before advancing across the ship toward Varrock's grand ship.

label: Fight through the approach dragons
detail: Fight through a red dragon, an iron dragon, and a brutal green dragon on the way to Varrock's grand ship.

label: Kill the green and blue dragons on the grand ship
detail: Kill the two green and two blue dragons battling the Varrockian soldiers on the grand ship; a checkpoint follows.

label: Kill the black, steel and brutal red dragons
detail: Kill the black, steel, then brutal red dragons that arrive one at a time; run away whenever Galvek performs a casting animation. A checkpoint follows.

label: Kill the mithril, adamant and rune dragons
detail: Kill the mithril, adamant, then rune dragons one at a time, dodging their melee/ranged/magic/dragonfire attacks; the adamant dragon adds a Blood-Forfeit ranged hit and a poison splash (mitigated by Antidote++), and the rune dragon adds a Life-Leech ranged hit and an electric arc (mitigated by insulated boots). A checkpoint follows.

label: Gear up fully for the Galvek fight
detail: Equip both a dragonfire shield and a dragonfire potion (super antifire alone is not enough protection) plus ranged gear, and turn off Auto Retaliate before engaging Galvek.

hints.value: Thralls cannot be summoned in this fight.

label: Kill Galvek across his four phases
detail: Kill Galvek across his four 300-hitpoint phases: dodge his ground-targeted fireballs and re-enable prayers after his pink dragonfire strips them, using Protect from Magic in phase 1 and Protect from Missiles in phases 2-4; dodge phase 1's fire traps, phase 2's stat-drain projectile, phase 3's wave gaps, and phase 4's earth-bind projectiles.

label: Finish the quest with Alec Kincade
detail: Return to Alec Kincade outside the Myths' Guild to complete Dragon Slayer II.

hints.value: 2 Let's talk about my quest.

label: Tell King Narnode Shareen you'll help find Glough
detail: Speak to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree, who reports Glough missing and asks for help investigating.

hints.value: I'll help you look for Glough.

label: Climb the eastern tree at Glough's house and investigate it
detail: Enter Glough's house south-east of the Grand Tree, climb the eastern tree, then right-click investigate it to receive a handkerchief. Carry no weapons or armour.

label: Ask Anita what's wrong
detail: Visit Anita's house north of the Gnome Ball Field; she says Glough might be in trouble and offers to help.

hints.value: What's wrong? -> He might be in trouble, I could help.

label: Turn the gnome statue to unlock the cupboard
detail: Return to Glough's house, climb the tree to the second then third floor (via the northern branch), then investigate and turn the gnome statue to unlock the cupboard.

hints.value: climbing to the 3rd floor requires clicking the northern branch

label: Search the cupboard for the book of spyology
detail: Search the now-unlocked cupboard to obtain a book of spyology.

label: Search the gnome crates for a brush
detail: Search the gnome crates in the same room to obtain a brush.

label: Search the fire remains for a mysterious note
detail: Search the fire remains to obtain a mysterious note.

label: Prepare reagents and reveal the scrawled note
detail: Solve the invisible-ink puzzle: crush the lemon with the pestle and mortar, use the resulting reagent on the notes over the candles, crush the grapes, coat the brush in the juice, then use the juice-coated brush on the mysterious note to reveal a scrawled note underneath. Read it once revealed.

hints.value: the exact intermediate reagent item names are not stated on the quick guide -- collapsed into one puzzle atom rather than fabricating names

label: Show King Narnode the scrawled note and read the translation book
detail: Talk to King Narnode Shareen, who hands over a translation book (skipped if already held from The Grand Tree).

label: Translate the note with the translation book
detail: Use the translation book on the scrawled note to attempt a translation, then talk to King Narnode again about the result.

label: Ask Anita to translate the notes
detail: Show the partially-translated notes to Anita and ask her to translate them fully, then read the translated note.

hints.value: Could you translate these notes?

label: Report the translated note to King Narnode
detail: Return to King Narnode Shareen and hand over the fully translated note.

label: Ask Assistant Lori who she is
detail: Talk to Assistant Lori, who stands next to the hot air balloon beside Glough's house.

hints.value: Who are you?

label: Fly the hot air balloon to Entrana
detail: Board the hot air balloon beside Glough's house and fly to Entrana.

label: Ask Auguste about Assistant Le Smith
detail: Talk to Auguste on Entrana about Assistant Le Smith.

hints.value: Talk about Assistant Le Smith. -> Thanks for the information.

label: Fly the balloon back to the Gnome Stronghold
detail: Return via hot air balloon to the Gnome Stronghold.

label: Report back to King Narnode to close Chapter I
detail: Talk to King Narnode Shareen once more to conclude Chapter I.

label: Travel to Ape Atoll
detail: Reach Ape Atoll via the CLR fairy ring code, one of the two Ape Atoll teleports, or the gliders used in the first quest.

label: Equip a monkey/gorilla greegree
detail: Equip a ninja monkey greegree or ancient gorilla greegree and use the agility shortcut vine to climb down into the village.

label: Buy a monkey talisman from Tutab if needed
detail: If you don't already have a monkey talisman, purchase one from Tutab in the Ape Atoll Magic shop.

hints.value: skip if a monkey talisman is already held

label: Tell Garkor King Narnode sent you
detail: Talk to Garkor outside Awowogei's house.

hints.value: King Narnode has sent me. -> It's worth a shot.

label: Offer to discuss military strategy with Awowogei
detail: Talk to Awowogei.

hints.value: I'm here to discuss military strategies. -> Of course, my king.

label: Return to Garkor
detail: Talk to Garkor again.

label: Ask a Monkey Archer about Kruk
detail: Travel to the west side of the island and up the hill to the Monkey Archers, then ask one about Kruk.

label: Follow the tracks to the dungeon trapdoor and descend
detail: Follow the foot prints from the foot of the hill to a trapdoor at the foot of a palm tree just north-west of the bamboo gate, then go down and head south.

hints.value: if inventory is full the greegree drops to the floor on entering

label: Cross the dodgy-ground agility route to the eastern cave
detail: Take the agility path east through Kruk's dungeon: only step on the uncracked (non-dodgy) tiles, switch Protect from Melee or Ranged as needed whenever you fall through, and head to the nearest hanging vine to climb back up until reaching the eastern cave (checkpoint 3).

hints.value: alternate tank path: cut webs with a slash weapon and mine blocking rocks with a pickaxe, pray ranged, take the north or south fork to loot a scratched or damaged combat key from one of two chests, then disarm/dodge floor-blade and dart traps and open the matching door -- both routes converge at checkpoint 5

label: Pick the chest lock in the eastern cave
detail: Pick the lock on the chest in the small eastern cave and search it for a bronze key.

label: Pass the bronze door and continue to checkpoint 5
detail: Move through the bronze door north-west of the chest, then continue north to checkpoint 4 (praying Ranged when falling) and west to checkpoint 5, watching the map for the correct route.

label: Cross the final dodgy ground into Kruk's room
detail: Pray Melee when falling on this stretch, keep prayer active after climbing the rope to guard against the three monkeys above, and follow whichever path does not give a 'feels wrong' message.

label: Investigate the untaken-path wall to unlock the bank shortcut
detail: Before crossing the dodgy ground into Kruk's room, investigate the wall facing the path you did not take to unlock a shortcut back to the dungeon entrance for restocking.

label: Kill Kruk
detail: Enter the large cave south of the dodgy ground to find Kruk (level 207, instanced) and kill him. He can be flinched by standing against a cave wall so he stands diagonally from you, attacking each time his health bar disappears then stepping back; otherwise use stamina potions, ranged, and Protect from Missiles with hit-and-run tactics.

label: Pick up Kruk's paw
detail: Pick up Kruk's paw after the kill.

label: Bring Kruk's paw and a monkey talisman to Zooknock
detail: Talk to Zooknock at the end of the Ape Atoll Dungeon from Monkey Madness I, bringing Kruk's paw and a monkey talisman; he gives a Kruk monkey greegree, which prevents damage from undead monkeys and spiders in the dungeon from here on.

hints.value: Talk about your mission.

label: Report to Awowogei
detail: Talk to Awowogei.

label: Report to Garkor to close Chapter II
detail: Talk to Garkor.

label: Teleport to Trollheim and enter the Troll Stronghold
detail: Teleport to Trollheim on the standard spellbook (or use a stony basalt) and enter the Troll Stronghold.

label: Confront Kob
detail: Go south-west of the entrance into Kob's room, activate Protect from Melee, and talk to him.

hints.value: I know about your deal with the monkeys. -> You won't be around to crush anyone when I'm done with you. -> I accept your challenge.

label: Fight Kob until he gives up
detail: Fight Kob (hits up to 58 through Protect from Melee if not active; can be safespotted in the doorway) until he gives up -- if the fight runs too long he despawns and his health resets, so flinching is not viable.

label: Talk to Kob again
detail: Talk to Kob a second time to conclude his part.

label: Travel to Gu'Tanoth
detail: Make your way to Gu'Tanoth using the level-71 Agility shortcut, or the western path for lower Agility.

hints.value: 71 Agility shortcut is optional; the western path works at any level

label: Confront Keef
detail: Activate Protect from Melee and talk to Keef.

hints.value: I know about your deal with the monkeys. -> I offer to spare your life. -> I accept your challenge.

label: Fight Keef until he gives up
detail: Fight Keef (also hits through protection prayers and despawns on a long fight) until he gives up; a tree north of him can be used as a safespot.

label: Bank combat gear and withdraw the graceful outfit
detail: Bank heavy armour and weapons and withdraw the graceful outfit plus stamina potions, since no more combat follows until Chapter IV.

label: Return to Ape Atoll
detail: Teleport back to Ape Atoll and talk to Garkor near Awowogei.

label: Check in with Garkor
detail: Talk to Garkor near Awowogei's house.

label: Find and question Assistant Le Smith
detail: Find Assistant Le Smith on the rooftops of Marim -- he spawns at one of four possible spots: the broken building's top floor near the Monkey Child, the jail's top floor, the building west of the Magic Stall's top floor (or its dungeon-cave shortcut, which can deal 30+ fall damage), or atop the bridge between the two main-gate watchtowers.

hints.value: I was going to ask you the same question. -> Why is that? -> Awowogei has already informed me about the battleships. -> Where is the fleet, currently?

label: Report the fleet location to Garkor
detail: Talk to Garkor.

label: Ask the monkey guard for passage to the airship platform
detail: Go to the west side of the island and talk to the monkey guard next to a boat to travel to the airship platform.

hints.value: What's going on here? -> Construction platform? -> Can I visit the platform?

label: Collect 6 satchels from the crates
detail: Sneak through the airship maze avoiding ninja monkeys: from the ground floor's east wall, pass the cyan ladder and climb the green ladder, go south then west and climb down the blue ladder, then pick up 6 satchels from the crates.

label: Fill the satchels with explosives
detail: Climb back to the ground floor's cyan ladder, climb down the magenta ladder, follow the path north to the explosives, then click the barrel to fill all 6 satchels (getting caught after this point means refilling them).

label: Place all 6 satchels on the marked sabotage points
detail: Place a filled satchel on each of the 6 marked weak points across the platform: weakened floorboards below the magenta ladder, support beams east of the ground floor, weakened floorboards at the end of the west path's north fork, both gas cylinders on the top floor, and the support beams in the west fork near the entrance, avoiding ninja monkey patrols throughout.

label: Return to the boat
detail: Head back to the boat -- getting caught on the way out no longer matters and can be faster.

label: Report the sabotage to Garkor
detail: Talk to Garkor.

label: Re-enter the dungeon where Kruk was fought
detail: Enter the trapdoor down to the dungeon where Kruk was fought.

label: Cross the monkey bars with the Kruk greegree
detail: Go north to the monkey bars, equip the Kruk greegree, and use the monkey bars to cross.

label: Enter Glough's laboratory
detail: Enter the passage into Glough's laboratory.

label: Mount the stunted demonic gorilla
detail: Climb on the stunted demonic gorilla and ride it down the stairs.

label: Fight the three gorillas until they retreat
detail: Fight the three gorillas (use Protect from Melee if necessary) until they return to their cages.

label: Dismount the stunted demonic gorilla
detail: Use the holding area to dismount the stunted demonic gorilla.

label: Search the crates for a chisel and hammer if needed
detail: Search the crates for a chisel and hammer if not already carrying them.

hints.value: skip if already held

label: Tamper with the device upstairs
detail: Go upstairs and tamper with the device to the north.

label: Deconstruct the charged onyx with the chisel
detail: Use the chisel on the charged onyx to deconstruct it, then use the deconstructed onyx on the device.

label: Investigate the incubation chamber
detail: Investigate the incubation chamber found in the laboratory.

label: Report to Garkor
detail: Talk to Garkor.

label: Report to Awowogei
detail: Talk to Awowogei.

label: Report to Garkor to close Chapter III
detail: Talk to Garkor again.

label: Return to the Grand Tree
detail: Travel back to the Grand Tree (e.g. via spirit tree, gnome glider, or teleport).

label: Report to King Narnode
detail: Talk to King Narnode in the Grand Tree.

label: Talk to Nieve about Monkey Madness II
detail: Talk to Nieve, who will wait at the Grand Tree's front doors if lost track of later.

hints.value: Talk about Monkey Madness II. -> Yes.

label: Kill 4 tortured gorillas around the Gnome Stronghold
detail: Walk around the Gnome Stronghold killing tortured gorillas (melee-only, safespottable behind objects) until Nieve notifies you to find Garkor.

label: Report to Garkor north-west of the Grand Tree
detail: Gear up with two attack styles and go north-west of the Grand Tree, near the swamp toad, king worm swamp, and tortoise enclosure, to find Garkor.

label: Enter the cave north-east of the Gnome Stronghold
detail: Leave the Gnome Stronghold and head north-east, past the tortured gorillas, to enter the (instanced) cave and follow the path to Glough.

label: Kill the 2 tortured and 2 demonic gorillas guarding Glough
detail: Kill 2 tortured gorillas and 2 demonic gorillas blocking the path; killing a tortured gorilla then the demonic gorilla that drops down, before repeating on the other pair, is recommended. This is a safe point to teleport out and restock -- Glough himself hits up to 66 melee and 40+ ranged.

label: Fight Glough in the first room until he retreats
detail: In the first (instanced) room, attack Glough (safespottable here) until he moves on to the next room.

label: Lure and fight Glough in the second room until he retreats
detail: Lure Glough back into the first room and hug the north wall two squares past the divot to safespot him with ranged or magic -- Protect from Missiles does not protect here -- until he moves on to the final room.

label: Kill Glough in the final room
detail: In the final room, kill Glough (level 431): use Protect from Melee up close and Protect from Magic at range, since he pushes/pulls you depending on distance; he can be flinched with a bow of range 10+ but requires a 10-minute de-aggro first.

label: Ask Zooknock to teleport you to the Grand Tree
detail: Talk to Zooknock and ask him to teleport you to the Grand Tree.

label: Complete the quest with King Narnode
detail: Talk to King Narnode to finish the quest.

label: Ask the Guildmaster for a quest
detail: Speak to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild to start the quest.

label: Learn about the dragon from Oziach
detail: Speak to Oziach in Edgeville; he explains the rune platebody and the dragon Elvarg.

label: Get the maze key and map-piece leads
detail: Return to the Guildmaster; get the Melzar's Maze key and ask where all three map pieces and the right ship are.

label: Get an anti-dragon shield if you lack one
detail: Optional: if you don't already own an anti-dragon shield, ask Duke Horacio on the 1st floor of Lumbridge Castle for one.

hints.value: skip if shield already owned

label: Ask the Oracle about Thalzar's map piece
detail: Speak to the Oracle on Ice Mountain about the map piece, after already asking the Guildmaster where it is.

label: Open the magic door in the Dwarven Mine
detail: In the Dwarven Mine's north-east side, use silk, a lobster pot, an unfired bowl, then the wizard's mind bomb on the magic door; it opens automatically.

label: Search the chest for Thalzar's map piece
detail: Open and search the chest beyond the magic door to collect the map piece; re-entry does not require reusing the items.

label: Enter Melzar's Maze
detail: With the maze key in hand, travel to Rimmington and enter Melzar's Maze.

label: Kill the long-tailed zombie rat for a key
detail: Kill the small zombie rat with the long tail, take its key, and go through the north-western door.

label: Kill the hooded ghost for a key
detail: Kill the ghost wearing a hood and tube top (no cape), take its key, go through the second door from the north on the east wall.

label: Kill the round-shield skeleton for a key
detail: Kill the skeleton carrying the round shield, take its key, go through the westmost door on the south wall and descend the ladder three times.

label: Kill zombies until a key drops
detail: Kill the maze zombies for a key, then go through the blue door. Exact number of zombies to defeat is unconfirmed.

label: Kill Melzar the Mad for a key
detail: Kill Melzar the Mad, take his key, and go through the purple (magenta) door.

label: Kill the level-82 lesser demon for a key
detail: Kill the level-82 lesser demon (can be safespotted by luring it to the magenta door), take its key, and go through the green door.

label: Search the maze's final chest
detail: Open and search the chest to collect Melzar's map piece.

label: Go to the Port Sarim jail
detail: Travel to the jail in Port Sarim to find Wormbrain.

label: Obtain Lozar's map piece from Wormbrain
detail: Kill Wormbrain with a ranged/magic/halberd attack and telegrab the dropped map piece, or pay him instead; ask the Guildmaster first for his location.

hints.value: pay Wormbrain 10,000 coins instead of killing him

label: Combine the three map pieces
detail: Use the three collected map pieces on each other to assemble the full Crandor map.

label: Ask the Guildmaster about a ship and captain
detail: Return to the Guildmaster and ask where to find a ship and its captain.

label: Withdraw boat-repair supplies
detail: Withdraw a hammer, 3 planks, 90 steel nails, and 2,000 coins from the bank.

label: Buy the ship from Klarense
detail: Speak to Klarense at the southern docks of Port Sarim near the Void Outpost boat and pay 2,000 coins for the ship.

label: Repair the hole in the ship
detail: Board the ship, climb down the ladder, and repair the hole three times using the planks, nails, and hammer.

label: Sail to Crandor with Ned
detail: Speak to Ned in Draynor Village with the Crandor map in your inventory to sail to Crandor.

label: Climb the volcano into Elvarg's lair
detail: Climb to the top of the volcano and enter the hole down to Elvarg's cave.

label: Equip the anti-dragon shield
detail: Equip the anti-dragon shield (and drink an antifire potion if carried) before approaching Elvarg.

label: Open the shortcut wall (optional)
detail: Optional: before teleporting out, open the wall south of Elvarg's cave to unlock a permanent shortcut through the Karamja volcano dungeon.

hints.value: unlocks a Karamja diary task and a shortcut route back

label: Kill Elvarg
detail: Kill the level-83 dragon Elvarg; flinching her from the south-east corner of the cave is a safer but slower approach. Her head is collected automatically as proof.

label: Report back to Oziach
detail: Return to Oziach in Edgeville to complete the quest.

label: Ask Martin about his failed crops
detail: Speak to Martin the Master Gardener in Draynor Market to start the quest; do not pickpocket him or he becomes unavailable for 10 in-game minutes.

mapMarkers.label: Martin the Master Gardener - Draynor Market

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Return to Martin after his crops fail again
detail: Wait 5 minutes of real-world time for Martin's crops to fail again, then speak to him a second time.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Travel to Fairy Nuff's grotto in Zanaris
detail: Make your way to Fairy Nuff's ransacked grotto in Zanaris, just north of the bank.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Pick up and study Nuff's certificate
detail: Take Nuff's healing certificate off the grotto floor and study it; if lost, another copy can be found by searching the potion shelves.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Decode the certificate using the Rune temple sign
detail: Read the Rune temple sign just south of the Cosmic Altar in south-west Zanaris to decipher the certificate's fairy-symbol code.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Ask the Fairy Godfather about the Queen
detail: Speak to the Fairy Godfather in the throne room about where the Fairy Queen was taken.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Learn to use the fairy ring network
detail: Speak to the Co-ordinator north of the throne room to unlock use of the fairy rings.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Speak to Fairy Fixit
detail: Speak to Fairy Fixit near the fairy ring west of the throne room.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Equip the dramen staff
detail: Equip the dramen staff before using the fairy ring so it can be operated.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Fairy-ring route to the Fairy Queen's hideout
detail: With Nuff's certificate in inventory, teleport via the fairy ring in sequence AIR, DLR, DJQ (no movement), then AJS to reach the hideout.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Learn the Queen's condition from Fairy Nuff
detail: Speak with Fairy Nuff and Fairy Very Wise in the north-east corner of the hideout about the dying Queen and the stolen secateurs.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Speak with Fairy Very Wise
detail: Speak with Fairy Very Wise alongside Fairy Nuff in the hideout.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Fairy-ring back to Zanaris
detail: Use fairy code BKS to return to Zanaris.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Pickpocket the Fairy Godfather for the secateurs
detail: Pickpocket the Fairy Godfather in Zanaris while he and his henchmen are not looking to obtain the Queen's secateurs; requires level 40 Thieving, no stat boost usable.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Fairy-ring back to the hideout
detail: Return to the hideout via fairy code sequence AIR, DLR, DJQ, AJS.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Give the secateurs to Fairy Nuff
detail: Give the Queen's secateurs to Fairy Nuff. Do not mix the magic essence potion before she explains how to make it, or it will not work on the Queen.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Wait for and pick a star flower
detail: Travel to fairy code CKP (requires Nuff's certificate in inventory) and wait for a star flower to grow, then pick it. Growth time is roughly 2-5 minutes per the guide.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Kill a gorak for its claws
detail: Travel to fairy code DIR, kill a level-145 gorak (can be safespotted using terrain), and pick up its claws.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Fairy-ring back to the hideout
detail: Return to the hideout via fairy code sequence AIR, DLR, DJQ, AJS.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Learn the magic essence recipe from Fairy Nuff
detail: Speak to Fairy Nuff so she explains how to brew the magic essence potion before you attempt to mix it.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Steep the star flower in a vial of water
detail: Use the star flower on a vial of water to prepare the flower base for the potion.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Grind the gorak claws into powder
detail: Grind the gorak claws into gorak claw powder.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Combine the two ingredients into magic essence
detail: Use the star-flower mixture and gorak claw powder on each other to brew a magic essence potion; requires level 57 Herblore.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Use the magic essence on the Fairy Queen
detail: Right-click use the magic essence potion on the Fairy Queen, who is laying on the stretcher near Fairy Nuff.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Speak with the revived Fairy Queen
detail: Speak with the Fairy Queen to complete the quest; she lets the Godfather keep the throne given his numerical advantage.

refs.title: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen/Quick guide

label: Speak to Gossip outside Sinclair Mansion
detail: Speak to Gossip outside Sinclair Mansion to begin the quest.

label: Speak to the guard in the courtyard
detail: Speak to the guard in the courtyard to the north of the mansion.

label: Break into the mansion
detail: Break in through the smashed window on the east side of Sinclair Mansion.

label: Take the scrap paper
detail: Grab the scrap paper in the ground-floor dining room next to the fireplace.

label: Take and read the address form
detail: Go up to the 1st floor library in the centre of the mansion, take the address form off the table, and read it.

label: Search the bookcase for a black knight helm
detail: Search the bookcase on the library's western wall for a black knight helm.

label: Hand the three items to the guard
detail: Return to the guard via the smashed window and give him the scrap paper, address form, and black knight helm.

label: Report back to Gossip
detail: Speak to Gossip again, working through all of the dialogue options.

label: Travel to the Seers' Village courthouse
detail: Travel south-east of the Seers' Village bank to the courthouse for Anna's trial.

label: Begin Anna's trial
detail: Speak to Anna, then head down the stairs to begin the trial.

label: Call the Dog Handler as a witness
detail: Ask the judge to call the Dog Handler, then question him about the poison.

label: Call the Butler as a witness
detail: Ask the judge to call the Butler, then question him about the dagger.

label: Call the Maid as a witness
detail: Ask the judge to call the Maid, then question her about the night of the murder.

label: Ask about the thread
detail: Ask the Maid (or another witness) about the thread; a correct trial ends with Anna declared not guilty.

label: Speak to Anna after the trial
detail: Exit the courtroom through the gate and speak to Anna again in her cell.

label: Find the statue at Camelot Castle
detail: Head east around Camelot Castle, past the gate, to the north-east, and search the statue there to trigger a cutscene.

label: Search the statue to start the cutscene
detail: Search the statue; clicking anywhere during the cutscene ends it early and it must be repeated.

label: Speak to the imprisoned Merlin
detail: Speak with Merlin inside his cell about what to do next.

label: Reach for the cell vent
detail: Reach for the vent at the north of Merlin's cell.

label: Telekinetic Grab the guard's hair clip
detail: Cast Telekinetic Grab on the guard fixing his hair outside the cell to obtain a hair clip; knights inside the cell can alternatively provide a lockpick or telekinetic-grab runes.

hints.value: ask the knights in the cell for a lockpick or runes instead

label: Pick the cell door lock
detail: Use the hair clip or a lockpick on the door to start the tumbler puzzle.

label: Solve the four-tumbler lock
detail: Raise each of the four tumblers by trial and error: start all at the lowest height, leave any tumbler green once it shows, and keep raising the rest until the lock opens.

label: Climb to the top floor
detail: Climb the staircases up to the top floor of the prison tower.

label: Search the table
detail: Search the table on the top floor.

label: Take the round purple box
detail: Choose the round purple box, second from the right, from the table.

label: Get an Animate Rock scroll from Wizard Cromperty
detail: Speak to Wizard Cromperty in Ardougne for an Animate Rock scroll; talk to him even if the scroll is already owned from One Small Favour.

label: Travel to Black Knights' Fortress
detail: Travel to Black Knights' Fortress, west of Edgeville and north of Ice Mountain.

label: Equip full black armour
detail: Equip a full set of black armour before entering the fortress.

label: Enter through the sturdy south door
detail: Enter the fortress through the sturdy door on the south wall while wearing full black armour.

label: Push the north wall
detail: Push the wall to the north to reveal the way down.

label: Free King Arthur with granite
detail: Climb down the ladder and free King Arthur from his statue using the granite.

label: Give King Arthur the helm and chainbody
detail: Talk to King Arthur and give him the bronze med helm and iron chainbody.

label: Return to Camelot's round table
detail: Travel back to Camelot Castle's round table room.

label: Report to King Arthur to finish
detail: Speak to King Arthur at the round table to complete the quest.

label: Travel to Lunar Isle and enter the mine cave
detail: Head to Lunar Isle, enter the mine in the north-east area, and crawl through the marked cave entrance to reach the fallen man.

label: Talk to the fallen man and close the interface
detail: Speak to the collapsed man in the cave, follow the dialogue, then close the interface that appears afterward.

label: Feed him the first round of food (4 pieces)
detail: Feed him 4 pieces of food, starting with whichever type you have seven of and cycling between the different foods without repeating one twice in a row.

label: Reassure him with a positive response
detail: Talk to him again and pick the reassuring dialogue option.

hints.value: Just don't worry. / Of course.

label: Feed him the second round of food (4 pieces)
detail: Feed him 4 more pieces of food as before, continuing to cycle between food types.

label: Keep reassuring him until he sits up
detail: Talk to him repeatedly, choosing positive responses, until a cutscene plays of him sitting up.

label: Feed him the third round of food (6 pieces)
detail: Feed him 6 more pieces of food, completing the 3-type, 20-piece total food requirement.

label: Talk him upright, then once more
detail: Talk to him repeatedly with positive responses until a cutscene shows him stand up, then talk to him one additional time.

until.state: fallen man stands up (cutscene), plus one extra talk

label: Ask 'Birds-Eye' Jack about Cyrisus's gear
detail: Talk to 'Birds-Eye' Jack in the bank and ask about Cyrisus in the mine to learn which equipment set he needs.

hints.value: Cyrisus in the mine

label: Withdraw the matching Armament equipment set
detail: Withdraw the equipment set matching Cyrisus's dominant combat style -- melee: dragon med helm, Abyssal whip, Ahrim's robetop/robeskirt, ranger boots; magic: Robin hood hat, dragon chainbody, black d'hide chaps, infinity boots, ancient staff; ranged: splitbark helm, Karil's leathertop, Torag's platelegs, adamant boots, magic shortbow -- then confirm the correct set with the NPC Contact spell.

label: Return the confirmed gear to Cyrisus
detail: Bring the confirmed equipment set back to Cyrisus for a cutscene, then choose to discuss the Armament.

hints.value: Talk about the Armament

label: Feed Cyrisus until his health reaches 100%
detail: Use food on Cyrisus repeatedly until his health bar fills to 100%.

label: Reassure Cyrisus until his spirit maxes out
detail: Talk to him again multiple times with positive responses until a cutscene triggers; feed him a bit more if it doesn't trigger yet.

label: Talk to the Oneiromancer for a dream vial
detail: Speak to the Oneiromancer at the Astral Altar to receive a dream vial.

hints.value: Cyrisus.

label: Optionally switch spellbook for the final fight
detail: Change spellbook now if you plan to use spells from a different spellbook during the Dream Hall fight.

hints.value: Optional -- only needed if your planned fight strategy uses a non-default spellbook.

label: Fill the dream vial with water
detail: Fill the vial received from the Oneiromancer with water.

label: Add goutweed to the vial
detail: Add a goutweed to the water-filled dream vial.

label: Hammer the astral rune into shards
detail: Use a hammer on an astral rune to crack it into shards.

label: Grind the shards into ground astral rune
detail: Grind the astral rune shards with a pestle and mortar.

label: Add the ground astral rune to finish the potion
detail: Add the ground astral rune to the prepared dream vial to complete the dream potion.

label: Gear up for the four fights
detail: Prepare combat gear for four consecutive fights where prayers and emergency teleports are disabled; keep the seal of passage on you rather than banking it, since 'Birds-Eye' Jack will not serve you without it beforehand.

hints.value: Do not bank the seal of passage before entering the Dream Hall.

label: Light the Ceremonial Brazier
detail: Light the Ceremonial Brazier inside the dream hall building to begin the encounter.

label: Talk to Cyrisus to start the fight
detail: Speak to Cyrisus and agree to proceed into the fight.

hints.value: Yes, let's go!
You can leave at any time via the lectern to the north, but this forces a re-battle of any defeated bosses.

label: Defeat The Inadequacy (level 343)
detail: Fight and kill The Inadequacy, the hardest of the four bosses; magic is recommended since it has low magic defence.

label: Defeat The Everlasting (level 223)
detail: Fight and kill The Everlasting; it can be safespotted from the lectern to the north.

label: Defeat The Untouchable (level 274)
detail: Fight and kill The Untouchable; it can also be safespotted from the lectern to the north.

label: Defeat The Illusive (level 108)
detail: Fight and kill The Illusive, which burrows and relocates during the fight.

label: Return to the Oneiromancer to finish
detail: Head back to the Oneiromancer and talk to her to complete the quest.

hints.value: Cyrisus.

label: Talk to a Legends' Guard east of Ardougne
detail: Speak to a Legends' Guard east of Ardougne and ask to be taken to Grand Vizier Erkle; fairy ring code BLR reaches the area.

hints.value: Can I speak to someone in charge? / Can I go on the quest? / Yes, I'd like to talk to Grand Vizier Erkle.

label: Talk to Radimus and accept the quest
detail: Talk to Radimus Erkle and agree to hear about and start the quest.

hints.value: Yes actually, what's involved? / Yes, it sounds great!

label: Take a machete from the cupboards
detail: Open the cupboards next to Radimus Erkle to obtain a machete, if you don't already carry one.

label: Take papyrus from the table
detail: Grab papyrus from the table next to Radimus Erkle, if needed for the jungle mapping.

label: Travel to the Kharazi Jungle south of Shilo Village
detail: Head to the Kharazi Jungle via fairy ring code CKR, or the Karamja gnome glider plus the stepping stones to the south-west, then chop through the jungle bush to get in.

label: Optionally restock papyrus and charcoal
detail: Buy extra papyrus and charcoal from the Shilo Village General Store before mapping, if you're short.

hints.value: Optional resupply -- skip if already carrying enough papyrus/charcoal.

label: Map the west section of the jungle
detail: Right-click Radimus notes and select 'complete' once you finish exploring the western jungle section.

label: Map the middle section of the jungle
detail: Complete the mapping of the middle jungle section with Radimus notes before moving on.

label: Map the east section of the jungle
detail: Complete the mapping of the eastern jungle section with Radimus notes to finish the map.

label: Trade the completed notes for a bullroarer
detail: Use the completed Radimus notes on a Jungle forester south of Shilo Village to receive a bullroarer; read the map to him first if he refuses.

hints.value: Yes, go ahead make a copy!

label: Return into the Kharazi Jungle
detail: Cut your way back into the jungle interior.

label: Swing the bullroarer to summon Gujuo
detail: Swing the bullroarer beside a totem pole; try a different pole if it doesn't work.

label: Talk to Gujuo about the native people
detail: Speak with Gujuo, working through the dialogue about attracting and befriending the jungle natives.

hints.value: I was hoping to attract the attention of a native. / I want to develop friendly relations with your people. / Can you get your people together? / What can we do instead then? / How do we make the totem pole? / I will release Ungadulu...

label: Search the Mossy rock and crawl inside
detail: Search the Mossy rock in the north-western jungle section and crawl inside; requires 50 Agility.

label: Investigate the Fire Wall
detail: Investigate the Fire Wall inside the cave to learn how it can be doused with sacred water.

hints.value: How can I extinguish the flames? / Where do I get pure water from?

label: Leave the cave and swing the bullroarer again
detail: Exit the cave and swing the bullroarer once more to ask Gujuo about the pure water and the vessel needed to carry it.

hints.value: I need some pure water to douse some magic flames. / Where is the pool of sacred water? / What kind of a vessel?

label: Smith the golden bowl
detail: Use 2 gold bars with a hammer on an anvil (a barbarian anvil will not work) to smith a golden bowl; this can fail.

label: Have Gujuo enchant the golden bowl
detail: Swing the bullroarer to summon Gujuo and ask him to bless the golden bowl; requires at least 42 Prayer points and can fail, costing prayer points on failure.

hints.value: Yes, I'd like you to bless my gold bowl.

label: Fill the blessed bowl with sacred water
detail: At the Water Pool west of the jungle centre, use a machete on the nearby reeds, then use the reeds on the pool to fill the blessed golden bowl.

label: Squeeze through the crevice behind the eastern bookcase
detail: Re-enter the north-western cave and search the eastern bookcase to slip through the hidden crevice behind it.

label: Pick the first gate's lock
detail: Use a lockpick on the gate to open it; carry a spare lockpick in case it breaks.

label: Smash the three boulders
detail: Smash all three boulders blocking the path; a failed smash can reduce Mining by 1, so bring a restore potion if needed.

label: Force open the second gate
detail: Push open the next gate; requires 50 Strength.

label: Walk to the marked wall
detail: Walk south-west then north-west, jumping the jagged walls along the way, until you reach the marked wall.

label: Search the marked wall first
detail: Search the marked wall before using runes on it, or the runes will be consumed with no effect.

label: Use the runes on the marked wall in order
detail: Use Soul, Mind, Earth, Law, and Law runes on the marked wall in that exact order.

label: Place the cut gems on the matching carved rocks
detail: Use each cut gem -- opal, jade, red topaz, sapphire, emerald, ruby, diamond -- on the carved rock whose colour matches it, per the in-cave map.

label: Pick up and read the binding book
detail: Take the binding book that appears once the wall opens, and read it.

label: Teleport out to prepare, then return
detail: Teleport away to gear up for the Nezikchened fight, then return to the first room of the cave.

label: Refill the bowl with sacred water if needed
detail: Top up the golden bowl with sacred water again -- leaving the jungle can evaporate what's inside.

label: Douse the fire around Ungadulu
detail: Use the sacred-water-filled golden bowl on the fire surrounding Ungadulu.

label: Bind Ungadulu with the binding book
detail: Use the binding book on Ungadulu, being careful not to left-click attack him by mistake.

label: Defeat Nezikchened (level 187)
detail: Fight and defeat Nezikchened; prayer drains to 1/10 of your level at the start, so ranged or melee with Protect from Melee is recommended since he strongly resists magic. Taking too long lets him despawn, forcing a redo of the water-and-book steps.

label: Talk to the freed Ungadulu
detail: Speak with Ungadulu about collecting Yommi tree seeds, careful not to attack him by mistake.

hints.value: I need to collect some Yommi tree seeds for Gujuo. / How do I grow the Yommi tree? / What will you do now? / How do I get out of here? / Ok, thanks...

label: Exit and tell Gujuo Ungadulu is free
detail: Leave the area, summon Gujuo, and tell him Ungadulu has been freed from the demon that possessed him.

hints.value: Ungadulu is free, he was possessed by a demon and I killed it. / What do I do now? / Ok thanks for your help.

label: Water the Yommi tree seeds
detail: Use your bowl of water on the Yommi tree seeds.

label: Cut reeds and try to refill the bowl
detail: Cut more reeds and attempt to refill the bowl at the pool.

hints.value: The pool has dried up at this point -- the refill attempt fails until the water source is restored later.

label: Tell Gujuo the water source is dry
detail: Summon Gujuo and explain the water pool has dried up, asking about the water's source and for his help reaching it.

hints.value: The water pool has dried up and I need more water. / Where is the source of the spring of pure water? / If I went, could you help me? / Ok thanks for your help.

label: Collect ardrigal from a large-leaved palm tree
detail: Search a large-leaved palm tree to collect ardrigal, if you're not already carrying extra from Jungle Potion.

label: Collect snake weed from a marshy jungle vine
detail: Search a marshy jungle vine to collect snake weed, if you're not already carrying extra.

label: Mix a bravery potion
detail: Mix the ardrigal and snake weed with a vial of water to make a bravery potion.

label: Drink the bravery potion before descending
detail: Drink the bravery potion now to save inventory space before heading back through the cave.

label: Cast Charge Orb on the north gate
detail: Return through the cave to the gem-pool chamber and cast a Charge Orb spell on the north gate to open it.

label: Use the rope on the winch and climb down
detail: Use a rope on the winch and climb down; without a rope, smash a barrel instead (a monster may spawn) and expect 10-20 fall damage either way.

label: Climb over the rocks to reach the bottom
detail: Climb over the rocky ledge to reach the bottom of the chasm; this can deal 40+ fall damage.

label: Kill the level-106 skeleton for a crystal piece
detail: Defeat the level-106 skeleton to obtain a crystal piece.

label: Kill the level-100 skeleton for a crystal piece
detail: Defeat the level-100 skeleton to obtain a crystal piece.

label: Kill the level-92 skeleton for a crystal piece
detail: Defeat the level-92 skeleton to obtain a crystal piece.

label: Feed the crystal pieces to the furnace
detail: Use each of the 3 crystal pieces on the north-eastern furnace to form a heart.

label: Use the heart on the mossy rock
detail: Search the one searchable mossy rock in the middle of the room, then use the heart on it.

label: Use the heart on the recess and walk through the barrier
detail: Run south-east, use the heart on the recess next to the barrier, then walk through the barrier.

label: Push a boulder aside
detail: Push one of the boulders to the west to clear the way.

label: Talk to Echned Zekin
detail: Speak with the ghost Echned Zekin about needing the water, and agree to help him.

hints.value: Who's asking? / What can I do about that? / I'll do what I must to get the water. / Ok, I'll do it.

label: [Evil path] Equip the dagger
detail: Evil/short path: climb back to the top of the ridge and equip the dagger.

hints.value: evil-short-path

label: [Evil path] Provoke and kill Viyeldi
detail: Evil/short path: try to take the blue hat and attack Viyeldi during the dialogue to kill him; confirm your dagger is glowing afterward before going back down.

hints.value: evil-short-path

label: [Evil path] Push the boulder; the ghost takes the dagger
detail: Evil/short path: go back and push the boulder; the ghost takes the glowing dagger from you.

hints.value: evil-short-path

label: [Evil path] Defeat Nezikchened again
detail: Evil/short path: a level-187 demon spawns immediately and drains your prayer -- defeat Nezikchened.

hints.value: evil-short-path

label: [Evil path] Push the boulder to reach the water
detail: Evil/short path: push the boulder again to reach the now-restored water pool.

hints.value: evil-short-path

label: [Evil path] Water the seeds if not already done
detail: Evil/short path: fill the bowl from the restored pool and use it on the seeds if you haven't already.

hints.value: evil-short-path
Teleporting evaporates the water -- the pool is now a repeatable source going forward.

label: [Good path] Pass through the fire wall
detail: Good/long path: do not touch the hat or talk to Viyeldi; teleport out, bank if desired, return to the start of the cave, and investigate the fire wall to pass through.

hints.value: good-long-path

label: [Good path] Use the dark dagger on Ungadulu
detail: Good/long path: use the dark dagger on Ungadulu.

hints.value: good-long-path

label: [Good path] Cast Charge Orb again
detail: Good/long path: head back into the cave and cast another Charge Orb spell on the door.

hints.value: good-long-path

label: [Good path] Push the boulder
detail: Good/long path: push the boulder aside.

hints.value: good-long-path

label: [Good path] Reveal Zekin's true form with Holy Force
detail: Good/long path: do not tell Zekin you lost the dagger -- instead cast Holy Force to reveal his true form.

hints.value: good-long-path

label: [Good path] Defeat Nezikchened
detail: Good/long path: defeat Nezikchened once his true form is revealed.

hints.value: good-long-path

label: [Good path] Push the far west boulder and collect water
detail: Good/long path: push the far west boulder out of the way and collect the sacred water.

hints.value: good-long-path
Teleporting evaporates the water -- the pool is now a repeatable source going forward.

label: Plant the Yommi tree seeds
detail: Use the germinated seeds on the fertile soil patch 8 steps north and 5 steps west of the pool; requires 45 Herblore (boostable) and may need retries until a sapling grows.

label: Water the Yommi bush into an adult tree
detail: Use sacred water on the grown Yommi bush to turn it into an adult Yommi tree.

hints.value: The tree rots if you delay too long before carving it, forcing a redo of the growth process including getting sacred water again.

label: Chop and carve the Yommi tree into a totem
detail: Use an axe on the adult Yommi tree, then use the axe on the downed tree twice more to carve it into a totem.

label: Pick up the Yommi totem
detail: Lift the carved totem from the ground into your inventory.

label: Activate Protect from Melee before the ritual
detail: Turn on Protect from Melee before using the totem -- you'll take 4 unavoidable hits, up to 72 damage total on one tick, without being able to move, eat, or change prayers.

label: Use the totem on an old totem pole
detail: Use your Yommi totem on any old, brown totem pole to begin the final ritual.

label: Kill the three ritual skeletons in sequence
detail: Kill the three skeletons that appear one at a time; keep Protect from Melee active, since Nezikchened reappears and hits you after each one dies.

label: Defeat Nezikchened at the totem pole
detail: Defeat Nezikchened once he appears after the three skeletons, keeping Protect from Melee active throughout.

label: Use the totem on the pole again
detail: Use your Yommi totem on the totem pole a second time to finish the ritual.

label: Receive the gilded totem from Gujuo
detail: Gujuo appears and hands over the gilded totem; swing the bullroarer to summon him if he doesn't show up.

label: Hand in the gilded totem and Radimus notes
detail: Talk to Radimus at the Legends' Guild (fairy ring code BLR) while carrying the gilded totem and the Radimus notes.

label: Choose four skills for training
detail: Talk to Radimus again in the main guild hall and select four skills for the quest's training reward.

label: Talk to Radimus once more to finish
detail: Speak to Radimus one final time to complete the quest.

label: Talk to King Lathas on the top floor of Ardougne Castle to begin
detail: He explains the plan to send you through the pass; committing here starts the point-of-no-return sequence once you reach Koftik.

hints.value: 1I am. What's our plan?
1Yes.

label: Talk to Koftik at the West Ardougne cave entrance
detail: Bring all remaining supplies now; nothing extra can be fetched once you commit to entering.

hints.value: 1I'll take my chances.

label: Enter the cave and head south at the first junction
detail: Zone transition into the dungeon proper.

label: Get cloth from Koftik and light an arrow with it
detail: Use the cloth on an arrow, then light it with a tinderbox (or use the arrow on the ground fire).

label: Shoot the lit arrow at the bridge's guide rope
detail: Equip a bow first and pick up any dropped items beforehand -- nothing can be recovered once you're across unless you pull the lever to return.

label: Grab the plank in the room north of the bridge
detail: Skip if already carrying a plank from earlier.

label: Use a rope on the rock above the pit to cross it
detail: Failing the crossing loses the rope.

label: Cross the tile grid by trial and error
detail: Keep Hitpoints above 15 while crossing; some tiles collapse and some paths are dead ends.

label: Pull the lever next to the gate
detail: Opens the way into the next area; also the point where you could pull it again to retreat across the bridge.

label: Activate Rapid Heal at the nearby altar
detail: Optional but recommended before the trap corridor ahead.

label: Pass west through the zombie-camp corridor
detail: Attempt to disable or walk past the five sets of wall traps marked along the corridor.

label: Pick up the plank by the furnace
detail: Skip if already carrying one.

label: Take the first light orb via the north path
detail: Use the plank on the flat rocks to reach it.

label: Take the second light orb via the north-west path
detail: Path is guarded by ogres and blessed spiders.

label: Take the third light orb via the centre-west path
detail: Use the plank on the flat rocks again to reach it.

label: Disarm the trap and search the rock for the fourth light orb
detail: Do not pick up the orb directly on this path -- search the rock beneath it instead.

label: Fuel the furnace with all four light orbs
detail: Return east to the zombie camp furnace first.

label: Turn off Rapid Heal and climb down the well
detail: Return to the altar before descending.

label: Search the two stacked crates for food
detail: Optional: yields 2 salmon and 2 meat pies.

label: Picklock the south-east slave cage gate
detail: Opens the route west toward the obstacle maze.

label: Dig the loose mud with a spade
detail: Marked as point 2 on the guide map.

label: Cross the ledge
detail: Marked as point 3; you may fall and need to retry from the slave cage.

label: Take the 50-Thieving shortcut, or cross the stone bridge maze without it
detail: Shortcut is point 5 (avoid the bubbles); the stone bridge maze at point 4 is the non-Thieving alternative.

hints.value: stone bridge maze at point 4 if under 50 Thieving

label: Squeeze through the pipe
detail: Marked as point 6 on the guide map.

label: Search the unicorn cage, then use a railing piece on the boulder above it
detail: The railing piece can be dropped after this step.

label: Search the cage again to take the unicorn horn
detail: The railing piece can be dropped once the horn is retrieved.

label: Follow the tunnel to the three knights guarding the well
detail: Zone transition through the cave passage.

label: Kill the three knights guarding the well
detail: Safespottable from the hallway to the south; optional dialogue with any of them before the fight yields food and potions.

label: Take a badge from each defeated knight
Use the three badges and the unicorn horn on the well to open the door
Head south and descend into the dwarf encampment
detail: You can drop your spade, plank, and any spare rope before this point.

label: Talk to Niloof the dwarf
detail: Also yields 2 meat pies and a meat pizza; declining Kamen's beer instead costs 75 coins for food, accepting costs 5 damage and -3 Agility.

label: Talk to Klank the dwarf for his gauntlets
detail: Keep one inventory slot free to receive them.

label: Cross the broken bridge north-east and search the witch's window from outside
detail: Locates her house before entering.

label: Pick up the witch's cat
Use the cat on the witch's door to open it
Open the chest inside the witch's house for loot
detail: Requires 4 free inventory spaces; do not skip the chat option that appears.

label: Kill the three demons west of the witch's house
Take an amulet from each defeated demon
Open the chest north of the middle demon
Use a bucket on the brew barrel in the eastern dwarf house
detail: A spare bucket is available in the larger western house if needed.

label: Use the dwarf brew and a tinderbox on the tomb in the south-east corner
detail: A spare tinderbox is available in the eastern house if needed.

label: Head north to Kalrag's spider pit
detail: You can drop your tinderbox and bucket before this point.

label: Kill Kalrag the spider
detail: Safespottable; its attacks ignore Protect from Melee.

label: Head north-west through the cave entrance to the half-souless area
Wear Klank's gauntlets and search the marked cage for Iban's dove
detail: Requires Klank's gauntlets equipped; the dove attaches to the doll automatically and never enters the inventory.

label: Head south to the broken bridge, then east and south into the Disciples of Iban maze
Kill a Disciple of Iban in the middle of the maze
Take the fallen disciple's ceremonial robes
Equip the ceremonial robes
detail: Required to be let through the temple doors.

label: Enter Iban's temple
detail: Do not drop anything you are not willing to lose -- using the doll on the well teleports you to the tunnel entrance.

label: Use the Doll of Iban on the well repeatedly until Iban is destroyed
detail: Standing one tile north of the well helps dodge his unblockable spikes (roughly 8 damage each); his attacks may interrupt the action several times before it lands.

label: Talk to Koftik to be transported back through the pass
Return to Ardougne Castle
Talk to King Lathas to complete the quest
Start the quest via the Canifis signpost or Dr Fenkenstrain
detail: The signpost is in the centre of Canifis.

label: Get a pickled brain from the Canifis tavern table
detail: Costs 50gp, or lift it with Telekinetic Grab.

label: Talk to Dr Fenkenstrain inside Fenkenstrain's Castle

hints.value: 1Yes.
4Braindead
4Grave-digging

label: Read "The Joy Of Grave Digging" in the west bookcase upstairs

hints.value: 4The Joy of Gravedigging
