label: Read "Handy Maggot Avoidance Techniques" in the east bookcase upstairs

hints.value: 2Handy Maggot Avoidance Techniques

label: Combine the marble amulet and obsidian amulet into the star amulet
Dig the cross-shaped grave marker in the Haunted Woods for a decapitated head
detail: South-east of Fenkenstrain's castle, immediately east of the alq fairy ring; the woods are infested with vampyres, so bring a holy symbol and food at low levels.

label: Combine the decapitated head and the pickled brain
Head north out of the Haunted Woods and use the star amulet on the easternmost memorial
detail: South-east of Fenkenstrain's castle.

label: Push the memorial to enter the Experiment Cave
Kill a level-51 Experiment for the cavern key
detail: If Rag and Bone Man II is started, also kill the level-25 Experiments for an Experiment bone.

label: Follow the north-western path to the end of the cave
Search the chest and climb the ladder
Dig the three graves for a torso, arms, and legs
Return to Dr Fenkenstrain and give him the body parts
detail: Fenkenstrain's Castle teleport works here.

hints.value: 1I have some body parts for you.

label: Talk to Dr Fenkenstrain again to give him the needle and thread
Talk to the Gardener Ghost for the shed key
detail: Requires an equipped ghostspeak amulet.

hints.value: 2Do you know where the key to the shed is?

label: Search the cupboard inside the shed for a garden brush
Take 3 canes from the pile next to the shed
Use all 3 canes on the garden brush to extend it
detail: Uses a total of 3 bronze wires.

label: Use the extended brush on the western fireplace upstairs for a conductor mould
Smelt a silver bar into a conductor (lightning rod)
detail: Nearest furnace is Port Phasmatys; alternatives are Falador, fairy ring to Zanaris, amulet of glory to Al Kharid, or Home Teleport to Lumbridge.

label: Climb to the lightning conductor and repair it
detail: Go upstairs then climb the southern ladder.

label: Return to Dr Fenkenstrain and talk to him
Go upstairs through the metal door and climb the northern ladder to talk to Fenkenstrain's monster
Go downstairs and pickpocket the doctor for the ring of charos
Talk to Sanfew on the top floor of the Taverley Herblore store to start
detail: Required items for this section: vodka, pineapple chunks, climbing boots.

hints.value: 1Have you any more work for me, to help reclaim the circle?
1I'll do it.

label: Climb to the top of Trollheim to Eadgar's Cave, or use the Rellekka secret-door route
detail: Burthorpe route: use the agility shortcuts up Trollheim. Rellekka route: slayer ring or fairy ring AJR to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, then head north-east through the secret entrance.

hints.value: secret door via Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (fairy ring AJR) instead of climbing Trollheim

label: Free Eadgar from the troll stronghold prison if not already done
detail: Pickpocket (30+ Thieving) or kill the sleeping guard Berry, then use the cell key on Eadgar's cell; check the Troll Stronghold quest log for confirmation he's rescued.

label: Speak with Eadgar in his cave

hints.value: 1I need to find some goutweed.

label: Talk to Burntmeat in his kitchen on the south end of the middle floor
Return to Eadgar and speak with him again
Travel to Ardougne Zoo and talk to Parroty Pete

hints.value: 2When did you add it?
3What do you feed them?

label: Use vodka on the pineapple chunks to make alco-chunks
detail: Right-click the vodka to avoid accidentally drinking it.

label: Use the alco-chunks on the aviary hatch on the west side of the parrot cage
detail: Do not drop the drugged parrot or it flies away and must be retrieved from Eadgar.

label: Talk to Eadgar in his cave about making the fake human
Use the parrot on the rack north of the cells in the Troll Stronghold
detail: Can be skipped and combined with the return trip to Eadgar if using the agility route.

label: Talk to Tegid in Taverley, south-east of the Herblore store, for a dirty robe
detail: 10 grain is available just south-west of Tegid; 5 raw chicken can be gathered by killing chickens at Tenzing's house.

hints.value: 2Sanfew won't be happy...

label: Pick a troll thistle from a grass patch near Eadgar's cave entrance
detail: It only spawns in one patch at a time and is small and grass-coloured -- zoom in close to spot the green flower.

label: Enter Eadgar's cave and talk to Eadgar
Light a fire and cook the troll thistle into a dried thistle
detail: A fire near the trolls to the west also works.

label: Grind the dried thistle with a pestle and mortar and add it to a ranarr potion (unf)
detail: Requires Herblore 31.

label: Talk to Eadgar again
Retrieve the drugged parrot from the rack in the troll stronghold
Talk to Eadgar to receive the fake man
Give the fake man to Burntmeat
Search the kitchen drawers by the south wall for a storeroom key
Go down the stairs inside the kitchen to the storeroom
Sneak to the back of the storeroom and take the goutweed, avoiding the two patrolling guards
detail: Taking 2 extra goutweed here is worth it for Dream Mentor/Dragon Slayer II since only one trip's worth can be carried out per run; expect 0-6 damage if caught.

label: Return the goutweed to Sanfew to complete the quest
Go to Glarial's Tomb entrance north-west of the Fishing Guild
detail: Not the waterfall cave -- the tomb entrance itself.

label: Talk to the ghost Valdez outside the tomb
detail: He explains he was cursed after Rennard stole the Staff of Armadyl he was delivering to Entrana; he gives a Ghostly robe (top) and a location hint that reveals which of the three ghost sequences to follow.

hints.value: 'pirates and a shipwreck' = Sequence 1; 'north-east' = Sequence 2; 'south-east' = Sequence 3

label: Talk to Rennard to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 1: near the shipwrecked ship between the Wilderness Agility Course and Pirates' Hideout, level 52 Wilderness. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Talk to Kharrim to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 1: the Chaos Temple (hut) altar in level 38 Wilderness, north of the Forgotten Cemetery. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Talk to Lennissa to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 1: Entrana church -- Morytania legs cannot be used here since they're banned on Entrana. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Talk to Dhalak to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 1: Wizards' Tower, ground floor. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Talk to Viggora to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 1: Rogues' Castle, upper floor, small easternmost room with a bronze sq shield spawn, level 52-56 Wilderness. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Talk to Rennard to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 2: the Bandit Camp (Wilderness) near the shops -- lure interrupting bandits into the nearby food store and shut the door if needed. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Talk to Kharrim to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 2: the Graveyard of Shadows, typically near the southern tomb. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Talk to Lennissa to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 2: Port Sarim docks at the Lady Lumbridge, second-southmost dock. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Talk to Dhalak to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 2: Edgeville Monastery, upstairs by the altar (requires Prayer 31). Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Talk to Viggora to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 2: Slayer Tower in Canifis, first floor by the Infernal Mages entrance on the eastern side. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Talk to Rennard to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 3: the Bandit Camp (Kharidian Desert), in the bar on the western side. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Talk to Kharrim to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 3: the end of the Lava Maze inside the second fenced-in area -- bring a slash weapon or knife to cut through the webs. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Talk to Lennissa to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 3: west side of Tree Gnome Stronghold, south of the Gnome Ball Field along the fence. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Talk to Dhalak to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 3: the Falador Party Room, upstairs on the eastern side. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Talk to Viggora to learn his part of the curse and claim his robe piece
detail: Sequence 3: the Edgeville Dungeon, northernmost room near the earth warriors -- trap them behind the ghost to avoid interrupted dialogue. Wear the ring of visibility plus a ghostspeak method (amulet or Morytania legs); ghosts don't show on the minimap.

label: Equip the full set of five ghostly robe pieces plus the top from Valdez
detail: Only the sequence matching Valdez's hint yields real ghost responses; the other two sequences' ghosts exist but won't progress the quest.

label: Return to Valdez wearing the complete ghost-robe set to end the curse
Talk to Lokar Searunner at the westernmost Rellekka docks
detail: He's found near the closest fairy ring; ask about traveling to Lunar Isle.

label: Ask Brundt the Chieftain in the Longhall for a seal of passage
detail: Request the seal needed to travel to and remain on Lunar Isle.

label: Return to Lokar Searunner now that you have the seal of passage
detail: Report back to board the ship.

label: Board the pirate ship and ask Captain Bentley about sailing to Lunar Isle
detail: Climb the ladders to board, then request passage to Lunar Isle.

label: Speak to Captain Bentley again
detail: Continue the conversation about departure.

label: Climb down the south stairs through the door and talk to 'Birds-Eye' Jack
detail: Meet the ship's navigator below decks.

label: Climb back up and talk to Captain Bentley again
detail: Raise the possibility that the navigator is at fault for the delay.

label: Return to 'Birds-Eye' Jack below decks
detail: Follow up with the navigator a second time.

label: Talk to 'Eagle-eye' Shultz at the very front (north end) of the ship
detail: Must be spoken to first in the fixed crew order.

hints.value: Talk to all 5 crew members in the exact order listed -- the quest enforces the order.

label: Talk to the Cabin boy one deck up from the captain (south)
detail: Second crew member in the required order.

label: Talk to 'Beefy' Burns on the lowest level of the ship
detail: Third crew member in the order; found belowdecks near the cook.

label: Talk to 'Lecherous' Lee at the very top-rear of the ship
detail: Fourth crew member in the order.

label: Talk to First mate 'Davey-boy' on the deck level, south room
detail: Fifth and final crew member in the order.

label: Climb back up and talk to the Cabin boy again
detail: Requires 2 free inventory spaces; this is where the emerald lens and lantern items for the clue hunt come from.

label: Prepare an emerald-lens lantern and light it
detail: Use the emerald lens on your lit bullseye lantern, or make lamp oil and add it to the Cabin boy's spare unlit lantern (or use a Tears of Guthix sapphire lantern) if you didn't bring a lightable one; light it with a tinderbox.

hints.value: If you lose the emerald lens, the Cabin boy will give you another.

label: Use the lit lantern on the ship's 5 hidden-symbol spots and rub away each symbol
detail: Search the eastern cannon (same level as the Cabin boy), the wallchart in the southern room down the stairs, the northern chest and the support pillar on the lowest level, and the crate directly east of the cooking range.

label: Report the findings to Captain Bentley
Climb down the ladders into the Lunar Isle city
detail: Triggers a short cutscene on arrival.

label: Head to the south-east of the island and talk to the Oneiromancer
Kill Suqah (safespottable, level 111) until a suqah tooth drops
detail: Also keep any suqah hides received as drops -- 4 total are needed later in the quest.

label: Enter the chicken house in the north of the city and talk to Baba Yaga
detail: Requires 1 free inventory space.

label: Use an empty vial on a nearby water source outside the chicken house
Add a guam leaf and a marrentill to the vial
detail: Ironmen can repeat this vial-making loop for Herblore XP if surplus guam/marrentill need using up.

label: Grind the suqah tooth and use it on the vial to complete the potion
Return to the Oneiromancer with the finished potion
Charge the Dramen staff at the Air Altar south of Falador
detail: Must be done first, in order.

label: Charge the staff at the Fire Altar (north of Al Kharid, Emir's Arena)
detail: Second altar, in order.

label: Charge the staff at the Water Altar in Lumbridge Swamp
detail: Third altar, in order.

label: Charge the staff at the Earth Altar north-east of Varrock
detail: Fourth and final altar; completes the Lunar staff.

label: Travel back to Lunar Isle and give the Lunar staff to the Oneiromancer
detail: Bring the seal of passage -- it's required to stay on the isle.

label: Climb down the ladder to the Lunar Mine in the north-east of the isle
Mine stalagmites for lunar ore (1 now, 3 extra for a later quest)
detail: Grabbing the extra ore now saves a return trip during The Fremennik Exiles.

label: Smelt the lunar ore into a lunar bar at a furnace, or superheat it

label: With a hammer, use the lunar bar on an anvil to smith the lunar helm
Return to Lunar Isle
In the north-west of the city, talk to Pauline Polaris and guess her real name

label: In the south of the city, talk to Meteora
Kill more Suqah until a special tiara drops
detail: Also keep up to 4 hides from these Suqah -- at least 4 total are needed for the ceremonial clothes.

label: Give Meteora the special tiara
South of the bank, talk to Rimae Sirsalis about the ceremonial clothes
Talk to Rimae Sirsalis again to have her tan your 4 suqah hides
Craft a Lunar torso, trousers, gloves and boots from the tanned hides
In the centre of the city, talk to Selene about a ring
Dig up the westernmost blue flowers past the two bridges south-west of the city

label: Use the waking-sleep potion on the kindling you were given
Gather combat supplies and wear all 8 pieces of lunar gear
detail: Keep the seal of passage in your inventory -- do not bank it. 4 free inventory spaces are required.

label: Enter the building with the ceremonial brazier on the village's west side

label: Light the ceremonial brazier, then use the soaked kindling on it
Talk to the Ethereal Being to begin the dream trials

hints.value: Logging out mid-dream requires re-visiting the Oneiromancer for a fresh waking-sleep potion and kindling.

Talk to Ethereal Fluke to start the dice puzzle
Roll dice to match each called number, 5-6 correct answers needed

Step onto the south-eastern purple platform

Click the numbers that continue each pattern until teleported back

hints.value: Pattern-to-answer reference is a table on the cited page, not reproduced here.

label: Talk to the Ethereal Being
Step onto the north-eastern blue platform
Talk to Ethereal Perceptive and agree to start the logging race

Step onto the north-western grey platform

Cross the chasm on the correct sequence of Dream Puffs stepping stones

label: Talk to the Ethereal Being
Step onto the eastern grey platform
Talk to Ethereal Expert and start the hurdle race
Run with the run toggle on and jump each hurdle without failing 3 times
detail: Failing 3 hurdle jumps loses the race.

label: After winning, talk to the Ethereal Being
Step onto the south-eastern green platform
Talk to Ethereal Mimic and agree to play
Click Ethereal Mimic and copy each emote he performs, 5 times correctly in a row
detail: He teleports you a short distance after each correct emote; after 5 corrects he teleports you back.

label: Talk to the Ethereal Being to begin the final fight
Kill Me (level 79, safespottable)
detail: You cannot teleport away or change equipment once the fight starts (a shield-slot item or tome of fire equipped beforehand is fine) -- you must win the fight or log out. Bringing combat runes makes it significantly easier.

label: Read the lectern to return to Lunar Isle
Talk to the Oneiromancer with the seal of passage on you to finish the quest
detail: The seal can be equipped or just carried in the inventory.

label: Talk to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village, north of the bridge at the quest icon
Optional: mine your own gems now at the Shilo Village Mine
detail: Needed later for Tindel Marchant's landing-light repair if you'd rather not buy replacement gems; red topaz needs 40 Mining.

hints.value: optional prep step -- can be done any time before the Tindel Marchant errand

label: Talk to the Jungle forester south of Shilo Village at the tree line
detail: Requires 1 free inventory space to receive a blunt axe.

label: Talk to Brian in the Port Sarim axe shop to have the blunt axe sharpened
Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village about being a character witness
Talk to Johanhus Ulsbrecht near the prison inside the H.A.M. Hideout
Talk to Fred the Farmer NE of the H.A.M. Hideout (Sheep Shearer's start)
Prepare a bowl of hot water, a pot, and 3 steel bars
detail: Bowl and pot come from the Lumbridge Castle kitchen; needed for the upcoming Sanfew and Horvik errands.

label: Talk to Seth Groats at the chicken farm east of the River Lum
Talk to Horvik at the Varrock armour shop and give him 3 steel bars
Talk to the Apothecary in Varrock, south of the western bank
Talk to Tassie Slipcast in Barbarian Village, at the pottery icon
Talk to Hammerspike Stoutbeard in the western Dwarven Mines
detail: South-west of the Ice Mountain entrance.

label: Gather 1 harralander, 2 guam leaves, and 1 marrentill for a Guthix rest tea
Pick up and drink a cup of tea north of Sanfew's shop for an empty cup
detail: Only needed if you don't already have an empty cup.

label: Talk to Sanfew on the top floor of the Taverley herblore shop
detail: About becoming an initiate. Option order is 2-2-3-1 instead if Eadgar's Ruse is complete.

label: Brew the Guthix rest tea: hot water, harralander, 2 guam leaves, marrentill
detail: Add the hot water to the teacup first, then the herbs.

label: Talk to Captain Bleemadge atop White Wolf Mountain, at the glider icon
Talk to Arhein on the Catherby docks, south of the bank
Talk to Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight north of the Seers' chapel for a forecast
In the Goblin Cave SE of the Fishing Guild, search the sculpture in the NE room
Talk to Wizard Cromperty in NE Ardougne about a girl stuck in some rock
detail: At the transportation icon; different opening option if the Ardougne Medium Diary is complete.

label: Take a hammer and chisel south of Cromperty, if you don't have your own
Talk to Tindel Marchant on the Port Khazard south dock about iron oxide
Bring 2 each of cut opal, jade, sapphire, red topaz, or gold as backup
detail: Gold covers replacement cost if a gem gets crushed later.

hints.value: red topaz can be mined with 40 Mining at Shilo Village

label: Talk to Rantz in the eastern Feldip Hills, at the quest icon, about a mattress
Talk to Gnormadium Avlafrim, west of Rantz, at the gnome glider icon
Search each landing light, cut its gem, and put the cut gem back
detail: If a gem is crushed, Gnormadium sells replacements for 500 coins each, up to 2.

hints.value: exact number of landing lights not stated on this page

label: Report back to Gnormadium Avlafrim that all the landing lights are fixed
Report back to Rantz
Give Tindel Marchant the mattress

hints.value: mattress hand-off from Rantz is never explicit in the fetched Quick guide text -- Rantz's earlier dialogue implies he fills it himself

label: Give Wizard Cromperty the iron oxide in Ardougne

hints.value: iron oxide acquisition point not stated in the fetched Quick guide text

label: Take 5 pigeon cages south of the north Ardougne bank, and gear up for Slagilith
At the Fishing Guild cave sculpture, read the animate rock scroll
Kill the level 92 Slagilith
detail: 67% damage reduction unless a pickaxe is equipped (melee and magic then deal full damage); weak to crush and magic; safespottable.

label: Read the scroll again to free Petra, and finish her dialogue fully
detail: Not completing the dialogue with Petra will block further quest progress.

label: Talk to Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight in Seers' Village about Petra's release
On the roof, hammer and search the weather vane twice for 3 parts
Use each vane part on the anvil north of the house with a bronze/iron/steel bar
Put each repaired part back onto the vane
Tell Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight the weather vane is fixed
Give Arhein the weather report in Catherby
Tell Captain Bleemadge on White Wolf Mountain you got the T.R.A.S.H.
Tell Sanfew in Taverley the Gnome Pilot has agreed to fly to the ogres
Gather combat gear and a weapon to fight Hammerspike's gang members
detail: Levels 44, 48, and 49; no specific gear named on this page.

label: Talk to Hammerspike Stoutbeard in the Dwarven Mine
Kill Hammerspike's 3 gang members (multicombat), then talk to him again
detail: Levels 44, 48, and 49.

label: Get clay from Tassie Slipcast, spin and fire it into a pot lid
detail: Spin the clay on a pottery wheel, then fire it in the pottery oven.

label: Use the pot lid on an empty pot
detail: The empty pot is found in the house to the north.

label: Give the Apothecary the pot lid and pot
Give Horvik the tincture and breathing salts

hints.value: tincture/breathing salts acquisition points not stated in the fetched Quick guide text

label: Return to Horvik and give him the 5 pigeon cages
Talk to Seth Groats at the Lumbridge chicken farm to close out his favour
Talk to Johanhus in the H.A.M. camp -- the chicken deal has been swung
Tell Aggie in Draynor that Jimmy has been released
Return to Brian in Port Sarim with the good news
Give the sharpened axe to the Jungle forester south of Shilo Village
Return to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village and hand over the red mahogany
detail: Wait for the dialogue to finish -- completes the quest.

label: Talk to Elder Raley in his house just south of the Summer Shore's bank
Talk to Elder Katt at the entrance to the Sacred Grove
Talk to Floopa in the Sacred Grove
Sail to Red Rock, far west of the Great Conch
detail: Optional: inspect the Sailors' Marker next to Shipwright Sylvia to unlock a sailor's amulet teleport here; charter ships also reach Red Rock afterward.

hints.value: no 'sail' primitive in the closed verb enum; mapped to teleport as the nearest point-to-point travel analog

label: Talk to the receptionist in the Trading Company headquarters building
Inspect all the displays in the headquarters

hints.value: exact display count not stated on this page

label: Talk to Theodore Paxton in his office to the south
Sail to Last Light, south of Red Rock
detail: Combat starts immediately on arrival -- stock up at the bank chest in north-east Red Rock first if needed.

label: Sink both pirate ships with cannons, or kill their crews with Magic/Ranged
detail: Activate Protect from Range immediately on seeing the ships -- you may take player damage. The fight is an instanced encounter you can leave at any time.

label: Dock at Last Light
detail: Do not teleport away after docking -- your ship and its contents will be lost at sea.

label: Defeat the 6 level-52 pirates who attack in multicombat on docking
detail: All attack with melee -- Protect from Melee prevents all damage. The 4 outside pirates can be safespotted north of the mooring point; the 2 inside can be flinched by standing north of the staircase. Escaping via the mooring port resets the fight; you won't need to refight them after they're dead if you leave normally.

label: Climb the staircase twice and fight Black Eye Bethel
detail: Step away from her charged attacks and keep Protect from Melee active; once she equips a dragon scimitar she can use its special attack to disable your protection prayer.

label: Return to Theodore Paxton
Sail to the middle of the Red Reef, east of Red Rock, and board The Zenith

hints.value: no 'sail' primitive; mapped to teleport
known bug: The Zenith can be missing on some worlds -- hop worlds if it's not at the marked Red Reef location

label: Talk to Spencer Brentwood aboard The Zenith
Equip diving gear (or the Medallion of the deep), then talk to Spencer again
detail: Spencer lends diving gear if you forgot yours; talk to him first to disembark and reach your boat for your own gear.

label: Under the sea, talk to Spencer, then head north to the coral dredger
Kill the level 112 giant lobster that attacks at the dredger
detail: Safespottable with Ranged/Magic by standing next to the dredger; move away when blue particles appear underfoot to dodge its special attack.

label: Repair the dredger, then go SE to the second dredger and talk to Spencer
Back on the ship, talk to Spencer Brentwood once more to return to your boat
Return to Floopa at Elder Raley's house to finish the quest
Gear up for the melee-only knight gauntlet
detail: Bring slash/crush weapons to cover the knights' alternating weaknesses (a zombie axe or Zamorakian hasta covers both), a dragon defender, rune armour or better, food such as karambwan, and a couple of stat-restore potions; a slower Guthan's-armour alternative leans on its passive healing to cut down food needed.

hints.value: Magic, Ranged, and Prayer do not function anywhere in this room.

label: Defeat the 8 Knight Waves knights in sequence
detail: Fight Sir Bedivere, Pelleas, Tristram, Palomedes, Lucan, Gawain, Kay, then Lancelot in order (levels 110-127); each knight is weak to a specific melee style and lowers a specific combat stat on hit, per the wiki's own knight table.

hints.value: Knights despawn if a fight drags on too long; logging out/in or teleporting away resumes at the knight that killed you, but leaving through the door resets progress to wave 1.

A flinch-behind-the-training-dummy method (draw the knight to the north-east corner, then west of a dummy, duck between dummies) avoids nearly all retaliation; a dragon dagger special can speed up each flinch kill.

label: Set your character's appearance in the Character Creator
detail: Choose body type, skin colour, and clothing style in the initial Character Creator interface; every option can be changed later for free via Makeover after leaving the island.

hints.value: no dedicated appearance-customization verb in the enum; mapped to toggle (a persistent character-state change).

label: Choose an Adventure Paths familiarity option
detail: Indicate you are brand new, or have played before but not recently, to unlock the Adventure Paths beginner-reward track (e.g. Mithril gear for reaching skill milestones); full details are shown after leaving the island.

label: Talk to the Gielinor Guide and open Settings
detail: He asks you to open the Settings interface (spanner icon); browsing its contents is optional, opening it once is the required step.

label: Talk to the Gielinor Guide again to move on
detail: He directs you to the first instructor; movement is left-click on the ground or minimap, and interacting with objects/NPCs is left-click for the primary action or right-click for the options menu.

label: Talk to the Survival Expert for a fishing net
detail: He gives a small fishing net and asks you to view it in your inventory before catching shrimp at the nearby pond.

label: Catch a shrimp at the fishing spot
detail: Use the net on the fishing spot, or simply left-click the spot to fish automatically, until you land a shrimp; this also prompts opening the Skills interface.

label: Talk to the Survival Expert again for fire-making tools
detail: He gives a bronze axe and a tinderbox and asks you to cook the shrimp over a fire.

label: Chop logs, light a fire, and cook the shrimp
detail: Chop any nearby tree for logs, use the tinderbox on the logs to light a fire, then use the raw shrimp on the fire to cook it.

label: Talk to the Master Chef for baking supplies
detail: He gives a pot of flour and a bucket of water and asks you to make some bread.

label: Make dough and bake it into bread
detail: Use the pot of flour on the bucket of water to make bread dough, then use the dough on the range (or simply left-click the range) to bake bread.

label: Talk to the Quest Guide and open the Quest List
detail: He asks you to open the Quest List interface.

label: Talk to the Quest Guide again for a questing overview
detail: He explains more about how questing works in Gielinor.

label: Talk to the Mining Instructor for a pickaxe
detail: He gives a bronze pickaxe and asks you to mine tin and copper ore.

label: Mine one tin ore and one copper ore
detail: Mine the tin rocks to the west and the copper rocks to the east until you have one of each ore.

label: Smelt the ores into a bronze bar
detail: Use one of the ores on the furnace to the south, or simply left-click the furnace, to smelt a bronze bar.

label: Talk to the Mining Instructor again for a hammer
detail: He gives a hammer and asks you to smith a bronze dagger at the nearby anvil.

label: Smith a bronze dagger at the anvil
detail: Use the bronze bar on the anvil, or simply left-click it, then select the dagger option.

label: Talk to the Combat Instructor about your equipment
detail: He asks you to view your worn-items and equipment-stats interfaces before wielding the dagger.

label: Equip the bronze dagger
detail: Click the bronze dagger in your inventory to equip it in the weapon slot.

label: Talk to the Combat Instructor again for melee gear
detail: He gives a bronze sword and a wooden shield.

label: Equip the bronze sword and wooden shield
detail: Equipping the sword unequips the dagger; equip the shield in the shield slot too.

label: Open the Combat Options interface
detail: Click the crossed-swords icon to view the different attack styles available with your weapon.

label: Kill a giant rat inside the rat pen
detail: Enter the rat pit through the gate and left-click a rat to kill it.

label: Talk to the Combat Instructor for a bow
detail: He gives a shortbow and 50 bronze arrows.

label: Equip the shortbow and bronze arrows
detail: Equip both the bow and the arrows.

label: Kill a giant rat outside the pen
detail: Kill another giant rat from outside the pen using the newly-equipped ranged gear.

label: Check your bank at the Account Guide's building
detail: Use the bank booth to view your starting bank, which holds 25 coins.

label: Use the poll booth
detail: Interact with the poll booth on the western wall to learn about the polling system used to add future content to the game.

label: Talk to the Account Guide and open Account Management
detail: He asks you to open the Account Management interface (the face-with-a-cog icon).

label: Talk to the Account Guide again for an account overview
detail: He explains Membership, Worlds, Bonds, and other account-level concepts.

label: Talk to Brother Brace and open the Prayer interface
detail: He asks you to open the Prayer interface (the star icon).

label: Talk to Brother Brace again for a Prayer overview
detail: He teaches you about activating prayers and burying bones for Prayer experience.

label: Talk to the Magic Instructor and open the spellbook
detail: He asks you to open the Magic interface to view your spellbook.

label: Talk to the Magic Instructor again for runes
detail: He gives air runes and mind runes and tells you to cast Wind Strike on the chickens in the northern pen.

label: Cast Wind Strike on a chicken
detail: Select Wind Strike in the Magic interface, then click a chicken in the northern pen; this completes the quest.

label: Talk to the Magic Instructor after finishing
detail: He offers to introduce the Ironman tutor before you leave the island.

hints.value: talk to the Ironman tutor first only if opting into Ironman Mode restrictions

label: Optionally talk to the Ironman tutor
detail: If you want to play in Ironman Mode, you must talk to this tutor about the mode's account restrictions before leaving the island; skip this atom otherwise.

hints.value: optional -- Ironman Mode opt-in only

label: Cast Lumbridge Home Teleport to leave the island
detail: Casting this spell (taught by the Magic Instructor) is how every new account leaves Tutorial Island for the mainland.

hints.value: no dedicated leave-the-tutorial verb; mapped to teleport.

label: Talk to Fabia or Xilo in the Tlati Rainforest
detail: Fabia is by the southern magic trees west of Kastori and believes she was to meet Xilo by 'the magic tree'; Xilo is by the river bank west of the Crypt of Tonali lift platform and believes she was to meet Fabia by 'the special tree'. Either NPC can be spoken to first.

label: Talk to whichever of the two you did not speak to first
detail: Speaking to the second NPC resolves the miscommunication about which tree they meant; she leaves her spot to go join the other, completing the miniquest.

label: Talk to King Arthur to start the quest
detail: He explains the path to becoming a Knight of the Round Table begins with finding out how Merlin got trapped.

label: Talk to Sir Gawain about Merlin
detail: Found in the courtyard to the south or nearby in the castle; ask how Merlin got trapped.

label: Talk to Sir Lancelot upstairs
detail: Ask for ideas on getting into Morgan Le Faye's stronghold, Keep Le Faye.

label: Make a bucket of wax at the Catherby beehives
detail: If you didn't already bring a bucket of wax, grab insect repellent from the house north of the Catherby bank, then use it on a beehive to the west with an empty bucket in your inventory.

hints.value: Skip this atom if you already brought a bucket of wax with you.

label: Hide in the crate to sneak into Keep Le Faye
detail: The crate is east of the candle maker's shop; hiding triggers a cutscene, after which you climb out already inside the keep.

label: Climb to the keep's top floor
detail: The Renegade Knights inside the keep will attack you on the way up.

label: Fight Sir Mordred
detail: He cannot be safespotted, but can be flinched using the stairs (stand him on the square left of the stairs while flinching from the square north-east of him); ring of recoil or a second account poisoning him are alternative methods.

label: Spare Sir Mordred when Morgan Le Faye intervenes
detail: When Mordred hits 0 hitpoints Morgan Le Faye appears and begs for his life; sparing him is how you learn to free Merlin. Do not interrupt this dialogue or you must fight Mordred again.

label: Get bat bones from a bat near the keep's west doors
detail: Only needed if you don't already have bat bones; exit through the west doors and kill a bat before leaving the keep.

label: Ask the Catherby candle-maker about black candles
detail: First conversation just establishes he has black candles.

label: Talk to the candle-maker again for a black candle
detail: He hands over the black candle needed for the ritual.

label: Ask the Lady of the Lake for Excalibur
detail: She is found south-east of Taverley on the peninsula.

label: Go to the Port Sarim jewellery shop
detail: Bring bread in your inventory before entering the shop to the north.

label: Give the beggar in the jewellery shop your bread
detail: This is the Lady of the Lake's disguised test of kindness; finish the conversation afterward.

hints.value: The Quick guide doesn't state the exact moment Excalibur enters your inventory after this exchange -- left as "??" rather than guessed.

label: Read the Chaos Altar inscription in Varrock
detail: The Zamorakian temple is in Varrock's south-east corner; bring a tinderbox with you for later. Reading the inscription reveals the ritual's required incantation.

hints.value: The incantation text itself is in-game dialogue, left as "??" per the own-words rule rather than quoted.

label: Go to Camelot's ritual site
detail: Enter the castle gates and head to the north-east corner of the grounds, a red star in the middle of 8 columns.

label: Light the black candle on the ritual star
detail: Stand on the star before lighting it.

label: Drop the bat bones on the ritual star and speak the incantation
detail: This summons Thrantax the Mighty (level 92); getting the incantation wrong causes him to attack instead.

until.state: Thrantax the Mighty summoned and boon granted

label: Climb to the top of Camelot's south-east tower
detail: This is where the giant crystal holding Merlin is kept.

label: Smash the crystal with Excalibur
detail: Use Excalibur on the crystal directly -- this does not require 20 Attack to wield it for this action.

label: Talk to King Arthur to finish the quest
detail: Completing this conversation finishes Merlin's Crystal.

label: Talk to Orlando Smith to start the quiz
detail: He's in the centre of the Varrock Museum basement; clicking a display's plaque before talking to him first just prompts that you need to speak to him.

label: Answer 3 questions correctly at each North room display
detail: Click the plaque in front of each of the 4 North room displays (Lizard, Battle tortoise, Dragon, Wyvern) and answer 3 questions correctly on each; only 3 right answers are needed regardless of how many questions are shown, and the answers are also given by that room's Natural historian and this wiki page's own creature sections.

hints.value: Wrong answers can be retried; once a display's 3 questions are answered its quiz is replaced by the creature's common and scientific name.

label: Answer 3 questions correctly at each East room display
detail: Click the plaque in front of each of the 4 East room displays (Snail, Snake, Sea slug, Monkey) and answer 3 questions correctly on each.

label: Answer 3 questions correctly at each South room display
detail: Click the plaque in front of each of the 2 South room displays (Kalphite Queen, Terrorbird) and answer 3 questions correctly on each.

label: Answer 3 questions correctly at each West room display
detail: Click the plaque in front of each of the 4 West room displays (Penguin, Mole, Camel, Leech) and answer 3 questions correctly on each.

label: Talk to Orlando Smith again for the XP reward
detail: Once all 14 displays across all 4 rooms are complete, speak to Orlando again to receive the quiz's Hunter and Slayer XP.

hints.value: If this is your first-ever Slayer XP, your first Slayer-master assignment won't include a free enchanted gem -- you'll need to pay 1 coin for it instead.

label: Talk to the Mage of Zamorak in level 4-7 Wilderness by the river
detail: He roams the riverbank in the Wilderness; you must not have any non-Zamorak god item equipped or he refuses to speak.

label: Talk to the Mage of Zamorak at the Chaos Temple altar, south-east Varrock
detail: Free an inventory slot first for the scrying orb he hands over; if Wanted! is started but not finished you get an extra dialogue branch to pick Runecrafting as the topic.

hints.value: Where do you get your runes from?
Yes

label: Teleport to the rune essence mine via Aubury's rune shop in Varrock
detail: Aubury's shop is the first of 3 mine entrances the orb needs to record; only 3 of the 5 possible entrances need visiting.

label: Teleport to the rune essence mine via Archmage Sedridor, bottom floor of the Wizards' Tower
detail: Fairy ring code DIS reaches the Wizards' Tower basement quickly.

label: Teleport to the rune essence mine via Wizard Cromperty in north-east Ardougne
detail: Third and final mine-entrance reading for the scrying orb.

label: Return to the Mage of Zamorak at the Chaos Temple
detail: He is back at the same south-eastern Varrock altar after the 3 readings are recorded.

label: Talk to the Mage of Zamorak again to complete the miniquest
detail: Second consecutive talk finalises the miniquest state.

label: Ask the Mage of Zamorak about the Abyss to finish
detail: Final dialogue opens the Abyss as an essence-mining and teleport hub.

hints.value: So what is this 'abyss' stuff?

label: Talk to Ellamaria at the garden east of Varrock Palace
detail: Starts the quest proper.

label: Take the Wise Old Man's quiz in Draynor Village
detail: Must be wearing the ring of charos to trigger the quiz.

hints.value: Show them a range of colours…
Take his generous gift…
It's absolutely...

No, especially…

detail: Rake, seed dibber, spade, secateurs, watering can, gardening trowel are all needed repeatedly across the seed-gathering chores.

label: Travel to Lyra west of Port Phasmatys (fairy ring AJQ)
Talk to Lyra to start the onion trade
Grow onions in both patches Lyra assigns
detail: Using both patches reduces the chance of a failed crop.

label: Give Lyra the grown onions for orchid seeds
Travel to Kragen north of Ardougne (fairy ring BLR)
Talk to Kragen to start the cabbage trade

hints.value: 1,2,2,2,2,2,1 (exact wording ??)

label: Grow cabbages in both patches Kragen assigns
detail: Using both patches reduces the chance of a failed crop.

label: Give Kragen the grown cabbages for snowdrop seeds
Travel to Elstan south of Falador
Talk to Elstan to start the marigold trade

hints.value: 1,2,3,2,2,1 (exact wording ??)

label: Grow the marigold seed in the patch
Give Elstan the grown marigolds for delphinium seeds
Travel to Dantaera in Catherby
Talk to Dantaera about the White Tree cutting

hints.value: 1,2,2,2 (exact wording ??)

label: Buy a filled plant pot from the nearby Catherby store
Travel to the northern part of Ice Mountain
Use secateurs on the White Tree to take a cutting
Put the cutting in the plant pot and water it
Travel to Brother Althric at the Edgeville monastery
Talk to Brother Althric about the rose seeds
Run to the well in Edgeville
Throw the ring of charos(a) down the well
detail: Required before the roses can be picked.

label: Take 4 seeds from the red, pink, and white roses
Retrieve the ring of charos(a) from the well with a fishing rod
Travel to Bernald behind the Burthorpe pub
Talk to Bernald about the diseased vines
Use 1 plant cure on Bernald's vines
Talk to Bernald again after curing the first vines
Travel to Alain by the Taverley tree patch
Talk to Alain about the second vine cure
Make rune dust (hammer/chisel rune essence, or pestle and mortar rune shards)
Use the rune dust on the other plant cure
Use the treated plant cure on Alain's vines at Taverley
Return to Bernald for the vine seeds
Ask Ellamaria about the statues to get a trolley
Travel to the statue of a king in Lumbridge Castle
Load the king statue onto the trolley
Push the trolley east over the bridge
Place the king statue on the eastern plinth in the garden
Travel to the Saradomin statue in Falador Square
Load the Saradomin statue onto the trolley
Push the trolley north through the gate
detail: Triggers a cutscene.

label: Place the Saradomin statue on the southern plinth in the garden
Fill the 2 garden plant pots with compost or supercompost
Plant everything gathered in Ellamaria's garden
detail: Orchid, snowdrop, delphinium, potted White Tree cutting, rose seeds and vine seeds all go in; growth takes 10-15 minutes and cannot fail.

label: Talk to Ellamaria once the garden has grown in
Talk to King Roald to finish the quest
detail: Ring of charos(a) must be equipped or he refuses to follow into the garden.

label: Talk to King Arthur in Camelot to start the quest

I'd enjoy trying that.

label: Talk to Merlin on Camelot castle's 1st floor, east room
detail: He won't show as a yellow minimap dot until you enter the room.

hints.value: Thank you for the advice.

label: Bank all weapons and armour before travelling to Entrana
detail: Entrana forbids combat equipment.

label: Travel to Entrana
Talk to the High Priest in the Entrana chapel

hints.value: Ok, I will go searching.

label: Travel to Galahad's house west of McGrubor's Wood (fairy ring ALS)
Talk to Galahad and receive the holy table napkin

hints.value: I seek an item from the realm of the Fisher King.

label: Travel to Draynor Manor's 2nd floor, southernmost room, with the napkin in inventory
detail: The 2 magic whistles on the table aren't visible until you enter the room.

label: Pick up the 2 magic whistles from the table
Equip armour, Excalibur and bring food for the Black Knight Titan fight
detail: Bring antipoison if your combat level is under 41; the killing blow must land with Excalibur or he heals to full.

label: Travel to the north-western peninsula north-west of Brimhaven
Stand under the tower and blow a magic whistle
detail: Teleports you into the Fisher Realm.
