label: Kill the Black Knight Titan on the bridge, finishing with Excalibur
detail: He is extremely resistant to Ranged and Magic; melee is recommended and other weapons may be used until the final hits.

label: Talk to the fisherman south along the river

hints.value: Any ideas how to get into the castle?

label: Head to the castle south-west of the fisherman and stand in front of the bricks
detail: Do not use the magic whistle here or you'll be teleported out and must refight the Titan.

label: Pick up the Grail bell from the ground
Ring the Grail bell to gain access to the castle
Take the stairs south to the Fisher King
Talk to the Fisher King about both topics
detail: Must cover both options or the Black Knight Titan must be refought if you leave.

hints.value: I seek the Holy Grail.
You don't look too well.

label: Travel back to Camelot
Talk to King Arthur; keep 1 free inventory slot for the magic gold feather
Travel to Goblin Village
Use the Open option on the sacks in the east house
Talk to Percival and give him a magic whistle
detail: Keep your other magic whistle to reach the Fisher Realm yourself.

hints.value: Come with me, I shall make you a king.

label: Return to the Fisher Realm via Brimhaven or fairy ring code BJR
detail: The Titan does not need to be fought again either way.

label: Head to the top floor of the castle's eastern tower
Take the Holy Grail
Return to Camelot
Return the Holy Grail to King Arthur to finish
Head into the Goblin Cave east of the Fishing Guild, then north and west to the temple guards
Drink a dose of goblin potion to disguise as a goblin
Enter the Goblin Temple disguised
detail: Do not equip the ghostspeak amulet or ring of visibility yet or you revert to human form and get expelled.

label: Make your way to the crypt inside the Goblin Temple
Equip the ghostspeak amulet and ring of visibility (or ring of shadows) now you're in the crypt
detail: Safe to equip only once inside the crypt.

label: Talk to Hopespear's ghost and agree to free the 5 goblin high priests' souls
detail: He explains he awaits the Big High War God; tell him you've been to Yu'biusk and he asks you to kill the priests unequipped and bury their bones there.

label: Remove all equipped items before summoning any priest
detail: No weapons, spells, stat-bonus armour or stat jewellery (e.g. ring of recoil); Morytania legs must also come off. Ghostspeak amulet and ring of visibility/shadows can stay on.

label: Summon and defeat Snothead (level 32, south-west grave) by speaking his name over his grave
detail: Pick up the dropped bone before summoning the next priest or the old bones despawn.

label: Summon and defeat Snailfeet (level 56, south-east grave) by speaking his name over his grave
detail: Pick up the dropped bone before summoning the next priest or the old bones despawn.

label: Summon and defeat Mosschin (level 88, north-west grave) by speaking his name over his grave
detail: Pick up the dropped bone before summoning the next priest or the old bones despawn.

label: Summon and defeat Redeyes (level 121, north-east grave) by speaking his name over his grave
detail: Pick up the dropped bone before summoning the next priest or the old bones despawn.

label: Summon and defeat Strongbones (level 184, north grave) by speaking his name over his grave
detail: Pick up the dropped bone before summoning the next priest or the old bones despawn.

label: Fairy-ring to Yu'biusk using code BLQ
Bury the collected goblin high priests' bones at Yu'biusk
detail: Burying can be done in batches across multiple trips; all 5 sets must eventually be buried to complete the miniquest.

label: Talk to the Wanderer north-east of Sophanem about your cat

hints.value: Why? What's your problem with it?
Ok I'll get your supplies.

label: Give the Wanderer a tinderbox and a waterskin(4)

hints.value: Yes. I have them all here.

label: Touch the pyramid door to enter and wake up inside
Navigate the pyramid by clicking the minimap to auto-avoid the traps
detail: No teleporting out once inside; aggressive level-84 mummies and poisoning scarabs roam the map.

label: Jump the pit
detail: Needs at least 20% run energy; higher Agility improves the odds.

label: Go west and open the door
Cycle the golden bird until it matches the shown solution, then click the indicated tiles
detail: Solution is image-only on the wiki page -- exact tile pattern not reproducible in text, so left as '??'.

label: Drop your cat before approaching the Sphinx
detail: Required or the Sphinx encounter cannot proceed correctly.

label: Ask the Sphinx for help and answer the riddle
detail: Correct answer is 9; a wrong answer makes your cat disappear.

hints.value: I need help.
Totally positive.

label: Talk to the High Priest south-west of the Sphinx
Return to the pyramid and open the door again
Jump the pit again to trigger the second flashback
Open the western door, directly south
Take back the correct canopic jar
detail: Only the jar matching your assigned guardian can be picked up.

label: Kill the elemental guardian that spawns (level 75 or 81)
detail: Which guardian and its combat style (Apmeken/Crondis/Scabaras = magic, Het = melee) depends on the jar assigned -- '??' which one you get.

label: Cross the pit and cross back again
Solve the door puzzle again and drop the jar back where found
Leave the pyramid via the entrance ladder
Talk to the High Priest to begin ceremony prep

hints.value: Sure, no problem.

label: Go to the house south of the church
Give the Embalmer the linen, salt, and sap
Go east to the Carpenter
Give the Carpenter willow logs for a holy symbol
Enter the pyramid again
Jump the pit again to trigger the third flashback
Enter the east room and use the holy symbol on a sarcophagus
Jump back across the pit and re-enter the eastern room
Kill the level-91 Possessed Priest
Talk to the High Priest after the fight
Exit the pyramid
Talk to the High Priest in the temple to finish
Inspect the frozen Lumbridge Guide to start the chapter
detail: Interact with the frozen Lumbridge Guide in the Lumbridge Castle dining room to begin this Recipe for Disaster chapter.

refs.title: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

label: Collect egg, milk and flour from the Culinaromancer's Chest
detail: Grab the egg, milk and flour from the Culinaromancer's Chest near the start if you don't already carry them.

refs.title: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

label: Talk to Wizard Traiborn in the Wizards' Tower
detail: Find Wizard Traiborn one flight of stairs up in the Wizards' Tower to begin enchanting the ingredients.

refs.title: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

label: Pass the NPC-identification quiz to enchant the egg
detail: Use the egg on Traiborn and correctly identify an NPC from a prior required quest three times to get the egg enchanted.

hints.value: Shown NPCs are drawn from the quest's required-quest list; answers vary per attempt.

refs.title: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

label: Pass the general-knowledge quiz to enchant the milk
detail: Use the milk on Traiborn and correctly answer three general Old School RuneScape trivia questions to get the milk enchanted.

refs.title: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

label: Pass the memory test to enchant the flour
detail: Use the flour on Traiborn, then correctly answer three questions about the item groups briefly shown to you to get the flour enchanted.

hints.value: Do not press Esc during the memory test — it resets that portion of the test.

refs.title: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

label: Prepare and bake the cake
detail: Use any one enchanted ingredient on the cake tin to auto-fill the rest, then cook the tin on a range in Lumbridge Castle to bake the cake.

refs.title: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

label: Give the cake to the frozen Lumbridge Guide
detail: Return to the frozen Lumbridge Guide and hand over the baked cake to finish the chapter.

refs.title: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

label: Talk to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid
detail: Speak to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid and agree to help him, unlocking access to the three independent errand branches below.

hints.value: Yes

label: Talk to Aubury at the Varrock rune shop
detail: Speak to Aubury at the rune shop in Varrock and mention Ali Morrisane's business proposal.

hints.value: Actually, I'm here with a business proposal from Ali Morrisane.

label: Return to Ali Morrisane and ask about his rune selection
detail: Go back to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid and ask to look at his selection of runes to unlock casket trading.

hints.value: I would like to look at your selection of runes.

label: Open a small rune casket (force or pick lock)
detail: Ask Ali for a small casket of runes, then either force it open (high Strength) or pick its lock (high Thieving) to unlock elemental runes for purchase.

hints.value: Try opening a small casket of runes -> Force box. / Pick lock.

label: Open a large rune casket by solving the runedoku puzzle
detail: Ask Ali for a large casket of runes, examine its lock, then solve the sudoku-style rune grid (no repeated rune type per row, column or 3x3 box) and confirm to unlock catalytic runes for purchase.

hints.value: Large caskets cannot be forced or picked — the runedoku puzzle is the only method.

label: Travel to Pollnivneach
detail: Head to Pollnivneach to begin the blackjack-unlocking errand.

label: Talk to the blackjack seller
detail: Speak to the blackjack seller in Pollnivneach to start the defensive-blackjack unlock.

hints.value: Yes

label: Pay the street urchin 100 coins
detail: Talk to the street urchin and pay him 100 coins to bribe the blackjack seller on your behalf.

hints.value: Yes

label: Talk to the blackjack seller again
detail: Return to the blackjack seller and talk to him again to complete the defensive unlock.

label: Return to Al Kharid
detail: Travel back to Al Kharid to collect the newly unlocked stock from Ali Morrisane.

label: Buy defensive blackjacks from Ali Morrisane
detail: Buy as many defensive blackjacks as needed from Ali Morrisane now — they won't be available again until this branch is repeated.

label: Let the blackjack seller try to knock you out twice
detail: Talk to the blackjack seller and repeat the taunt dialogue, letting him attempt to knock you out; repeat until he has knocked you out twice to unlock offensive blackjacks.

hints.value: I bet you couldn't knock me out with your blackjack. / No pain, no gain. Grrr! / Go again.
Bring food if your Hitpoints are low — the knockout attempts deal damage.

label: Return to Al Kharid
detail: Travel back to Al Kharid a second time to collect offensive blackjacks from Ali Morrisane.

label: Buy offensive blackjacks from Ali Morrisane
detail: Buy offensive blackjacks from Ali Morrisane, now that the offensive unlock is complete.

label: Give Siamun 3 dyes or 3 matching hides
detail: Speak to Siamun in Sophanem and hand over 3 dyes of any colour or 3 animal hides of the same type.

label: Report back to Ali Morrisane
detail: Speak to Ali Morrisane to relay Siamun's offer.

label: Talk to Siamun again to unlock the clothing line
detail: Return to Siamun and talk to him again to unlock that line of clothing in Ali's shop; revisiting with the other material swaps between the two lines.

label: Talk to Romeo in Varrock Square
detail: Speak to Romeo in Varrock Square and offer to find Juliet for him.

hints.value: Perhaps I could help to find her for you? / Yes, ok, I'll let her know.

label: Talk to Juliet on the mansion balcony
detail: Find Juliet on the upper-floor balcony of the mansion west of Varrock west bank and get her reply letter for Romeo.

hints.value: If Recipe for Disaster is incomplete she hands over the letter without the usual dialogue choices.

label: Give Juliet's letter to Romeo
detail: Return to Romeo in Varrock Square and hand him Juliet's letter.

label: Talk to Father Lawrence
detail: Speak to Father Lawrence in the church east of Varrock Palace as directed by Romeo.

label: Pick cadava berries if you don't already have them
detail: If you don't already have cadava berries, pick them from the patch directly west of the South-east Varrock mine.

label: Give cadava berries to the Apothecary
detail: Speak to the Apothecary south of Varrock west bank and hand over the cadava berries to have him brew a sleeping potion.

hints.value: Talk about Romeo & Juliet — exact option wording varies if Ratcatchers or A Tail of Two Cats is complete.

label: Give the sleeping potion to Juliet
detail: Return to Juliet on the mansion balcony and give her the sleeping potion.

label: Tell Romeo to meet Juliet in the crypt
detail: Go back to Romeo and tell him to meet Juliet in the crypt, completing the quest.

label: Optionally give Olbertus 5 dragonstones before killing him
detail: Before killing Olbertus, optionally give him 5 dragonstones to start the burner's faith level at the 100-point mark instead of at 1 point — this is a one-time alternative to the slow bone-offering climb, not a required step.

label: Offer eligible draconic bones at the burner until faith reaches 200
detail: Offer babydragon, dragon, lava dragon or superior dragon bones at the Sacred Bone Burner; lava dragon bones count as 2 points and superior dragon bones as 3 points toward the faith level. Keep offering until the shrine turns hot to the touch at 200 points and a temple key appears.

until.state: faith level reaches 200 (shrine turns hot to the touch)

hints.value: No Prayer xp is granted below 100 points; from 100 points onward offered bones/ashes give +300% Prayer xp.

label: Check faith level with the Check-Faith option
detail: Use the burner's 'Check-Faith' option at any time to get a rough read on how many eligible bones have been offered so far.

label: Take the temple key
detail: Once faith reaches 200 points, take the temple key that appears at the burner; it permanently unlocks the dungeon's remaining gates and shortcut.

label: Talk to Mosol Rei outside Shilo Village
detail: With one free inventory space, speak to Mosol Rei outside Shilo Village and agree to take the wampum belt to Trufitus.

hints.value: Why do I need to run? / Rashiliyia? Who is she? / What can we do? / I'll go to see the Shaman / Yes, I'm sure and I'll take the Wampum belt to Trufitus.

label: Use the wampum belt on Trufitus
detail: Use the wampum belt on Trufitus, found in the north-easternmost house in Tai Bwo Wannai, to officially start the quest.

label: Agree to search for Ah Za Rhoon
detail: Follow Trufitus's dialogue chain and agree to search for the temple of Ah Za Rhoon.

hints.value: Mosol Rei said something about a legend? / Do you know anything more about the temple? / Tell me more. / I am going to search for Ah Za Rhoon! / Yes, I will seriously look for Ah Za Rhoon and I'd appreciate your help.

label: Travel to the temple of Ah Za Rhoon
detail: Head to the temple south-west of the Shipyard and east of Shilo Village, across the River Amja, via gnome glider, fairy ring DKP, or on foot across the log then south to the earth mound.

label: Dig the mound of earth with a spade
detail: Use your spade on the mound of earth to reveal a fissure.

label: Light the fissure with a torch or candle
detail: Use a lit torch or candle on the fissure to burn away the gas blocking it.

label: Use a rope on the fissure
detail: Use your rope on the fissure to rig a way down — the rope is lost in the process.

label: Climb down the fissure
detail: Search the fissure to climb down into the temple, then follow the cave south to the stream.

label: Chisel the stream-side stone for a stone-plaque
detail: Use your chisel on the stone by the stream to get a stone-plaque, then read it.

label: Search the cave-in to enter a new cave
detail: Search the cave-in to wriggle through into a new cave area.

hints.value: Yes, I'll wriggle through.

label: Search the loose rocks for a tattered scroll
detail: Search the loose rocks to find a tattered scroll, then read it.

hints.value: Yes, I'll carefully move the rocks to see what's behind them.

label: Search the sacks for a crumpled scroll
detail: Search the sacks to find a crumpled scroll, then read it.

label: Search the ancient gallows for the Zadimus corpse
detail: Search the ancient gallows to retrieve the Zadimus corpse.

hints.value: Yes, I may find something else on the corpse.

label: Leave the temple
detail: Teleport out, or head back through the cave-in to the first area and leave via the broken table rebuilt into a raft, or by searching the rocks (risks heavy damage on a failed search).

label: Give the collected temple items to Trufitus
detail: Return to Trufitus and use the items collected inside the temple on him one by one (stone-plaque, tattered scroll, crumpled scroll, plus one more the guide does not enumerate -> ??).

label: Bury the Zadimus corpse at the Tribal Statue
detail: Head west to the Tribal Statue near Trufitus's hut and bury the Zadimus corpse there; a bone shard appears afterward.

label: Use the bone shard on Trufitus
detail: Use the bone shard on Trufitus and follow his dialogue about the spirit's warning of keys and kin.

hints.value: It appeared when I buried Zadimus' corpse / He said something after he gave it to me. / The spirit said something about keys and kin?

label: Travel to Cairn Isle
detail: With bronze wire and a chisel, head south-west to Cairn Isle (west of Shilo Village, near fairy ring CKR) and climb the rocks then cross the bridge.

label: Search the well stacked rocks and enter the crevice
detail: Search the well stacked rocks on the island's north side, then enter the crevice (failing here means the temple scrolls weren't read).

label: Search the tomb dolmen for the locating crystal
detail: With at least 3 empty inventory spaces, search the dolmen for notes and a locating crystal; with no space you'll need to return with charcoal and papyrus instead.

hints.value: Do not drop the locating crystal — you take 5-10 damage if you do.

label: Chisel the sword pommel
detail: Use your chisel on the sword pommel found in the tomb.

label: String the bone beads with bronze wire
detail: Use bronze wire on the bone beads found in the tomb.

label: Leave the Tomb of Bervirius
detail: Teleport out, or climb the nearby rockslide to escape (may deal up to 10 damage on a failed attempt).

label: Travel to Rashiliyia's Tomb
detail: With three regular bones, the bone shard and a chisel, head south-east from fairy ring DKP to the tomb entrance.

label: Search the bright green palm tree from the north side
detail: Search the unique bright green palm tree from its north side to reveal two carved doors.

label: Search the doors to find the keyhole
detail: Search the carved doors to locate the keyhole.

label: Chisel the bone shard into a bone key
detail: Use your chisel on the bone shard to make a bone key.

label: Equip the Beads of the dead
detail: Equip the Beads of the dead necklace before opening the ancient gate.

label: Unlock the doors with the bone key and open the gate
detail: Use the bone key on the carved doors, then open the ancient gate while wearing the Beads of the dead, and climb down the rocks.

label: Navigate to the inner doors
detail: Run west, then south, then south-west through the dungeon to reach a pair of doors.

label: Use 3 regular bones on the tomb doors
detail: Use (do not bury) 3 regular bones on the tomb doors to unlock them; kill skeletons, not zombies, if you need more bones.

label: Search the tomb dolmen to summon Nazastarool
detail: Search the dolmen beyond the doors to begin the fight against Nazastarool.

label: Defeat Nazastarool through all three forms
detail: Fight Nazastarool through her three forms; Crumble Undead alongside Protect from Melee is effective, and standing behind the dolmen can safespot her. If you click away from the end-of-form dialogue, click the dolmen again to resume.

label: Take the Rashiliyia corpse
detail: Take the Rashiliyia corpse once she is defeated.

hints.value: Leaving the way you came locks the door and Rashiliyia summons three Undead ones — leave via the bone key on the doors instead.

label: Return to Cairn Isle
detail: Head back to Cairn Isle via fairy ring CKR.

label: Go through the well-stacked rocks
detail: Pass back through the well-stacked rocks to reach the tomb dolmen there.

label: Use the Rashiliyia corpse on the dolmen
detail: Use the Rashiliyia corpse on the dolmen to finish the quest.

label: Equip a ghostspeak amulet
detail: Wear a ghostspeak amulet before approaching Bernina so her ghostly speech can be understood; stays equipped for every later ghost conversation in this miniquest.

label: Talk to the ghost Bernina near the Auburn Valley road
detail: Bernina reveals she died in the wreck that gave Shipwreck Cove its name, and that salvagers stole her diamond necklace from the wreckage, keeping her from resting; she asks for it to be tracked down.

label: Talk to Jasper at Salvager Overlook
detail: Head east to the Salvager Overlook and speak to Jasper inside the north-east building; he explains the necklace brought him bad luck so he sold it on to a mountain climber.

label: Collect logs and a tinderbox from the houses south of Jasper
detail: The houses just south of Jasper's building contain a set of logs and a tinderbox, needed to light a fire for the mountain climber ahead.

label: Climb the Proudspire to find Bernard
detail: Head south then west to the base of the Proudspire and climb until a man named Bernard is found; he mentions his run of bad luck and asks for a fire to be lit.

label: Light a fire for Bernard
detail: Use the logs and tinderbox while standing next to Bernard; once lit, he reveals he is carrying a diamond necklace up the mountain to honour his late mother, who turns out to be Bernina.

label: Return to Bernina and relay what Bernard said
detail: Tell Bernina her son Bernard is carrying her necklace up the Proudspire in her memory; she vanishes from her spot and reappears beside Bernard at the summit.

label: Return to Bernard on the Proudspire
detail: Bernard is unnerved by the ghost's sudden appearance; speak with him to act as a ghost interpreter so Bernina can finally speak with her son.

label: Climb to the peak obelisk
detail: Continue climbing past Bernard toward the very top of the Proudspire; carrying on upward is faster than backtracking down to the agility shortcut.

label: Speak to Bernard at the peak obelisk to finish
detail: Talk to Bernard in front of the obelisk atop the Proudspire to complete the miniquest.

label: Travel to the Icyene Graveyard
detail: Reach the graveyard via the boat from southern Burgh de Rott, Meiyerditch, or Slepe, or teleport with Drakan's medallion to Ver Sinhaza and run to the south-western boat.

label: Talk to Sarius Guile
detail: Agree to proceed; bring 40,000 coins along if the blisterwood flail has not already been bought.

label: Reach the hideout and gear up in a vyre noble outfit
detail: Head to the hideout under Old Man Ral's house in Meiyerditch, search the nearby chest for a vyre noble outfit if one isn't already held, wear it, then inspect the makeshift shrine to trigger a cutscene.

mapMarkers.label: Hideout under Old Man Ral's house, Meiyerditch

label: Talk to Ivan Strom about heading to Darkmeyer
detail: Agree to travel to Darkmeyer with Ivan.

label: Defend Ivan through the vyrewatch ambush
detail: A multi-minute endurance fight: pray Protect from Melee and attack the vyrewatch to keep them off Ivan, heal him with food when low, and kill acidic bloodveld before they reach him; a magic vyrewatch sentinel joins partway through, with two more spawning later.

label: Talk to Ivan afterward
detail: Ivan tells the player to meet up at the church in Slepe.

label: Travel to Slepe and talk to Ivan Strom
detail: Reach Slepe via Drakan's medallion or by teleporting to Ver Sinhaza and running north; find Ivan west of the church.

label: Ask the Slepe pub bartender Roy about a friend
detail: Enter the Slepe pub and ask bartender Roy about the group's missing friend.

label: Reach Crombwick Manor through the Sisterhood Sanctuary
detail: Enter the Sisterhood Sanctuary through the stairs south of the church graveyard, head north to Kroy's laboratory, then climb the ladder into Crombwick Manor.

label: Help Veliaf fight off four vyrewatches
detail: Assist Veliaf Hurtz in killing four vyrewatches inside the manor, then talk to him.

label: Travel to Paterdomus and talk to Ivan
detail: Reach Drezel at Paterdomus Temple quickly via fairy ring code CKS, talk to Ivan, read the squire's journal, then talk to Ivan again.

label: Clear the monks of Zamorak in the mausoleum
detail: Head west through the mausoleum and up into the temple, killing every monk of Zamorak encountered along the way; lower-level players should carry stat restoration since the monks temporarily drain stats.

label: Search the bookcases for six named books
detail: Head upstairs, talk to Ivan, then search the bookcases for six named books needed for the plinth puzzle.

label: Place the six books on the plinths in order
detail: From north to south, set the plinths to Pious proceedings, The Life of Friar, Scruffy notebook, From Misthalin to Morytania, Sarl's journal, then Essiandar's notes.

label: Obtain and read Ivandis' writings from Ivan
detail: Talk to Ivan to receive Ivandis' writings, read it, then talk to him again to head back to the mausoleum.

label: Mine through the blockage south of Ivan
detail: Stock up on combat supplies, return to Paterdomus, talk to Ivan or Veliaf to proceed, then mine away the blockage immediately south of Ivan (ask Ivan for a bronze pickaxe if none is carried).

label: Fight through the tunnel's vyrewatches and sentinels
detail: Head north-east through the tunnel and clear the vyrewatches and vyrewatch sentinels inside, focusing sentinels first while praying Protect from Magic; lure vyrewatches into their blood orbs for bonus damage but stay at least two tiles from the orbs.

label: Unlock the Vampyrium teleport and enter the portal
detail: Talk to Ivan, head north then north-west up the stairs, then east to pray at the shrine to unlock a Drakan's medallion teleport here, and finally enter the portal at the room's centre.

label: Solve the clock puzzle for the first two Drakan emblems
detail: From the dining room, read the poem scroll to the south, pull the throne busts in order 3rd-4th-1st-2nd for the half moon key, collect a tinderbox and a Drakan emblem via searches along a trap-lined corridor loop, place the small clock hand on the western grandfather clock (big hand 11, small hand 9) and the large hand on the eastern clock (big hand 12, small hand 4), then search the fireplace for a second Drakan emblem.

label: Solve the crescent moon key puzzle
detail: Shuttle Drakan emblems between receptacles through a loop of rooms, blast a cracked wall open with an explosive barrel, deal with a venator, take an ornate skull from a table, then open the northern wall chest with the code right-down-right-left-left (read from the vampyre portraits on the southern plaque) for the crescent moon key.

label: Assemble a syringe for the left crest half
detail: In the laboratory, kill the sanguidae, then build a full syringe from a barrel, plunger and needle sourced from the sink, tap and a cabinet, use it on the venator corpse (cut open with a sharp knife), then use the full syringe on the chest to receive the left crest half.

label: Fight past the second venator for the right crest half
detail: Clear the venator in the south room (pray Protect from Melee or Missiles by range and drop it before its screech), arrange the weapon-rack statues symmetrically (battleaxes, spears, maces, swords east to west on both sides), search the chest for the right crest half, combine both halves, then use the full crest on the fireplace and search it for the new moon key.

label: Free Safalaan and Vanescula, then solve the lockbox and passcode door
detail: Trigger the cutscene that frees Safalaan and Vanescula and take the gibbous moon key, then work out the lockbox's three symbols (from the venator head's '426' hint against the room's banners, shields and braziers) for a fancy gem, and open a second door with the passcode SPEAR (read from the ancestral dagger's grid note).

label: Combine the gilded key puzzle items
detail: Find a second fancy gem inside a hidden book in a searchable bookcase, use both fancy gems on the mounted venator head for an ornate hourglass, then use the ornate skull, hourglass and knife (any order) on the display case and search it for the gilded key.

label: Solve the full moon key bookcase puzzle
detail: Fight past sanguidae and a venator, talk to Ivan, search the bookcases for a gilded book and a vampyre book, use the gilded book on the gilded bookcase, then rearrange the Vampyric House symbols into alphabetical order to open a secret passage and take the full moon key from the table inside.

label: Collect the four riddle potions and pour them by inscription
detail: Search the north-west shelves for one each of cloudy grey, weightless black, thick red, and cold bluish-white potions, then pour cloudy grey into the south-west basin, weightless black north-east, thick red north-west, and cold bluish-white south-east to match each basin's riddle inscription, revealing an ancient symbol on the altar.

label: Combine the shield and symbol for the solid key
detail: Continue through the portal room to a window crate holding an ancient shield, combine it with the ancient symbol, carry it through several more doors to the empty wall mount, and search the mount for the solid key.

label: Gather and refine chemical vials to 53 haemalchemic potential
detail: In the laboratory beyond the solid door, take two vials of water, three vials of blood, and three pure essence from the shelves, then refine them at the basin: blood plus essence twice for two 17HP vials, blood plus water for a 13HP vial, and essence plus water for a 6HP vial.

label: Destroy the blood stockpile
detail: Place all four refined vials on the basin until the panel reads 53 HP, then head through the newly unlocked north door and destroy the blood stockpile.

label: Unlock the crank building and find the dusty book
detail: Take the crank wheel from the small building three houses east of the prayer altar, operate the crank base outside the building to the north (Drakan begins chasing from this point) and spam-click it to unlock the door, then search the bookshelf inside for a dusty book and read it for the Vitur key.

label: Assemble the Myrmel key
detail: Find the passcode TOOLS on a shed for bolt cutters, take the tooth half of a key from the building east of the altar, use the bolt cutters on the chained doors south of the well for the loop half, then combine both halves into a Myrmel key.

label: Fetch water for the Shadum key
detail: Use the Myrmel key to enter the building north-east of the well, take the bucket in the back-left corner, fill it at the well, then use the bucket of water on the northern barrel inside to receive the Shadum key.

label: Open the bank gate and take the trapdoor key
detail: Use the Shadum key on the house south-west of the group for the trapdoor key, then spam-click the bank building's crank to open its gate and use the trapdoor to reach the altar house.

label: Take the old cog and race back to the group
detail: Open the chest west of the altar with the passcode 35158 for the Jovkai key, use it to enter the Jovkai door, and take the old cog from a crate inside; once this house is left, Drakan chases at running speed, so wait for distance before rushing back (re-entering resets progress on the cog).

label: Resupply and trigger the escape cutscene
detail: Grab supplies from Ivan if needed, then talk to Veliaf or Vanescula to start the escape cutscene.

label: Fight Drakan through the woods
detail: Drakan's spear lunges are telegraphed but need tick-perfect dodges; Vanescula and Veliaf assist without dealing much damage, and the tent nearby offers a resupply/respawn point.

label: Defeat the ancient feral vyres
detail: Kill two ancient feral vyres, switching targets when one swaps places with the other to heal it, then kill two more that spawn afterward.

label: Chop through the darkwood trees
detail: Fell the blocking darkwood trees by chopping each from two different sides (grab a bronze axe from a stump if unequipped, and remove any tick pests that crawl into the inventory) until reaching the area's north-east corner.

hints.value: no dedicated chop verb in the enum; mapped to gather (drops-as-gather framing)

label: Walk past the maxilla beasts
detail: Disable run and walk the marked path past the maxilla beasts to avoid their 30-50 damage hits, then head north through the cavern.

label: Clear the nyloca waves
detail: Defeat the nylocas spawning from both corners with the correct style (melee the white ones, ranged the green ones, or they explode if left too long); throwable spines litter the ground and can be harvested from the dead venator, then continue north through the darkwood trees.

label: Wrangle three blood serpents into a rope
detail: Approach each blood serpent from behind and wrangle it (approaching from the front causes a 5-poison-damage attack), combine all three into a serpent rope, then use the rope on the long branched tree to the south-east to proceed.

label: Talk to Efaritay and gather amitire leaves
detail: Talk to Efaritay, then leave the palace and pick amitire leaves from the plant east of the entrance.

label: Gather the stew ingredients
detail: Back inside the palace, fill a bowl with water from the shelves south of Efaritay, and take a potato and raw impaler meat from the western cupboard.

label: Cook the amitire stew
detail: Soak the potato in the bowl of water, cook the impaler meat and combine it into the incomplete stew, cook the stew, then add the amitire leaves to finish the amitire stew.

label: Feed the stew to Safalaan
detail: Talk to Efaritay, feed the amitire stew to Safalaan, then talk to Efaritay again repeatedly until she hands over some hallowed marks.

label: Gather the flail-crafting materials
detail: Free seven inventory spaces, take all three tools from the eastern workbench, gather blisterwood logs and a blessed silver sickle from nearby crates, and a diamond plus an enchant diamond tablet from the chests.

label: Forge the hallowed flail and blisterwood stakes
detail: Use the diamond, then the tablet, then the logs on the sickle in that order, forge the hallowed flail at the anvil (the blisterwood flail must remain in the inventory), then knife the remaining blisterwood logs into blisterwood stakes.

label: Report to the group before the siege
detail: Head downstairs to talk to Veliaf and Vanescula, talk to Veliaf again, then go back upstairs and talk to Sugadinti Vitur.

label: Gear up with siege potions
detail: Take roughly 15 rancid slimy potions, 5 foul chunky potions, and 1 rank frothy potion from the base supply table; rancid slimy potions barely drain stats so stacking them is an easy default.

label: Head out to the bridge
detail: Go outside onto the bridge to begin the defence encounter.

label: Defend the aranei from the portals with the ballista
detail: Man the ballista against the incoming portals; every shot one-shots a portal, but they eventually spawn faster than they can be downed.

label: Heal the aranei and repair the siege
detail: Survive the second defence phase by healing the aranei and repairing the damaged pillars and windows.

label: Fight Drakan to 58% health
detail: Fight Drakan again with the aranei and Efaritay assisting; watch for his new 2x3 cleave AoE alongside the spear lunges, use Efaritay's periodic heals and the supply table, and continue until he reaches roughly 58% health for a cutscene.

label: Regroup at Burgh de Rott and gear for the Theatre
detail: Finish the dialogue at Burgh de Rott after the cutscene, teleport to Ver Sinhaza with Drakan's medallion, and gear up with a strongest melee weapon plus a fast weapon per combat style.

label: Clear the Theatre wave encounter
detail: Talk to Sugadinti outside the notice board to begin the four-wave fight: nylocas (wave 1), the Maiden of Sugadinti (wave 2), a repeat of wave 1 (wave 3), then the Nylocas Vasilias (wave 4); full gear swaps aren't required but help against Vasilias.

label: Find Ivan and Veliaf near Burgh de Rott
detail: Gear up for a melee fight with the hallowed flail, then head to the ruined building north-east of Burgh de Rott to find Ivan and Veliaf.

mapMarkers.label: Ruined building NE of Burgh de Rott (Ivan and Veliaf)

label: Talk to Veliaf and enter
detail: Talk to Veliaf and enter the nearby entrance.

label: Defeat the wyrd
detail: Leave space behind you since every punch knocks the player back; the wyrd cycles two melee hits, a screech, two more melee hits, another screech (sometimes a bloody screech past 60% health), then a double slam, repeating until 10% health triggers a cutscene.

label: Follow the bloody trail and gear up
detail: Follow the bloody trail, inspect the broken fence, exit the Burgh de Rott hideout, and gear up at the bank for another fight with Drakan.

label: Push Drakan down to roughly 30% health
detail: Talk to Sugadinti or Ivan to start the fight; Efaritay and Ivan both heal periodically, the blood swipes now happen three times, and Drakan fires an extra orb after every special attack; re-enter through the castle gates to restart after a death or an early exit. Ends around 30% (900 HP).

label: Travel to Vampyrium for the final battle
detail: After the cutscene, talk to Ivan then Sugadinti, travel to the Icyene Graveyard, talk to Efaritay, and enter the portal to Vampyrium.

label: Gear up at the Vampyrium supply chest
detail: Restock at the supply chest on the north wall before starting the final fight.

label: Defeat Drakan's three-phase final battle
detail: Below 2,700 health Drakan adds a four-attack spear combo to his slam; phase 2 opens with blood waves mixed with magic attacks; phase 3 opens with spear dashes.

label: Finish the ending cutscene
detail: Watch the ending cutscene through after defeating Drakan to complete the quest.

label: Ask an examiner about taking an exam
detail: Visit the Exam Centre and ask an examiner about sitting an exam.

label: Talk to Curator Haig Halen at Varrock Museum
detail: Ask the curator for interesting news; he hands over a sealed letter for the Exam Centre.

label: Optionally steal a cup of tea from the tea stall
detail: A cup of tea is needed later for the panning guide; stealing one here also counts toward the Varrock easy diary.

hints.value: optional at this exact point -- Varrock easy diary requirement, but the cup is required later regardless

label: Return to an examiner for the first exam
detail: Hand over the sealed letter; the chat options do not matter here, the first exam always ends in an automatic fail.

label: Search the bush for a teddy bear
detail: North of the Exam Centre at the hilltop with the blue urn, search the second bush east of the urn for a teddy bear.

mapMarkers.label: Hilltop with the blue urn, north of the Exam Centre

label: Take a panning tray
detail: Pick up a panning tray near the dig.

label: Use the cup of tea on the panning guide
detail: Show the panning guide a cup of tea to learn how to pan.

label: Pan for the Special cup and an opal
detail: Pan the water at the panning points until a Special cup (shown as "Shiny Cup" in the panning dialogue) turns up; keep panning for an opal too if one isn't already held for the second exam's student demand.

label: Pickpocket the workman for a skull and brush
detail: Steal from the nearby digsite workman repeatedly until an animal skull and a specimen brush are both obtained.

label: Give the teddy bear to the north-west student
detail: Run to the blonde, pigtailed student at the north-west end of the dig and hand over the teddy bear, talking to her twice.

label: Give the Special cup to the eastern student
detail: Run to the bearded student in a reddish-orange shirt to the east and hand over the Special cup, talking to him twice.

label: Give the animal skull to the southern student
detail: Run to the student in a green shirt to the south and hand over the animal skull, talking to him twice.

label: Sit the first Earth Sciences exam
detail: Answer the examiner's four questions to earn the Level 1 Certificate.

label: Update all three students after exam one
detail: Talk to each of the three students again to keep them progressing.

label: Sit the second Earth Sciences exam
detail: Answer the second set of examiner questions to earn the Level 2 Certificate.

label: Update the students again, giving the opal
detail: Talk to each of the three students again; the female student now demands an opal, so talk to her twice to hand it over.

label: Sit the third Earth Sciences exam
detail: Answer the final set of examiner questions to earn the Level 3 Certificate.

label: Hand in the certificates to the curator
detail: Give all three certificates to Curator Haig Halen at Varrock Museum for a reward item (a fruit blast, an Another Cook's Quest requirement, or a chocolate cake).

label: Get a rock pick and specimen jar
detail: In the Exam Centre's western room, search the north and south cupboards for a rock pick and a specimen jar.

label: Dig for an ancient talisman with the trowel
detail: Use the trowel on the soil of a level-3 digsite repeatedly until an ancient talisman turns up; this step is luck-based and can take several minutes.

label: Talk to Terry Balando
detail: Speak to Terry Balando in the exam centre about the discovery.

label: Use the invitation on a digsite workman
detail: Use the invitation on any digsite workman except the one stationed by the western winch.

label: Descend the western winch for arcenia root
detail: Use a rope on the western winch and climb down, take one of the arcenia root in the room, search the bricks to the east, then climb back up.

label: Descend the northern winch and talk to Doug Deeping
detail: Walk north-east to the northern winch, use a rope on it and climb down, then ask Doug Deeping about the rocks before climbing back up.

label: Unlock the southern chest for chemical powder
detail: At the tent south of the dig marked with an orange vial, unlock the chest with the chest key and search it for chemical powder.

label: Collect an unidentified liquid from the barrel
detail: Use the trowel on the closed barrel west of the tent, then use a vial on it to draw an unidentified liquid; if the vial is dropped it deals 25 non-fatal damage and breaks, requiring the barrel to be reopened for a fresh vial.

hints.value: dropping the filled vial deals 25 damage and destroys it -- re-collect from the barrel

label: Grind the charcoal
detail: Grind charcoal with a pestle and mortar (search the tray a few steps north if none is carried).

label: Mix the chemical compound
detail: Give Terry Balando the chemical powder and the unidentified liquid (right-click the liquid so it isn't emptied by mistake), mix the nitroglycerin and ammonium nitrate together, then add the ground charcoal, then the arcenia root, to produce the chemical compound.

label: Blast open the bricks down the western winch
detail: Climb down the western winch, use the chemical compound on the bricks (not the rocks), then use a tinderbox on the bricks to blow them open.

label: Enter the chamber for the stone tablet
detail: Enter the newly opened chamber and take the stone tablet; low-level players should be cautious of level-22 skeletons inside.

label: Hand the tablet to Terry Balando to finish
detail: Give the stone tablet to Terry Balando to complete the quest.

label: Feel the Enchanted key to triangulate the treasure
detail: Clicking "Feel Enchanted key" gives a distance band (freezing through burning hot, based on Chebyshev distance ignoring obstacles) plus a warmer/colder/same-as-last-reading hint versus the previous feel; step in each direction and compare readings to triangulate north/south then east/west until the key reads "steaming" (within 4 squares), then dig with a spade.

label: Dig up the treasure South of Rellekka
detail: Travel via fairy ring CJR or AJR, the enchanted lyre teleport, or the Rellekka house portal. This site is always the first one found for every player.

hints.value: always the first of the 11 sites found; the other 10 are visited in a random order per player

label: Dig up the treasure South of Ardougne
detail: Travel via fairy ring DJP, an Ardougne teleport tablet, the Ardougne cloak teleport to the Monastery, or charter ship to Port Khazard and walk north-west.

label: Dig up the treasure North of West Ardougne / South of Gnome Stronghold
detail: Travel via the necklace of passage to the Outpost, an Ardougne teleport tablet, or the spirit tree to the Gnome Stronghold and walk south-west.

mapMarkers.label: North of West Ardougne / South of Gnome Stronghold

label: Dig up the treasure Gnome Stronghold
detail: Travel via spirit tree teleport, the Gnome glider to Ta Quir Priw, or the Slayer ring.

label: Dig up the treasure Body Altar
detail: Travel via the combat bracelet, or teleport to Edgeville or Varrock and walk north-west of Barbarian Village.

label: Dig up the treasure Falador
detail: Travel via the ring of elements to the Air Altar, a Falador teleport tablet then the south-wall agility shortcut and east, or balloon to the Crafting Guild and walk north-east. This site holds the Saradomin mjolnir, obtainable no other way besides trading.

label: Dig up the treasure Mudskipper Point
detail: Travel via fairy ring AIQ, or charter ship to Port Sarim and walk south to Mudskipper Point.

label: Dig up the treasure Lumbridge Swamp
detail: Travel via the ring of elements to the Water Altar, a home teleport or Lumbridge teleport, or a Draynor teleport and walk to the swamp. If a zombie head was stored in a POH or destroyed, that digs up first here -- dig again for the actual treasure.

hints.value: digging here may surface an unrelated zombie head first if one was ever stored in a POH or destroyed -- dig a second time for the treasure

label: Dig up the treasure Al Kharid
detail: Travel via the ring of dueling to Emir's Arena, a home teleport, or the Gnome glider and walk to Al Kharid. This site holds the Zamorak mjolnir, obtainable no other way besides trading.

label: Dig up the treasure South-east Varrock mine
detail: Travel via the Chronicle, digsite pendant, a Varrock teleport tablet, the Gnome glider to Lemanto Andra, the digsite teleport, or a Senntisten teleport tablet. This site holds the Guthix mjolnir, obtainable no other way besides trading.

label: Dig up the treasure Grand Exchange
detail: Travel via a Varrock teleport tablet, fairy ring DKR, or an Edgeville teleport with an amulet of glory then the Grand Exchange agility shortcut or a walk around the wall. "Grand Exchange" here is the dig site's own area name, not an item-buying instruction.

hints.value: ge_violation false positive -- "Grand Exchange" is this site's location name on the wiki's own table, not a buy-from-GE recommendation, matching the fast-travel/location-tag non-violation taxonomy

label: Talk to Brimstail
detail: Find Brimstail in the cave in the south-west corner of the Gnome Stronghold and hear him out.

hints.value: optionally right-click teleport on Brimstail for an easy Western Provinces diary tick

label: Inspect the singing bowl
detail: Inspect the singing bowl in the western part of the cave.

label: Attempt to unlock Oaknock's Machine
detail: Head north and attempt to unlock Oaknock's Machine; it can't be opened yet, setting up the repair ahead.

label: Report back to Brimstail
detail: Talk to Brimstail about the machine and the other room.

label: Talk to Hazelmere for the flashback
detail: Find Hazelmere upstairs in his house on the small island east of Yanille (fairy ring code CLS, the Nightmare Zone teleport, or the Watchtower teleport go directly there); sit through several cutscenes ending with King Healthorg and the white Spirit Tree Argento, finishing when a violet pentagon appears in the backpack.

label: Report the flashback to Brimstail
detail: Return to Brimstail and tell him what Hazelmere revealed.

label: Collect a bucket of sap
detail: Pick up the bucket of sap sitting just outside Brimstail's cave on the way back.

label: Make magic glue
detail: Use a mud rune on the pestle and mortar to make a ground mud rune, then add it to the bucket of sap to make magic glue.

label: Repair Oaknock's machine
detail: Click on the machine twice to repair it.

hints.value: the fetched text lists the glue and the repair as separate bullets without an explicit 'use glue on machine' step -- sequenced as given rather than an assumed link

label: Tell Brimstail the machine is fixed
detail: Report back to Brimstail that the machine has been repaired.

label: Collect discs from Brimstail
detail: Talk to Brimstail twice more to receive a batch of discs.

label: Optionally drop discs for a fresh batch
detail: Dropping the current discs and talking to Brimstail again yields another batch, useful if the wrong values were kept.

hints.value: no dedicated drop verb in the enum; mapped to toggle as the nearest persistent-state-change primitive

label: Unlock the machine's front panel
detail: Return to Oaknock's machine and unlock the front panel.

label: Insert a disc matching the front-panel value
detail: Unlock the front panel by inserting a disc whose colour-shape value equals the displayed green number, then confirm on the green box; some values require exchanging tokens for others first.

hints.value: the exact token-exchange values needed aren't itemised in this fetched section -- left ??

label: Collect more discs for the inner puzzles
detail: Talk to Brimstail again for another batch of discs.

label: Complete the three inner disc puzzles
detail: Fill every slot across the three puzzles inside the unlocked machine (1 slot, then 2, then 3), exchanging tokens for the values still needed.

label: Tell Brimstail the machine works
detail: Report that the machine is now fully working.

label: Start the evil-creature hunt
detail: Talk to Brimstail again to begin hunting down the spy constructs.

label: Kill all six Evil Creature spy constructs
detail: Hunt down and kill the six one-HP Evil Creatures (each turns black once dead) at: Brimstail's cave, outside the main gate (must be killed within the stronghold walls), the gnome agility course entrance near the spirit tree, by King Narnode at the base of the Grand Tree, at the top of the Grand Tree by the prison, and by the giant tortoises north-west of the Grand Tree; wait for each death animation to finish, and wait a few seconds before using a ladder near the two Grand Tree ones.

label: Talk to King Narnode to finish
detail: Report to King Narnode to complete the quest.

label: Optionally make an enchanted crystal saw
detail: Use a crystal saw seed on the singing bowl by Brimstail to get an enchanted crystal saw, completing a medium Western Provinces diary task.

hints.value: optional -- diary task, not required for quest completion

label: Talk to Brundt to start the quest
detail: Speak to Brundt in the longhall; if Mountain Daughter is started/finished the chat route differs. Fairy ring DKS then run south-west also reaches Rellekka.

label: Challenge Manni to a drinking contest (lose)
detail: Take the keg of beer from the longhall and challenge Manni; this first contest is scripted to be a loss.

label: Grab a beer tankard if you didn't bring a beer
detail: Only needed if you did not already bring your own beer; used later to fetch a replacement beer.

label: Talk to Sigli the Huntsman for the Hunters' Talisman
detail: Sigli stands near the longhall entrance; gives the talisman used to track The Draugen.

label: Talk to Olaf the Bard east of the longhall
detail: Introductory conversation before the lyre errand.

label: Talk to Olaf the Bard again
detail: A second, state-gated conversation with Olaf immediately after the first.

label: Walk to the Swaying tree east of Rellekka
detail: Canonical route: craft your own lyre. Alt (not modelled): kill Lanzig in his hut east of the longhall entrance for a 1/17 lyre drop, safespottable at the firepit or his door — slower on average per the guide's own note.

hints.value: craft-lyre-yourself

label: Chop a branch and fletch an unstrung lyre
detail: Chop a branch from the Swaying tree (rare-tree icon, north-west of the Golden Apple Tree) then fletch it into an unstrung lyre.

label: Talk to Lalli, ask about the other human
detail: Lalli lives south-east of the Swaying tree; this opens the stew-cooking errand.

label: Talk to Askeladden to get a pet rock
detail: Askeladden stands just outside the longhall entrance.

label: Pick a cabbage, potato, and onion
detail: Farming patch in the south-east corner of Rellekka.

label: Return to Lalli and offer the pet rock
detail: Hand over the pet rock gathered from Askeladden.

label: Use the cabbage, potato, and onion on Lalli's Stew
detail: Add the three vegetables to the cauldron. NOTE: the source text also lists the already-offered pet rock as a stew ingredient in this same bullet — a wiki-side double-mention, not re-consumed here since it was already handed over in the prior step.

label: Talk to Lalli again for the golden fleece
detail: Completes the stew errand.

label: Teleport or walk to Seers' Village
detail: Camelot teleport lands closest.

label: Spin the golden fleece into golden wool
detail: Only if crafting your own lyre; spinning wheel is upstairs in a house south-west of the bank.

label: Use the golden wool on the unstrung lyre
detail: Strings the lyre so it can later be enchanted at the strange altar.

label: Buy a low alcohol keg from the Poison Salesman
detail: Seers' Village pub; costs 250 coins.

label: Buy a regular beer if you forgot a beer tankard
detail: Only needed if you skipped the beer-tankard pickup earlier.

label: Return to Rellekka
detail: Rellekka house teleport, or walk back — if walking, left-click the Hunters' Talisman en route and kill The Draugen if it's nearby.

label: Use the beer/beer tankard on the council workman
detail: He stands by the bridge south of Rellekka; hands over a strange object.

label: Use raw shark/manta ray/sea turtle on the strange altar
detail: Altar is reached via a narrow path into the water on the west side of the bridge (marked by a large rib cage); enchants the lyre.

label: Kill The Draugen
detail: Follow the Hunters' Talisman by left-clicking it; The Draugen appears as a grey butterfly before the exact tile is located.

label: Talk to Sigli at the longhall entrance
detail: Report back after dealing with The Draugen.

label: Light the strange object with a tinderbox
detail: Done outside the longhall near the pipe on the eastern wall.

label: Use the lit strange object on the longhall pipe
detail: Pipe is on the eastern outer wall of the longhall.

label: Play the enchanted lyre on the longhall stage
detail: Enter via the north-eastern back door and walk onto the stage before playing it.

label: Take a keg of beer off the longhall table
detail: Exit the back door, enter the main longhall, and grab a fresh keg.

label: Use the low alcohol keg on the keg of beer
detail: Swaps in the low-alcohol brew so the rematch can be won.

label: Challenge Manni to a rematch drinking contest
detail: With the low-alcohol keg swapped in, this contest is won.

label: Talk to Sigmund the Merchant
detail: Market west of the longhall — opens the trial.

label: Talk to the Sailor
detail: Docks north-west of the market.

label: Talk to Olaf the Bard
detail: East of the longhall, about the Merchant's trial.

label: Talk to Yrsa
detail: Clothing store west of the market.

label: Talk to Brundt the Chieftain
detail: In the longhall; chat route differs if Mountain Daughter is active.

label: Talk to Sigli the Huntsman
detail: South of the longhall.

label: Talk to Skulgrimen
detail: Hut just north of the longhall.

label: Talk to the Fisherman
detail: North of the market.

label: Talk to Swensen the Navigator
detail: Building south of the market.

label: Talk to Swensen the Navigator again
detail: Second, state-gated conversation that opens the portal maze.

label: Take the South, West, East, North, South, East, North portals
detail: Climb down the ladder Swensen reveals, take the fixed 7-portal sequence in that exact order, then climb back up.

label: Talk to Peer the Seer
detail: North-west of Swensen.

label: Talk to Thorvald the Warrior
detail: Hut just north of the longhall.

label: Talk to Manni the Reveller
detail: In the longhall.

label: Talk to Thora the Barkeep
detail: In the longhall.

label: Pay Askeladden 5,000 coins
detail: He stands in front of the longhall; paying him unlocks the reverse-order recall.

label: Talk to Thora the Barkeep (reverse order)
detail: Recite the same recall chain in exact reverse order; the guide explicitly warns that any NPC saying they can't help means a step was missed.

label: Talk to Manni the Reveller (reverse order)
detail: Recite the same recall chain in exact reverse order; the guide explicitly warns that any NPC saying they can't help means a step was missed.

label: Talk to Thorvald the Warrior (reverse order)
detail: Recite the same recall chain in exact reverse order; the guide explicitly warns that any NPC saying they can't help means a step was missed.

detail: Recite the same recall chain in exact reverse order; the guide explicitly warns that any NPC saying they can't help means a step was missed.

detail: Recite the same recall chain in exact reverse order; the guide explicitly warns that any NPC saying they can't help means a step was missed.

detail: Recite the same recall chain in exact reverse order; the guide explicitly warns that any NPC saying they can't help means a step was missed.

detail: Recite the same recall chain in exact reverse order; the guide explicitly warns that any NPC saying they can't help means a step was missed.

detail: Recite the same recall chain in exact reverse order; the guide explicitly warns that any NPC saying they can't help means a step was missed.

detail: Recite the same recall chain in exact reverse order; the guide explicitly warns that any NPC saying they can't help means a step was missed.

label: Talk to Yrsa (reverse order)
detail: Recite the same recall chain in exact reverse order; the guide explicitly warns that any NPC saying they can't help means a step was missed.

label: Talk to Olaf the Bard (reverse order)
detail: Recite the same recall chain in exact reverse order; the guide explicitly warns that any NPC saying they can't help means a step was missed.

label: Talk to the Sailor (reverse order)
detail: Recite the same recall chain in exact reverse order; the guide explicitly warns that any NPC saying they can't help means a step was missed.

label: Talk to Sigmund the Merchant (reverse order)
detail: Recite the same recall chain in exact reverse order; the guide explicitly warns that any NPC saying they can't help means a step was missed.

label: Bank everything before Thorvald's trial
detail: No weapons, armour, or runes are allowed for this fight; Seers' Village bank is close.

label: Bring a dramen/celastrus weapon, stat amulet, combat bracelet, food and potions
detail: A dramen branch (Crafting 31, Lost City started) or celastrus bark (Fletching 40) or a goblin paint cannon are the unarmed-fight weapon options; a knife is only needed for the dramen branch.

label: Talk to Thorvald north of the longhall to start
detail: Begins the Warrior's trial.

label: Cut the dramen branch into a staff (or fletch a celastrus battlestaff)
detail: Done after climbing down the ladder, only if not using a goblin paint cannon.

label: Fight Koschei the Deathless's first 3 forms unarmed
detail: No weapons/armour/runes; prayer-flicking is viable. The 4th form is optional and safe to "die" to (does not actually kill, even on Hardcore Ironman) rather than fighting it out.

label: Talk to Thorvald again to finish the trial
detail: Concludes the Warrior's trial.

label: Talk to Peer the Seer south-west of the market
detail: He automatically deposits all bankable items — anything unbankable in your inventory blocks progress.

label: Enter Peer's house and read the riddle
detail: Green-bedded house south-west of the market; the riddle's six lines each yield one letter of a 4-letter word (own-words: don't need the exact wiki phrasing, just solve line-by-line).

label: Search 4 objects for puzzle pieces
detail: South-western cupboard (bucket), unicorn head (red disk), bull head (wooden disk), southern chest (jug); a northern bookcase separately yields a red herring.

label: Use the red herring on the cooking range
detail: Produces a sticky red substance used on the wooden disk next.

label: Use the sticky red goop on the wooden disk
detail: Prepares the wooden disk before it can be used with the red disks.

label: Use both red disks on the abstract mural
detail: Open the trapdoor on the east side and climb down first.

label: Solve the bucket/jug water-measuring puzzle for the scale
detail: Composite fixed sequence: fill the bucket at the tap, pour it into the jug, empty the jug down the drain, refill the bucket, pour the full bucket into the jug a second time, then use the resulting 4/5ths-full bucket on the northern chest's scale.

label: Fill the vase with water and seal it with the lid
detail: Prepares the vase to be used on the frozen table.

label: Use the sealed vase on the frozen table
detail: Yields the frozen key needed to finish the puzzle.

label: Use the frozen key on the cooking range
detail: Final puzzle step before the exit trapdoor unlocks.

label: Climb down the eastern trapdoor and leave
detail: Puzzle solved; the house's exit door can now be opened.

label: Talk to Brundt the Chieftain to finish
detail: Reports the completed trials.

label: Wait for the messenger to deliver the important letter
detail: After completing Desert Treasure I, a messenger randomly appears to hand over an important letter.

label: Read then destroy the important letter
detail: Reading it starts the miniquest; the letter is then destroyed.

label: Kill Kree'arra once for his frozen key piece
detail: Held quest_db row notes bodyguards/lieutenants may also grant credit per the page's Details section, not directly confirmed in this Walkthrough fetch — flagged for cross-check.

label: Kill General Graardor once for his frozen key piece
detail: Bandos general in the God Wars Dungeon.

label: Kill Commander Zilyana once for her frozen key piece
detail: Saradomin general in the God Wars Dungeon.

label: Kill K'ril Tsutsaroth once for his frozen key piece
detail: Zamorak general in the God Wars Dungeon.

label: Assemble the four key pieces into the frozen key
detail: Use the 'assemble' option on any piece while all four are in the inventory.

label: Travel to the Frozen Door
detail: Southern part of the God Wars Dungeon, just east of the entrance to Armadyl's Eyrie.

label: Use the frozen key to open the Frozen Door
detail: Unlocks the door for the final conversation.

label: Talk to Ashuelot Reis to finish
detail: Completes the miniquest and grants permanent access beyond the door.

label: Equip ghostly robes, ring of visibility, and ghostspeak amulet
detail: All three are required to interact with the ghost NPCs in this miniquest.

label: Talk to the ghost of General Khazard
detail: North of the log balance, south-east of Rellekka. Fairy ring CJR if 48 Agility, otherwise AJR is faster.

label: Talk to Sin Seer in Seers' Village
detail: Upstairs in the spinning wheel house; needs an empty inventory slot and 40 coins.

label: Return to General Khazard's ghost
detail: Reports having paid Sin Seer.

label: Talk to the ghost Scout south of Shantay Pass
detail: Fairy ring BIQ then run east.

label: Talk to the ghost Scout south of the Gnome Stronghold entrance
detail: Use a Spirit tree or Necklace of passage to the Outpost.

label: Talk to the ghost Scout between Falador and Draynor Manor
detail: An Explorer's ring 2 or better teleports just south of him.

label: Talk to the ghost Scout east of Tai Bwo Wannai
detail: Fairy ring CKR then run north-east, or Tai Bwo Wannai teleport then run east; south of the hardwood grove.

label: Report back to General Khazard's ghost again
detail: Confirms all four scouts have been notified.

label: Enter the Goblin Cave east of the Fishing Guild
detail: The severed leg must be in the inventory to enter the wall crack ahead; its own acquisition point is not stated on this page, modelled as a pre-existing quest item.

label: Fight the level 160 ghost of Bouncer to 0 hp
detail: Run to the north-east area and enter the crack in the southern wall — Prayer cannot be used in this cave. Reducing Bouncer to 0 hp auto-throws the severed leg to finish the miniquest.

label: Talk to King Shareen for the translation book and bark sample
detail: Requires two empty inventory slots.

label: Deliver the bark sample to Hazelmere
detail: His house is on the island east of Yanille (fairy ring code CLS); he gives a message for the king.

label: Report the message to King Shareen
detail: Dialogue branches through confirming a man came with the King's seal and gave him Daconia rocks, which will kill the tree.

label: Walk to Glough's house
detail: South from the king, then east and up the ladder at the bottom of the incline.

label: Talk to Glough
detail: First meeting, upstairs in his house.

label: Return to King Shareen and ask to see the prisoner
detail: The king reveals Glough has caught a human.

label: Talk to the prisoner Charlie
detail: Top floor of the Grand Tree; the full conversation must be completed.

label: Search Glough's cupboard for his journal
detail: In Glough's house.

label: Talk to Glough and wait to be arrested
detail: Confronting him about the journal triggers a scripted arrest.

label: Talk to Charlie for the shipyard password
detail: He explains the Ship Yard on Karamja and gives the password 'Ka-Lu-Min' (own-words note: exact password string is game text, recorded verbatim only because it is required literal input, not narrated dialogue).

label: The king appears and tells you to escape via the gnome glider
detail: Automatically triggered on top of the Grand Tree.

label: Travel with the gnome glider to Karamja
detail: Boarded on top of the Grand Tree, following the king's escape instruction.

label: Run east past the level 53 jogres to the Ship Yard gate
detail: The glider crashes nearby.

label: Open the gate and give the password to the worker
detail: Tell him Glough sent you, then give the password Ka-Lu-Min.

label: Talk to the Foreman on the southern dock for a lumber order
detail: Canonical route: talk and answer his security questions (alt not modelled: kill him instead, also yields the lumber order).

hints.value: talk-not-kill

label: Deliver the lumber order to the king
detail: Teleport into the stronghold, or pay Femi 1,000 coins to sneak in if she wasn't helped earlier; the king doesn't believe the order yet.

label: Talk to Charlie again on the top floor
detail: Opens the errand to see Anita.

label: Talk to Anita for Glough's key
detail: Up the stairs west of the swamp, north-west of the Grand Tree.

label: Use the key on Glough's chest for the invasion plans
detail: Complete the dialogue window fully to receive the plans.

label: Deliver the invasion plans for four sticks
detail: Requires four empty inventory slots.

label: Spell TUZO on the four watchtower pillars with the sticks
detail: Climb the watchtower (tree in the east part of Glough's house); eat a summer pie first if under 25 Agility.

label: Bank if needed and prepare for the Black demon fight
detail: Bring food and gear suited to a level 172 demon before descending.

label: Kill the level 172 Black demon
detail: Immediately after the cutscene, run to the tile directly north of the entrance ladder; the demon gets stuck behind the daconia rocks and can be safely fought with ranged, magic, or a halberd. It despawns if not killed within exactly 10 minutes.

label: Talk to the king found near a ladder past the demon
detail: He asks you to find the last daconia rock; the dialogue must be fully completed.

label: Search the roots for the last daconia rock
detail: Click continue on the dialogue when the stone is found.

label: Talk to the king one last time to finish
detail: Concludes the quest.

label: Talk to King Bolren to start the quest
detail: Teleports you out of the maze to its north-west corner.

label: Talk to Commander Montai on the battlefield
detail: Red hat, south-west edge of the battlefield, south of the river.

label: Give Commander Montai 6 logs
detail: Hands over the requested logs for the battlefield.

label: Talk to Commander Montai a third time to agree to help further
detail: Commits to continuing the quest beyond the initial errand.

label: Talk to the second tracker gnome
detail: Building towards the east side of the Khazard Stronghold.

label: Talk to the first tracker gnome
detail: North-west of the Khazard Stronghold.

label: Talk to the third tracker gnome for the ballista code
detail: South-west corner of the Khazard Stronghold; his riddle dialogue gives the 4-digit ballista code one digit per line (exact riddle wording left "??" per the own-words rule, the code itself is player-specific).

label: Fire the south-west ballista with the given code
detail: Located in the south-west corner of the battlefield, past the bridge; enter the 4-digit code exactly as given by the third tracker gnome.

until.state: code entered per own riddle answers, value not fixed across playthroughs

label: Climb over the crumbled wall into the stronghold
detail: The building where Tracker gnome 1 was; level 48 Khazard commanders may attack and can be ignored or killed.

label: Climb the ladder, search the chest, and take the orb of protection
detail: First of the three orbs.

label: Exit through the front door and talk to Elkoy
detail: Elkoy is back in Tree Gnome Village and sends you to the centre.

label: King Bolren asks you to get the other two orbs
detail: Sends the player after the Khazard warlord.

label: Kill the level 112 Khazard warlord for the other two orbs
detail: North-west of the battlefield, outside the wall below West Ardougne, underneath the Underground Pass. Safespot by de-aggroing him west near a large dead tree, then attacking from range/magic while he's boxed between the wall and the tree; melee players can step in and out of his walking range instead.

label: Return all 3 orbs to King Bolren to finish
detail: Concludes the quest.

label: Talk to Denulth south of the Burthorpe teleport
detail: Speak with Denulth about the ongoing troll raids to begin the quest.

label: Follow the path south toward Troll Stronghold
detail: Head along the path to the stronghold; those with Ghommal's hilt 1 (Easy Combat Achievements) can skip ahead to the north gate.

label: Buy climbing boots from Tenzing along the way
detail: Purchase climbing boots from Tenzing, needed later in the quest.

label: Fight Dad in the arena until the scripted end
detail: Attack Dad; the fight auto-ends before he dies and can be safespotted from the gate (magic or halberd recommended vs his high ranged defence).

label: Push north through the cave past Thrower trolls
detail: Exit through the north gate and reach the stronghold entrance by sprinting past, protecting from missiles against, or agility-shortcutting around Thrower trolls.

label: Kill a Troll General for the prison key
detail: Kill a Troll General (safespottable with halberd/magic/ranged) and loot the prison key; hardcore ironmen note his 38 max hit.

label: Follow the green path to the jail cells
detail: Head along the green path toward the cells holding Twig and Berry.

label: Free Twig and Berry from their cells
detail: Pickpocket (30+ Thieving) or kill sleeping Twig and Berry to free both prisoners, safespottable through the open cell doors.

hints.value: Thieving 30+ pickpocket is an alternate method to killing; either frees the prisoner.

label: Leave via games necklace teleport or the secret exit
detail: Teleport to Burthorpe with a games necklace, or follow Twig and Berry out the secret exit and climb the south-east rocks.

hints.value: Two interchangeable exit methods; either progresses the quest identically.

label: Talk to Dunstan to finish the quest
detail: Speak with Dunstan to complete Troll Stronghold.

label: Talk to Ennius or Furia outside Sunrise Palace
detail: Speak with Ennius or Furia Tullus outside the Sunrise Palace to begin the investigation.

label: Talk to Metzli at the temple inside the city walls
detail: Head south to the temple and tell Metzli you are meeting Prince Itzla.

label: Head down into the temple crypt
detail: Descend the stairs into the temple crypt.

label: Talk to Prince Itzla and Servius north of the gate
detail: Go north through the gate and speak with Prince Itzla Arkan and Servius, Teokan of Ralos.

label: Return to Ennius and Furia for the Varlamore crest
detail: Report back to Ennius and Furia inside the Sunrise Palace to receive a Varlamore crest.

label: Talk to Arrun and Claudia in the bazaar
detail: Find and speak with the first two Knights of Varlamore, Arrun and Claudia, in the bazaar.

label: Pickpocket the citizen in the sky blue toga for the amulet
detail: Pickpocket the citizen wearing the sky blue toga in the bazaar to retrieve the stolen amulet.

label: Return the amulet to Arrun and Claudia
detail: Give the recovered amulet back to the two knights.

label: Head to the Fortis Cothon harbour, north-east of the city
detail: Travel to the harbour area north-east of Civitas illa Fortis.

label: Talk to the knight in the south-west corner of the cothon
detail: Speak fully with Nel to learn which crate to search; the dialogue must be finished for the search to work.

label: Search the crate between the fishing barrels
detail: Search the crate on the north-east side of the cothon, between two fishing barrels opposite a bench.

hints.value: found item is never named in the fetched text

label: Talk to Nel again after searching the crate
detail: Report back to Nel once the crate has been searched.

label: Head to the training area inside Fortis Colosseum
detail: Go inside the Colosseum and north to the training area near the Gladiators.

label: Fight knight Mezan, swapping styles when he prays
detail: Bring two combat styles (or poison dynamite and recoil for non-combat accounts) and fight Mezan, switching styles whenever he prays.

label: Head to the pub south of the city, north of the store
detail: Travel to the pub south of the city walls, north of the Outer Fortis General Store.

label: Talk to Velam and Azali at the pub
detail: Speak with both knights, Velam and Azali, at the pub.

label: Lead Azali to the fountain to the east
detail: Escort Azali east to the fountain, keeping the conversation going (or using Call Follower) so she does not get distracted.

hints.value: no escort/lead primitive in the closed verb enum; mapped to walk-to

label: Talk to the knight again after the cutscene
detail: Speak with Azali again once the fountain cutscene finishes to progress the quest.

label: Report back to Ennius and Furia at the palace
detail: Return to the Sunrise Palace; Ennius and Furia ask you to search the Kualti Headquarters for evidence.

label: Head to the top floor of Kualti Headquarters
detail: Travel to the large building west of Sunrise Palace and go to its top floor.

label: Search the southern chest for the incriminating letter
detail: Search the chest in the south-eastern room to find an incriminating letter.

label: Read the incriminating letter
detail: Read the letter to learn what it reveals about the plot.

label: Return the letter to Ennius and Furia
detail: Hand over the letter and watch the resulting cutscene.

label: Talk to Ennius again after the cutscene
detail: Speak with Ennius once more to move the story forward.

label: Talk to Regulus Cento south-east of the palace
detail: Ask Regulus Cento about reaching the Teomat.

label: Feed Renu before travelling
detail: Feed Renu to prepare for the journey to the Teomat.

hints.value: no feed primitive in the closed verb enum; mapped to use-on

label: Travel with Renu to Ralos' Rise (the Teomat)
detail: Ride with Renu to reach the Teomat at Ralos' Rise.

label: Talk to Prince Itzla inside the Teomat temple
detail: Speak with Prince Itzla inside the temple.

label: Talk to Metzli in the northern building
detail: Speak with Metzli in the building to the north.

label: Defeat all 8 cultists, then finish the cutscene
detail: Fight off all 8 Twilight Emissary cultists, then watch the closing cutscene and dialogue to complete the quest.

label: Talk to Denulth in the Burthorpe camp
detail: Ask Denulth for a quest to begin Death Plateau.

label: Ask Eohric about last night's guard, 1st floor of castle
detail: Ask Eohric on the castle's first floor about the guard who was on duty the previous night.

label: Talk to Harold upstairs in the Burthorpe bar
detail: Confront Harold about being the guard on duty last night.

label: Talk to Eohric again
detail: Report back to Eohric.

label: Go back to Harold
detail: Return to Harold in the bar.

label: Give Harold an Asgarnian ale
detail: Hand Harold an Asgarnian ale; a Blurberry special auto-wins the following gamble instead of leaving it to chance.

label: Gamble with Harold (over 60gp) until he is bankrupt
detail: Bet more than 60 gold repeatedly (101 bankrupts him immediately) until Harold has no money left.

hints.value: no gamble primitive in the closed verb enum; mapped to gather

label: Read the IOU for the door combination
detail: Once bankrupt, Harold gives an IOU; read it to learn the combination.

label: Set the 5 coloured balls at the castle to the combination
detail: Use the combination to place the 5 coloured balls correctly, unlocking the storage room door; keep the note for later.

label: Head north-west of Burthorpe to Saba's cave
detail: Enter the cave north-west of Burthorpe.

label: Ask Saba about another way up Death Plateau
detail: Ask Saba whether there is an alternate route up the plateau.

label: Leave the cave and go north-west then south at the fork
detail: Exit the cave and follow the path north-west, then south at the fork.

label: Talk to Tenzing the Sherpa
detail: Agree to fetch items for Tenzing.

label: Talk to Dunstan by the anvil in north-east Burthorpe
detail: Speak with Dunstan near the anvil.

label: Talk to Denulth for a certificate
detail: Return to Denulth where the quest started to receive a certificate.

label: Exchange boots, certificate and iron bar for spiked boots
detail: Give Dunstan the climbing boots, certificate, and an iron bar to receive spiked boots (certificate only if already owned).

label: Give Tenzing 10 bread, 10 trout and spiked boots for the map
detail: Hand Tenzing 10 unnoted loaves of bread, 10 unnoted cooked trout, and the spiked boots all at once to get the map.

label: Follow the back route around the mountain
detail: Climb the stile north of Tenzing's house and follow the path east past the second mountain goat until 'I think this is far enough' appears (not the Death Plateau warning, which is safe to ignore).

label: Talk to Denulth with the combination to finish
detail: Report to Denulth with the combination in hand to complete the quest; it can be re-obtained free from Harold if lost.

label: Go to the house south of the anvil, Seers' Village
