detail: Head to the house immediately south of the anvil in Seers' Village.

label: Search the bookcase for a battered book
detail: Search the bookcase on the eastern wall to find a battered book.

label: Read the book, then slash it with a knife
detail: Read the battered book, then use a knife on it for a battered key; keep the now-slashed book, it is needed later.

label: Open the odd looking wall in the anvil building
detail: Use the battered key on the odd looking wall in the north of the anvil building to enter the workshop.

label: Go down the stairs into the workshop
detail: Descend the stairs to reach the underground Elemental Workshop.

label: Turn the water control east of the water wheel
detail: Set the eastern water control (in the north room).

label: Turn the water control west of the water wheel
detail: Set the western water control.

label: Pull the lever by the water wheel
detail: Start the water wheel.

label: Optional: kill one of each Elemental for Kandarin Easy
detail: Optionally fight one of each roaming Elemental type; for the Earth Elemental it must be an actual walking Elemental, not the rock that spawns one.

hints.value: optional side task for the Kandarin Easy Diary, not required for quest completion

label: Optional: search the crate for leather
detail: Search the crate north of the staircase in the middle room for leather.

hints.value: optional -- only needed if not already carrying leather

label: Optional: search the stacked crates for a needle
detail: Search the two stacked crates on the left of the west room entrance for a needle.

hints.value: optional -- only needed if not already carrying a needle

label: Fix the bellows with needle, thread and leather
detail: Use a needle, thread, and leather together to repair the bellows in the east room.

label: Pull the lever by the bellows
detail: Activate the repaired bellows.

label: Search the boxes for a stone bowl
detail: Search the boxes in the north-east of the middle room for a stone bowl.

label: Fill the stone bowl with lava
detail: Use the stone bowl on the lava trough in the south room.

label: Pour the lava into the furnace
detail: Use the bowl of lava on the furnace in the south room.

label: Mine the elemental rock in the west room
detail: Mine the elemental rock to make an Earth elemental spawn and attack.

label: Kill the Earth elemental for elemental ore
detail: Defeat the spawned Earth elemental and collect its elemental ore; grab 2 extra now if planning Elemental Workshop II or a Mind shield.

label: Smelt the ore and coal into elemental metal
detail: Use the elemental ore with 4 coal on the southern furnace to produce elemental metal.

label: Smith the elemental shield at the workbench
detail: With the slashed book in your inventory, use the elemental metal on the middle-room workbench to smith the elemental shield and finish the quest.

label: Talk to Trufitus north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai
detail: Agree to help Trufitus; each new herb must be shown to him before hunting the next.

label: Search the marshy vines south-west of the village
detail: Search the green-and-yellow marshy jungle vines south-west of Tai Bwo Wannai and clean the snake weed; take 3 if planning Legends' Quest and Zogre Flesh Eaters.

label: Show Trufitus the cleaned snake weed
detail: Return and confirm the snake weed is cleaned.

label: Search the palm trees north-east of Trufitus
detail: Search the palm trees near the Harpie Bug Swarms and clean the ardrigal; take 2 if planning Legends' Quest.

label: Show Trufitus the cleaned ardrigal
detail: Return and confirm the ardrigal is cleaned.

label: Search the scorched earth south of the village
detail: Search the ground next to the fire on the scorched earth patch and clean the sito foil.

label: Show Trufitus the cleaned sito foil
detail: Return and confirm the sito foil is cleaned.

label: Search the rocks at the Karamja Jungle mine
detail: Search the rocks at the mine south-east of Trufitus and clean the volencia moss; take 2 if planning Fairytale I - Growing Pains.

label: Show Trufitus the cleaned volencia moss
detail: Return and confirm the volencia moss is cleaned.

label: Enter the Pothole Dungeon north-west past the Harpie Bug Swarms
detail: Search the rocks over the cavern to enter the cave.

label: Search the glowing wall fungus, south inside the cave
detail: Search the green Fungus covered Cavern wall spots and clean the rogue's purse; it must come from the wall, not a Jogre kill, and take 2 if planning Zogre Flesh Eaters.

hints.value: killing a Jogre in this cave also completes an easy Karamja Diary task

label: Show Trufitus the rogue's purse to finish
detail: Return to Trufitus with the final herb to complete the quest.

label: Reach the top floor of the Watchtower
detail: Get to the top floor via another player's Watchtower portal (World 330 house party), the Nightmare Zone minigame teleport, or fairy ring CIQ then the trellis and ladder.

label: Talk to the Watchtower Wizard
detail: Ask the wizard what the matter is.

label: Search the far north-west bush for fingernails
detail: Climb down two ladders and search the bush in the far north-west corner.

label: Optional: kill a giant bat in Yanille dungeon for bat bones
detail: Only needed if not already carrying bat bones for the potion brewed later.

hints.value: optional -- skip if bat bones are already held

label: Talk to the Watchtower Wizard again
detail: Report back with the fingernails.

label: Talk to Og, north-west of Yanille, for Toban's key
detail: Ask Og for entrance to the city of ogres; reach him via fairy ring CIQ west, or a ring of dueling to Castle Wars then south and north-east.

label: Rope across to Jangerberry island
detail: Use a rope on the branch (not the trunk) of the long-branched tree west of the island.

label: Talk to Grew on Jangerberry island
detail: Convince Grew not to eat you and to help instead.

label: Enter the Tunnel to Toban, south of Gu'Tanoth
detail: Reach it via Feldip Hills teleport running north, fairy ring AKS, or ring of dueling to Castle Wars then south past Jiggig; a death rune lies near the hole if still needed.

label: Kill Gorad and take his tooth
detail: Defeat the level 68 Gorad; keep an inventory slot free or the tooth is lost.

label: Talk to Toban
detail: Offer to help Toban in exchange for entrance.

label: Give Toban dragon bones for relic part 3
detail: Talk to Toban again with dragon bones in your inventory.

label: Search the chest for Toban's stolen gold
detail: Search the chest and take a spare rope too if a second one is needed.

label: Talk to Grew again, take jangerberries if needed
detail: Return to Jangerberry island and collect jangerberries for the potion brewed later.

label: Go back and talk to Og
detail: Report back to Og with the relic pieces.

label: Talk to the Wizard to assemble the ogre relic
detail: Hand over all three relic pieces; the wizard combines them into the ogre relic, take a lit candle too if a light source is still needed.

label: Enter Gu'Tanoth via the north-east path
detail: Head west to the gate and show the ogre relic to the Ogre Guard for entry.

label: Buy a pestle and mortar and a vial from the Ogre merchant
detail: Buy both before stealing the rock cake below (27 coins combined).

label: Steal a rock cake from the market counter
detail: Steal from the counter on the south side of the central Gu'Tanoth market.

label: Talk to the guard at the battlement
detail: Climb around south to the battlement and speak to the guard there.

label: Talk to the guard again with the rock cake
detail: Show the guard the stolen rock cake.

label: Pay 20 coins to cross the bridge
detail: Try to jump the bridge north-east, then agree to pay the guards 20 coins instead.

label: Talk to a City guard about the skavid caves
detail: Ask a City guard for passage into the skavid caves.

label: Talk to a City guard again with a death rune
detail: Show a death rune to receive the skavid map.

label: Head to the Skavid caves north of the second gate
detail: Return through the north-west gate, walk east then turn south to the second city gate.

label: Talk to the scared skavid
detail: Reassure the scared skavid you mean no harm.

label: Answer the word-repeat puzzle in each of the 4 skavid caves
detail: Speak to the regular skavid in the caves east, north-east, north, and north-west of Gu'Tanoth (near the Yanille gate), answering Nod/Cur/Ar/Ig to their four prompts; the north-west cave also has a cave nightshade to grab.

label: Give the gold bar to the guard at the Eastern City gate
detail: Click the gate and hand over the gold bar for access.

label: Answer the Mad Skavid's 8-part word-repeat puzzle
detail: Cross the bridge into the cave and respond Gor/Cur/Tanath/Bidith/Cur/Nod/Ig/Ar to the Mad Skavid's paired prompts, in order.

label: Take a second cave nightshade
detail: Grab another nightshade in the same cave; world-hop if it has not respawned. Two total are needed.

label: Return to the Gu'Tanoth market
detail: Leave the way you entered, not down the hole.

label: Use nightshade on an Enclave guard
detail: Complete the dialogue fully, then enter the cave and watch the cutscene before teleporting or running out.

label: Talk to the Watchtower Wizard about the potion
detail: Fill a vial with water at the fountain outside the tower first if one is still needed.

label: Add guam leaf to the water vial
detail: Make a guam potion (unf) as the first ingredient.

label: Add jangerberries to the potion second
detail: Use (not eat) the jangerberries on the unfinished potion.

label: Add ground bat bones to the potion last
detail: Grind the bat bones with a pestle and mortar first, then use (not bury) them last, or the water evaporates.

label: Give the Wizard the finished potion
detail: Hand over the completed unfinished potion to receive the magic ogre potion.

label: Equip an anti-dragon shield before returning
detail: The Ogre Enclave has hostile ogres and a blue dragon.

label: Return to the Gu'Tanoth market square
detail: Head back to the market square to re-enter the Enclave.

label: Use nightshade on an Enclave guard to re-enter
detail: Show a nightshade to an Enclave guard again to access the cave.

label: Potion all 6 ogre shamans for the 3rd crystal
detail: Activate protect from melee before pouring, since the potion's pouring animation stalls you against nearby dragons and demons.

label: Mine the Rock of Dalgroth for the 4th crystal
detail: Right-click mine the rock in the centre of the Ogre Enclave.

label: Return all 4 crystals to the pillars
detail: Place NE magenta, SE grey, SW yellow, NW cyan; leave and re-enter the room if any crystal is still sitting on a pillar.

label: Pull the lever to the west to finish
detail: Pull the lever to complete Watchtower.

label: Talk to the guard outside Sinclair Mansion and agree to help.
detail: Approach the guard at the mansion's front gate and accept the investigation task to start the quest.

label: Take 4 flypapers from the sacks in the shed north-west of the mansion.
detail: Investigate the sacks in the shed to obtain the flypapers used later to lift fingerprints.

label: Take the pungent pot from inside the mansion.
detail: Search the mansion interior for the pot, later filled with flour for dusting prints.

label: Take the criminal's dagger from inside the mansion.
detail: Search the mansion interior for the murder weapon, whose print will be matched to a suspect.

label: Investigate the smashed east window for the criminal's thread.
detail: The thread snagged in the broken window is a colour clue that narrows which two suspects to search.

label: Search the thread-matched suspects' bedroom barrels for 2 silver items.
detail: Thread colour picks the suspect pair to search: red -> Bob and Carol, green -> Anna and David, blue -> Elizabeth and Frank. Only one pair is real for a given playthrough.

hints.value: red thread -> search Bob and Carol's barrels
green thread -> search Anna and David's barrels
blue thread -> search Elizabeth and Frank's barrels

label: Fill the pungent pot with flour from the kitchen barrel.
detail: The kitchen barrel supplies the flour needed alongside flypaper to dust fingerprints.

label: Dust the dagger and both silver items with flour and flypaper to reveal prints.
detail: Apply flour then flypaper to each of the three objects (the dagger and the two silver items) to lift a print from each.

label: Compare each silver item's print against the dagger's print until they match.
detail: Try each lifted print against the dagger's print in turn; the matching suspect is randomised per playthrough (one of Anna, Bob, Carol, David, Elizabeth, Frank).

until.state: a silver item's print matches the dagger's print, identifying the culprit

label: Talk to Gossip outside the mansion's front gate and ask who he suspects.
detail: Gossip offers a rumour on who he thinks is responsible for the murder.

label: Talk to the poison salesman in the Seers' Village pub and ask who bought poison.
detail: Select the Murder Mystery quest option (not Fremennik Trials) to learn who purchased poison at the house.

hints.value: salesman shares a dialogue option with the unrelated Fremennik Trials quest -- pick the Murder Mystery option

label: Talk to the print-matched suspect and ask why they bought poison.
detail: Confront the suspect identified by the fingerprint match from the earlier comparison.

label: Search the item the suspect claims they used the poison on.
detail: Which object to search depends on the matched suspect: Anna's compost heap, Bob's beehive in the cow pen, Frank's family crest east of the front door, David's spiders' nest upstairs, Carol's kitchen drain west of the front door, or Elizabeth's fountain. Only one applies for a given playthrough.

hints.value: Anna -> search the compost heap
Bob -> search the beehive in the cow pen
Frank -> search the family crest east of the front door
David -> search the spiders' nest upstairs
Carol -> search the kitchen drain west of the front door
Elizabeth -> search the fountain
no dedicated search/investigate verb in the enum; mapped to gather (object-interaction primitive), no tangible item produced -- confirms guilt as a quest-state change

label: Talk to a guard and report who is responsible to complete the quest.
detail: Deliver your conclusion to a guard, ending the investigation.

label: Ask Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle for a quest to receive an air talisman.
detail: Duke Horacio hands over an air talisman and sends the player to research it at the Wizards' Tower.

label: Give the air talisman to Archmage Sedridor in the Wizards' Tower basement.
detail: Sedridor takes the talisman for research and hands back a sealed research package to deliver to Aubury.

label: Give the research package to Aubury in the Varrock rune shop.
detail: Aubury examines the package and hands back research notes to carry to Sedridor.

label: Bring the research notes back to Archmage Sedridor to complete the quest.
detail: Sedridor reads the notes, explains the basics of Runecraft, and returns the (now researched) talisman, finishing the quest.

label: Speak with Ivy Sophista in Taverley to start the quest.
detail: Find Ivy Sophista in the building housing the crystal chest in Taverley and begin the conversation.

label: Climb the ladder east and speak with Thaerisk.
detail: Climb the nearby ladder to the east and speak with Thaerisk to learn two assassins are coming.

label: Defeat both assassins that ambush you.
detail: Pray Protect from Missiles; when an assassin shouts a warning and fires an arrow, swap to Protect from Melee right after it lands, then swap back.

hints.value: A known glitch can make the second assassin unattackable - let Thaerisk finish it, he cannot die in this fight.

label: Finish the conversation with Thaerisk.
detail: Wrap up the dialogue with Thaerisk to close out this chapter.

label: Travel to the Fight Arena north of Yanille.
detail: Head to the Fight Arena, just north of Yanille, to begin investigating Movario.

label: Charm or bribe the Khazard Launderer for information.
detail: Speak to the Khazard Launderer at the laundry house two buildings north of the Fight Arena Bar; use a ring of Charos(a) or pay 500 coins.

hints.value: 500 coins is only needed if you lack a ring of Charos(a).

label: Fairy-ring to Feldip Hills (code AKS) to find the Hunting Expert.
detail: Use fairy ring code AKS to reach Feldip Hills and locate the Hunting Expert.

label: Ask the Hunting Expert for a creature to track Movario.
detail: Speak with the Hunting Expert about a creature that can track down a person.

label: Set, bait, and dismantle a pit trap to catch a broav.
detail: Set up a pit trap west of the Hunting Expert and bait it, then dismantle it to receive an unconscious broav.

label: Have the Hunting Expert train the broav.
detail: Return the unconscious broav to the Hunting Expert so she can train it to track Movario.

label: Head to the run-down house in the battlefield with the broav.
detail: Bring the trained broav to the run-down house in the battlefield to find a broken table.

label: Use the dirty shirt on the broav to sniff out the hidden entrance.
detail: Drop the trained broav (not release), use a dirty shirt on it, and once it squeals, search the broken table.

label: Climb down into Movario's underground base.
detail: Climb down the trapdoor revealed by the broken table to enter Movario's base.

label: Search the open chest to the north-west for runes.
detail: Run north-west from the base entrance and search the open chest for a supply of runes.

label: Solve the rune-letter door puzzle and open it.
detail: Identify which letter in "PROHIBITED" is stylised as a rune symbol (varies per player) and use the matching rune on the door; a wrong rune deals 20+ damage but its blast colour reveals the right rune.

hints.value: Must be under a certain carry weight to open the door - unequip graceful or other weight-reducing gear.

label: Follow the illuminated wires between bookcases to kill the power.
detail: Search bookcases in sequence, each click revealing which bookcase to search next via glowing floor wires, until the electric gate deactivates.

label: Disable the trap on the spiral staircase and climb it.
detail: Open the now-deactivated gate, right-click search the spiral staircase to disable its trap, then climb up.

label: Search the desk for Movario's notes (volume 1).
detail: Search the desk to obtain Movario's notes (volume 1) and read all its pages; avoid the trapped treasure pile to the north-west.

hints.value: Do not interact with the nearby treasure pile - it deals 20+ damage.

label: Search the waste-paper basket by the desk for a ruby key.
detail: Pick up the waste-paper basket next to the desk and search it to find a ruby key.

label: Use the ruby key on the north-western bookcase.
detail: Use the ruby key on the bookcase against the west wall, in the north-western corner, to reveal the way upstairs.

label: Unlock and loot the bed chest for Movario's notes (volume 2).
detail: Search the bed, use the ruby key on the bed chest, search it again to disable its trap (else 18+ damage), then open it and read Movario's notes (volume 2).

label: Pull the lever behind the wall painting and cross the gap.
detail: Head back downstairs to the south side of the room, inspect the wall painting, pull its lever, and cross the broken wall it opens.

label: Search the drawers for notes on pressure.
detail: Search the drawers beyond the broken wall to obtain and read notes on pressure.

label: Solve the weight puzzle using the pressure gauge.
detail: Read the pressure gauge's tickit value, check your own weight in the Equipment Stats interface, then add or remove 1kg/2kg/5kg weights (placing extras on the statue, carrying a deficit) until your weight matches the gauge.

label: Exit Movario's base via the eastern door.
detail: Leave through the eastern door; the Elite Khazard Guards attack again on the way out.

label: Return both volumes of Movario's notes to Thaerisk.
detail: Bring Movario's notes (volume 1) and (volume 2) back to Thaerisk in Taverley.

label: Fairy-ring to McGrubor's Wood (code ALS).
detail: Use fairy ring code ALS to travel to McGrubor's Wood.

label: Reach the building past the loose railing for a cutscene.
detail: Head east past the loose railing to the building and trigger the cutscene there.

label: Defeat the mercenaries guarding Idria.
detail: Fight off the mercenaries at the building near McGrubor's Wood to free Idria.

label: Speak to Idria once the mercenaries are defeated.
detail: Talk to Idria after clearing the mercenaries to continue the storyline.

label: Head to White Knights' Castle.
detail: Travel to White Knights' Castle in Falador.

label: Speak to Akrisae until he gives you a teleorb.
detail: Find Akrisae on the ground floor to the east of White Knights' Castle and talk with him until he hands over a teleorb.

label: Accept a one-time teleport to Draynor Village from Akrisae.
detail: Speak to Akrisae again and accept his offer of a one-time teleport to Draynor Village.

label: Plant the teleorb on a shady stranger in Draynor.
detail: Use the teleorb on any shady stranger near Diango's Toy Store, just south of it, in Draynor Village.

label: Report back to Akrisae after planting the teleorb.
detail: Return to White Knights' Castle and speak to Akrisae once the teleorb is planted.

label: Get the snapdragon seed from Thaerisk before teleporting.
detail: After the cutscene, finish talking with Thaerisk and be sure to ask for his snapdragon seed before accepting his teleport to Port Sarim.

hints.value: Requesting the seed before accepting the teleport is easy to miss.

label: Buy a pink dye from Betty at her Magic Emporium.
detail: Head west to Betty's Magic Emporium in Port Sarim and buy a pink dye for 20 coins.

label: Dye the lantern lens rose-tinted.
detail: Use the pink dye on your lantern lens to create a rose-tinted lens.

label: Ask Betty to help enrich the snapdragon seed.
detail: Speak to Betty again about enriching the snapdragon seed with the rose-tinted lens.

label: Enrich the snapdragon seed on the shop counter.
detail: Stand in the shop doorway, use the rose-tinted lens on the counter to enrich the seed, then take the enriched seed from the counter.

label: Travel to Falador Castle and climb to the top.
detail: Head back to Falador and climb the westernmost stairs of the castle all the way up.

label: Plant the enriched snapdragon seed in the special patch.
detail: Plant the enriched snapdragon seed in the special patch atop Falador Castle.

label: Speak to Idria to begin rallying allies against Lucien.
detail: Talk to Idria to kick off the ally-gathering phase.

label: Cast NPC Contact (or visit) to ask Turael about Lucien.
detail: Cast NPC Contact and choose the Lucien-related option with Turael, or visit him in person.

hints.value: NPC Contact has no dedicated primitive; mapped to talk-to.

label: Cast NPC Contact (or visit) to ask Mazchna about Lucien.
detail: Cast NPC Contact and choose the Lucien-related option with Mazchna, or visit him in person.

hints.value: NPC Contact has no dedicated primitive; mapped to talk-to.

label: Cast NPC Contact to ask Cyrisus about Lucien.
detail: Cast NPC Contact and choose the Lucien-related option with Cyrisus; he cannot be visited in person for this.

hints.value: NPC Contact has no dedicated primitive; mapped to talk-to.

label: Cast NPC Contact (or visit) to ask Duradel about Lucien.
detail: Cast NPC Contact and choose the Lucien-related option with Duradel, or visit him in person.

hints.value: NPC Contact has no dedicated primitive; mapped to talk-to.

label: Harvest the enriched snapdragon at White Knights' Castle.
detail: Return to White Knights' Castle and harvest the fully-grown enriched snapdragon.

label: Get truth serum from Thaerisk.
detail: Speak to Thaerisk to receive some truth serum.

label: Combine the enriched snapdragon with the truth serum.
detail: Use the harvested enriched snapdragon on the truth serum to make a super truth serum.

label: Get charcoal and papyrus from the drawers by the jail cell.
detail: Search the drawers just south of the jail cell for charcoal and papyrus.

label: Interrogate the captured shady stranger with super truth serum.
detail: Enter the jail cell and use the super truth serum on the shady stranger to produce a suspect sketch.

label: Give the suspect sketch to Idria.
detail: Exit the jail cell and hand the suspect sketch over to Idria.

label: Head to the Warriors' Guild.
detail: Travel to the Warriors' Guild to recruit its members.

label: Recruit Ghommal by asking about Lucien.
detail: Speak to Ghommal, found near the guild's entrance, and ask about Lucien.

label: Recruit Harrallak Menarous by asking about Lucien.
detail: Speak to Harrallak Menarous, also near the guild's entrance, and ask about Lucien.

label: Recruit Sloane by asking about Lucien.
detail: Find Sloane one floor up through the heavy door to the north-east and ask about Lucien.

label: Optionally buy a Black Knights' Fortress disguise.
detail: If you lack a disguise for the Black Knights' Fortress, buy a bronze med helm and iron chainbody from the Warriors' Guild Armoury upstairs.

hints.value: Optional - skip if you already own a disguise or full black armour set.

label: Watch the Hazelmere cutscene and teleport to the Fortress.
detail: Return to Akrisae at White Knights' Castle, watch the cutscene with Hazelmere, then accept his teleport to the Black Knights' Fortress.

hints.value: If the teleport is missed, Mind Altar Teleport, combat bracelet to Edgeville Monastery, or Lassar Teleport all reach the Fortress too.

label: Equip your disguise for the Black Knights' Fortress.
detail: Wear the bronze med helm and iron chainbody, or a full black armour set, to disguise yourself.

label: Push through the hidden wall and descend the ladder.
detail: Push the hidden wall directly ahead, then climb down the ladder behind it.

label: Charge-orb the carved tile to open the trapdoor.
detail: Head to the tiled flooring south, inspect the orb-symbol carved tile, and cast a charged orb spell on it to reveal the trapdoor to the Black Knight Catacombs.

label: Cross the broken bridge under Protect from Missiles.
detail: Head immediately north to the western broken bridge, pray Protect from Missiles, and jump across.

label: Farm Elite Black Knights for a full elite black armour set.
detail: Pray Protect from Melee and repeatedly kill the Elite Black Knight (accompanied by Elite Dark Warriors) until you own a full set of elite black armour.

label: Wear the elite black armour and climb to the second level.
detail: Equip the elite black armour set, then run to the north-east path and climb the wall up to the second level.

label: Find the shortcut door and enter the Dark Squall's base.
detail: Head north around the barricades to two solid doors; use the western one to unlock a shortcut back to the Catacombs' exit, then enter the northern door.

label: Search the north wardrobe for a spare elite black armour set.
detail: Search the wardrobe north of the entrance for a second elite black armour set to give Silif.

label: Search the south wardrobe for the Dark Squall's robes.
detail: Search the wardrobe south of the room for the Dark Squall's robes.

label: Take the lobster, restore potion, and desk items from the table.
detail: Search the table for a lobster and restore potion; also grab the strange teleorb, a death rune, and a law rune from the desks if you have space.

hints.value: The teleorb/death rune/law rune can be collected later on the return trip if inventory space is tight.

label: Search the key rack for a cell key.
detail: Search the key rack on the north wall for a cell key.

label: Unlock Silif's cell with the cell key.
detail: Take the long eastern path back and use the cell key to open the gate to Silif's cell.

label: Revive Silif with food and a restore potion.
detail: Use the lobster (or any food) and the restore potion on Silif to revive him.

label: Give Silif the spare elite black armour.
detail: Talk to Silif until you hand over the spare elite black armour; you can swap into the Dark Squall's robes yourself now if needed.

label: Head back to the Dark Squall's inner base with Silif.
detail: With Silif following you, return to the Dark Squall's inner base.

label: Get a teleorb from Silif at the map board.
detail: Go to the map board south-east of the entrance; finishing the conversation with Silif there grants a teleorb.

label: Equip the Dark Squall's robes and climb up to face Surok.
detail: Equip the Dark Squall's robes, then climb the ladder on the eastern side of the room to prepare for the boss fight.

label: Defeat Surok Magis with Magic.
detail: Fight Surok Magis (450 HP, Magic-only - other styles fail): Bind his Agile Warrior summon and Weaken his Strong Warrior summon, telegrab and alch his explosive orbs before they detonate, and cast the opposite element back at his elemental surges (air-earth, water-fire); pray Protect from Magic and bring food for chip damage.

label: Plant the orb on the defeated Surok.
detail: Once Surok is defeated, plant the unpowered orb on his body.

label: Return to Akrisae after defeating Surok.
detail: Finish the conversation, then head back to Akrisae at White Knights' Castle.

label: Collect the strange teleorb and runes if not taken earlier.
detail: Wear the Dark Squall's robes, enter the jail cell, and take the strange teleorb, death rune, and law rune from the desks if you skipped them before.

label: Teleport to Lucien's camp with the strange teleorb.
detail: Stand in the magic circle in the middle of the room and activate the strange teleorb.

label: Cross the ice wall to reach the Chaos Temple roof.
detail: Follow the north-east path across from the Chaos Temple, climb the ice wall, and jump to the ledge (this does not enter the Wilderness, items stay safe).

label: Trigger the roof cutscene and return to White Knights' Castle.
detail: Walk to the eastern side of the Chaos Temple's roof to view the cutscene, then head back to White Knights' Castle.

label: Talk to Idria to begin the descent into the Chasm.
detail: Speak to Idria to start the final approach to the Chasm of Tears.

label: Speak to Movario at the Chasm of Tears in the Dark Squall's robes.
detail: Head to the Chasm of Tears and speak to Movario while wearing the Dark Squall's robes.

label: Use a lit sapphire lantern on a light creature to descend.
detail: Use a lit sapphire lantern on a light creature near the chasm to be transported down into it.

label: Search the skeletal remains for basic tools.
detail: Search the nearby skeletal remains to obtain a spade, a hammer, and a chisel.

label: Uncover and chisel the first brazier for a fire orb.
detail: Use the spade on the pile of rocks to uncover a brazier, then chisel it for a fire orb.

label: Uncover and chisel the western brazier for an earth orb.
detail: Head further west and repeat the spade-then-chisel process on the lone pile of rocks for an earth orb.

label: Chisel the southern brazier for an air orb.
detail: Head directly south and use the chisel on the intact brazier there for an air orb.

label: Chisel the eastern brazier for a water orb.
detail: Head east and use the chisel on the intact brazier there for a water orb.

label: Use the elemental orbs on the recessed blocks by each cavity.
detail: At the three skull cavities south, use three of the four orbs on the recessed blocks by each entrance, then climb up near the centre skull to use the last orb on the fourth recessed block.

label: Solve the elemental-block mechanism inside each skull cavity.
detail: Unequip weapon and shield, crawl into each skull nose cavity to its end, and use the correct elemental block on the mechanism inside, matching the symbols shown (positions vary per player).

label: Use the fire block on the fourth skull's recessed block.
detail: Climb back up to the fourth skull and use the fire elemental block on its recessed block.

label: Enter the cave opening revealed in the skull.
detail: Inspect the stone cube and enter the cave opening in the skull, dropping your tools first if you need the space.

label: Search the skeleton for a silver sickle (b) and druid pouches.
detail: In the central chamber, search the skeleton to receive a silver sickle (b) and six druid pouches.

label: Collect herblore ingredients from druid spirits along the paths.
detail: Use the druid pouches on the druid spirits along the forked paths to receive herblore ingredients for the statues; recharge pouches by casting Bloom on nearby vines (using the silver sickle (b)) if you run low.

label: Match herblore ingredients to each statue's keyword.
detail: Examine each of the (up to 8 of 13 possible, varies per player) statues and use its matching herblore ingredients per the keyword table (e.g. Attack = guam leaf + eye of newt, Defence = ranarr weed + white berries); a wrong combination can be retried after teleporting out and back via Tears of Guthix.

label: Use all eight dolmens on the stone table to open the huge door.
detail: Once you have collected all eight dolmens from the statues, use them (one at a time if needed) on the stone table to open the huge door.

label: Bank the Dark Squall's robes and gear up for the final fights.
detail: Leave the temple, bank the Dark Squall's robes, and equip your best gear for all three combat styles plus 3-4 super restores, a Menaphite remedy, 10-12 combo food, a sapphire lantern, and an emergency teleport (not runes).

label: Use the lit sapphire lantern on a light creature to re-enter the chasm.
detail: Use a lit sapphire lantern on a light creature to descend into the chasm once more.

label: Proceed past the huge door to the Mysterious Stone.
detail: Walk through the now-open huge door until you reach the Mysterious Stone.

label: Defeat the Balance Elemental.
detail: Pray against its current style (Fiery/Orange=Ranged, Airy/White=Melee, Watery/Blue=Magic); it prays against your own style from 50% hp and attacks faster with double prayers at 25%, draining stats every 3-4 hits - drink restores or a pre-fight Menaphite remedy dose, and consider a pillar for safe exchanges at 25% hp.

hints.value: Dying here respawns your grave at the top of the chasm at Tears of Guthix, not in the fight room.

label: Search the Mysterious Stone again to trigger the next cutscene.
detail: After defeating the Balance Elemental, search the Mysterious Stone again.

label: Defeat the two Tormented Demons alongside the Guardians of Armadyl.
detail: Fight both Tormented Demons; they switch protection prayers and attack styles roughly every 16 seconds, but sitting behind the south-western column and letting the Guardians of Armadyl finish them off removes combat entirely (slow, but safe).

label: Have Idria teleport you back to White Knights' Castle.
detail: Speak to Idria to be teleported back to White Knights' Castle.

label: Speak to Idria again to complete the quest.
detail: Talk to Idria once more at White Knights' Castle to finish While Guthix Sleeps.

label: Accept the quest from Burntmeat in the Troll Stronghold kitchen.
detail: Burntmeat is down the stairs after entering the Stronghold; accepting starts the quest.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Tell My Arm on the Stronghold roof that you'll travel to Weiss by sea.
detail: My Arm waits by the herb patch on the roof, reached via the west ladder or an Agility shortcut.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Fairy-ring to code DKS to reach the coastline near Rellekka.
detail: The transport spot Larry uses is on the coast to the north, east of Rellekka.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Walk to the transport symbol on the coast and ask Larry to ferry My Arm.
detail: Larry needs convincing that My Arm is trustworthy despite being a troll.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Talk to Larry a second time to confirm passage.
detail: The exact dialogue options differ depending on whether the player still has an earlier quest's clockwork book.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Board Larry's boat to sail to Weiss.
detail: Boarding starts the voyage to Weiss and ends with the boat wrecking on arrival.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Search the wrecked boat for a rope if you don't already have one.
detail: The wrecked boat also has a pickaxe available nearby for the mining ahead.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Mine the blocked cave entrance without using any Mining boost yet.
detail: Save any stat boost for the harder mining check at the cave exit later.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Climb the rockslides, rope across the tree ledge, and pass the fallen tree to reach Boulder.
detail: Boost Agility to 68 first if the level isn't met naturally.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Tell Boulder that Wolfbone sent My Arm from the Troll Stronghold.
detail: Boulder lets the pair through toward the walled troll city.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Slip through the broken fence and run south then west along the city's edge to the alleyway, recovering run energy as needed.
detail: This begins the stealth run past a large number of hostile trolls inside the walled city.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Reach the checkpoint at the narrow gap in the fence before climbing the ramp.
detail: Passing this gap without stopping sets a checkpoint that respawns you here if a troll catches you later; stopping short of it or climbing the ramp fails the sneak and ejects you outside the city.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Empty your hands and swim past the first set of trolls, dodging their thrown stones.
detail: An empty inventory avoids losing items if a stone hits.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Step onto the second troll group's thrown stones as they land, forming a path of 5 stones across the water.
detail: Move one tile forward as each stone lands; a miss sends you back to just before this troll group and the path must be restarted.

until.state: a continuous 5-stone path reaches the far edge

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Mine the cave exit, boosting Mining to 72 if the level isn't met naturally.
detail: Clearing this exit leads into Weiss proper and Mother's chamber.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Talk to Mother and let the introductory conversation play out.
detail: This is the first meeting between My Arm's group and Mother, Snowflake's guardian.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: After Snowflake leaves, reassure Odd Mushroom by picking every offered talking point.
detail: All of the offered responses in this conversation are worth selecting, in own words rather than quoted.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Debrief with My Arm about Mother, Snowflake, and the Odd Mushroom.
detail: Wraps up the party's reaction to the tense first meeting before heading to Draynor.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Ask the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village to fake his death for My Arm's sake.
detail: This begins the plan to trick Mother using a staged funeral.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Build a coffin next to the Wise Old Man using a hammer, saw, mahogany planks and a bolt of cloth.
detail: The hammer and saw are tools, not consumed; the coffin itself is picked up later after the Apothecary is consulted.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Ask the Apothecary in Varrock about Making Friends with My Arm.
detail: The Apothecary supplies whatever is needed to convincingly fake the Wise Old Man's death.

hints.value: chat options here vary by which other quests are completed -- pick the Making Friends with My Arm topic specifically

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Return to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village once the Apothecary has helped.
detail: This finalises the fake-death setup ahead of taking the coffin.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Take the Old man's coffin.
detail: The finished, occupied coffin is the prop used to convince Mother the Wise Old Man has died.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Sail back to Weiss on Larry's boat and enter the cave.
detail: Returns the party to the entrance used earlier in the quest.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Meet My Arm at Weiss's north entrance with the coffin.
detail: Regroups the party before entering Mother's territory with the fake-death prop.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Reassure Odd Mushroom that you won't leave.
detail: Odd Mushroom is nervous ahead of the coming fight.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Talk to Snowflake and accept the risk of being unable to teleport and possibly losing items.
detail: Confirms entry into the instanced fight area ahead.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Defeat Don't Know What using Protect from Missiles with melee or Ranged damage.
detail: The fight is instanced; food and potions help since attacks can hit through Prayer.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Grab a bucket from the pile near Mother's chamber.
detail: The bucket is needed to douse Mother's protective fire before the fight can be won.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Fill the bucket from the large barrel of water.
detail: Produces the bucket of water used to extinguish the Fire of Domination.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Douse the Fire of Domination with the bucket of water to make Mother vulnerable.
detail: Extinguishing the fire is required before damage to Mother becomes effective.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Fight Mother with Protect from Missiles active, favouring Ranged while kiting away from her melee stun.
detail: Mother can stun and drain Prayer at melee range; she can also be safespotted east of the staircase, standing in the western-most square just south of the stairs.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Talk to My Arm after defeating Mother.
detail: Moves the story into the aftermath of the fight and toward naming a new troll leader.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Talk to the Wise Old Man about the plan for a new troll leader.
detail: Sets up the final errand needed to close out the quest.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Talk to Snowflake, who asks about goat dung.
detail: Snowflake needs goat dung for the final part of the plan.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Pick up goat dung in the north-east building.
detail: Buckets of water found in the same building can be emptied if one is needed elsewhere.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Bring the goat dung back to Snowflake.
detail: Delivers the item Snowflake asked for.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Read the Weiss fire notes Snowflake gives you.
detail: The notes contain Weiss's closely-guarded fire-making secrets, the quest's central prize.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Talk to Snowflake once more to complete the quest.
detail: This final conversation finishes Making Friends with My Arm.

refs.title: Making Friends with My Arm/Quick guide

label: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the Burgh de Rott pub basement.
detail: Veliaf explains the Sanguinesti region and how to search for the Myreque there, starting the quest.

label: Go south-east to the docks and find the hut with the wrecked boat.
detail: The hut sits at the docks near Burgh de Rott.

label: Repair the boat and its chute using both planks and the nails.
detail: One plank patches the boat, the other the chute; a hammer is needed as a tool but isn't consumed.

label: Push the repaired boat down the chute and board it to sail to Meiyerditch.
detail: Boarding starts the crossing into Morytania's vampyre-ruled city.

hints.value: while in Meiyerditch, logging out avoids further interaction if a Vyrewatch provokes the player

label: Search the pier floor, kick it open, and climb down into Meiyerditch.
detail: Still on the pier, a short walk north-west finds the loose floorboard.

label: Climb over the wall rubble and ask a Meiyerditch citizen about the Myreque.
detail: Any citizen in the streets can point toward Old Man Ral.

label: Talk to Old Man Ral to the north for help reaching the Myreque.
detail: Ral points the way to the hideout entrance.

label: Climb the ladder in the building south-west of Old Man Ral to start the agility course.
detail: This ladder is the entrance to the sickle-logo agility course.

label: Jump the floorboards, push the walls, and crawl under the gaps through sector one to the first ladder down.
detail: A continuous run of floorboard jumps and wall-pushes across two rooms.

label: Search the table's trapdoor and climb through it, then work the shelf and crawl-under to the eastern ladder.
detail: Continues the course toward the room with the eastern door.

label: Search the pots near the eastern door for a door key.
detail: The key is needed to pass through the locked eastern door.

label: Use the door key to open the eastern door.
detail: Opens the way into the next room of the course.

label: Climb up through the eastern room, cross the washing line, and work the shelves and floorboards north to the ladder wall.
detail: A long stretch of the course through multiple rooms and levels.

label: Search the western wall for a ladder top.
detail: The ladder top is needed to fix a broken ladder ahead.

label: Repair the broken ladder with the ladder top and climb down into sector three.
detail: This is the transition point into the course's final sector.

label: Climb the ladder in the fireplace house to pick up a knife, if you don't already have one.
detail: The knife is needed twice more in this quest, so grabbing it here saves a return trip.

label: Work through sector three's houses and past the barricade toward the sickle logo near the stairs.
detail: Continues the traversal toward the hideout's trapdoor.

label: Search the wall by the stairs, slash it with the knife, then push it open.
detail: The knife is a tool here, not consumed.

label: Press the decorated wall to the north, open the lumpy rug's south-east square, and climb down into the Myreque Hideout.
detail: This is the final hidden entrance into Vertida's hideout, ending the agility course.

label: Run north and talk to Vertida Sefalatis to receive her note.
detail: Double-check the quest log updated after this conversation, or the entire agility course must be repeated.

hints.value: a specific chat option is required to actually receive the note -- verify the quest log advanced before leaving, or the whole agility course must be re-run

label: Travel back to Burgh de Rott.
detail: Returns to the surface Myreque contact point.

label: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the pub basement to hand over Vertida's note.
detail: Advances the plot toward the next errand.

label: Fairy-ring to code CKS to reach the Paterdomus Temple.
detail: Fastest route to Paterdomus for the meeting with Drezel.

label: Talk to Drezel underneath Paterdomus.
detail: Drezel sends the player out toward a bush to trigger a cutscene.

label: Take the west exit past the monuments to a bush south-west of the temple steps and search it.
detail: With 65 Agility, a shortcut toward Canifis up the side of the temple can be used instead.

hints.value: 65 Agility -> take the Canifis-side shortcut up the temple wall instead of the west exit

label: Wait for the cutscene to finish, then return to Drezel for Varrock Teleport runes.
detail: Drezel rewards the search with teleport runes for the next leg.

label: Teleport or travel to Varrock.
detail: Heads to the palace to speak with King Roald.

label: Talk to King Roald in the Varrock palace and ask about Morytania.
detail: The right question prompts the king to teleport the player back to Paterdomus directly.

label: Travel back to Burgh de Rott and talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the pub basement.
detail: Closes out the Urgent business errand loop.

label: Return to Meiyerditch and speak to a Vyrewatch to be sent to the mines.
detail: Starts the return trip into Meiyerditch for the castle-wall infiltration.

label: Talk to a Meiyerditch miner to get a pickaxe if you don't already have one.
detail: The pickaxe is needed to mine daeyalt ore in the mines.

label: Mine the daeyalt rocks on the walls until you have 15 daeyalt ore.
detail: Requires the Mining level for this quest.

label: Use all 15 daeyalt ore on the mine cart, then talk to a Vampyre Juvinate.
detail: The Juvinate transports the ore and opens the way onward.

label: Follow the marked blue path north to south to the Myreque Hideout, then climb down and enter.
detail: Passes through 3 doors and a ladder, then floorboards and stairs into the hideout.

label: Talk to Vertida and agree to be led onward.
detail: Vertida leads the way back out toward the castle wall.

label: Climb out of the hideout and retrace the route back to the wall rubble at the Meiyerditch entrance.
detail: Runs south and climbs over the same rubble used to first enter Meiyerditch.

label: Search the rocky surface, then push north through the barricade and climb the ladders toward the castle wall.
detail: A chain of climbs leads up onto the castle wall itself.

label: Run west along the wall and talk to Safalaan, making sure you have 4 free inventory spaces.
detail: Free inventory space is required for the sketches taken during the wall walk.

label: Use papyrus on charcoal at the north sickle logo for the first castle sketch.
detail: Continue running clockwise along the wall to find the marked sickle logo.

label: Run counter-clockwise to the west sickle logo and repeat for the second castle sketch.
detail: Same papyrus-and-charcoal action at the second marked spot.

label: Activate Protect from Melee as the cutscene begins at the south sickle logo.
detail: Prayer activated before the cutscene starts deactivates once Vanstrom Klause attacks, so timing it right at the cutscene's start avoids damage.

label: Wait out the cutscene, then let Vanstrom Klause attack you 5 times to be knocked out.
detail: Vanstrom scripts 5 hits during the sketch cutscenes; surviving them is all that's required, no combat kill needed.

label: Return and finish the final castle sketch at the south sickle logo.
detail: Completes the third and last of the wall sketches.

label: Talk to Sarius Guile if she doesn't automatically speak to you after being knocked out.
detail: A fallback trigger for the post-Vanstrom cutscene dialogue.

label: Speak to a nearby Vyrewatch and use the mine technique to get back to base.
detail: Reuses the mine-cart trick from earlier to return underground.

label: Use your knife on the fireplace in the house south-west of the hideout ladder for a message.
detail: A knife spawn is available upstairs in that house if the earlier one wasn't kept.

label: Use your knife on the portrait on the house's south wall for a large ornate key.
detail: If the key isn't obtained automatically, inspecting the portrait again should produce it.

label: Return to the Myreque Hideout and give Safalaan the fireplace message.
detail: Delivers the recovered message, advancing the plot toward the hidden lab.

label: Exit the base, climb the stairs, jump the gap, and climb down the ladder.
detail: Leaves the hideout heading toward the mine district.

label: Travel north toward the mine to find the red-and-yellow tapestry building against the Eastern city wall.
detail: The tapestry marks the hidden entrance to the vampyre laboratory.

label: Slash the tapestry with your knife, walk through it, and use the large ornate key on the statue.
detail: Reveals the hidden passage down into the laboratory.

label: Open the door, climb down the staircase, and use Telekinetic Grab on Haemalchemy volume 1.
detail: Runes for Telekinetic Grab can be found in the Broken rune case nearby if needed.

label: Return to the base and give Safalaan Haemalchemy volume 1.
detail: The alchemy tome is the key discovery of this leg of the quest.

label: Travel back to Burgh de Rott.
detail: Final leg before completing the quest.

label: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the pub basement with a message for Safalaan to complete the quest.
detail: Delivering this final message finishes Darkness of Hallowvale.

label: Talk to Elias White at the Jolly Boar Inn
detail: Speak with Elias White inside the inn to begin the investigation.

hints.value: Yes.

label: Follow the forest trail inspecting rocks, plants and bushes
detail: Follow the trail west then south then east then north, inspecting each marked rock, plant or bush in sequence; the eastern spiny bush yields a grubby key.

label: Find the trapdoor at the end of the northern trail
detail: Run past the end of the northern trail to uncover a hidden trapdoor into the dungeon.

label: Finish the dialogue with Elias upon entering the dungeon
detail: Continue speaking with Elias after entering to proceed further in.

hints.value: Let's do it.

label: Head north then look east over the balcony
detail: Run north to the end of the corridor, then look east over the balcony to trigger a cutscene.

label: Pick up three bottles after the cutscene
detail: Run west after the cutscene and collect three empty bottles.

label: Kill three armoured zombies and bottle their red mist
detail: Kill three armoured zombies, using an empty bottle on the red mist each leaves behind.

label: Open the west door to find Arrav
detail: After collecting three bottles of red mist, open the west door to encounter Arrav.

label: Head north through the corridor once Arrav leaves
detail: Continue north through the corridor after Arrav departs.

label: Kill three more armoured zombies and bottle their red mist
detail: Kill three additional armoured zombies for red mist, same bottling process as before; this is the last safe point before entering the shared instance zone.

hints.value: Quick guide only describes picking up 3 bottles once but bottles 6 zombies total (3+3) -- second-batch bottle sourcing is unstated, not fabricated here.

label: Open the east door and look south over the balcony
detail: Run further east to the end of the corridor, then look south over the balcony; leave the dungeon after the cutscene.

label: Report your findings to Elias at Varrock Palace
detail: Speak to Elias at Varrock Palace to report what was found in the dungeon.

label: Head to the Ruins of Camdozaal
detail: Travel to the Ruins of Camdozaal after finishing the conversation with Captain Rovin.

label: Ask Ramarno at the Sacred Forge about a shield
detail: Speak to Ramarno near the Sacred Forge; if he isn't there, find him at the ruins' big door shortly after entering.

hints.value: I need your help with a shield.
chat option number (2/3/4) varies with prior quest completion

label: Kill Chaos Golems for a chaos core drop
detail: Kill Chaos Golems in the south-eastern end of the ruins; chaos cores drop at roughly 2/15.

label: Mine a barronite deposit at the Camdozaal Mines
detail: Mine barronite rocks just west of the Sacred Forge; deposits drop at roughly 24% per rock (a bronze pickaxe is available from a nearby barrel).

label: Use the chaos core on the barronite deposit
detail: Combine the chaos core with the barronite deposit to imbue it.

label: Use the imbued barronite on the Sacred Forge
detail: Forge the imbued barronite at the Sacred Forge to produce the next quest item.

hints.value: the fetched Quick guide never names the forge's output item explicitly; held quest_db row calls it a barronite ore but that text is not wiki-sourced here

label: Head to Varrock Palace
detail: Travel to Varrock Palace to continue the investigation.

label: Speak to Captain Rovin for the Shield of Arrav
detail: Find Captain Rovin two flights up the north-western staircase to receive the Shield of Arrav.

label: Head to the Varrock Palace library
detail: Travel to the library within Varrock Palace.

label: Speak to Reldo
detail: Talk to Reldo in the library.

label: Search the scrolls and read the List of Elders and Varrock Census
detail: Search the scrolls by the flipped table in the north-east corner, then read the List of Elders and the Varrock Census just west of the scrolls.

label: Question suspect NPCs until one mentions the Fitzharmon family
detail: Speak to each of six named Varrock NPCs (finishing each dialogue fully) until one of them mentions the Fitzharmon family; which NPC holds the clue varies by playthrough.

hints.value: wiki's own map desc= labels for Sir Prysin/Romeo/Horvik give fuller names (Enhtor Prysin/Romeo Gontamue/Horvik Ravitz) than the bullet's wikilink text -- treated as the same NPCs

mapMarkers.label: Aeonisig Raispher, Varrock Palace throne room
King Roald, Varrock Palace throne room

label: Head to south-east Varrock
detail: Travel to the gated area in south-east Varrock (the Rat Pits minigame teleport is a convenient shortcut).

label: Confront Dimintheis
detail: Speak to Dimintheis in the gated area to trigger the finale cutscene.

hints.value: I need your help with the zombie invasion.

label: Finish the dialogue with Captain Rovin
detail: Watch the cutscene and complete the closing conversation with Captain Rovin to finish the quest.

label: Talk to the Odd Old Man to start
detail: Speak to the Odd Old Man, found north of the Digsite and north of the Limestone mine.

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man II/Quick guide

label: Kill each of the 27 quest-specific monsters for their bones
detail: Kill one of each listed species (bats, undead cows, experiments, werewolves, ghouls, zombies, moss giants, cave goblins, jackals, desert lizards, vultures, seagulls, ice giants, mogres, snakes, jogres, baby blue dragons, trolls, rabbits, basilisks, dagannoths, fire giants, terrorbirds, wolves, ogres and zogres) to collect one named bone/rib/wing/spine per species; basilisks need 40 Slayer plus a mirror shield (or a poison/recoil-ring or safespot alternative). Full per-species drop notes and preferred locations are in the cited Quick guide table.

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man II/Quick guide

label: Buy 27 jugs of vinegar from Fortunato
detail: Buy 27 jugs of vinegar from Fortunato in the Draynor marketplace.

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man II/Quick guide

label: Make 27 pots of vinegar
detail: Use every jug of vinegar with a pot to make 27 pots of vinegar.

hints.value: pot sourcing itself is not stated in the fetched Quick guide text; modelled as a pre-existing/bought item

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man II/Quick guide

label: Steep all 27 bones in vinegar
detail: Use each collected bone with a pot of vinegar to make 27 bones in vinegar.

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man II/Quick guide

label: Withdraw a tinderbox and logs (or an axe)
detail: Withdraw a tinderbox and either logs or an axe; nearby trees can be cut for logs if needed (one set of logs is used per bone in vinegar).

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man II/Quick guide

label: Return to the Odd Old Man
detail: Head back to the Odd Old Man and talk to him to begin the boiling process.

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man II/Quick guide

label: Boil each bone in vinegar on the pot-boiler
detail: For every bone in vinegar: place a set of logs on the pot-boiler, use the bone in vinegar with the pot-boiler, light the logs with a tinderbox, then wait about 12 seconds (or hop worlds) for the fire to burn out before removing the pot.

hints.value: the fetched Quick guide never names the finished polished-bone item

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man II/Quick guide

label: Talk to the Odd Old Man to finish
detail: Speak to the Odd Old Man once more to complete the quest.

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man II/Quick guide

label: Talk to Launa by the rift
detail: Speak with Launa, found north-east of Varrock near the Digsite by the rift.

hints.value: Would you like me to go down and look for your husband and son?

label: Enter the rift with a rope
detail: Enter the rift using a rope to begin the instanced dungeon; do not click outside the dialogue boxes during the entry cutscene or you will return to the surface.

label: Fill the rage bar using the four themed weapons
detail: Use the anger sword on angry unicorns, the anger spear on angry bears, the anger mace on angry giant rats, and the anger battleaxe on angry goblins from the room's rack until the rage bar is full (logging out resets the bar); filling it grants 40 Attack experience.

label: Head east to the next cave
detail: Move east into the next chamber after the rage-bar cutscene.

label: Search holes clockwise for fear reapers
detail: Look inside the dark holes going clockwise (a searched hole cannot be searched again) and kill 5 or 6 fear reapers to trigger the room's cutscene.

label: Enter the black hole to the west
detail: Move west through the black hole once enough fear reapers are defeated.

label: Defeat confusion beasts until one door remains
detail: Attack confusion beasts to tell the real one (takes damage) from the fakes (which give combat xp on missed hits and vanish after 8 hits); disengage by running to the opposite end of the room if needed, and repeat until only one door remains.

label: Enter the remaining door
detail: Move through the one door left open after the confusion beasts are cleared.

label: Kill every hopeless creature three times each
detail: Defeat each hopeless creature in the room three times.

label: Cross the bridge toward Tolna
detail: Cross the bridge to prepare for the fight against Tolna's three level-46 heads.

label: Kill Tolna's three heads
detail: Defeat all three of Tolna's heads; using Protect from Missiles (ranged) or Protect from Melee (melee, if underlevelled) avoids damage. The final cutscene/dialogue must be finished before attacking or you are returned to the entrance.

label: Talk to Tolna
detail: Speak with Tolna after defeating his three heads.

label: Talk to Tolna again on the surface
detail: Return to the surface and speak with Tolna once more to finish the quest; re-entering the rift afterward completes a Varrock Medium Achievement Diary task.

label: Talk to Marlo at the Varrock Estate Agent's house
detail: Speak with Marlo in the Estate Agent's house in north-east Varrock to take the job.

hints.value: What kind of favour do you want me to do?

label: Pick up a saw if you don't already have one
detail: A saw is available at Marlo's house for anyone not already carrying one.

label: Head to Old Man Yarlo's house
detail: Travel to Old Man Yarlo's house, south-west of Aubury's Rune Shop.

label: Talk to Old Man Yarlo
detail: Speak with Old Man Yarlo to begin the furniture job.

label: Remove all 7 old furniture hotspots
detail: Remove the old broken chair, rotten carpet, two broken stools, two broken tables and campbed (7 hotspots total) from the house.

label: Talk to Old Man Yarlo again
detail: Speak with Old Man Yarlo again once the old furniture is cleared.

hints.value: Skip Yarlo's lecture. He'll offer it later if you like.

label: Search the marked crates for 3 waxwood logs
detail: Search the crates with the black symbol on them, west of the range, for 3 waxwood logs.

label: Take the waxwood logs to the Varrock sawmill operator
detail: Speak to the Sawmill operator at the Varrock sawmill to have the waxwood logs milled into 3 waxwood planks.

hints.value: I need some waxwood planks for Old Man Yarlo.

label: Buy remaining materials if needed: 10 planks, steel nails and 5 bolts of cloth
detail: Buy 10 regular planks (if not already held), steel nails, and 5 bolts of cloth from a nearby shop before building.

hints.value: the vendor and exact steel nail count are not named in the fetched Quick guide text; modelled as an NPC shop purchase, never Grand Exchange

label: Get a hammer and saw from Old Man Yarlo if needed
detail: Ask Old Man Yarlo for a hammer and saw if you don't already have them.

hints.value: I need some tools.
Yes please.

label: Build all 7 new furniture pieces
detail: Build the new carpet, two stools, two tables, chair and waxwood bed on their white translucent hotspots using the milled planks, nails and cloth.

label: Talk to Old Man Yarlo
detail: Speak with Old Man Yarlo once all the furniture is built.

label: Talk to Marlo to claim the reward
detail: Return to Marlo to collect payment and finish the miniquest.

hints.value: Yeah, what have you got for me?

label: Talk to Sigmund on Lumbridge Castle's first floor
detail: Accept the quest from Sigmund to start investigating the collapsed cellar wall.

label: Ask castle residents about the cellar collapse
detail: Ask up to six castle residents (Duke Horacio, the Cook, Hans, Father Aereck, Bob, Gee or Donie) what happened; stop once one mentions a goblin sighting in the basement.

until.state: one witness mentions a goblin sighting in the basement

hints.value: candidate NPCs: Duke Horacio, Cook, Hans, Father Aereck, Bob, Gee/Donie

label: Report the cook's sighting back to Duke Horacio
detail: Tell the Duke that the cook saw something in the cellar.

label: Climb down the kitchen trapdoor
detail: Descend the trapdoor in the ground-floor kitchen of Lumbridge Castle.

label: Mine through the rubble and climb through
detail: Use a pickaxe on the rubble in the basement, then climb through the hole it opens.

label: Light your light source
detail: Ignite a light source before proceeding further into the cave.

label: Find the brooch about ten steps into the cave
detail: Pick up the brooch lying on the floor a short way into the cave.

label: Show the brooch to Duke Horacio
detail: Present the recovered brooch to the Duke as proof of the cellar sighting.

label: Travel to the Varrock Palace library
detail: Head to the library inside Varrock Palace.

label: Talk to Reldo in the library
detail: Speak to Reldo about the brooch and goblin sighting.

label: Search the northern bookcase for the goblin symbol book
detail: Search the northern bookcase on the library's west wall to find a goblin symbol book.

label: Read the goblin symbol book
detail: Read through the goblin symbol book found in the bookcase.

label: Travel to Goblin Village
detail: Head to Goblin Village to meet with the goblin generals.

label: Mediate between the goblin generals
detail: Talk to the two goblin generals and mediate between them until they teach you the Goblin Bow and Goblin Salute emotes.

until.state: both generals agree and teach the Goblin Bow and Goblin Salute emotes

label: Follow the mapped cave path to Mistag
detail: Return to the Lumbridge Castle cellar caves and follow the marked path without straying; clicking the minimap auto-paths it.

label: Perform the Goblin Bow emote in front of Mistag
detail: Use the Goblin Bow emote learned from the generals in front of Mistag.

label: Talk to Mistag and let him escort you back
detail: Speak to Mistag, who then leads you back to Lumbridge.

label: Report contact with Mistag to the Duke
detail: Tell the Duke you made contact with the cave goblins; he does not believe you.

label: Pickpocket Sigmund and open his chest for HAM robes
detail: Pickpocket Sigmund then unlock his chest in the other room to find HAM robes; keep them for Death to the Dorgeshuun.

label: Travel to the HAM lair west of Lumbridge Castle
detail: Head to the HAM Dungeon entrance west of Lumbridge Castle.

label: Pick the lock on the HAM lair trapdoor
detail: Pick the trapdoor lock and enter the HAM lair.

label: Search the crate south of the ladder for the silverware
detail: Search the crate south of the ladder to find the stolen silverware.

label: Return the silverware to the Duke
detail: Hand over the stolen silverware; the Duke fires Sigmund and gives you a signed peace treaty.

label: Go back into the Lumbridge Castle basement
detail: Return to the basement caves beneath Lumbridge Castle.

label: Follow Kazgar to Mistag
detail: Follow Kazgar through the caves back to Mistag.

label: Give Mistag the peace treaty to finish
detail: Hand Mistag the signed peace treaty while it is in your inventory to trigger the finishing cutscene.

label: Talk to Morgan in Draynor Village
detail: Accept the quest from Morgan to start.

label: Take garlic from the cupboard upstairs
detail: Go upstairs in Morgan's house and take garlic from the cupboard.

detail: Speak to Dr Harlow at the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock, south of Varrock Centre, about the vampyre threat.

label: Buy a beer at the Blue Moon Inn
detail: Buy a beer at the bar if you do not already have one.

label: Talk to Dr Harlow again for a stake
detail: Speak to Dr Harlow a second time to receive a stake.

label: Buy a hammer from the general store
detail: Buy a hammer from the general store just north of the Blue Moon Inn.

label: Travel to Draynor Manor
detail: Bring combat gear (food recommended), garlic, hammer, and stake to Draynor Manor.

label: Go to the basement via the east stairs
detail: Descend to the basement using the east stairs, not the west room.

label: Open the coffin in the basement
detail: Open the coffin to confront Count Draynor.

detail: Defeat Count Draynor with your combat gear; the hammer and stake only need to be carried in your inventory, not actively used.

detail: Ask Noah (or Alina) when the Varlamore delegation will arrive.

hints.value: either Noah or Alina works

until.state: reached the final hiding spot without the guard spotting you

label: Report to Sergeant Tobyn by the castle wall
detail: Return to Varrock Square and talk to Sergeant Tobyn.

label: Mark the unarmed guard outside Aris's tent
detail: Click to mark the guard standing outside Aris's tent with hands on hips and no weapon.

label: Mark the helmetless guard near Benny's news stand
detail: Click to mark the guard near Benny's news stand who is not wearing a helmet.

label: Mark the weaponless guard by the archery shop
detail: Click to mark the guard leaning on the wall outside Lowe's Archery Emporium's east path, with no weapon.

label: Mark the mace-wielding guard near the east bank
detail: Click to mark the guard further along the east path between the archery shop and Varrock east bank, wielding a mace instead of a sword.

detail: Report the four marked bandits to Sergeant Tobyn to complete the quest.

detail: Speak to Aris in Varrock Square and hand over 1 gp to start the quest; remember the incantation Wally chants in the cutscene, as it varies per player.

label: Go to the palace's north-west tower
detail: Head to the north-west corner of the palace and climb two flights of stairs.

label: Talk to Captain Rovin about the demon
detail: Speak to Captain Rovin in the north-west tower to receive the first Silverlight key.

label: Fill a bucket of water at the palace kitchen sink
detail: Grab a bucket from the room east of the kitchen stairs if needed, then fill it at the sink.

label: Use the bucket of water on the eastern drain
detail: Use the bucket of water on the drain outside the palace kitchen's east wall.

label: Climb down the manhole east of the palace
detail: Descend the manhole east of the palace, just outside the wall near the tree patch.

label: Take the rusty key from the floor
detail: Follow the north-west path to its end and take the rusty Silverlight key from the floor; it does not appear on the minimap.

label: Withdraw 25 un-noted bones
detail: Withdraw 25 un-noted bones from your bank.

label: Travel to the Wizards' Tower
detail: Head to the Wizards' Tower south of Draynor Village (fairy ring code DIS).

label: Give Wizard Traiborn 25 bones for the third key
detail: Speak to Wizard Traiborn and hand over 25 un-noted bones (noted bones will not work) to receive his key.

label: Give all three keys to Sir Prysin
detail: Return to Sir Prysin in the south-west room of Varrock Castle and hand over all three Silverlight keys.

label: Wield Silverlight and head to Varrock's south entrance
detail: Wield Silverlight and travel to the Dark wizards by Varrock's south entrance; a cutscene occurs on arrival.

label: Defeat Delrith and banish him
detail: Fight Delrith down, then right-click him and banish him using the incantation from earlier; Aris can remind you of it if forgotten.

label: Talk to Veronica to start the quest
detail: Accept the quest from Veronica, who is looking for her missing fiance Ernest.

label: Enter Draynor Manor
detail: Head inside Draynor Manor to begin the search.

label: Pick up poison south of the kitchen
detail: Pick up poison from the room south of the kitchen on the ground floor.

label: Pick up fish food near the ghost room
detail: Pick up fish food on the first floor, in the room south of the stairs containing the ghost.

detail: Use the fish food on the poison to make poisoned fish food.

label: Search the western ground-floor bookcase
detail: Search the bookcase on the western side of the ground floor to open the way down to the basement.

label: Climb down the ladder to the basement
detail: Descend the ladder into the manor's basement.

detail: Follow the fixed sequence: pull levers B then A down and enter door 1; pull lever D down and enter door 1; pull levers B then A up and enter doors 3, 4, 5; pull levers E then F down and enter doors 6, 7; pull lever C down and enter doors 7, 6; pull lever E up and enter doors 6, 8, 3; go through door 9 to reach the oil can.

label: Climb up and pull the exit lever
detail: Go back up the ladder and pull the lever there.

label: Pick up the spade in the far eastern room
detail: Pick up the spade in the far eastern room on the ground floor.

label: Head to the compost heap behind the manor
detail: Exit through the back door in the same room, then go north around the west side of the manor to the compost heap.

label: Dig up a key from the compost heap
detail: Search the compost heap with the spade to dig up a key.

label: Poison the fountain in the south-west grounds
detail: Use the poisoned fish food on the fountain in the south-west corner of the grounds.

label: Retrieve the pressure gauge from the poisoned fountain
detail: Search the poisoned fountain to retrieve a pressure gauge.

label: Pick up the rubber tube from the skeleton's room

label: Kill Vanstrom Klause
detail: Use Protect from Magic. Phase 1: kill the spawned Acidic Bloodveld with ranged before it explodes; avoid standing on the healing blood orb (or lure Vanstrom onto it instead); track his attack count and turn away pre-emptively before 'Stare into darkness' lands, since it gives almost no warning. After he drops to 0hp he self-heals 200hp and stops using those three specials -- turn off protection prayers (they no longer help) but keep buffing prayers like Piety active, and dodge the dark-circle tiles before his lightning strikes (max hit 46; disabling RuneLite's 117 HD plugin can make the warning tiles easier to see). Veliaf allows a re-attempt if you die. Watch the ending cutscene to complete the quest.

label: Use the blood potion on the door, then open it.

At 65%/25% health he goes airborne, summons two level-87 vyrewatch, and lobs 30-damage blood bombs at your tile (step aside so they hit the vyrewatch instead); once both are dead he goes berserk with faster but weaker (max 6) attacks, easily handled with Protect from Melee.
