label: Enter the Haunted Mine cave west of Burgh de Rott
detail: Climb over the mine cart south of the Zealot and crawl down the cart tunnel to reach Level 1 of the mine.

label: Head north through the mine to the lair entrance
detail: Follow the mine path to its northern end and enter Tarn's Lair; a cutscene shows the mutant and its terror-dog statues.

label: Pass the floor traps at the lair entrance
detail: Head east past the marked floor traps and any attacking monsters to the end of the entry passage.

label: Disarm the two wall traps heading north to the bank
detail: Search the southern wall trap on the west wall, then the northern one on the east wall, to disarm both before the banker's room.

label: Use the banker in the small room at the hall's end
detail: The banker charges 100 coins per use and is the last restock or heal point before Tarn's chamber.

label: Turn off Auto Retaliate before the trap gauntlet
detail: Disable Auto Retaliate so a disarmed trap or a nearby monster doesn't drag you back into danger while crossing.

label: Disarm the three floor traps north of the bank
detail: From the bank go north, west along the U-shaped hall, then north into the square room and search each of its three floor traps to disarm them.

label: Pass the wall traps in the inverted-T hallway
detail: Take the north passage of the inverted-T hallway and disarm its wall trap on the west wall, then the one on the east wall.

label: Disarm the log-swing trap in the first pillar room
detail: Cross the southern pillars to the west side and search the floor to disable the log-swing trap; it re-arms after any fall, so redisarm it if knocked down.

label: Cross the second row of pillars north
detail: Use the second row of pillars from the west to continue north once the log trap is disabled.

label: Pass the wall traps before the receding-wall room
detail: Head east along a path with a wall trap on the south wall, then one on the north wall, disarming both.

label: Time the receding walls to cross the hole room
detail: Wait for the shooting walls to retract, then run past them to the east passage without being knocked down a level.

label: Activate Protect from Magic before the final pillar room
detail: Turn on Protect from Magic to nullify damage from the two level-94 skeleton mages guarding the zigzag pillar crossing.

label: Cross the zigzag pillars and take the stairs down
detail: Jump the pillars north-west to south-east while ignoring the skeleton mages, then descend the stairs to the passage leading to Tarn's chamber.

label: Stock up on prayer potions and food before entering
detail: Bring at least 2 prayer potions and 15+ pieces of monkfish-or-better food; the salve amulet is not required to start or end the fight.

label: Turn on Protect from Melee as the fight starts
detail: After the transformation cutscene ends, activate Protect from Melee against Tarn (level 69) since the terror dogs also only use melee.

label: Kill Tarn Razorlor through both forms
detail: Fight only Tarn -- ignore the terror dogs and animated armour -- through his mutant form and his easier ghost form afterward; prayer drains constantly and poison carries over between forms.

label: Read Tarn's diary to finish
detail: Find Tarn's diary on the table in the room beyond his chamber and read it to complete the miniquest.

label: Search the shelf in the ruined south-west house and read the diary
detail: Enter the ruined house in south-west Mort'ton, search the wall shelf, and read the diary to start the quest and unlock Serum 207.

label: Search the smashed table for tarromin (if you didn't bring your own)
detail: If you didn't bring unfinished tarromin potions, pick up empty vials from the north-east house then search the smashed table for two grimy tarromin and a grimy rogue's purse.

label: Brew two doses of Serum 207
detail: Add clean tarromin to a vial of water, then add ashes, to make two doses of Serum 207.

label: Dose Razmire with Serum 207 and agree to help
detail: Use a Serum 207 on the afflicted Razmire in the general store and pick the dialogue confirming you'll deal with the shadowy creatures; avoid the temple's official world until the repair step so NPC chats aren't interrupted.

hints.value: What are all these shadowy creatures?
Yes, I'll dispatch those dark and evil creatures.

label: Kill five loar shades for their remains
detail: Shades killed before talking to Razmire don't count, so kill five afterward and pick up their remains.

label: Return the loar remains to Razmire
detail: Hand the remains to Razmire; he may ask for another dose of Serum 207 before accepting them.

label: Buy an olive oil from Razmire's general store
detail: Open Razmire's general store stock and buy a bottle of olive oil.

label: Buy temple-repair materials from the builders' store
detail: Buy 5 timber beams, 5 limestone bricks and 25 swamp paste, plus an optional Flamtaer hammer, from Razmire's builders' store.

label: Dose Ulsquire Shauncy with Serum 207
detail: Find Ulsquire Shauncy in the house east of the general store, use a Serum 207 on him, then talk to him while carrying the loar remains.

label: Ask Ulsquire about the remains and the temple
detail: Talk to Ulsquire again and route the dialogue to ask what he found out about the remains, then about the temple.

hints.value: What did you find out about the remains?
What can you tell me about that temple?

label: Repair the temple to 100% with at least 20 sanctity
detail: Head north-east of Mort'ton and repair the temple in the minigame area until it reaches full repair and at least 20 sanctity; the official world is recommended for help from other players.

label: Light the sacred altar at the temple's centre
detail: Light the sacred altar yourself if able, or wait for another player with at least level 5 Firemaking to light it.

label: Pour olive oil on the flame to make sacred oil
detail: Use the olive oil on the lit altar's flame to produce sacred oil.

label: Dip Serum 207 in the flame to make Serum 208
detail: Use a dose of Serum 207 on the flame to permanently upgrade it into Serum 208, the permanent-cure version.

label: Make a pyre log with the sacred oil
detail: Use the sacred oil on a log to create a pyre log.

label: Set up and light a stone funeral pyre
detail: Head to any grouping of four stone funeral pyres west of the general store, use the pyre log then the loar remains on one, and light it for Prayer experience.

label: Collect the reward from the burned pyre
detail: Pick up the reward left behind once the funeral pyre burns down.

label: Cure Razmire with Serum 208
detail: Use Serum 208 on Razmire to cure him permanently.

label: Cure Ulsquire and finish the quest
detail: Use Serum 208 on Ulsquire Shauncy and complete the closing dialogue to finish the quest.

label: Talk to the Injured Tortugan on the remote island
detail: Approach the injured tortugan stranded on the remote island north-west of the Great Conch and agree to help her.

detail: Collect seaweed from the ground near the stranded tortugan.

detail: Head back to Lletya (a teleport crystal can shortcut this).

label: Talk to Arianwyn
detail: Speak to Arianwyn back in Lletya.

label: Talk to Elena by the pond
detail: Speak to Elena near the pond in Lletya.

hints.value: 2Now's not the time for stories.

label: Plant the cadantine seed
detail: Plant the cadantine seed in the nearby farming patch (Barbarian Farming removes the need for a seed dibber).

hints.value: 1How do I find Lady Trahaearn?|2I'll be back later.

detail: Bring the crystal seed to Eluned, just south of the Lletya Archery Shop, north of the pond, to have it enchanted.

hints.value: 1I have a seed from Baxtorian that I think needs enchanting.

label: Head to the Underground Pass entrance
detail: Travel north of Lletya to the Underground Pass cave entrance on the east side of Tirannwn.

label: Find the blocked crevice near the Well of Voyage
detail: Walk south of the Well of Voyage and inspect the blocked crevice.

label: Break through the blocked crevice
detail: Use a pickaxe to break through the crevice and enter.

label: Repair the Elderly Elf's exoskeleton
detail: Use a hammer and a runite bar to fix the Elderly Elf's broken exoskeleton.

label: Talk to Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
detail: Speak to Lady Tangwen Trahaearn.

label: Rub the crystal seed to enter the Enchanted Valley
detail: Rub the enchanted crystal seed to be taken to the Enchanted Valley.

label: Return with Lord Amlodd
detail: Speak to the Mysterious Figure in the Enchanted Valley; any dialogue option returns you to Lletya with Lord Ieuan Amlodd.

label: Get the elder cadantine from Elena
detail: Talk to Elena to receive the elder cadantine.

label: Get the old crystal from Arianwyn
detail: Talk to Arianwyn to receive the old crystal.

label: Grind the crystal into dust
detail: Use a pestle and mortar on the old crystal to produce crystal dust.

label: Make the unfinished cadantine potion
detail: Use the elder cadantine on a vial of water to create the elder cadantine potion (unf).

label: Brew the inversion potion
detail: Use the crystal dust on the unfinished potion to create the inversion potion.

label: Report the inversion potion to Arianwyn
detail: Speak to Arianwyn with the finished inversion potion.

label: Enter the Grand Library
detail: Talk to Lord Ieuan Amlodd to be transported into the Grand Library; logging out inside saves your progress.

charge teleport crystals beforehand — the area becomes instanced and you can't charge them again for a while

detail: Speak to Lady Hefin.

detail: Chop the dead tree north of the pond, directly west of the stick trap; Lord Crwys appears and speaks to you automatically.

hints.value: chop has no closed-enum primitive; mapped to gather

label: Talk to Lord Crwys
detail: Speak with Lord Crwys after he appears.

label: Return to Lletya
detail: Head back to Lletya.

detail: Speak with Baxtorian.

label: Head to the Iorwerth Camp in combat gear
detail: Equip combat gear and travel to the Iorwerth Camp.

label: Defeat the Iorwerth Archer
detail: Enter the cave on the north side of camp and kill the level 90 Iorwerth Archer; trap it behind the Warrior to fight them one at a time.

label: Defeat the Iorwerth Warrior
detail: Kill the level 108 Iorwerth Warrior guarding the cave.

label: Take the orb of light from the chest
detail: Search the chest to receive the orb of light.

label: Return to Lletya
detail: Head back to Lletya.

label: Deliver the orb of light to Baxtorian
detail: Speak with Baxtorian.

hints.value: 2I'll get going then.

detail: Speak to Elena near the pond and ask about Ysgawyn (drinking a dose of antidote++ beforehand saves inventory space).

hints.value: 2That's fair. Anyway, I wanted to ask you about Ysgawyn.

label: Leave Lletya via the north-west exit
detail: Exit Lletya through its north-west entrance.

label: Inspect the mushrooms near the entrance
detail: Inspect the mushrooms just outside the north-west entrance to pick up the footprint trail.

hints.value: inspect has no closed-enum primitive; mapped to use-on

label: Follow the footprint trail to Isafdar's centre
detail: Follow the trail of footprints, inspecting rocks, mushrooms and lamps along the way, to the whiteberry bush spawn in central Isafdar.

label: Talk to Ysgawyn
detail: Speak with Ysgawyn once you find him.

hints.value: 2So what have you been discussing?

label: Find Eoin in the south house
detail: Search the east table in the house to the south to find Eoin hiding there.

hints.value: Eoin is found, not an item

detail: Go up the ladder and search the cooking pots by the south cooking range to find Iona.

hints.value: Iona is found, not an item

label: Defeat Arianwyn in the bow fight
detail: Fight Arianwyn — Protect from Range nullifies his normal attacks, purple arrows disable prayers (re-enable them after), and orange 1x1 bomb arrows must be dodged by moving off-tile.

hints.value: if you die, reclaim items from the Rebel Scout outside Lletya for 80,000 coins — dying again before reclaiming permanently deletes them

detail: Ask Baxtorian for both Lady Ithell's and Lady Meilyr's clues.

hints.value: 1What's Lady Ithell's clue?|1What's Lady Meilyr's clue?

label: Find the five glowing symbols around Lletya
detail: Search Lletya's bank west wall, the building north of Elena, the general store's south wall, the store's upper north wall, and the upper prayer-altar room's west wall for five glowing symbols.

hints.value: searching for symbols has no closed-enum primitive; mapped to gather

label: Build the statue in the village centre
detail: Use limestone bricks, a hammer and a saw to build the statue in the centre of Lletya, finishing the full dialogue.

hints.value: must finish the full dialogue or the next step won't unlock

label: Talk to Lady Ithell at her statue
detail: Speak with Lady Ithell, who appears at the statue.

label: Head to the dig site south of Isafdar
detail: Bank your hammer and saw and gather remaining supplies (keep your spade), then travel to the swamp south of Isafdar.

label: Dig at the Isafdar swamp site
detail: Dig at the marked spot near the swamp south of Isafdar.

label: Head to the STASH unit near Zul-Andra
detail: Travel to the STASH unit near Zul-Andra (fairy ring code BJS, then run east; 76 Agility, a Zul-andra teleport, or a ship charter to Port Tyras all work).

label: Dig two steps north of the STASH unit
detail: Dig two steps north of the STASH unit near Zul-Andra.

label: Head to the south gates of Prifddinas
detail: Travel to the south gates of Prifddinas (Iorwerth camp teleport helps).

label: Dig outside the Prifddinas south gates
detail: Dig outside the south gates of Prifddinas.

label: Head to the western Underground Pass entrance
detail: Travel to the western entrance of the Underground Pass with nothing equipped (a teleport crystal to Lletya helps getting there).

label: Spin at the Underground Pass entrance
detail: Spin at the western Underground Pass entrance with nothing equipped; bank up for combat afterward if you haven't already.

hints.value: spin has no closed-enum primitive; mapped to toggle
the fetched text never shows an explicit 'talk to Lady Meilyr' step after this clue chain despite the checkpoint naming her — flagged for consolidator

label: Reach the dwarf camp inside the Underground Pass
detail: Enter the Underground Pass from the Isafdar side, go through the Well of Voyage, and follow the winding path south to the dwarf camp at ground level.

label: Talk to Baxtorian at the dwarf camp
detail: Speak with Baxtorian.

label: Talk to Elena about the defence plan
detail: Speak with Elena about her idea to help the camp's defence.

hints.value: 2Baxtorian said you had an idea to help our defence.

label: Fill the holes with Explosive potions
detail: Fill the seven holes outside the camp with Explosive potions.

label: Signal you're ready to defend the camp
detail: Tell Baxtorian you're ready to begin the camp's defence.

hints.value: 1I'm ready.

label: Defend the dwarf camp barricade for four minutes
detail: Fight off the elf archers and warriors attacking the barricade for four minutes; you don't need to kill every attacker, just keep them off the barricade (a new attacker spawns randomly after each kill).

hints.value: Protect from Melee handles the warriors; switch to Protect from Missiles once warriors pile up and stop attacking you

label: Defeat Essyllt
detail: Fight Essyllt — Protect from Melee blocks most of his damage, switch to Protect from Range right after his stun attack, and drink a stat-restore potion after his potion attack.

label: Enter the Temple of Light
detail: A cutscene automatically brings you into the Temple of Light; if unequipped, teleport out and back in through the same crack you used to enter the dwarf camp.

label: Defeat the Fragment of Seren
detail: Fight the Fragment using Magic only (Protect from Range blocks most normal damage) through its four repeating specials: a teleport-in orb (run away after), a split into copies (attack the real one, marked by crystals underneath and a lighter aura), summoned healing orbs (pop them with any fast attack), and a freeze-then-near-max hit (overheal above 100% HP with Saradomin brews/anglerfish beforehand or die in one shot).

hints.value: if you die, reclaim gear from the elf NPC outside the cave entrance for 80,000 coins — items are permanently lost if you die elsewhere first

label: Enter Prifddinas
detail: Speak to Baxtorian, who invites you into Prifddinas — quest complete.

label: Talk to Attala to start the quest
detail: Speak to Attala near the temple entrance at the southern base of Ralos' Rise.

label: Kill the Sulphur Nagua guarding the south-east ledge
detail: Kill the level 98 Sulphur Nagua on Ralos' Rise's south-east ledge to reach Attala.

hints.value: climb the rocks north-east instead (requires 47 Agility)

label: Return to Attala and cross into Cam Torum
detail: Return to Attala, cross the drawbridge, and enter Cam Torum.

label: Speak to Jessamine in northern Cam Torum
detail: Go north and attempt to speak with Jessamine; a guard interrupts, then speak with her in the northern part of the city.

label: Enter the Neypotzli dungeon
detail: Pass through the entrance to the north into the Neypotzli dungeon.

label: Speak to Attala in the Antechamber
detail: Speak to Attala, the first of three, in the Antechamber.

label: Speak to Zuma in the Antechamber
detail: Speak to Zuma, the second of three, in the Antechamber.

label: Speak to Jessamine in the Antechamber
detail: Speak to Jessamine, the third of three, in the Antechamber.

label: Claim building supplies from the crate
detail: Take from the crate of building supplies just west of Jessamine to receive a hammer, saw, and three Building supplies.

label: Build the camp at Ancient Prison
detail: Pass through the south-western entrance (Protect from Melee negates the level 98 Sulphur Nagua there), run to the north-west corner, and build the camp spot, then return to the Antechamber.

label: Build the camp at Streambound Cavern
detail: Pass through the north-eastern entrance, cross the bridge, follow the trail up the south stairs, and build the camp spot, then return to the Antechamber.

label: Build the camp at Earthbound Cavern
detail: Pass through the north-western entrance, follow the trail west then south down the stairs, and build the camp spot; the hammer and saw can now be dropped.

label: Ask Attala about the talismans
detail: Speak to Attala in the Antechamber to receive a Water talisman and an Earth talisman.

hints.value: What does the inscription say? / What do we do now?

label: Get Nahta to begin infusing the talismans
detail: Exit Neypotzli south to the magic shop and speak to Nahta to have the talismans infused.

hints.value: Actually, I've been sent by Attala
infusion modifies the same talisman items in place; wiki names no distinct 'infused' item id

label: Get the blacksmith to finish the infusion
detail: Go north-east to the furnace and speak to the blacksmith to complete the talisman infusion.

hints.value: I need your help with these talismans / Can you help?

label: Return to Attala in the Antechamber
detail: Head back north into Neypotzli to return to Attala with the infused talismans.

label: Dowse with both talismans to find Eyatlalli
detail: Use the infused water and earth talismans repeatedly like a hot/cold clue; the direction they point is different for each player, and you may need to check a corner chamber or the ancient shrine.

label: Speak to any of the three to summon Eyatlalli
detail: Return to the Antechamber and attempt to speak to any of Attala, Zuma, or Jessamine; Eyatlalli will appear.

label: Speak to Eyatlalli again after the dialogue ends
detail: After the dialogue ends, speak with Eyatlalli again.

label: Travel to the Streambound Cavern camp
detail: Go to the Streambound Cavern to the north-east and follow the path to the camp spot; optionally restock supplies or make tea for run energy.

label: Collect a moonlight grub from the sapling
detail: Collect from the Grubby sapling east of the camp spot to obtain a Moonlight grub.

label: Grind the moonlight grub into paste
detail: Use the Moonlight grub on a Pestle and mortar to receive Moonlight grub paste.

label: Fish a raw bream from the bridge spot
detail: Go to the river south-east of the camp spot and fish the spot up the stairs on the bridge to catch a Raw bream.

label: Scale the bream with a knife
detail: Use a knife on the Raw bream to receive Bream scales.

label: Head to the trapping area
detail: Walk north down the stairs, enter the small entrance, and walk west to the rocks that can be trapped.

label: Set a trap on two rocks and rustle the bush
detail: Click on two separate rocks to set a trap, then rustle a bush to trap a moss lizard.

label: Pick up the trapped raw moss lizard
detail: Pick up the Raw moss lizard from the trap.

label: Cut the tail from the moss lizard
detail: Use a knife on the Raw moss lizard to receive a Moss lizard tail.

label: Return to the Antechamber
detail: Exit the Earthbound Cavern to return to the Antechamber with all three ritual items.

label: Give Eyatlalli the three items to begin the ritual
detail: Speak to Eyatlalli with the moonlight grub paste, bream scales, and moss lizard tail to begin the ritual.

label: Defeat the Blue Moon (weak to crush)
detail: Enter the north-western chamber; stand in the rotating safe circle, punch free your weapon if frozen in ice while dodging spikes, and re-light the two braziers when extinguished while avoiding tornadoes.

label: Defeat the Blood Moon (weak to slash)
detail: Enter the south-western chamber; stand in the rotating safe circle, step off blood pools during Raining Blood, and fight the spawned Blood jaguar near Eyatlalli's glyph while dodging its attack range during Blood Jaguar.

label: Defeat the Eclipse Moon (weak to stab)
detail: Enter the north-eastern chamber; stand in the rotating safe circle, keep the moon shield between you and the boss during Eclipse Shield, and face each clone as it spawns during Mimic. Damage taken during a special still counts toward overall boss damage.

label: Speak to Attala after defeating the Moons
detail: Return to the Antechamber and speak to Attala.

label: Speak to Zuma after defeating the Moons
detail: Speak to Zuma in the Antechamber.

label: Speak to Jessamine after defeating the Moons
detail: Speak to Jessamine in the Antechamber.

label: Speak to Eyatlalli to finish the quest
detail: Speak to Eyatlalli in the Antechamber to complete Perilous Moons.

label: Talk to Servius to start the quest
detail: Talk to Servius at the ground floor of the Sunrise Palace to start the quest.

detail: Make your way to the Twilight Temple.

label: Equip the emissary robes and enter the temple
detail: Equip the emissary robes and enter the Twilight Temple.

detail: After the cutscene, attempt to go downstairs and enter the passcode "Final Dawn" to access the basement.

hints.value: Final Dawn

detail: Enter the basement and head east toward the backroom while avoiding the Emissary Enforcer, then watch the cutscene inside.

detail: Search the large bed in the south room for a key.

hints.value: key's later use is never explicitly named in the fetched text

detail: Open the drawer in either the south or north room for the canvas piece.

label: Picklock the blue chest for the emissary scroll
detail: Picklock the blue chest by moving the tumblers via the slots above them; brute force by confirming, checking which show green, and shifting everything up by one, at most eight tries.

label: Defeat the Emissary Enforcer (180 HP, AoE melee)
detail: Fight the Emissary Enforcer without teleporting, praying, or changing gear; step back during normal attacks and step sideways when it shouts 'Traitor!' or 'Thief!'. Dying here respawns your gravestone at the temple entrance.

label: Pick up and read the emissary scroll
detail: Pick up and read the emissary scroll.

hints.value: text does not explain why the scroll must be picked up again after the chest already yielded it

detail: Return to Queen Zyanyi at the top floor of the Sunrise Palace.

detail: Go behind the safe house south of the western bank in Civitas illa Fortis.

detail: Talk to Captain Vibia behind the safe house.

detail: Inspect the southernmost window on the east side of the safe house and enter through it.

label: Feed the dog bones, raw meat, or cooked meat
detail: Use bones, raw meat, or cooked meat (player's choice) on the dog inside the window.

label: Pet the dog to learn the door passcode "GUS"
detail: Pet the dog to receive the door's passcode.

hints.value: GUS

label: Grab and empty the sack of potatoes
detail: Grab the sack of potatoes and empty it to obtain the empty sack.

label: Take the knife nearby
detail: Take the knife nearby.

label: Head to the middle floor for the coin purse
detail: Head up to the middle floor and pick up the coin purse.

label: Empty the coin purse and head to the top floor
detail: Empty the purse, then head up to the top floor.

label: Cut a branch from the diseased potted plant
detail: Use the knife on the diseased off-green potted plant for a branch.

label: Fill the empty coin purse with sand
detail: Use the empty coin purse on the pot of sand to fill it up.

label: Combine the branch and sandy coin purse
detail: Use the branch and the sandy coin purse on each other to create the makeshift blackjack.

label: Show the sack and blackjack to Captain Vibia
detail: Show the sack and the makeshift blackjack to Captain Vibia to trigger a cutscene.

label: Search Janus for a key
detail: Search Janus for a key, triggering another cutscene.

label: Agree to travel with Queen Zyanyi to Cam Torum
detail: Agree to go with Queen Zyanyi to Cam Torum.

hints.value: Yes, let's go.

label: Speak to Attala in the Cam Torum market
detail: Speak to Attala in the Cam Torum market.

label: Enter Teumo's house east of the bank
detail: Enter Teumo's house east of the bank.

label: Pick up the beer upstairs
detail: Head upstairs and pick up the beer.

label: Give Galna the beer downstairs
detail: Return downstairs and use the beer on Galna.

label: Enter Teumo's basement
detail: Enter Teumo's basement.

label: Take one of each beverage from the cabinet
detail: Search the cabinet to the south-west and grab one each of steamforge brew, dwarven stout, beer, and wizard's mind bomb.

label: Place the steamforge brew on the steaming barrel
detail: Place the steamforge brew on the barrel directly south of the cabinet (marked "steam").

label: Place the stout on the black-liquid barrel
detail: Place the dwarven stout directly east of the steam barrel (marked "black liquid").

label: Place the beer on the northern barrel
detail: Place the beer on the northern barrel (marked "smells like a standard Gielinorian pub").

label: Place the mind bomb on the bubbling barrel
detail: Place the wizard's mind bomb on the south-eastern barrel (marked "bubbling").

detail: Drink the beer on the barrel south of the staircase (marked "empty") to receive a beer glass.

label: Place the beer glass on the empty barrel
detail: Place the beer glass on the empty barrel.

label: Inspect the fireplace and pull the hidden lever
detail: Inspect the fireplace and pull a hidden lever.

label: Climb through the hole in the south-eastern wall
detail: Climb through the hole in the wall in the south-eastern room to trigger a cutscene.

label: Talk to Servius in the basement
detail: Return to Servius in the basement and talk to him.

label: Talk to Attala in the basement
detail: Talk to Attala in the basement.

label: Bank and prepare for the cultist fight
detail: Head to the bank and prepare for a fight against two level 160 cultists.

label: Get the keystone fragment from Eyatlalli
detail: Head north to Neypotzli to have Eyatlalli give you a keystone fragment.

label: Use the keystone to find the resonating tile
detail: Head through the Streambound and Earthbound Caverns, using the keystone fragment to pinpoint the exact tile that resonates with the key.

detail: Head to the Ancient Prison and use the resonating tile in the room to the south-east of the section.

label: Touch the glowing symbol
detail: Touch the glowing symbol to trigger a cutscene.

label: Defeat Lucius and Chimalli together
detail: Fight both bosses at once: alternate Protect from Magic and Protect from Ranged, step into golden circles to dodge Lucius' special, and step away from landing zones to avoid Chimalli's fire arrows. Killing Lucius first is recommended, since once one falls the other pierces prayer and attacks more often.

label: Report back to Attala
detail: Talk to Attala.

label: Travel to Tal Teklan
detail: Head to Tal Teklan; Servius is north-east of the Quetzal Transport System landing site, east of the altar.

detail: The Crypt of Tonali is a fair distance to the south-east, just west of Kastori.

label: Enter the Crypt of Tonali
detail: Enter the Crypt of Tonali to trigger a cutscene.

label: Survive six waves of cultists, healing allies with food
detail: Kill six waves of cultists; heal the allied Tonali warriors and archers with food. If all of them die, the current wave resets.

label: Defeat Ennius Tullus (380 HP, melee, enrages at 0 HP)
detail: Fight Ennius Tullus under Protect from Melee, melee-only; dodge Sunfire Blast via the telegraphed safespots, avoid Sunfire Strike's row/column beam, and expect Sunfire Smite to disable overhead prayers. At 0 HP he enrages, healing 120 and attacking faster with a wider Sunfire Strike.

label: Descend into the Tonali Cavern
detail: After the cutscene, descend into the Tonali Cavern.

label: Cross to the northern end of the cavern
detail: Make your way across the agility shortcuts or portals to reach the northern end of the cavern.

label: Inspect the Strange Platform
detail: Inspect the Strange Platform, which unlocks a surface entrance directly east of Tal Teklan.

label: Descend into the sun puzzle room
detail: Proceed north slightly, then descend east into the sun puzzle room.

label: Search the urns for Kuhu essence
detail: Search all the urns for Kuhu essence.

label: Solve the sun statue puzzle by imbuing altars
detail: Altars are numbered 1-8 clockwise from the north-east; inspect the sun statue for an engraving giving two words (e.g. 'Naui Koma-Makti' means altar 4 for Itzla, altar 7 for you), using the table Oma=2, Naui=4, Kuli=5, Chaki=6, Koma=7, Ueai=8, Makti=10 (the third word is unused). Imbue the indicated altars; the puzzle completes after three successful imbues.

label: Descend into the moon puzzle room
detail: Descend west into the moon puzzle room.

label: Search the old tools for a knife blade
detail: Search the old tools and obtain a knife blade.

label: Pull the tree roots for ancient roots
detail: Pull the tree roots around the room for some ancient roots.

label: Cut the ancient roots into root kindling
detail: Use the knife blade on the ancient roots for some root kindling.

detail: Reach the bank via the Edgeville/Ardougne levers, Ice Plateau teleport, or Ghorrock teleport; bring something to cut the web outside and keep risk low.

label: Gear up in low-risk equipment
detail: Wear minimal-risk items before the fight and reward area, both of which sit in deep Wilderness where other players can attack you.

label: Talk to Kolodion at the bank to start the fight
detail: Accepting his challenge teleports you into the arena, which sits in level 54 Wilderness.

hints.value: Can I fight here? -> Yes indeedy. -> Okay, let's fight.

label: Defeat all five of Kolodion's forms
detail: Kolodion transforms sequentially (himself, ogre, frost spider, ghost, then a level-112 black demon); every form after the first only deals magic damage, so Protect from Magic tanks the fight.

hints.value: can be safespotted behind a skeleton inside the arena

label: Step into the north-east Sparkling pool
detail: Moves you from the fight into the reward area with the god statues.

label: Pray at the statue matching your chosen god
detail: Walk north and pray at the statue of Saradomin, Guthix, or Zamorak; this choice sets which cape and staff you receive next.

hints.value: pick one: Saradomin, Guthix, or Zamorak

label: Pick up the matching god cape
detail: Collect the cape (Saradomin, Guthix, or Zamorak) that matches the statue you just prayed at.

label: Talk to the Chamber Guardian for the matching god staff
detail: Head south and speak to the Chamber Guardian, who hands over the staff (Saradomin, Guthix, or Zamorak) matching your earlier choice.

label: Step into the south Sparkling pool
detail: Returns you from the reward area toward Kolodion to finish up.

label: Talk to Kolodion to complete the miniquest
detail: Reporting back finishes Mage Arena I; the god spellbook prayer still needs roughly 50-100 total casts of the god spell to fully unlock afterward.

label: Talk to Kolodion at the Mage Arena bank for the enchanted symbol
detail: Ask him for the next challenge; he hands over the enchanted symbol used to track the three wandering followers.

hints.value: Are there any more challenges available? -> Great, I've been waiting for an improvement!

label: Use the enchanted symbol to hot-and-cold search for a follower
detail: Use the symbol at various Wilderness spots to narrow in on where one of the three followers (Porazdir, Justiciar Zachariah, or Derwen) has spawned; the spot is random per player and shifts roughly every 45 minutes of Wilderness time.

label: Equip the god staff and runes matching the target follower
detail: Each follower can only be damaged by its own god spell (Saradomin, Guthix, or Zamorak), so bring the matching staff plus enough runes for 50+ casts before engaging.

label: Use the enchanted symbol at the location to spawn the follower
detail: Spawns the follower so it can be fought; it hits hard with both magic and melee and despawns if not killed fast enough.

label: Kill the spawned follower and collect its remains
detail: Defeat the follower with its matching god spell and pick up the remains it drops; repeat this locate-gear-kill loop across all three named followers.

label: Hand the follower's remains to Kolodion
detail: Turn in remains one at a time or save them up to hand in together after killing more than one follower; handing in remains from all three completes the miniquest.

label: Restock at the bank and switch staff for the next follower
detail: Refill runes, food, and potions, then swap to the god staff matching whichever follower you target next.
